description: Set in the 90s, seventeen-year-old Vivek is sent away from home to attend a rigorous program to prepare for the highly competitive IIT entrance exams.

title: Agneepath
description: The evil and sadistic Kaancha hangs Vijay's father to death. Vijay grows up with a single aim of avenging his father's death. The story surrounding Vijay Chauhan, his relationships with his family and above all, his revenge.

title: Agneepath
description: A boy grows up to become a gangster in pursuit of the mobster who killed his innocent father, but revenge and reparation may come at great costs.

title: Anjaam
description: A wealthy industrialist’s dangerous obsession with a flight attendant destroys her world, until she takes matters into her own hands to exact revenge.

title: Ankahi Kahaniya
description: As big city life buzzes around them, lonely souls discover surprising sources of connection and companionship in three tales of love, loss and longing.

title: Afwaah
description: A woman seeks to escape her engagement to a violent politician, but when a stranger comes to her aid, the two face an onslaught of bigotry and hate.

title: Amar Singh Chamkila
description: A humble singer's brash lyrics ignite fame and fury across Punjab as he grapples with soaring success and brutal criticism before his untimely death.

title: Alpha
description: After enduring military experiments as a child, an elite assassin hunts those responsible, only to confront a past she never knew.

title: Aśoka
description: In this biopic set before his rise to power, young Prince Asoka works to perfect his skills in battle and also deals with family conflict. During a struggle with one of his step-brothers, his mother urges Asoka to escape to stay alive. While away, Asoka meets Kaurwaki and falls in love, but must use his skills as a warrior to protect her. A dangerous and heartbreaking web of conspiracy follows, which leads Asoka to embrace a Buddhist path.

title: Aaina
description:
Roma (Amrita Singh) leaves Ravi (Jackie Shroff) at the alter in pursuit of her bigger ambitions. Her sister Reema (Juhi Chawla), a pale reflection of Roma, steps in and saves the day for her family, having secretly been in love with Ravi all her life.

The newly weds start building a life together till suddenly Roma returns, determined to get back what she thinks Reema stole from her.

title: Aakhri Adaalat
description: An intrepid police inspector forced into a desk job must take matters into his own hands when ruthless criminals are released on a technicality.

title: Azaad
description: Set in the 1920s, a stablehand's dream of riding a high-spirited stallion lands him in the middle of India's fight for independence from British rule.

title: Adipurush
description: Raghav, Ayodhya’s exiled prince, embarks on a quest to rescue his wife Janaki with the help of a monkey army, from the clutches of Lanka’s ten-headed demon king Raavan.

title: Amrapali
description: In the age of Buddha and his philosophy of nonviolence, a warmonger king plots the destruction of an enemy kingdom to rescue the woman he loves.

title: Article 370
description: Ahead of a major constitutional decision, special agent Zooni Haksar is tasked with a secret mission to quell violence in a conflict-ridden region.

title: English Babu Desi Mem
description: After his brother dies, wealthy Vikram reluctantly returns to India and forms a surprise bond with his orphaned nephew and the showgirl raising him.

title: Indian Predator: The Diary of a Serial Killer
description: When a suspect is found in a journalist's murder, the case is considered closed until a secret diary suggests 13 more victims — and possible cannibalism.

title: Indian Predator: The Butcher of Delhi
description: A series of mutilated bodies and taunting notes left outside a Delhi jail sends police hunting for a seasoned killer with a grudge against the system.

title: Indian Predator: Murder in a Courtroom
description: In 2004, a brutal predator was lynched in a courtroom. This is the story of the community he terrorized — and the vengeance they unleashed.

title: Ittefaq
description: A homemaker and a writer are prime suspects — and the only witnesses — in a double murder, and it's up to one detective to uncover the elusive truth.

title: Indoo Ki Jawani
description: A spirited but naive young woman seeks a one-night stand, but after discovering her date’s real identity, things quickly go from casual to complicated.

title: Emergency
description: This dramatic portrayal of the Emergency era in India explores Indira Gandhi's leadership, political oppression and the resulting societal upheaval.

title: Ishaqzaade
description: While fighting for the political supremacy of their respective families, a Hindu man and a Muslim woman share a forbidden romance.

title: Inspector Zende
description: In 1980s Mumbai, a sharp cop (Manoj Bajpayee) is tasked with nabbing a notorious serial killer at large (Jim Sarbh). With Girija Oak and Bhau Kadam.

title: Udta Punjab
description: Drug abuse and the darker side of Punjab rear their heads in the intense, interwoven tales of a cop, a doctor, a migrant worker and a rock star.

title: Ufff Yeh Siyapaa
description: Accused of having an affair, a man's (Sohum Shah) world unravels when a misdelivered drug parcel pulls him into a wordless chain of absurd events.

title: Ungli
description: When a corrupt judicial system lets a drunken driver off scott-free, four gym friends become vigilantes to avenge the death of their trainer.

title: Ek Chatur Naar
description: Mamta uses her wit and cunning to make ends meet, but everything changes when she finds a corrupt tycoon's phone and begins a risky blackmail scheme.

title: Ek Tha Tiger
description: When a secret agent investigates a scientist suspected of leaking sensitive research, he doesn't expect to fall for the scientist's enigmatic caretaker.

title: Starfish
description: While working at a dredging company, a diver seeks out the truth behind a tragic loss  — but will unexpected romance help or hinder her search?

title: Ek Ladki Ko Dekha Toh Aisa Laga
description: As her family seeks to marry her off and a hopeful writer pursues her, a small-town woman struggles to reveal the long-hidden truth about who she loves.

title: Ek Villain Returns
description: When a singer goes missing amid a serial killing spree, a cabbie and a businessman’s son cross paths in a twisted tale where good and evil is blurred.

title: LSD 2: Love, Sex aur Dhokha 2
description: In a high-tech world, three interwoven stories revolve around identity, online intimacy and the allure of social media.

title: Ae Dil Hai Mushkil
description: The trials and triumphs of unrequited love through the intertwining lives of Ayan, Alizeh and Saba.

title: Operation Safed Sagar: The Untold Story of the Kargil War
description: An audacious Air Force squadron flies into danger to change history as India and Pakistan face a violent war. Starring Siddharth and Jimmy Shergill.

title: OMG 2
description: A devout father takes on a dogmatic school — and his own moral beliefs — after the school expels his son over an embarrassing video that goes viral.

title: Ok Jaanu
description: Adi and Tara move to Bombay to pursue their dreams. A chance meeting sparks off a heady, no strings attached romance until their careers pull them apart. Will ambition prevail over matters of the heart?

title: Om Shanti Om
description: A film extra in 1970s Bollywood is madly in love with a reigning superstar. However, she loves a devious producer, but his greed for power and money is greater than his need for her, and when she comes in the way of his ambitions, he decides to murder her.

title: Oh Darling! Yeh Hai India!
description: A penniless actor new to Mumbai and a beautiful woman he meets one fateful night try to stop a gangster from replacing India's president with a twin.

title: Aurangzeb
description: Gurgaon rose from a small town to a boom town satellite city in just 15 years.Under the guise of a respected citizen Yashwardhan (Jackie Shroff) runs a parallel world where he is an Emperor. When Vishal (Arjun Kapoor) is planted in Yashwardhan's world in place of Ajay (Arjun Kapoor) the lawmakers (Rishi Kapoor & Prithviraj) roll the dice to unravel events in a world where Kingship knows no Kinship

title: Kathal
description: When two prized jackfruits disappear from a politician's garden, a spirited cop's investigation takes an unexpected turn as she digs for the truth.

title: CTRL
description: Nella and Joe are the perfect influencer couple. But when he cheats on her, she turns to an AI app to erase him from her life — until it takes control.

title: Kapil Sharma: I'm Not Done Yet
description: From the liquid courage behind his tweets to the sobering realities of making it in Mumbai, Kapil's pouring his heart out — with a heavy glug of humor.

title: Kapoor & Sons
description: Brothers Arjun and Rahul return home to visit their ailing grandfather. Amidst numerous ongoing family problems, emotions get intensified when a girl causes a rift between the two.

title: Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna
description: Unhappy in their respective marriages, an ex-footballer and a teacher find true love in each other, but guilt, jealousy and tragedy cloud their affair.

title: Kabhi Kabhie
description: Kabhi Kabhie is a story of how Amit (Amitabh Bachchan) and Pooja (Rakhee) visualize a future together. Pooja bows to the wishes of her parents and marries Vijay (Shashi Kapoor). Amit marries Anjali (Waheeda Rehman). Pooja and Vijay’s son Vicky (Rishi Kapoor) and Anjali’s daughter Pinky (Neetu Singh) from a prior relationship, fall in love. A chain of events brings together old lovers as friends.

title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham
description: Years after his father disowns his adopted brother for marrying a woman of lower social standing, a young man goes on a mission to reunite his family.

title: Kabhi Haan Kabhi Naa
description: A dreamer falls for a girl who is in love with someone else and tries to create a rift between her and the man she loves.

title: Kartavya
description: A dogged police officer (Saif Ali Khan) investigates a journalist's murder, even as trouble brews close to home. With Sanjay Mishra.

title: Kalank
description: Set in 1945, in Pre-Independent India, ‘Kalank’ is the story of a vivid and ethereal world, lost when the fire of Partition engulfs the city and the country. It’s the story of the shades of Reds in their lives as they yearn for hues of love while Husnabad gets soaked in the reds of violence and revenge.

title: Kal Ho Naa Ho
description: Naina Kapur is a beautiful introvert and often keeps to herself. Her life soon changes, when she befriends her neighbour, Aman Mathur, who is jaunty and bubbly. Naina falls in love with Aman and decides to confess her love to him. She is heart-broken, when she finds out that Aman is married. But the truth unravels, and Aman has lied about being married. His lie hides a dark secret.

title: Qala
description: This compelling period drama about a successful singer battling her own demons is directed by Anvitaa Dutt (“Bulbbul”).

title: Kaamyaab
description: An actor rethinks his planned retirement after realising he is on the cusp of completing his 500th film.

title: Kaal
description: Trapped in a national park, a tiger expert and a group of hunters turn to an enigmatic local for help when they mysteriously begin to die one by one.

title: Kaala Patthar
description: Three improbable heroes join forces to save hundreds of trapped men when disaster strikes at the coal mine where they work.

title: Kaala Paani
description: When a mysterious illness descends upon the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, a desperate fight for survival collides with a race to find a cure.

title: Kaali Khuhi
description: When a restless spirit curses a village that has a history of female infanticide, the town's fate lies in the hands of a 10-year-old girl.

title: Kill Dil
description: Once upon a time in North India, two killers – Dev (Ranveer Singh) and Tutu (Ali Zafar), roamed free. Abandoned when young and vulnerable, Bhaiyaji (Govinda) gave them shelter and... nurtured them to kill! All is normal in their lives until destiny throws free-spirited Disha (Parineeti Chopra) into the mix. What follows is a game of defiance, deception and love.

title: Killer Soup
description: Swathi dreams of owning a restaurant. But when murder derails her plan, she and her lover take an outrageous step — to replace her husband with him.

title: Kuch Kuch Hota Hai
description: Before dying, a woman leaves letters asking her daughter to play matchmaker for her father and his college friend.

title: Kuttey
description: Crooked cops, an aging crime lord and cutthroat rebels collide when a plan to loot a high-security van transporting cash careens into chaos.

title: Kesari
description: Based on an incredible true story of the Battle of Saragarhi in which an army of 21 Sikhs fought against 10,000 Afghans in 1897.

title: Cocktail 2
description: A romantic Italian trip leads to a crisis when Diya asks an old friend to test her longtime partner's loyalty. From the director of "Murder Mubarak."

title: Kota Factory
description: In a city of coaching centers known to train India’s finest collegiate minds, an earnest but unexceptional student and his friends navigate campus life.

title: Code Name: Tiranga
description: Tasked with capturing a wanted criminal, a fierce undercover agent wrestles with perilously high stakes when her heart is pulled into the mission.

title: Kohrra
description: Troubled homes, dark secrets, brutal deaths. In this suspenseful crime drama, police navigate broken families to solve complex murders.

title: Class
description: Three students from a poor neighborhood join an exclusive high school for Delhi elite where dark secrets and rumors ultimately lead to murder.

title: Class of '83
description: Demoted to an academy job, a cop trains five foolhardy students as assassins in his risky revenge plot against police corruption and the underworld.

title: Khakee: The Bengal Chapter
description: When upright cop Arjun Maitra takes on Kolkata’s feared don Bagha and his henchmen, he must battle a broken system and navigate bloody gang wars.

title: Khufiya
description: When a mole in an intelligence unit leads to the murder of an undercover spy, a hardened agent relentlessly pursues him to avenge the death.

title: Khel Khel Mein
description: An unhappily married couple and five friends decide to share every call or text they get over one night with each other. There's nothing to hide — right?

title: Kho Gaye Hum Kahan
description: Three best friends juggle life as 20-somethings in Mumbai, where romance, ambition and heartbreak collide with the addictive draw of social media.

title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
description: Duped and sold to a brothel, a young woman fearlessly reclaims her power, using underworld connections to preside over the world she was once a pawn in.

title: Guns & Gulaabs
description: In the cartel-run town of Gulaabgunj, an unprecedented opium deal pulls a big-city cop and a lovesick mechanic into its chaotic clutches.

title: Gandhari
description: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

title: Ginny Weds Sunny
description: Eager to marry but constantly rejected by women, a bachelor hopes to win over a former crush by accepting help from an unlikely source: her mother.

title: Gunjan Saxena: The Kargil Girl
description: Flight Lieutenant Gunjan Saxena makes history in her journey from aspiring aviator to India's first female combat pilot in the Kargil War.

title: Goodbye
description: After a mother's sudden death, chaos and grief collide when four adult siblings return to their traditional father's home for the funeral.

title: Gunday
description: The war of 1971 gave birth to Bangladesh & two young orphans - Bikram (Ranveer Singh) and Bala (Arjun Kapoor).They became Calcutta's most loved and most powerful GUNDAY! Nandita (Priyanka Chopra), the beautiful cabaret dancer, walked in & they fell head over heels in love with her. And then entered ACP Satyajeet Sarkar (Irrfan Khan), a law for every outlaw and a counter force for Bikram and Bala.

title: Gumraah
description: A murder investigation becomes more complicated when a police inspector discovers that the primary suspect has an uncanny look-alike.

title: Guru
description: In 1950s India, a tenacious small-town man sets out to pursue his capitalist dreams in Mumbai, starting a checkered rise to become a powerful tycoon.

title: Gori Tere Pyaar Mein
description: Sriram is concerned only with spending money, until he meets Dia, a principled activist. Now he's determined to prove himself worthy of her affection.

title: Greater Kalesh
description: Twinkle returns home for a surprise Diwali trip, but secrets and disagreements test her family's bonds in ways she never imagined.

title: Glory
description: When murder strikes, brothers Dev and Ravi search for the truth under the shadow of a violent mafia and a ruthless boxing coach.

title: Chak De! India
description: "Kabir Khan (Shahrukh Khan), the ex Indian Captain has now come back as the Coach of the Women's National Hockey team. A rag-tag bunch of girls who’ve forgotten what it’s like to play for the love of the game. CHAK DE INDIA is the story of a coach's fight of making his team, Team India by overcoming their diverse backgrounds, by learning to use everything that life hurls on them as a secret weapon

title: Chandigarh Kare Aashiqui
description: Sparks fly when bodybuilder Manu meets Zumba instructor Maanvi, but Manu struggles with ingrained bias upon learning Maanvi's deeply personal story.

title: Chamatkar
description: A village schoolteacher and the ghost of a murdered man, who were both betrayed by those closest to them, join forces to help each other.

title: Chalte Chalte
description: Raj is brash and earthy, while Priya is sophisticated and something of a perfectionist in all she does. Nonetheless, they dare to fall in love.

title: Chandni
description: In a cruel stroke of fate, Chandni’s (Sridevi) heart is shattered as Rohit (Rishi Kapoor) disappears from her life. When she meets Lalit (Vinod Khanna) who is fighting the demons of tragic memories, they both find solace in this new friendship. Lalit’s affection gives a new direction to Chandni’s life, but Lalit falls for her and Chandni resigns to destiny, till one day, Rohit knocks on her door.

title: Chaahat
description: A vulnerable singer is forced to choose between the girl he loves and another who has developed an unhealthy obsession with him.

title: Chumbak
description: Five quirky families navigate life as neighbors in Chumbak Colony, where chaotic conflicts and hilarious antics turn each day into a new chapter.

title: Choona
description: When an unlikely group of misfits discovers a common enemy in the same ruthless yet superstitious politician, they plot a heist to exact revenge.

title: Chopsticks
description: A gifted but insecure woman embarks on a transformative journey when she enlists an enigmatic con man to recover her stolen car from an eccentric thug.

title: Choked: Paisa Bolta Hai
description: A bank employee weighed down by her jobless husband's debts — and her own broken dreams — finds a secret source of seemingly unlimited cash in her home.

title: Chor Nikal Ke Bhaga
description: A flight attendant and her boyfriend must steal a cache of diamonds to clear an old debt — but the plan spins into mayhem when the plane is hijacked.

title: Chhaava
description: After the death of his father, warrior-king Sambhaji Maharaj battles Mughal forces led by Aurangzeb to keep the Maratha Empire alive.

title: Chhota Bheem aur Krishna: Pataliputra - City of the Dead
description: Krishna needs Bheem’s help: The ruined city of Pataliputra has been cursed! Can the friends do what it takes to bring light back into this town?

title: Chhota Bheem and the Curse of Damyaan
description: To stop the demon Damyaan from spreading evil, Chhota Bheem and his friends must go back in time in this live-action version of the popular cartoon.

title: Chhota Bheem: Journey to Petra
description: The king has been away to meet an old friend, but when he sends for urgent help, Bheem finds himself on an action-packed rescue mission to Egypt!

title: Chhota Bheem: Master of Shaolin
description: Summoned by a monk to help reclaim a temple from a dangerous leader, Bheem must master the Shaolin kung fu techniques if he wants a fighting chance!

title: Jab Tak Hai Jaan
description: A fearless yet reserved army officer must confront his painful past and lost love when a journalist enters his life.

title: Jab Harry Met Sejal
description: A search for Sejal's engagement ring makes Harry understand love and relationships better, while Sejal experiences newfound freedom, security and solace in Harry's company.

title: Jai Mummy Di
description: Sick of keeping their love a secret from their constantly bickering mothers, a young couple seeks to uncover the cause of the women’s longstanding war.

title: Jai Ho
description: Jai dedicates his life to battling corruption and encouraging good deeds, a philosophy that's tested when he runs afoul of an ambitious politician.

title: Jersey
description: Ten years after quitting cricket, a gifted but dejected ex-batsman pursues a spot on the national team, hoping to fulfill his son's wish for a jersey.

title: Jawan
description: A prison warden recruits inmates to commit outrageous crimes that shed light on corruption and injustice — and that lead him to an unexpected reunion.

title: Jaat
description: A mysterious stranger journeys to a remote town controlled by a callous crime lord, with one violent mission — restoring justice to its people.

title: Jaadugar
description: A small-town magician with zero interest in football must lead his local team to the finals of a tournament if he wishes to marry the love of his life.

title: Jaane Jaan
description: When a single mother is caught in a crime investigation, her neighbor — a gifted math teacher — offers to help and a relentless cop digs into the case.

title: Jigra
description: When Ankur is wrongfully imprisoned and sentenced to death in a foreign country, his steely sister Satya is driven by a lethal resolve to break him free.

title: Jogi
description: Amid tension in 1980s India, three friends of different faiths unite in a noble yet dangerous effort to save hundreds in their town.

title: Jewel Thief - The Heist Begins
description: In this high-octane battle of wits and wills, ingenious con artist Rehan devises a diamond heist while trying to outsmart Rajan, his sadistic adversary.

title: Tiger Zinda Hai
description: Inspired by real events, Tiger Zinda Hai is a sequel to the blockbuster Ek Tha Tiger, and an espionage action drama that follows a daring rescue mission in Iraq. When a group of Indian and Pakistani nurses are held hostage in Iraq by the militant Abu Usman, Indian intelligence (RAW) tracks down the reclusive agent Tiger 8 years after he fled with former Pakistani intelligence (ISI) agent Zoya. Joining forces in the name of humanity, Tiger and Zoya lead a team of RAW and ISI agents to covertly enter the hospital where the nurses are trapped, and get the nurses to safety before an American airstrike blows up the hospital. Tiger Zinda Hai is an all-out entertainer with gritty action, music and drama.

title: Toaster
description: In this quirky dark comedy, a miserly man's fixation on a toaster soon unravels into murder and mayhem.

title: Dunki
description: When his friends in Punjab struggle to clear the immigration process, an ex-soldier guides them on a risky journey to enter the UK without permission.

title: Dabba Cartel
description: When an investigation into a pharma company hits close to home, five women launch a tiffin service with a secret ingredient.

title: Darr
description: DARR is Rahul’s (Shahrukh Khan) story whose love and obsession for Kiran (Juhi Chawla) frees him from all fears of life & death. It is Sunil’s (Sunny Deol) story, whose enduring love & passion for Kiran gives him the courage to face the fear of death. It is Kiran’s story caught between one man’s love & another man’s obsession. She fears one & fears for the other.

title: Dining with the Kapoors
description: Featuring the Kapoors, a rare glimpse into Hindi Cinema's first family unfolds over an afternoon filled with laughter, nostalgia and home-cooked secrets.

title: Darlings
description: Badru hopes her volatile husband will reform if he stops drinking. But when his rage goes too far, she and her mom boldly, albeit clumsily, seek revenge.

title: Detective Byomkesh Bakshy!
description: Plunged into the chaos of Calcutta during World War II, a rookie detective finds himself opposing a malevolent genius with world domination plans.

title: Almost Pyaar with DJ Mohabbat
description: In pursuit of forbidden love, two young couples from different worlds find their lives entangled as rebellion and intolerance collide in dual stories.

title: Duplicate
description: Hilarious mix-ups and deadly encounters ensue when a convict seeks to escape authorities by assuming the identity of his doppelgänger, a perky chef.

title: Doctor G
description: Medical student Uday Gupta grudgingly joins an all-women's gynecology class, but being a good doctor — and person — rests on pondering his prejudice.

title: Dolly Kitty and Those Twinkling Stars
description: A disillusioned Delhi wife and her newly-arrived cousin navigate secrets, dreams, and their complex dynamic on their respective paths to freedom.

title: Dream Girl 2
description: Karam secretly turns his female alter ego into a dancer and woos a millionaire's son in hopes of paying family debts and impressing his fiancée's father.

title: Talvar
description: A double murder case of a teenage girl and the family's domestic help shakes the nation. With many suspects and multiple theories, who is the real culprit?

title: Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web
description: Customs officers tackle rising crime at Mumbai's international airport in this Neeraj Pandey drama that "brings us to the edge of our seats" (The Hindu).

title: Tara vs Bilal
description: Sparks fly when vivacious yet sensitive Tara collides with reclusive charmer Bilal in this slice of life story set in a vibrant and diverse London.

title: Titli
description: Desperate to escape his brothers' criminal world, a young man finds an unlikely ally in the woman he's forced to marry.

title: Tu Jhoothi Main Makkaar
description: To earn extra cash, Mickey helps couples break up — but life gets complicated when he falls for Tinni, a career woman with an independent streak.

title: Toolsidas Junior
description: A young boy seeks to master the game of snooker to defend his father’s legacy after a humiliating loss. But first, he’ll need help from a hardened pro.

title: Tere Ishk Mein
description: A hot-headed fighter pilot and a psychologist confront their turbulent romantic past when they meet years later — with new lives and unresolved feelings.

title: Tehran
description: After a deadly car bombing, a Delhi police officer finds himself caught in a covert conspiracy as international peace hangs in the balance.

title: Tribhanga
description: When her estranged mother falls into a coma, a self-made single mom grapples with regret and resentment while reflecting on their strained relationship.

title: Tribhuvan Mishra CA Topper
description: A banking crisis forces CA topper Tribhuvan Mishra to take up sex work. Will this dual existence alleviate his troubles — or create entirely new ones?

title: The Archies
description: In this Indian reboot of the classic comic, Archie Andrews seeks to forge a path away from Riverdale. But will he walk away when his town needs him?

title: The Girl on the Train
description: A troubled divorcée fixates on a seemingly ideal couple from afar until a shocking observation sends her spiraling straight into a knotty murder case.

title: Dangal
description: A once-promising wrestler pursues the gold medal he never won by training two of his daughters to compete at the Commonwealth Games.

title: Dange
description: Former friends Xavier and Yuva meet again in college as adversaries when their respective cohorts come to blows during their annual cultural festival.

title: The Great Indian Kapil Show
description: New stage. Same beloved Kapil. The family fun never ends as the iconic crew of comedians bring their signature desi humor to a new show.

title: Dabangg 3
description: Chulbul Pandey, the playful and fearless inspector, returns once again in a face-to-face with Balli Singh, a criminal whose antics annoy and who disturbed the lives of many victims.

title: Dum Laga Ke Haisha
description: Prem is a shy music buff who runs a tape recording shop. Sandhya is about to carve a niche for herself as a teacher. Will a regular arranged marriage turn out to be a perfect mismatch? From overcoming his fear of the English language to dealing with an overbearing father, he discovers that his oversized wife, who he thought was a spanner in his spool, will actually lead him to something quite cool

title: The Railway Men - The Untold Story of Bhopal 1984
description: After a deadly gas leaks from a factory in Bhopal, brave railway workers risk their lives to save others in the face of an unspeakable disaster.

title: The Royals
description: When charming Prince Aviraaj meets Sophia, a self-made girl boss, the worlds of royalty and startups collide in a whirlwind of romance and ambition.

title: The Roshans
description: This documentary series chronicles the trials and triumphs of Bollywood’s iconic Roshan family — musician Roshan Lal Nagrath, Rajesh, Rakesh and Hrithik.

title: Dasvi
description: Jailed under a tough cop, an uneducated politician decides to spend his time studying for high school, while his scheming wife has plans of her own.

title: Daag
description: Sunil (Rajesh Khanna) is forced to leave behind his new bride Sonia (Sharmila Tagore), when he kills her would-be rapist. A new identity beckons when Sunil meets Chandni (Rakhee) and ends up marrying her to give her illegitimate child a father’s name. Now a respected Mayor of his town, Sunil’s past catches up with him and brings together Sunil and Sonia. Can he outrun his destiny for long?

title: Daadi Ki Shaadi
description: A grandmother's decision to remarry throws her granddaughter's wedding plans into chaos, forcing the family to confront deep rifts to set things right.

title: Daawat-e-Ishq
description: A deliciously romantic coming together of Gullu (Parineeti Chopra), a Hyderabadi shoe-sales girl disillusioned with love because of her encounters with dowry-seeking men; and Taru (Aditya Roy Kapur), a Lucknawi cook who can charm anybody with the aroma and flavours of his biryani and kebabs.

title: Dil To Pagal Hai
description: Promised to another via arranged marriage, a dancer falls in love with her director.

title: Dil Bole Hadippa!
description: Veera (Rani Mukerji) is a fire-cracker of a village girl but dreams of playing cricket in the big league. Rohan (Shahid Kapoor) is a captain of a cricket team in England but returns to India to captain his father's cricket team which has been losing. Veera puts on a turban and beard and earns her place in Rohan's team. This tale of turbans, twists and tricks will make your heart go Hadippa!

title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
description: Charming, handsome and wealthy Raj follows the reserved Simran from London to India to win her over — even though she's betrothed to another.

title: Dil Se..
description: Prematho is the dubbed version of Hindi movie Dil Se. Amar (Shahrukh Khan) a radio journalist falls in love with a mysterious Assamese woman Meghana alias Moina (Manisha Koirala) and chases her with the hope of marrying her and slowly discovers that Meghana is a suicide bomber.

title: Delhi Crime

title: Duniya

title: De De Pyaar De 2
description: Age is just a number — but when Ayesha's parents find out just how old her boyfriend Ashish is, they'll do whatever it takes to break them up.

title: Deva

title: Dobaaraa

description: Two straight guys pretend to be a gay couple to secure a posh Miami apartment, but both of them fall for their gorgeous roommate Neha.

title: Pyaar Impossible!
description: A shy software developer takes a job as a nanny under false pretenses, but his deception brings consequences for his work life and budding romance.

title: Pyaar Ka Punchnama
description: After falling in love, three room-mates experience changes in their lives.

title: Professor

title: Plan A Plan B
description: When an earnest matchmaker moves into an office next to a cynical divorce attorney, their bitter conflict is complicated by a growing attraction.

title: Fanaa

description: When confronted with a dangerous enemy, India’s best fighter pilots — the “Air Dragons” — take to the skies while grappling with personal demons.

title: Faasle

When Vijay (Rohan Kapoor) comes into Chandni’s life - her father’s disapproval and her impending arranged marriage threatens the love between Chandni and Vijay. FAASLE is a story of everyone doing what they believe to be right.

title: Phir Aayi Hasseen Dillruba
description: While evading the cops in Agra, Rani and Rishu scheme to run away together. But when their plans go awry, Rani asks a mild-mannered admirer for help.

title: Phir Bhi Dil Hai Hindustani
description: In this Bollywood entertainment, two journalists, Ajay and Ria, work for rival TV stations and compete heavily to mask their feelings for each other.

title: Force 2
description: An ex-cop investigates the death of his best friend and two other spies, killings that lead to a mole operating from India's embassy in Budapest.

description: Meet Raj (Ranbir Kapoor),who keeps falling in love. It’s not his fault that he’s a heartbreaker. Come discover his three love stories; Raj & Mahi (Minissha Lamba), Raj & Radhika (Bipasha Basu), Raj & Gayatri (Deepika Padukone). Different ladyloves at different times in his life. And each of them, teach him a little bit about love & a little bit about life, in their own sweet, sexy or sassy way.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
description: A kind-hearted Indian man makes it his personal mission to ensure a young speech-impaired girl safely returns to her family home in Pakistan.

description: When two ambitious dreamers and schemers from a pair of dead-end towns meet up, girl and boy team Bunty and Babli is unleashed on the world, giving rise to a series of increasingly wild and wacky capers. title: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan
description: Two elite soldiers with troubled pasts are enlisted for a daring mission when a deadly masked villain threatens India's defenses.

title: Badmaash Company
description: Four friends with big dreams and little money set out to make a fortune in the world of business — even if it means breaking the law.

title: Badla
description: When a woman is accused of killing her lover, a renowned lawyer is hired. However, the more they try to untangle the truth, the more convoluted it becomes.

title: Badhaai Do

title: Baramulla
description: A case of missing children in Kashmir pulls a newly posted cop into an eerie investigation, where no one is safe. From the producers of "Dhurandhar."

title: Billu

title: Bulbbul
description: A child bride grows up to be an enigmatic woman presiding over her household, harboring a painful past as supernatural murders of men plague her village.

title: Befikre
description: Befikre is a carefree love story of Dharam and Shyra, who find love in an engaging series of experiences. Doused in the spirit of Paris, it celebrates a sensual and free-spirited love.

title: Bewakoofiyaan
description: Mohit - a marketing whiz kid vying for a step up the career ladder. Mayera – a financial brain with a penchant for shoes. They’re a young middle-class corporate couple that’s ambitious and likes the good life too.Their obstacle: Mayera’s wilful bureaucratic father V. K. Sehgal. Who gets the last laugh when recession strikes and the lack of money tests love? Mohit-Mayera or V. K. Sehgal?

title: Bank Chor
description: Champak Chiplunkar (Riteish Deshmukh) recruits 2 people from Delhi and picks the worst day possible to rob a bank. With the craziest bunch of hostages, a possibly undercover cop and Baba Sehgal, it gets worse with an unpredictable CBI officer Amjad Khan (Vivek Anand Oberoi) and a mad media circus outside led by fashion journo turned crime reporter Gayatri Ganguly (Rhea Chakraborty).

title: Bombay Begums
description: From boardrooms to society's margins, five ambitious women from various walks of life navigate dreams, desires and disappointments in modern Mumbai.

title: Border 2
description: Set during the 1971 India-Pakistan War, this epic drama follows three Indian soldiers as they balance combat, loss and hope on the front lines.

title: Brothers
description: Two estranged, street-fighting brothers square off against each other in a mixed martial arts tournament.

title: Brij Mohan Amar Rahe!
description: Faking his death to escape the realities of his uneventful life worked out well for Brij Mohan -- until he was sentenced to death for his own murder.

title: Black Warrant
description: Based on certain real events, this true-crime drama traces the corruption and gang wars within Tihar Jail through the eyes of an honest officer.

title: Bhakshak
description: A struggling local journalist begins a dogged investigation into harrowing cases of abuse being covered up at a shelter for young girls.

title: Bhangra Paa Le
description: Both Jaggi and Simi have been harboring a dream of winning Amritsar’s biggest inter-college bhangra competition for their respective colleges (who also happen to be arch-rivals). But, amidst endless banter and bhangra beats, the unusual duo finds love. With feelings seeping into their lives uninvited, will their zest to win the ultimate contest – Bhangra Battle in London – take a backseat?

title: Bharat
description: Bharat is a journey of a man and a nation together. At the cusp of India's birth as an Independent nation, a family makes an arduous journey to freedom. Played by Indian superstar, Salman Khan in the title role, with Katrina Kaif, Sunil Grover, Tabu and Disha Patni, Bharat is an entertaining and endearing film about a man’s sacrifices to fulfill a promise made to his father.

title: Bheed
description: A border cop’s assignment to stop migrant workers from crossing during a lockdown erupts into a fight for humanity amid prejudice and suffering.

title: Bhooth Bangla
description: Akshay Kumar ("Hera Pheri") stars as a man determined to host his sister's wedding at his recently inherited palace — despite the curse that haunts it.

title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
description: Siddharth and Avni’s life changes when they move into his ancestral home. In this maze of superstitions, how will they find their way?

title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2
description: When strangers Reet and Ruhan cross paths, their journey leads to an abandoned mansion and a dreaded spirit who has been trapped for 18 years.

title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3
description: A fake ghostbuster is blackmailed into helping a royal family with their haunted palace, but dueling demonic possessions complicate matters.

title: Mandala Murders
description: When a series of ritualistic murders shakes a small town, a detective and an ex-cop must investigate a mystery with deep ties to their pasts.

title: Murder Mubarak
description: When a gym trainer is murdered at an elite Delhi club, a wily investigator unravels the sordid secrets of its ultrarich members to find the killer.

title: Mardaani
description: To find a missing teen and the man behind her abduction, a Mumbai police officer must venture deep into the world of human trafficking.

title: Mardaani 2
description: A 21-year old boy named Sunny (Vishal Jethwa), comes to the city on a murder contract given to him by the city’s strongest political player. Sunny looks like any other innocent 21-year old, but there’s more to him. He has a penchant for sexually assaulting and eventually murdering young girls. While at it, he locks horns with Shivani Shivaji Roy (Rani Mukerji), the newly appointed chief of the city police. Sunny’s fascinated by her persona. That’s when we come to know that he has a thing for strong, independent women. Shivani persists and manages to get a witness who can identify Sunny. But he manages to eliminate the witness, that too from right under Shivani's nose. This creates unrest in the city and leads to the transfer of Shivani from her position. But before her transfer could come into force, with her small team, she decides to take on Sunny and nab him within 48 hours. Bit by bit, Shivani tracks Sunny’s hideout. In one particularly nerve-wracking pursuit, Shivani chases him down but he jumps into the Chambal river. An injured Shivani tries to catch him, but he escapes. From here begins a thrilling cat and mouse hunt between them. Sunny is all set with an escape plan out of the city as well. His plan includes abducting a female social worker who’s about to stand for the next election and using her to negotiate his way out. Meanwhile, Shivani is hounded by the media, led by the well-known reporter Amit Sharma about her role in instigating the serial killer to go a killing spree in city. On one hand the partial media and on the other hand... only a few hours left to hunt a serial killer who’s out to target more women. Will Shivani manage to nab Sunny, or does she too turn into one of his victims?

title: Mardaani 3
description: When two young girls go missing, a fearless cop sets out to find them — and uncovers a sinister conspiracy that puts her own life in grave danger.

title: Malang
description: Years after a police encounter separates him from his lover, an angry young man goes on a killing spree, with an equally vengeful cop on his heels.

title: Malaal
description: Class divides become thorns in the budding romance between the crony of a nativist Mumbai politician and the new, North Indian resident of his chawl.

title: Masaba Masaba
description: Real life mom-daughter duo Neena and Masaba Gupta play versions of themselves in this playful, fictional peek into their lives in fashion and film.

title: Maharaj
description: A crusading journalist ignites controversy when he confronts a revered leader's immoral behavior in this drama based on a real-life historic court case.

title: Maa
description: In a cursed village, a mother must summon the power of a goddess when a child-stealing demonic force threatens the life of her daughter.

title: Mai: A Mother's Rage
description: A grieving mother discovers the criminals behind her daughter's tragic death, and transforms from meek to merciless to get the real story.

title: Maa Behen
description: A woman calls her estranged daughters in the middle of the night with chilling news — she may have just killed her neighbor. Starring Madhuri Dixit.

title: Maamla Legal Hai
description: At District Court Patparganj, a quirky cast of characters seeks to uphold law and order in the Delhi suburb — but not without chaos and comedy. From the producer of "Kota Factory," this legal dramedy stars Ravi Kishan, Naila Grewal and Anant Joshi.

title: Maya Memsaab
description: A beautiful, wealthy woman’s insatiable appetite for romance leads to tragedy and a police investigation.

title: Mimi
description: An aspiring actress in a small town agrees to bear a child for a visiting couple seeking a surrogate mother, but her experience takes unexpected turns.

title: Mili
description: After she's accidentally trapped in a walk-in freezer at work, a young woman fights to stay alive as her father and boyfriend launch a search for her.

title: Mission Majnu
description: In the 1970s, an undercover Indian spy takes on a deadly mission to expose a covert nuclear weapons program in the heart of Pakistan.

title: Mission Raniganj
description: When a flood leaves dozens of workers trapped in a coal mine, an engineer embarks on a daring rescue mission to save them. Inspired by real events.

title: Mrs. Chatterjee Vs Norway
description: An immigrant mother from India embarks on a fierce custody battle when Norwegian authorities take her children away from her. Based on a true story.

description: When a washed-up cricketer discovers his newlywed wife's talent on the pitch, he begins to coach her. But his resentment grows as she starts to shine.

title: Mister Mummy
description: A grumpy teacher and his kind wife clash on the subject of kids, but a rare twist of fate leads them to connect in ways they never thought possible.

title: Meenakshi Sundareshwar
description: When two newlyweds must live apart due to a unique job prospect, their long-distance marriage and extended family make for both hassles and hilarity.

title: Milestone
description: Recently marking 500,000 kilometers on the road, a newly bereaved trucker faces the threat of losing the job that has come to define him to a new intern.

title: Mujrim
description: Jailed as a teenager, Shankar has been unable to stay on the right side of the law ever since, despite his wife's pleas and his mother's rejection.

title: Mujhse Dosti Karoge!
description: "What would you do if the one you loved was not actually the one you loved. What would you do if your best friend was in love with the one you love. What would you do if your best friends are sacrificing their love for you. Meet Raj (Hrithik Roshan), Pooja (Rani Mukerji) and Tina (Kareena Kapoor)- 3 best friends thrown into a situation that time, letters, love and separation have created for th

title: Musafir Cafe
description: Set in Mussoorie, this romantic drama follows Chander through love, heartbreak and longing as he dreams of opening a hillside café for wandering souls.

title: Metro... In Dino
description: The bittersweet stories of four urban-dwelling couples intertwine as they navigate the complexities and joys of relationships in modern-day India.

title: Merry Christmas
description: A Christmas Eve encounter between two enigmatic strangers sparks a poignant connection — but a dark turn of events threatens to expose their murky pasts.

title: Meri Pyaari Bindu
description: A successful writer, Abhimanyu Roy (Ayushmann Khurrana) returns to his roots to write an old-fashioned love story, 3 years in the making. This writer's block is called Bindu (Parineeti Chopra). How do you contain this live wire in the pages of a book? When Abhi stumbles across an old audio cassette of their favourite playlist, it sends him down memory lane and his novel starts writing itself.

title: Mere Brother Ki Dulhan
description: "Kush (Imran Khan) is looking for the ideal Indian bride for his brother Luv (Ali Zafar). In his quest, Kush goes through an array of wacky encounters until he finds that perfect girl in Dimple (Katrina Kaif), the craziest girl he’s ever known. But Kush falls in love with Dimple - his brother's dulhan. What follows is an unpredictable series of events in this unusual topsy-turvy tale of love. "

title: Madam Chief Minister
description: Rising from disadvantage to become a state leader, a tenacious politician learns that with great power comes great responsibility, ruthlessness and risk.

description: An aspiring comedian seeks to solve the mystery of his dying grandfather's lost love and bring closure to a story rooted in the 1947 Partition of India.

description: An Army officer is charged with protecting a general's daughter while waging battle against a terrorist in this action-packed drama.

description: Dark comedy meets murder mayhem in this mystery-thriller starring Rajkummar Rao (“Stree”), Huma Qureshi (“Kaala”) and Radhika Apte (“Raat Akeli Hai”).

description: Relentlessly pursued by a powerful politician's daughter who'll do anything to make him hers, a man slips down a dark path to reclaim his life.

description: On a trekking trip, an introvert falls for a charming ex-classmate, whose thirst for adventure drives them apart. Years later, their paths cross again.

description: After the wedding ceremony between Surinder Sahni and Taani, Surinder discovers that his new wife cares little for him. When she decides to enter a dance competition, Surinder disguises himself, joins the class and tries to befriend her. Taani soon falls in love with her new dance partner, Raj, unaware that he is in fact her husband.

title: The Diplomat
description: An Indian diplomat maneuvers political and moral tensions to free a young woman claiming forced marriage in Pakistan. Based on true events.

title: Raja Shivaji
description: This historical action drama chronicles Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj's early life, struggles and rise as he lays the foundation of the Hindavi Swarajya.

title: Raazi
description: Set in 1971, when the winds of war were blowing between India and Pakistan, Raazi – an adaptation of Harinder Sikka’s novel “Calling Sehmat” – is a true-life story involving a 20 year old Kashmiri girl.

title: Rana Naidu
description: Rana Naidu is the go-to problem solver for the rich and famous. But when his father is released from jail, the one mess he can't handle may be his own.

title: Raat Akeli Hai
description: When a newly married landlord is murdered, a misfit cop’s investigation is complicated by the victim’s secretive family and his own conflicted heart.

title: Raat Akeli Hai - The Bansal Murders
description: A powerful family. A mansion of secrets. When tragedy strikes a household, buried lies surface — and no one is innocent. With Nawazuddin Siddiqui.

title: Ram Jaane
description: Two boyhood pals -- one righteous, the other a criminal -- take very different paths to adulthood. Their love for the same woman may prove disastrous.

title: Roohi
description: Hired to kidnap a bride, two bumbling pals face a wacky predicament when one falls for their abductee — and the other, for the spirit possessing her.

title: Raid 2
description: Transferred to a small town in Rajasthan, an honest income tax officer pursues a beloved politician whose public good deeds conceal rampant corruption.

title: Rocket Singh: Salesman of the Year
description: Harpreet Singh Bedi has just graduated and decides to five into the world of sales for an adventurous career. But soon his idea of success begins to clash. It's the story of a fresh graduate trying to find a balance between the maddening demands of the ‘professional’ way, and the way of his heart - and stumbling upon a crazy way which turned his world upside down and his career right side up.

title: Lafangey Parindey
description: When Pinky (Deepika Padukone), a girl from the slums, loses her eyesight in an accident, she doesn’t lose her will and determination. Nandu (Neil Nitin Mukesh), an underground boxing champ, decides to teach her how to see without eyes and help her roller skate her way to success. An intriguing journey of a blindfolded street fighter and a blind dancer who set out to achieve the impossible.

title: Lamhe
description: Viren (Anil Kapoor) comes to India, he is captivated by Pallavi (Sridevi). When he learns she's spoken for, he returns. When he gets the news of Pallavi and her husband dying and leaving their daughter Pooja (Sridevi) behind, Viren ensures she is taken care of. 20 years on, Viren comes back to India and sees Pooja - a spitting image of her mother! What follows is a life-changing turn of events.

title: Love Aaj Kal
description: A love story from a bygone decade may provide some wisdom for a modern-day couple when career goals pull them in different directions.

title: Luv Ka The End
description: Rhea is the typical girl next door who is in love with Luv Nanda, a rich and famous boy in college. As they plan to take their relationship to the next level, Rhea realises that Luv is not as nice as she thought. So, she decides to get even and bring Luv down! All in the span of one night. Buckle up for one crazy night as the girls discover the meaning of love, life, friendship and more.

title: Loveyatri
description: Sushrut falls head over heels for Michelle at a festival in India. When she heads home, he follows her – and his heart – all the way to London.

title: Laaga Chunari Mein Daag
description: Hoping to support her sister's education, a young woman moves to Mumbai to find a job, but her chance to earn money comes at a price.

title: Lost Ladies
description: Mistakenly swapped en route to their new husbands' homes, two brides navigate their unexpected surroundings, making delightful self-discovery journeys.

title: Lal Patthar
description: A vain, self-righteous nobleman falls in love with a village girl and tries to transform her into his version of the ideal woman.

title: Laal Singh Chaddha

description: A television reporter and a politician's headstrong daughter decide to try out a live-in relationship during a 20-day business trip, but things get complicated when the whole traditional family joins in.

title: Laila Majnu
description: Two lovers are forced apart because of their family rivalry. Years later, their intense feelings start to consume them in unexpected ways.

title: Vadh
description: Buried under a mountain of debt, Shambhunath Mishra is pushed to a murderous brink when a menacing loan shark begins threatening his family.

title: One 2 Ka 4
description: When his partner is killed, a young cop is forced to care for the man's four children, and solicits the help of a woman who moves in with them.

title: Wild Wild Punjab
description: Four friends road-trip across Punjab to help one of them get over an ex-girlfriend, but are quickly caught in a fiasco like no other.

title: Vicky Vidya Ka Woh Wala Video
description: On the night of their wedding, Vicky and Vidya decide to record a private video. But when the CD is stolen, a panicked hunt for the footage unfolds.

title: Vijay
description: When Arjun (Anil Kapoor) and Vicky (Rishi Kapoor) meet, they are oblivious to the fact that they are cousin brothers. They meet as friends until one day the truth dawns that the person behind the humiliation and destruction of Arjun’s mother is their grandfather Yodhraj (Anupam Kher). The battle lines are drawn. Arjun takes up his mothers cause against his own grandfather and vows to destroy him.

title: Vijay 69
description: An adventurous, foul-mouthed former swimming coach reaches for record-breaking glory when he attempts a triathlon at 69 years old.

title: Veer-Zaara
description: A lawyer fights to free an Indian prisoner who has languished in a jail in Pakistan for two decades — and to reunite him with the woman he loves.

title: Veere Di Wedding
description: Four best friends come together after one gets engaged, working through relationship troubles, family expectations and marriage drama.

title: War 2
description: High-stakes espionage and explosive action fuel this spy thriller, as a rogue ex-spy works with a powerful syndicate — and a former ally hunts him down.

title: Shehzada
description: After realizing he was switched at birth by a conniving father, a rakish Bantu's life is upended when he becomes the heir to a billionaire.

title: Shaandaar
description: A young wedding planner, Jagjinder Joginder (Shahid Kapoor), brings together Bipin Arora's flawed family in the backdrop of a destination wedding in London for his eldest daughter, while both the families try to save their empires. Will the Shaandar wedding succeed and also help the families save their dignifies empires.

title: Shabaash Mithu
description: From child prodigy to trailblazing captain, sports icon Mithali Raj navigates the highs and lows of professional cricket in this coming-of-age drama.

title: Shikari
description: When Shankar, who performs on the road with partner Chanchal and elephant Appu, falls for a Russian circus performer, jealousies and conflicts arise.

title: Shuddh Desi Romance
description: Raghu (Sushant Singh Rajput), a tourist guide in Jaipur, wants love in his life. Gayatri (Parineeti Chopra), a part-time instructor, has been around the block a few times. Tara (Vaani Kapoor), who's dying to get out there and fly, knows what's right for her. 3 young people who junk the society's syllabus for finding love, get their beliefs challenged and loves tested as their lives crisscross.

title: Zero
description: A vertically-challenged bachelor with a larger-than-life personality discovers his life's purpose through his relationships with two wildly different women.

title: Sherdil: The Pilibhit Saga

description: A wonderfully fun and sexy lesbian romp! With a celesbian cast to die for that includes Ashleigh Sumner, Jill Bennett, Cathy DeBuono and Jessica Graham this sexy, fun and energetic lesbian feature follows Lola on a wild San Francisco dash to save her job and her girlfriend.

description: The story of an unlikely friendship that forms between a Devon cattle farmer and the vet who is assigned to cull his precious herd.

title: And Then There Were None
description: Ten strangers are gathered at a manor house on an isolated island by an unknown absentee host and are being killed off one-by-one. Trying to keep their wits, the survivors reach a disturbing conclusion: one of them must be the killer.

description: While working on a writing project on a picturesque volcanic island off the coast of Italy, a married woman enters into an affair with a younger man.

title: Andy Irons: Kissed by God
description: Take a look behind the scenes at the characters involved in Andy Irons: Kissed By God, Teton Gravity Research's 2018 film about the late surfer's life. From neurological experts to Andy's closest friends and family, it's an intimate look at Andy's life.

title: Andy Kindler: I Wish I Was Bitter
description: With good natured rage, comedian and professional trouble maker Andy Kindler ridicules popular culture, show business, and himself in this intimate stand-up comedy performance.

title: Andy Peters: Exclamation Mark Question Point
description: Filmed at The Virgil in Los Angeles, Andy Peters debuts his first stand-up special. Fearless and often off-the-cuff, Andy litters the show with playful self-deprecating bits, a healthy dose of "screaming at strangers" and a nonstop stream of riffs.

title: Andy Somebody
description: A depressed Chicago accountant steals millions of dollars from his corrupt plastic surgeon boss and runs to LA to start a new life.

title: Andy's Rainbow
description: When rebellious teenager Rayne Davis is sentenced to community service at a special needs home, she wonders if life can get any worse. Then she meets Andy, a young man whose profoundly simplistic insights on life, death, and God softens her heart and helps her to look at life with a newfound optimism.

title: Andy Warhol: A Life in Art
description: Warhol was an enigma, yet ironically one of the world’s most well-known artists and a cult icon. The most glamorous figure of 20th Century Art, he surrounded himself with the elite of New York who all tell compelling stories of their time with him.

description: A mother moves into an ancient mansion with her son to help a dying family member, but the house’s tortured past begins to prey on their minds.

title: An Englishman Abroad
description: Alan Bates stars in a splendid story by Alan Bennett, based on a true incident which took place in Moscow in 1958. British spy Guy Burgess encounters actress Coral Browne on tour from the 'old country'. Invited to lunch at Burgess's shabby apartment, he presents her with a strange request.

title: An Englishman in New York
description: John Hurt gives a bravura portrayal of British gay icon Quentin Crisp, focusing on Crisp's emigration to the United States and the final years of his life.

description: Inspired by Stephen Sayers's rise from the streets of Newcastle to the top of the criminal ladder and the authorities' attempt to bring him down.

description: After his daughter vanishes, a wealthy man hires investigative journalists to probe into a deserted town, hoping to uncover clues to her whereabouts.

However, the relationship deteriorates into abuse and violence, giving rise to one of Brazil's most infamous murders.

description: After being nursed back to health by a captivating Quaker girl, a notorious gunman must choose between his way of life and hers.

description: Jason deCaire's Taylor's hauntingly beautiful underwater life-like statues let's us witness the birth of an artificial coral reef, learn how we are connected to the ocean, and are left to think how our choices determine the future.

When the eerie late-night visits become ever more menacing, they decide to fight the supernatural force. Prepare to be spooked!

description: An apprentice angel is sent to Earth to help 13-year-old Desi navigate her problems at home and school while teaching her it's okay to be herself.

It's a series that celebrates science, technology, engineering and math and does it all through the lens of an 11 year-old girl.

description: Anne Edmonds is the rock star of Australian comedy and everybody knows it. Welcome to her debut special. In just one hour, she's going to tell you what's wrong with you and everyone else.

description: Henry (Adam Driver) is a provocative stand-up comedian with a fierce sense of humour who falls in love with Ann (Marion Cotillard), a world-famous soprano. description: In this gripping thriller, a close-knit family is caught in the turmoil of a controversial rising movement known as "The Change."

description: A young woman and an old soldier trapped in an isolated cabin endure abuse and violence while questioning who will come out on top.

Giovana finds herself stuck at home with a man she just met, leaving them strangers at first. As years of shared lockdown pass, they make the effort to act as a couple. While Yago is living in his own utopia, Giovana feels her life has changed in a way she never expected, feeling trapped inside.

In ANVIL! Howard remained an artist foremost and an enigma to the end. The film is in four season-sections, and plays out against that backdrop: spring showers, drought, heat wave, hail and storms, harvest moons and the damp cold of winter. Each vintage is a time capsule, a bottled piece of history of a very specific year, with its particular weather pattern, its crises and its triumphs.
