description: A female reporter with marital problems is sent by her boss to cover the campaign of a young political neophyte who's running against the local crooked political boss.

title: Beware! The Blob
description: A geologist unwittingly unleashes a mass of carnivorous goo that grows as it eats the unsuspecting residents of a small town in this Sci-Fi sequel.

title: Beyblade X
description: When aspiring pro Blader Robin Kazami joins up with former champ Jaxon Cross and mega-popular influencer Multi Nana-iro to form Team Persona, this unlikely trio set their sights on reaching the pinnacle of the Blading world: the top of The X, a looming tower where the best of the best duke it out for the title of champion. It's time to show the world something X-traordinary!

title: Beyonce & Jay-Z: Power Love
description: The story of R&B princess Beyonce Knowles and hip-hop icon Jay-Z through their rise to the top of their industries and their status as a power couple.

title: Beyonce: Limited Edition
description: This music documentary looks at the life and career of Beyoncé Knowles, the record-breaking artist whose powerful female image has inspired millions.

title: Beyond
description: Detective John Koski, an expert in tracking down kidnapped children, is about to be thrust into one of the strangest cases of his career. When the police chief's niece, Amy, goes missing her workaholic mother, sinister father and a flirtatious babysitter all come under suspicion. But the most mysterious suspect of all is Rory, Amy's imaginary friend who's starting to become very real.

title: Beyond After
description: BEYOND AFTER is a documentary exploring the social and cultural impact of the AFTER franchise. It reveals how Anna Todd's novels became a cinematic phenomenon through interviews with Hero Fiennes Tiffin, Josephine Langford, and Anna Todd. The film features heartfelt testimonials from fans, showcasing their profound emotional connections. Narrated by Louise Lombard, it's a must-watch for fans.

title: Beyond a Reasonable Doubt
description: An ambitious rookie journalist begins investigating a high-profile lawyer for tampering with evidence to secure his convictions.

title: Beyond Belief: Fact or Fiction
description: Each episode of this cult anthology series presents several stories that appear to defy logic - the supernatural, ghosts, psychic phenomena, destiny and the divine - and offers the viewer a chance to decide what is fact and what is fiction.

title: Beyond Black Beauty
description: In season one,15-year-old equestrian Jolie Dumont's privileged European life implodes when her mother inexplicably leaves her father and drags Jolie to her family's urban ranch in Baltimore. There, a rebellious horse named Beauty inspires Jolie with her raw talent. These two lost souls bond as Jolie embraces her family's rodeo legacy, kickstarts her Olympic training, and even meets her first love.

title: Beyond Disclosure - The Corey Goode Files
description: A profile of Corey Goode, who became an icon and polarizing figure in the UFO community after claiming he served 20 years in a secret space program.

title: Beyond Driven
description: When Lella Lombardi scored in Formula One in 1975, she inspired the next generation of young women to pursue the challenging motorsport.

title: Beyond Evil
description: An architect and his wife move into a Colonial-era mansion where the demonic presence of the original owner's wife has been residing for centuries.

title: Beyond Existence
description: Ellen, a government agent is forced to protect a professor with a deadly secret from an immortal bounty hunter in order to save the human race.

title: Beyond Food
description: Beyond Food is a picture of what extraordinary health looks like today and all the possibilities that are available to people who want to experience maximum health. Hacking our biology, our food options, the emotions we nurture on a daily basis, the affordable transformative technologies that are available on our smartphones and how today's science comes together with ancient methods of managing your nervous system like... breathing. We traveled all over the US on a mission to interview a group of extraordinary people, courageous pioneers challenging mainstream health advice and sat with them for in-depth, mind-expanding interviews. We personally knew this journey would change us, but we never imagined the degree to which our life would improve, in ways we could have never imagined. We are grateful for this knowledge, tools and this group of amazing humans for opening their doors to us. This movie is for you so that you can bring all this into your life.

title: Beyond Hoarding
description: A fresh look at hoarding explores the lives of people who suffer as they clutter, as mental health experts address the disorder, treatment, and hope.

title: Beyond Loch Ness
description: A cryptozoologist in search of the infamous Loch Ness monster discovers that the malevolent, forty-foot long reptile from Scotland has traveled to Lake Superior via an elaborate series of subterranean tunnels, and that she's brought her hungry offspring along for a feeding frenzy.

title: Beyond Prognosis
description: Destined for a global career in downhill mountain biking, 17-year-old Yannis Pelé suffers a devastating crash during a competition. The diagnosis is clear-cut: fractured vertebrae and spinal cord damage. Yannis loses the use of his legs and with them, his dream of becoming an athlete. When a childhood dream comes to an abrupt halt, what is left but hope?

title: Beyond Redemption
description: Un policía encubierto intenta salvar a la hija de un notorio criminal de convertirse en daño colateral en una operación encubierta que salió mal.

title: Beyond Skyline
description: When the population of Los Angeles is sucked off the face of the earth, Detective Mark Corley (Frank Grillo) storms his way onto an alien ship to rescue his estranged son. After the ship crashes in Southeast Asia, Mark must forge an alliance with a band of survivors to discover the key to saving his son and taking back the planet once and for all.

title: Beyond the Call of Duty
description: A renegade soldier and a female American reporter being chased on a high-speed gunboat in Vietnam find that when duty ends, the battle begins.

title: Beyond the Check: Worker Owner Edition
description: Hit the culinary trail to explore chef-owned restaurants around the country and learn how a sense of personal investment contributes to their success.

title: Beyond the Dunwich Horror
description: After arriving in Dunwich to find his missing brother, a man finds himself lured into an underworld of ancient madness and ritual killings.

title: Beyond the Grave
description: Is death the end or is it just the beginning? With interviews from experts, this film seeks to uncover the truth behind what happens beyond the grave.

title: Beyond the Lake
description: The seemingly picturesque life of an ex-musician musician turns upside down when the woman who caused him to quit music moves in down the street.

title: Beyond the Law
description: A cop goes undercover to stop a biker gang’s drug and arms smuggling operation, but the closer he gets, the more his own demons return to haunt him.

title: Beyond the Law
description: After hearing of his son’s brutal murder, a former private eye goes head-to-head with the mob with the goal of getting some bloody revenge.

title: Beyond the Lights
description: La fama tiene a Noni al límite, hasta que conoce a Kaz, un policía que la ayuda a encontrar su voz y ser la artista que siempre debió ser.

title: Beyond the Line
description: In the final days of the war, two Allied soldiers find themselves trapped behind enemy lines and struggle to survive as the Nazis begin closing in.

title: Beyond the Mask
description: Un asesino de la Compañía Británica de Comercio de las Indias Orientales trata de salvar su pasado frustrando un plan contra la libertad de la nación.

title: Beyond the Neon
description: A reckless YouTuber and his crew plunge into the high-stakes escort system in an attempt to rescue a woman from human sex trafficking.

title: Beyond the Pale
description:
When Whicher is hired to investigate threats made against
the son of former Home Secretary Sir Edward Shore, he is led to dangerous corners of Victorian London’s Docklands, and also to the woman of his dreams.

title: Beyond the Purple Hills
description: Gene Autry becomes the new Sheriff after bank robbers kill the former sheriff. When Judge Beaumont is murdered, evidence points to the judge's wild son. Believing the young man, Gene tries to help.

title: Beyond the Reach
description: In temperatures exceeding 130 degrees in the middle of the Mojave Desert with no food or water, a young unclothed man is hunted by a corporate shark.

title: Beyond the Reef
description: Join actor and part-time adventurer Shuang Hu on an epic adventure of a lifetime into one of the world's most unique and beautiful locations.

title: Beyond The Ring
description: When his daughter needs life-saving surgery, a widowed martial artist returns to the ring for one final fight so that he can cover the medical bills.

title: Beyond the Sea
description: The spotlight shines on the life of “Mack the Knife” crooner Bobby Darin and his marriage to Hollywood starlet Sandra Dee in this tuneful biopic.

title: Beyond the Spectrum: Being Taken
description: A rich and precise history of alleged alien abductions of human beings is sorted out, from hoaxes to some of the most credible cases on record.

title: Beyond The Spectrum: Maussan's UFO Files
description: This film follows the incredible story of Jaime Maussan and his pursuit in the main stream journalism field to uncover the truth about UFOs internationally. Watch his story unfold as we recount his rise as a journalist covering controversial Mexican UFO events.

title: Beyond The Spectrum: The Underground
description: Phil Schneider died in 1996. Before his death he had been on tour across the United States speaking out about various subjects including his involvement with building a secret underground base in Dulce, New Mexico for the military. This documentary explores some of the information Phil Schneider spoke about to the public in the 1990's by examining each claim in detail.

title: Beyond the Veil
description: Beyond the Veil follows a group of 5 Northern Nigerian women as they navigate the ups-and- downs of modern life, which includes careers, friendships, romances and often clash of cultures.

title: Beyond the Wasteland
description: Traverse the oddball world of Mad Max fandom—from Australia to Japan—with cast member Bertrand Cadart during his brave battle with advanced leukemia.

title: Beyond Tomorrow
description: On Christmas eve, the ghosts of three industrialists return to Earth to help reignite the romantic spark between a young Texas cowboy and teacher.

title: Beyond Weight Loss: Breaking the Fat Loss Code
description: In America, confusing labels and diet trends often lead consumers towards unhealthy products and unsustainable lifestyle choices.

title: Beyond White Space
description: After a state-of-the-art U.S. spacecraft discovers a massive monster in space, pirates ransack their ship - and the crew decides to hunt the creature.

title: Beyto
description: A star student and closeted gay champion swimmer from a devout Muslim immigrant family could stand to lose it all when he falls for his male coach.

title: Bhoot: Part One - The Haunted Ship
description: In June 2012, A huge, dead, unmanned ship-“Sea Bird”, on its way to a shipyard, broke its ties and ran ashore Juhu beach. Prithvi, a shipping officer recovering from psychotic depression due to the loss of his family, is in charge of getting Sea Bird back afloat.

title: Bibi & Tina
description: Bibi's summer vacation at her best friend Tina's start excitingly. Within no time the Martin's farm suffers from drought, rain, and a heavy storm. In addition to that, entrepreneur Kim Win Win wants to dig for gravel on their ranch. Bibi and Tina have to do something! Will the mysterious Spanish boy Chico help them? A turbulent summer awaits.

title: Bible Bees
description: Two young bees buzz about the countryside, making friends with other creatures and learning about gratitude, telling the truth, and apologizing.

title: Bible Land Passages
description: The Bible story and its message of salvation are connected to a real place and time in history. This documentary takes you through it all.

title: Bible Secrets Revealed
description: Bible Secrets Revealed seeks to answer lingering questions about the world's all-time best-selling book. Who wrote it? How old is it? And is it accurate? Scholars, archaeologists, and religious leaders investigate.

title: Bickford Shmeckler's Cool Ideas
description: When a sexy co-ed (Olivia Wilde) steals a book of mind-blowing theories written by brilliant but troubled college student Bickford Shmeckler (Patrick Fugit), his world is turned upside down. From the creators of American Pie, this wild rollercoaster ride to reclaim his book is an award winning clever comedy starring some of today’s hottest stars.

title: Bieber Generation
description: Pop star Justin Bieber is more than just a singer for his most passionate fans. For the Beliebers, his impact has been life-changing.

title: Better Brain Health: We Are What We Eat
description: Food is fuel for the brain. What have recent scientific discoveries revealed about our mental health and moods when we eat junk food?

title: Welcome to Hell
description: To escape the leader of a satanic death metal band and the father of her unborn child, a young woman moves to a remote location in the woods.

title: Welcome Aboard
description: Isabelle (Valérie Lemercier), head of HR for Costa Cruises, has made the cardinal error of having an affair with her boss (Lionnel Astier). But before the inaugural cruise of the company’s flagship vessel, he decides to throw her out of his life and out of her job! Some women seek vengeance with poison, others with firearms or scandal. Isabelle opts for Rémy (Frank Dubosc), a flamboyant loser who has screwed up everything on land, and who thinks that maybe he’ll do better at sea. She signs him up as on-board entertainer. At first, he proves to be the worst nightmare for the Chairman and Cruise Director (Gérard Darmon). But gradually, Rémy finds his way on this floating palace, and with it, love and success. He changes his own destiny and that of all those who sail with him.

title: Welcome to the Sticks
description: Philippe Abrams is the director of a post office in the southern France. He's married to Julie, whose depressed state makes life impossible. To make her happy, Philippe plots to get transferred to the French Riviera. But it backfires, and he is transferred to Bergues, a small town in northern France, instead.

title: Big Ass Spider!
description: Un equipo de científicos y un exterminador deben enfrentarse a una araña alienígena gigante antes de que destruya la ciudad de Los Ángeles.

title: Big Bad BeetleBorgs
description: When their wish to become comic book heroes comes true, three kids must face off against the heroes' mortal enemies in various thrilling adventures.

title: Big Bad Mama
description: A pistol-packing mother and her gorgeous daughters embark on a string of daring bank heists across Depression-era America in this cult classic.

title: Big Bad Mama II
description: Wilma McClatchie and her sexy daughters return to a life of crime, and vow vengeance against the evil land baron who foreclosed on their home.

title: Big Boys Don’t Cry
description: The true story of a man fighting for vengeance and forced to tell of the abuse he suffered in foster care after his childhood friend commits suicide.

title: Big Bully
description: A predatory instinct is reawakened in a former childhood bully when his favourite victim returns to their hometown.

title: Big Crow
description: This doc looks at a young Lakota basketball star turned activist who continues to help her people reclaim their culture 30 years after her death.

title: Big Eden
description: In this romantic fable, a successful NY artist returns home to Montana’s timberland and confronts unrequited love and his emotions about being gay.

title: Big Fan
description: A parking garage attendant, who lives for New York Giants football, struggles to deal with the fallout when he gets beaten up by his favorite player.

title: Big Font. Large Spacing
description: To pass their class and secure their futures, two lazy psychology students must complete a lengthy essay in the course of one night.

title: Bigfoot: Grip of the Monster
description: Twenty years after writing about a terrifying Bigfoot encounter, a bestselling author returns to the scene of the incident in Maine’s northern woods.

title: Bigfoot or Bust
description: Comedic hijinks ensue as a team of celebrities and a group of time-traveling women from the future go on a quest to search for the loveable Bigfoot.

title: Bigfoot: The Conspiracy
description: A retired Border Patrol agent discovers the possible existence of Bigfoot and the shroud of darkness that surrounds it.  Unsure what he should do, he is resigned to do what he must to protect his family.

title: Bigfoot, UFOs and Jesus
description: A woman returns to her quirky hometown, where her family and other locals witness a growing mystery surrounding strange lights in the sky.

title: Bigger Than the Sky
description: Drama starring John Corbett, Amy Smart, Sean Astin and Patty Duke. The story centers on a man stuck in a dead-end life who decides to audition for a small role in a local community theater's production of Cyrano de Bergerac. Despite having no experience as an actor, he lands the lead role, which wreaks havoc upon his life.

title: Biggie: The Life of Notorious B.I.G.
description: This documentary traces the life, death and legacy of the late Christopher Wallace, as told by his widow Faith Evans, his mother, his close friend Lil Cease and some of hip-hop's biggest superstars. Employing archival footage & audio recordings that have never been heard before, the film allows "The Notorious B.I.G." to narrate his own story.

title: Big Girls Don't Cry
description: A new girl joins, old friends re-unite, and adventures ensue as another term begins at the all-girls boarding school nestled in the hills. Welcome to Vandana Valley!

title: Big Gold Brick
description: The story of fledgling writer Samuel Liston, who is enlisted by an enigmatic, middle-aged father of two, Floyd Deveraux, to write his biography.

title: Big History
description: From the creators of "The Universe" and "Life After People", Big History puts a sci-fi spin on history, linking iconic events to our daily lives.

title: Big House
description: A fun weekend getaway amongst friends goes terribly wrong when a guest’s fiancé unexpectedly shows up, throwing off the whole flirtatious dynamic.

title: Big in Japan
description: With adulthood calling and a lack of success pulling them down, Seattle indie rock band Tennis Pro decide to put it all on the line and take a crack at making it big in Japan before calling it quits for good.

title: Big Kill
description: A Philadelphia accountant, two misfit gamblers on the lam, and a deadly preacher have a wild date with destiny, in a Western boom town gone bust.

title: Big Legend
description: While tracking down his missing fiancée, a man gets more than he bargained for when teaming with a hunter who has eyes on a different prize: Bigfoot.

title: Bigorexia
description: Explores the physical and psychological depths of muscle dysmorphia disorder through the eyes of five subjects in the bodybuilding industry.

title: Big Rig Bounty Hunters
description: Truckers spend a lot of time on the road carrying valuable cargo in their rigs and, as big as the 18-wheelers are, you'd think it would be hard for one to go missing, right? Wrong. It is a fairly common occurrence on American roads for a truck and its cargo to be missing in action. When it happens, the so-called big-rig bounty hunters kick into gear to try to locate and haul in the trucks. If the vehicle can't be found, the trucking company pays the price for the missing cargo that can be worth millions. This factual programme follows people - ranging from an ex-cop to Vietnam vets and even a former pro wrestler - who hit the road to retrieve the missing loads. It can be dangerous - they sometimes chase trucks that have been hijacked - but the potential to earn big bucks keeps the big-rig hunters on the job.

title: Big Sky
description: A group of pilots at a small aviation company deal with everyday life while trying to prevent their company from going under.

title: Big Town Scandal
description: Returning for their final film in the Big Town series, crusading newspaper editor Steve Wilson (Reed) and his girl Friday Lorelei Kilbourne (Brooke) come to the aid of wayward teenage boys by paroling them under his care. Steve attempts to set up jobs and a Youth Center for the boys, putting five of them on a basketball team. However, local gangsters soon use the center to hide their ill-gotten gains and try to throw a basketball match with the boys, aided by one of the boys, Tommy.  After one of Tommy's fellow miscreants is killed, Tommy amends his ways and helps put the gangsters away for good with Steve and Lorelei's help. Look for former Our Gang members "Alfalfa" Switzer and Tommy "Butch" Bond as two of the teenage hoodlums.

title: Bihter: A Forbidden Passion
description: Amazon Original movie from Turkey unlocks a new perspective on Halid Ziya Uşaklıgil’s novel, Aşk-ı Memnu (Forbidden Love). Explore the love by diving into the thoughts of the heroine. Bihter sees marrying rich but elderly Adnan an escape from societies labels. However Bihter is engulfed by desires for Behlül, a relative of Adnan. Bihter is the story of passion, infidelity, courage, and cowardice.

title: Bikie Wars: Brothers in Arms
description: On Father's Day 1984, two biker clubs warred at a public swap meet, leaving many dead and hospitalized. Discover how that fateful day came to pass.

title: Bikini Shark
description: The deranged CEO of Bikini-Net hatches a deadly scheme that involves his toxic swimsuits and a shiver of engineered predators attracted to them.

title: Bilal: A New Breed of Hero
description: When Bilal and his sister are abducted and thrown into a world of injustice, he finds the courage to make a change. Inspired by true events.

title: Billable Hours
description: Billable Hours is a half hour dramatic comedy series that follows the office lives of three lawyers, Sam Caponelli, Robin Howland and Clark Claxton III who work for the fictitious Bay Street law firm of Fagan & Harrison.

title: Bill Bellamy: I Want My Life Back
description: Live from Tribeca, the comic delves into the complexities of life while appreciating the simple things in this new era of quarantines and mandates.

title: Bill Coors: The Will to Live
description: Beer titan Bill Coors is a legend in his field, but also bravely searched for a holistic treatment for his family’s legacy of anxiety and depression.

title: Bill Engvall: Here's Your Sign, It's Finally Time My Last Show
description: After spending over four decades delighting audiences, the renowned comedian takes the stage for the last time in his farewell stand-up special.

title: Bill Evans Time Remembered
description: An intimate look at the talented and turbulent life of musician Bill Evans and the influential contributions he made to the world of jazz.

title: Bill Hicks: Relentless
description: In this classic special from 1992, comedian Bill Hicks tells us how he feels about non-smokers, blow-jobs, religion, war, peace, drugs and music.

title: Bill Hicks: Revelations
description: The last special Bill Hicks ever taped in 1992 and features him the height of his genius. Recorded at the Dominion Theatre in London, Bill Hicks opens our eyes and minds to the hypocrisy and ludicrousness of the world around us.

title: Bill Hicks: Sane Man
description: Sane Man was Bill's first full-length comedy special, taped in 1989. This is the early years and the foundation of what would become his signature material and point of view. Funny and thought provoking, he attacks corporate America with venom, and almost screams at people to start thinking for themselves.

title: Billionaire Boys Club
description: Set in Los Angeles during a decade of excess, a group of wealthy young men discover that their money-making plan spirals into deadly consequences.

title: Billionaire Murders
description: Following the investigation into the deaths of billionaire and generic drug mogul Barry Sherman and his philanthropist wife Honey by Toronto Star reporter Kevin Donovan.

title: Billionaire's Paradise: Inside Necker Island
description: Explore the exclusive Caribbean resort that only the world’s richest and most powerful can afford to enjoy and hear from the workers who staff it.

title: Billion Dollar Space Race: Bezos Vs Musk Vs Branson
description: In an era of unchecked wealth for the very top, learn how three of the world’s richest men are launching space tourism and colonization ventures.

title: Billion Dollar Wreck
description: Billion Dollar Wreck follows famed treasure hunter Martin Bayerle and his son Grant as they pursue a billion dollars worth of gold aboard RMS Republic.

title: Billy Boy
description: When Billy's (Blake Jenner, "Glee") friend is found dead, his world unravels. As he tries to move on, he falls in love with Jennifer (Melissa Benoist, "Supergirl"), but his life is unexpectedly threatened by the sins of his past.

title: Billy Gardell: Halftime
description: Billy Gardell, the star of CBS’ hit comedy "Mike & Molly," has appeared in dozens of television series, including "Yes, Dear," "My Name Is Earl," "The King of Queens" and "Desperate Housewives." But his first love (apart from his Steelers) has always been stand-up comedy where his disarming no nonsense approach to life continues to sell out comedy clubs and theaters nationwide. Now Billy returns home to Pittsburgh, where all the funny began for him, in a one-hour live event that celebrates working-class America. ON CHILDHOOD: “Kids today get to do whatever they want. My Dad’s answer for everywhere you ever wanted to go was ‘they’re closed.’” ON MARRIAGE: “After 10 years of marriage, dinner and a movie don’t cut it. After 10 years, you gotta say stuff like ‘Who wants new floors?’”ON HALFTIME: “I’m 40. I’m at halftime in my life, and I played a sloppy first half. You know you’re getting old when you hurt yourself sleeping.”

title: Billy the Exterminator
description: In Louisiana, a pest remover faces deadly snakes, angry gators, and loose critters, handling them with compassion, humor, and a fearless attitude.

title: Billy The Kid Returns
description: When Cowboy Roy is mistaken for the newly-deceased Billy the Kid, he uses the opportunity to help homesteaders stand up to powerful big ranchers.

title: Binary Samurai
description: Two warriors wander the wasteland, battling scavengers and searching for Nodes, remnants of the Net, which are keys to unlimited power.

title: Bing Crosby: Legends in Concert
description: The silky-smooth crooner who could sing both pop and jazz performs some of his timeless hits in a rare live concert.

title: Bingo Hell
description: A feisty senior citizen fights to protect her beloved neighborhood from an evil force that’s taken over the local bingo hall and is killing the residents in gruesome ways. Part of the Welcome to the Blumhouse collection.

title: Binhi: The Seed
description: A young couple expecting their first child leaves Manila for a fresh start. But their seemingly perfect new house is haunted by a sinister spirit.

title: Biography: The Trump Dynasty
description: Firsthand accounts and never-before-seen archival footage examine the life and heritage of Donald Trump, from his childhood in Queens to his risky move into the world of Manhattan real estate and his successful 2016 presidential campaign.

title: Biography: WWE Legends
description: Jump into the ring with this docuseries about the personal lives of iconic WWE superstars, featuring archival footage and original interviews.

title: Biohazard
description: This early ‘80s sci-fi horror cult classic is about what happens when an alien monster tries to override a psychic’s will and take over planet Earth.

title: Nature Tech
description: Exciting new developments in computer technology, chemistry and physics are now enabling us to understand Nature's designs better than ever before. Scientists are not simply trying to copy nature - they are taking hints, extracting principles and applying winning designs of evolution in a new, human context.

title: Bio-Tech Warrior
description: Following the explosion of a space shuttle in Earth’s atmosphere, a government agent gets tasked with finding and destroying a deadly rogue cyborg.

title: Bird
description: Mientras corre por su vida, una testigo con recuerdos fragmentados de un asesinato se cruza con un criminal en medio de un atraco que salió mal.

title: Birdemic 3: Sea Eagle
description: Global warming causes a flock of sea eagles to attack a coastal California town in the third sequel to "worst movie ever" cult favorite Birdemic.

title: Birdemic: Shock and Terror
description: Midnight movie cult-favorite about a picturesque California town under attack by millions of killer birds that swoop in and wreak bloody havoc.

title: Bird of Paradise
description: An island native saves a man who falls overboard. They fall in love, but local custom demands her sacrifice to the gods when a volcano erupts.

title: Bird on a Wire
description: Goldie Hawn and Mel Gibson star in this action-packed comedy about an FBI witness and his old flame on a cross-country scramble to evade gangsters, the police and a love-struck veterinarian.

title: Birds of Paradise
description: Two dancers at an elite ballet academy compete for a contract to join the highly coveted Opéra national de Paris.

title: Birdy
description: Birdy comes back from Vietnam mentally shattered and deludes himself into thinking that he is a bird, an animal that has obsessed him since childhood. His best friend Al (Nicolas Cage), also a wounded Vietnam vet, visits Birdy every day, determined to bring him back to reality.

title: When I'm Done Dying
description: When I'm Done Dying is an emotional roller coaster into Istanbul youth, steeped into edgy rap composed by one of the most acclaimed beatmakers and rappers in Turkey, Da Poet.

title: Birthmarked
description: Two married scientists raise three children in a manner contrary to their genetic tendencies, to prove the ultimate power of nurture over nature.

title: Birthrite
description: When a couple expecting their first child move to a new town hoping for a fresh start, they are confronted by a darkness that threatens to claim their unborn child as they discover their place in the cursed history of their new home.

title: Biswa Kalyan Rath's Mood Kharaab
description: Biswa Kalyan Rath, is a comedian who used to be angry at the world. Now he is disappointed. In this special, shot in London because London is on Earth and he is a human of Earth, he explores various themes on how the world is an irritating place. On second thought he’s still angry but that’s none of your business unless you are also angry, in which case please watch. Enjoy. Or don’t. Any problem?

title: Biswa Kalyan Rath: Sushi
description: A carefully assorted platter of raw but delicate jokes skillfully assembled with great care and precision from thinly sliced observations caught from the sea of existence of humanity on planet earth that leaves your soul feeling cheerful, happy, content and light.

title: Bit
description: On her summer break in Los Angeles, a transgender teen girl falls in with a gang of queer feminist vampires rooting out the city’s toxic masculinity.

title: Bitch Slap
description: Three bad girls with hidden agendas travel to a remote desert hideaway to steal a fortune in diamonds from a ruthless underworld kingpin.

description: A reformed criminal and an enterprising young woman are forced back into the underground when a hard drive containing $800K in Bitcoin goes missing.

title: Bite
description: Pursued by a dangerous criminal after a failed theft, con artists Nina and Yaz get more than they bargained for when they target an elderly widow.

title: Bite Me
description: A vampire and her IRS auditor are forced to confront whether they have the courage to commit to the terrifyingly radical act of falling in love.

title: Bite Night
description: When three pretty young Goths get to spend the night in their favorite band's house, they have a hellish night of madness that they helped create.

title: Bite the Dust
description: Two infamous bounty hunters searching for missing orphan children face off against a cruel baron and his small army that control the town.

description: A troubled teenage girl must decide if the man she loves is worth saving from his stifling debts by offering her virginity in an auction.

In their 'boulevard,' they find a raw, liberating love. But as his past threatens to destroy them both, Hasley faces a heartbreaking choice: can you save someone who isn't ready to be rescued?

He has made it his mission to travel the world with his 9 year-old daughter teaching disabled children to surf. As he journeys to all four oceans of the world, his wife Aileen stays behind to take care of the family and manage their life. But beneath the surface of this yearlong adventure are the pains and problems of everyday life. Over the course of a year Jack quits his job, adopts a child, and yet still continues his trek across the globe. Each success of his charity is met with a new problem at home, and his marriage begins to suffer. With bills piling up and his family struggling to find time together, something has to give. And for Aileen, the stress of managing the family, paying for the charity, and working a full time job is starting to be too much. But how do you tell a man working with Indian orphans, children with autism, and many more in need, to stop? Bound By Sea presents both the highs and lows of a family fighting to live one man’s dream while also staying together.

description: Brad has a satisfying career and a comfortable life in suburban Sacramento where he lives with his sweet-natured wife, Melanie (Jenna Fischer), and their musical prodigy son, Troy, but it's not quite what he imagined during his college glory days. Brad begins to question whether he has really failed or if, in some essential ways, his friends' lives are more flawed than they appear.

title: Braid
description: Desperate for money, two criminals visit their wealthy childhood friend who they believe they can rob, that is if they can survive her bizarre games.

title: Brain Dead
description: An experimental operation plunges a brilliant neurosurgeon into a mind-bending nightmare that blurs the line between reality and delusion.

title: Brain Freeze
description: It’s up to a security guard and a pair of siblings to save humanity when a country club’s genetically modified fertilizer causes a zombie outbreak.

title: Brainwashed
description: Why do people join cults? Why don't battered women leave their husbands? How do countries fall victim to dictators? This series seeks to find answers.

title: Bram Stoker's Van Helsing
description: When a woman falls victim to a strange illness, her fiancé turns to his former professor and rival to help him uncover the terrifying vampiric truth.

title: Branded a Coward
description: Orphaned as a boy after his parents were murdered, Johnny Hume is all grown up now. Though he’s an expert rider, he remains traumatized by the past.

title: Identicals
description: When Slater's girlfriend is abducted by Brand New-U, he must become an Identical to navigate a world of life upgrades and identity swaps to find her.

title: Brangelina: The Inside Story
description: Follow the story of two of the most famous actors in Hollywood, who after a decade of hysteria, ended their marriage, leaving the world shocked.

title: Braquo
description: A dark realistic cop series from world-famous filmmaker and former police office Olivier Marchal. Braquo (slang for Heist) follows a squad of Paris cops who exist in the blurred boundaries at the very edge of the law, often using violence and intimidation to get the job done.

title: Brash Boys Club
description: In one bold and brazen night of stand-up comedy, three diverse, gay male comedians hosted by one gay female comic, perform hilarious half-hour sets.

title: Brassic
description: In a small town in Northern England, slacker Dylan must choose between the love of his life and his inseparable gang of deadbeat mates.

title: Brave New Jersey
description: On the night of Orson Welles’ famous “War of the Worlds” radio hoax, life-changing events unfold for citizens of a small town, preparing for the end.

title: Braving Rapids
description: While on a river rafting trip, a family grieving a great loss finds a wolf pup and works to get it to safety from thieves.

title: Bravo! Common Men, Uncommon Valor
description: Fourteen Marines and one Corpsman relive their journey from enlistment through the epic 77-day Siege of Khe Sanh during the Vietnam War. Just boys in 1968, they recount their ferocious experience in that wet and isolated battleground, fighting fear and the enemy only to return to a nation at odds with this controversial war. Still today, the Khe Sanh experience simmers just beneath their skin.

title: Brazen Hussies
description: Maureen Hardcastle is furious when her husband Jimmy brings in strippers to boost their pub takings. But on the opening night, she is reunited with her long-lost schoolfriend (the star act) and her boyfriend/manager Billy Bowmans. Then Maureen inherits a fortune and turns the tables on the men by hiring male strippers. Billy has no intention of taking it lying down.

title: Breach
description: An edge-of-your-seat sci-fi thriller with an (inter)stellar cast starring Bruce Willis (Die Hard), Cody Kearsley (Riverdale) and Thomas Jane (The Mist). Set in the near future, a spaceship with survivors flees a devastating plague on planet Earth. But the ship has a stowaway: a shape-shifting alien whose goal is to kill. Clay and his team of mechanics are picked to maintain the interstellar ark.

title: Breach
description: Filmmaker Jonathan Zwick exposes Iceland's continued participation in commercial harvesting of the endangered finback whale.

title: Breach of Faith: A Family of Cops II
description: A Catholic priest’s murder in an Eastern European community triggers a face-off between a Milwaukee police chief and his sons and the Russian mob.

title: Break
description: A pool player wasting his talents for a life of crime gets a wake-up call from his jailed father to go pro as a player and leave lawlessness behind.

title: Breaker
description: A troubled young veteran returns to his rural home and forges a bond with a hermit rancher, who offers him refuge from his dysfunctional family.

title: Breaker Morant
description: During the Boer War, an English-Australian lieutenant is tried for war crimes after executing captured Boers and a German missionary.

title: Break Even
description: Scuba-diving pals think they hit the jackpot when they find $50 million in cash, unaware that a crooked DEA agent and drug lord aim to reel them in.

title: Break Every Chain
description: Faced with the threat of losing his family and his job as a police officer, a depressed man turns to faith to find hope and redemption.

title: Breakfast of Champions
description: On the brink of suicide, a self-made family man gains a new sense of faith after meeting a down-and-out, borderline psychotic science fiction writer.

title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
description: When a greedy developer tries to demolish a San Francisco community center, the best way for these fly kids to fight the power is to bust a move.

title: Breaking Brooklyn
description: A 12-year-old dancer and his brother are rescued from the streets by an old showman who takes them to live with his estranged former dancing partner.

title: Breaking & Exiting
description: An act of burglary leads to a path of self-discovery when a charming house thief saves his victim from herself and they fall in love.

title: Breaking Fast
description: A devout Muslim living in West Hollywood makes an unexpected connection with an actor during the holy month of Ramadan.

title: Breaking Infinity
description: A scientific researcher who has become unstuck in time must figure out what happened to him and stop the coming end of the world.

title: Breaking Legs
description: A high school freshman joins her new school’s dance group, but when the team captain’s boyfriend falls for her, there’s a new battle to be won.

title: Breaking News
description: O What happens when you are the "new hire" in a world as competitive as tv news? "Ultima Hora" newscast will give a lot to talk about and to laugh about. Erika will face new challenges leaving her colleagues amazed and furious; while the envious will claim they deserve the position and will not give up until they get it.

title: Breaking Pickleball
description: Breaking Pickleball is the story of the Arizona Pickleball League, which took place in Spring 2023.

title: Breaking Point
description: Two estranged brothers reunite after their mother’s death to chase a shared dream: making the UK breakdance team for the World Championships.

title: Breaking Spirits
description: When an exchange student from China is bullied by the girls at school, she receives unexpected help from a classmate with a dark gift for vengeance.

title: Breaking Surface
description: During a dive on a remote part of the coast in Norway, two sisters' lives fall into danger when a rockfall traps one of them on the ocean floor.

title: Breaking Wind
description: This raunchy, irreverent parody of the Twilight Saga is filled with vain vampires, horny werewolves, and plenty of paranormal hijinks.

title: Break Night
description: Serving life in prison, a safecracker can earn his freedom by pulling off a near-impossible job for a shot-caller looking to consolidate his turf.

title: Breakout
description: Having taken control of a maximum security prison, a criminal mastermind faces off against a Black Ops agent who is visiting his incarcerated son.

title: Break Point
description: A sibling comedy about two brothers at a crossroads who reunite to attempt the impossible and make a grand slam at a tennis tournament.

title: Breakthrough: Women Changing the Game
description: Breakthrough: Women Changing the Game follows a diverse group of female athletes through make-or-break seasons in traditionally male-dominated sports.

title: Breakwater
description: A young ex-con risks his newfound freedom to track down the estranged daughter of a fellow inmate, and unknowingly brings a devil from her past straight to her doorstep.

title: Breath
description: Breath follows two teenage boys, hungry for discovery, in mid-70s coastal Australia, who form an unlikely friendship with an enigmatic man and his wife, who push them to take risks that will have a lasting and profound impact on their lives.

title: Breathe
description: Breathe is an Indian drama that explores the lives of ordinary men faced with extraordinary circumstances. Kabir, a brilliant but non-conventional officer of the Crime Branch, puts the pieces together of seemingly unconnected deaths of organ donors that lead up to an unlikely suspect - the affable Danny. Kabir will not stop till he cracks the case and delivers justice.

title: Breathe: Into the Shadows
description: A 6-year-old girl is kidnapped and the kidnapper has an unusual request; a father's love is subjected to a cruel test as a ruthless policeman is determined to find the truth.

title: Breathing Fire
description: A Vietnam veteran with two kids leads a bank heist that ends up killing one of his war comrades, leaving him to protect the murdered man’s daughter.

title: Breathing In
description: On a dark and stormy night during the last bitter days of the Anglo-Boer War, a gravely wounded Boer General is nursed by an herbalist with powers.

title: Breath of Life
description: Timi, a gifted clergyman turns into an old lonely curmudgeon when his family is tragically taken from him. Until Elijah, a humble man with big dreams of becoming a priest, comes into his life. Through Elijah, Timi not only learns to live again, but also realizes purpose for all his gifts and wealth.

title: Breeder
description: A woman discovers a cosmetics firm with an underground facility where bio-hacking experiments are performed on women to extract valuable DNA.

title: Breed of Greed
description: After its patriarch's odd death, a pharma family falls prey to an ancient curse. As the outsider in the dynasty, Henry (Andrew Boszhardt) must battle his ruthless stepmother (Gina Gershon), who is under the influence of a demon that feeds on greed.

title: Breezy
description: Clint Eastwood directs this story of a disillusioned businessman who tries to isolate himself at his beach house but is unable to turn away a free-spirited girl who appears on his doorstep.

title: Brendan Smyth:  Betrayal of Trust
description: Father Brendan Smyth evades detection as a child abuser for 30 years, thanks in no small part to collusion with the Abbot-General of the Norbertines.

title: The Lithium Conspiracy
description: Giulio, torn between a demanding wife who left him and a job that seems to have no future after a banking merge, is being practically pushed on a plane to a place called Queimada in South America, which hides the largest lithium deposit in the world. He's given no information on what he should be doing with the cryptic statement "the less you know, the better..."

title: Brewster’s Millions: Christmas
description: BET+ ORIGINAL. With her assets frozen, wealthy heiress Monica Brewster must complete unusual tasks from her late Uncle Monty's will to prove she's worthy of her inheritance by Christmas Eve.

title: Brexit Means Brexit: The Unofficial Version
description: A filmmaker’s year spent in the United Kingdom after the 2016 Brexit vote as the political battle being waged for Britain’s soul may turn disastrous.

title: Brian Cox: Life Of A Universe
description: inspiration from the southern sky as he travels around Australia, renowned physicist and television personality Professor Brian Cox ponders the big questions about the universe.

title: Brian Eno 1971–1977: The Man Who Fell To Earth
description: A first-of-its-kind retrospective about one of the most influential singers, composers, producers and visual artists in the history of modern music.

title: Brian Gaar: Jokes I Wrote At Work
description: In his first hour-long comedy special, Twitter sensation Brian Gaar tackles everything from the challenges of fatherhood to trying to keep his gamer cred in his 30s. Filmed live at the Spider House Ballroom in Austin, Texas.

title: Brian Simpson: Live from the Mothership
description: From embracing his inner hater to the rigid rules of masculinity, comedian Brian Simpson goes full throttle in this unfiltered stand-up special.

title: Brian Wilson: Long Promised Road
description: Brian Wilson: Long Promised Road is a deeply personal documentary that explores the life and career of Brian Wilson, the legendary songwriter and cofounder of the Beach Boys, through a literal and metaphorical road trip across Los Angeles, Brian's hometown.

title: Bridal Boot Camp
description: When a young woman attends a bridal camp to prepare for her wedding, she meets a handsome delivery man and begins to question her engagement.

title: Bride of Frankenstein Awakens
description: A grieving newlywed turns to the occult to revive his dead bride, but his desperate act unleashes a deadly force beyond his control

title: Bride of Scarecrow
description: Una presentadora de radio fallida descubre que ha heredado una granja, solo para descubrir que la tierra está maldita hasta la muerte.

title: Bridesmaids
description: Maid of Honor Annie leads four wild bridesmaids on a hilarious ride to their friend's wedding.

title: Bridge of Dragons
description: A tough mercenary falls for a rebellious princess, and together they join forces to take down a power-hungry general with plans to rule the country.

title: Bridge of the Doomed
description: Holding a bridge during a zombie outbreak proves to be deadly for a group of soldiers.

title: Bridge to Terabithia
description: A fifth-grader and the new girl in his class create their own magical world, where they can explore and reign as king and queen each day after school.

title: Brigham City
description: Sheriff Wes Clayton is also a Mormon bishop in a picturesque little burg called Brigham City whose residents are stalked by an unknown serial killer. This mystery will keep you on the edge of your seat until the shocking final twist.

title: Brightheart: Let Your Light Shine
description: A popular firefly is the hero of her town until an equally attention-grabbing robot visits the village and captivates the locals with stories.

title: Brightheart 2: Firefly Action Brigade
description: Brightheart and her insect buddies form the Firefly Action Brigade just in time to protect and serve their village, when an alien spacecraft lands.

title: Bright Hill Road
description: A troubled woman with substance abuse issues stemming from a tragic past confronts her inner demons during a stay at a mysterious boarding house.

title: Bright Sky
description: Maria and her son flee a dangerous past to start anew, healing with a pastor's help as romance blooms with an outlaw seeking redemption.

title: Bright Young Things
description: A look into the dramatic and cosmopolitan lives of young Londoners who kept the 1930’s tabloids running with their posh lifestyles and wild ways.

title: Brimstone Incorporated
description: Three diabolical tales of terror.

title: Brina
description: Young Inncocent lahula's mother mathru and elder sister rajjo have multiple husbands at the same time.Illegal but socially accepted polyandry is practiced in their community for varios socio-economic reasons.Multiple brother share one woman as their wife and she is supposed to sexually oblige all of them in equal manner.

title: Bring Him Back Dead
description: After a heist goes wrong, a team of violent thieves gets sent to track down and eliminate the man who betrayed them and ran off with their loot.

title: Bring Him to Me
description: Under orders from a ruthless crime boss, a getaway driver must battle his conscience and drive an unsuspecting crew member to an ambush execution. There is a long drive ahead.

title: Bringing Back Christmas
description: Guided by a sassy angel, a dad who was fired before his son’s pricey surgery embarks on a heartwarming journey to witness the First Family Christmas.

title: Bring It On
description: The Toro cheerleading squad has spirit, spunk, sass and a killer routine that's sure to land them the national championship trophy for the sixth year in a row. But for newly-elected team captain, Torrance (Kirsten Dunst), the Toro's road to cheer glory stumbles when she discovers their perfectly choreographed routines were stolen from a hot hip-hop squad across town. Now the squad must scramble to find a new routine to compete in this year's competition.

title: Britain at Low Tide
description: Every day, on a sandy beach or a rocky foreshore, fascinating evidence of British history appears and disappears as the tide rolls in and rolls out again. Dr. Tori Herridge and her crack team of archaeologists explore sea beds and sand banks to discover all the bits of history found on Britain's shoreline, including shipwrecks, prehistoric stone forts, and medieval villages.

title: Britain's Best Home Cook
description: This is the ultimate immersive cooking competition with home at its heart, bringing passionate home cooks from across the country together while they compete for the crown. From South Wales to Glasgow and from Salford to Kent, the 10 home cooks will leave their own homes from around Britain to live under the same roof during the competition.

title: Britain's Darkest Taboos
description: A powerful true crime series that recounts sickening acts of violence between those closest to each other.

title: Britain's Secret Islands
description: Join Stewart McPherson on a journey around the UK to discover the history, wildlife, cultures, and landscapes of the most spectacular British Isles.

title: Britannia
description: Britannia begins in 43AD as the Roman Army, determined and terrified in equal measure, returns to crush the Celtic heart of Britannia –a mysterious land ruled by wild warrior women and powerful druids who can channel the mysterious forces of the Underworld. Arch Celtic rivals Kerra (Kelly Reilly) and Antedia (Zoë Wanamaker) must face the Roman invasion led by the towering figure of Aulus Plaut...

title: Britney Spears: Breaking Free
description: In this documentary, follow Britney and her legal battle with her father, as she fights to end her conservatorship and regain control of her life.

title: Britney Spears: Fighting for Freedom
description: A look at the resilient pop star's courtroom battle for her personal autonomy and the role of the #FreeBritney movement in supporting her journey.

title: Brittany Runs a Marathon
description: Hilarious and outgoing, Brittany Forgler, is everybody’s best friend - except her own. Her partying, underemployment and toxic relationships are catching up with her. Too broke for a gym and too proud to ask for help, Brit is at a loss, until her neighbor pushes her to run one sweaty block. Soon, she sets an almost unthinkable goal: the New York City Marathon.

title: Brittown
description: The second award-winning motorcycle movie from the directors of infamous biker documentary Choppertown... A modern-day homage to On Any Sunday, Brittown features Meatball from the Hell On Wheels bike shop in Anaheim, CA. As a master mechanic, vintage Britbike connoisseur and motorcycle racer, Meatball splits his time between family, his shop and his rock band Smiling Face Down. Join Meatball for several months as he runs his old BSA in vintage motocross races, hits the desert with the No Gooders bike club, flies down the Willow Springs straightaways on his Norstar, and uses all his skill to rebuild a vintage 650 Triumph Bonneville motor into a blazing road-ready screamer. Featuring an insider's view of the SoCal Britbike culture including vintage motocross, dirt track, road racing, custom street bikes, and even a wild vintage lingerie beauty contest! Brittown is a ride you won't soon forget.

title: Broadcast
description: A seemingly harmless kid’s toy tells the story of mankind’s fate with an anti-aging drug while revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

title: Broadcast Signal Intrusion
description: In the late '90s, a video archivist unearths a series of sinister pirate broadcasts and becomes obsessed with uncovering the conspiracy behind them.

title: Broadway Limited
description: A borrowed baby used for a publicity stunt aboard a long-distance train creates a world of trouble for a high-strung film director and his leading lady.

title: Broadway Rising
description: Directed by Emmy-nominated Amy Rice, Broadway Rising is an inspiring documentary that chronicles the reopening of Broadway after the COVID-19 shutdown. The film turns the spotlight on the community and highlights their stories of doubt, anxiety, perseverance and ultimately triumph on the long-awaited opening night.

title: Brotherhood
description: Brotherhood is a potent, fiery drama which explores what happens when you add same-sex attraction to the already volatile world of neo-Nazis.

title: Brody Stevens: Live from the Main Room
description: Comic Brody Stevens takes the stage to humor audiences at the World-Famous Comedy Store on Sunset Boulevard in West Hollywood, California.

title: Broken
description: A woman goes to England in search of a new life. She takes a job caring for a tetraplegic, but the burden of the work stirs up painful memories.

title: Broken Diamonds
description: A young writer’s dream of moving to Paris is put in jeopardy when he's forced to temporarily take in his wildly unpredictable, mentally ill sister.

title: Broken Glass
description: Adaptation of Arthur Miller's play set in Brooklyn 1938, focusing on the marriage of Sylvia and Phillip Gellburg against the backdrop of Kristallnacht in Nazi Germany.

title: Broken Horses
description: Set in the shadows of the US-Mexico border gang wars, story is an epic thriller about the bonds of brotherhood, the laws of loyalty, and the futility of violence.

title: Broken Lullaby
description: An orphan’s quest to trace her past begins with a childhood photo of herself beside a rare Faberge music box and leads to a seductive treasure hunter.

title: Broken Rage
description: A seemingly unremarkable man but actually a hit man called “Mouse” is caught by the police. In exchange for his freedom, he goes undercover, infiltrates a drug ring, and arranges a fake deal, but an unexpected turn of events occurs... Director Takeshi Kitano presents a two-part film: a serious yakuza action and a self-parodying comedy of the same story. What is the fate of "Mouse"?

title: Broken: The Incredible Story of Brangelina
description: From the public fascination to the sudden split, this doc explores the enigmatic relationship of Hollywood power couple Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie.

title: Broken Vows: Stories of Separation
description: A captivating documentary that steps into the shoes of women experiencing separation and who have been caught in the crossfire of marriage breakdown.

title: Bromates
description: Jonesie and Sid both break up with their girlfriends at the same time and move in together in an attempt to help each other through their breakups.

title: Brooklyn Love Stories
description: This feature combines six short films made by talented up-and-coming filmmakers, all connected by the desire to be loved in a turbulent world.

title: Brothel
description: After her lover commits suicide, Julianne runs away from her life in the city and moves to the small ghost town of Jerome, Arizona. She purchases an abandoned brothel from the turn of the century, and sets to work turning it into a hotel; but in the process of restoring the past, she comes to know the ghosts of the brothel.

title: Brother
description: Clement Virgo's stirring drama Brother is a soulful meditation on wounded masculinity, fractured identity and the power of family. Unfolding across three timelines, from childhood to young adulthood, the film explores the fluctuating relationship between two Jamaican-Canadian brothers (played by Aaron Pierre and Lamar Johnson), united by love but drawn apart by circumstances.

title: Brother Future
description: A selfish teen who is hit by a car while fleeing from the police wakes up as a slave on a 19th century plantation and must learn how to get back home.

title: Brotherhood of Blood
description: In a rescue attempt of one of their own, a team of vampire slayers infiltrate the claustrophobic quarters of an undead lair to battle a reborn demon.

title: Brotherly Love
description: A teen basketball star faces pressure to make it big, while his twin sister embarks on a risky romance and their brother is drawn into a street war.

title: Brother Orange
description: Matt Stopera’s stolen phone leads to a viral story and an unexpected friendship with “Brother Orange” in China. Their media-fueled bond transcends cultural barriers, strengthening their lifelong friendship.

title: Brothers
description: As Marine Captain Sam Cahill prepares for a tour of Afghanistan, his wayward brother Tommy is released from jail for armed robbery. Leaving behind his beloved wife Grace and two daughters. Same departs, but an attack by insurgents leaves him missing and presumed dead. Struggling with her grief, Grace finds comfort in Tommy's company.

title: Brothers
description: Brothers tells the story of a reformed criminal (Josh Brolin) whose attempt at going straight is derailed when he reunites with his sanity-testing twin brother (Peter Dinklage) on a cross-country road trip for the score of a lifetime. Dodging bullets, the law, and an overbearing mother along the way, they must heal their severed family bond before they end up killing each other.

title: Brothers in Arms
description: The cast of the Oscar-winning Vietnam War film “Platoon” talk about making the film under director Oliver Stone’s hyper-realistic drills and realism.

title: Brothers' Nest
description: With their mother dying of cancer, two brothers take extreme measures to keep their stepfather from ending up with what they see as their inheritance.

title: Brothers of the West
description: An unusual set of tire tracks is the only clue a range detective has to prove his brother’s innocence for the robbery and murder of a bank president.

title: Brothers of the Wind
description: After discovering a struggling baby eagle, a boy helps nurture the animal and teaches it to fly, forming an unforgettable bond between them.

title: Brothers O'Toole
description: A pair of ne'er-do-well brothers turn a sleepy mining town upside down in their search for quick riches in this classic Western genre send-up.

title: Brothers: The Series
description: A Western in the Antarctic? That's finally something new! In the post-apocalyptic web series, a rising tale of suspense and surprising twists tells a story that keeps the viewer in suspense.

title: Brown Girl Begins
description: On an island off the coast of a walled-off Toronto in 2049, a young woman must harness the power of Caribbean spirits in order to save her people.

title: Brown Paper Bag
description: In 1940 Hollywood, a blacklisted Black actor’s only hope of getting his dream back is to find a missing girl and bring her back to a studio boss.

title: Bruce Lee: The Way of the Warrior
description: Experience the enduring legend of the Hollywood icon and martial arts pioneer through the eyes of co-stars, longtime friends, and family members.

title: Bruce Springsteen: Born to Rock
description: Bruce Springsteen's journey from the Jersey Shore to global fame, capturing the American dream through his music.

title: Bruce Springsteen: Glory Days
description: Bruce Springsteen, more fondly know as "The Boss" by his millions of fans, is widely regarded as one of the most influential songwriters of the 20th century and one of the greatest artists of all time. This is his remarkable story.

title: Bruce Springsteen: MTV Unplugged & Uncut
description: In 1992, Bruce Springsteen took the MTV Unplugged stage, debuting 'Red Headed Woman' and delivering his first recorded performance of 'Light of Day.'

title: Brüno
description: When clueless homosexual fashionista Bruno, the presenter of Funkyzeit (the most popular fashion programme in every German-speaking country apart from Germany), is effectively banned from Europe following a disastrous incident at a show, he sets his sights on America.

title: Bruno Sammartino
description: The story of the World Heavyweight Championship wrestler whose career served as tribute to his mother who escaped the Nazis in World War II Italy.

title: Brutus vs Cesar
description: Faced with the tyranny of Caesar who acts as absolute master over Rome, Senators Rufus and Cassius form a plot to assassinate him.

title: Bryan Callen: Complicated Apes
description: Bryan Callen records his third special in Chicago's historic Thalia Hall and reconsiders our debate on all things equality. He rails against our tendencies to turn each other into nouns like black, white, immigrant, Muslim, gay, straight, man, woman, and instead suggests that the best way to navigate our current culture war is to think of our fellow humans not as a fixed label, but as verbs.

title: Bryan Callen: Man Class
description: In his first one-hour comedy special Bryan Callen gives his unique take on how to be a real man in modern society.

title: Bryan Callen: Never Grow Up
description: The comedian examines the way our modern culture works, and wonders why we feel the need to view each other in such a narrow box.

title: Bubble Bip
description: The hilarious adventures of Bubble Bip, a video game hero who slings bubbles at sassy squids, and the zany group of Earth kids he makes friends with.

title: Buckjumping
description: Welcome to the vibrant culture of present day New Orleans, Louisiana. Where local dancers embody the city’s bold and brilliant essence.

title: Buckley's Chance
description: A boy learns that he may feel lost, but he can be found after his dad dies and he’s sent to live with his grizzled grandpa in the Australian Outback.

title: Buckskin
description: Set in 1820, the tale of a Texan fur trapper follows his journey into the mysterious Buckskin woods, where he hopes to rescue a young boy who is lost.

title: Buckskin Frontier
description: A battle for control over a mountain pass plays out between a railroad surveyor and a freight company owner and a daughter caught in the middle.

title: Buddy Goes to Nollywood
description: During ten days in Africa, an out-of-work British entertainer seeks his fortune in one of the largest but least known movie industries in the world.

title: Buddymoon
description: When his fiance dumps him, David and his impossibly upbeat best man go on the honeymoon together: a backpacking trip through the Oregon mountains.

title: Good Night, Said Miss Bird
description: Un adulterio, un secreto de familia, un asesino en serie. Una historia hecha con la estructura de las muñecas rusas y al ritmo de las montañas rusas.

title: Buffalo '66
description: Billy Brown just got out of jail. Now he’s going to serve some real time. He’s going home.

title: Buffalo Bill, Hero of the Far West
description: The scout is sent by President Grant to put out a frontier fire started by cavalry men trading whiskey and weapons with Yellow Hand’s tribe.

title: Buffalo Girls
description: Based on Larry McMurtry's best-selling novel, which celebrates the bold escapades of the legendary Calamity Jane and her illustrious cohorts.

title: Bug
description: Una muchacha quiere deshacer el supuesto agravio de que su abuelo, un sheriff retirado, quizá cometió y encubrió un asesinato racial hace años.

title: Bug Buster
description: After killer cockroaches invade a lakeside community, it’s up to a sheriff, doctor, and a former military man to destroy the mutant insects.

title: Bugged
description: A group of exterminators faces off against colossal critters after unwittingly spraying their client’s home with a genetic mutating agent.

title: GadgetGang in Outer Space
description: After crash landing on Earth, a group of funny aliens discovers the wonders of the new planet, until they realize the whole galaxy is in peril.

title: Bug Man
description: After enduring a lousy breakup on the side of an Oklahoma highway, a young man moves into a 1968 VW Beetle with 8-foot spider legs.

title: Building a Bridge
description: Follows the journey of Father James Martin as he fights to make the Catholic Church more accepting of the LGBTQ+ community despite opposition.

title: Building Burma's Death Railway: Moving Half the Mountain
description: Moving Half The Mountain documents the true stories of the survivors from one of the worst atrocities of the Second World War the brutal use of prisoners (POWs) and forced local labour by the Japanese to build a railway linking Thailand to Burma. These men are now in their twilight years but their memories are as clear as though it were yesterday.

title: Building the Impossible
description: Presenter Rob Bell is on a voyage of discovery, taking him from the lighthouses of Britain and America through the storms of the North Sea to the tropics of Panama and the dust of the Mojave desert. This series he's uncovering extraordinary feats of human ingenuity and exploring some of the wonders of the engineering world.

title: Built To Win: John Surtees
description: Explores the career of John Surtees, a champion on both two and four wheels who made history when he won the Isle of Man TT three times in a row.

description: When an officer with the Department of Homeland Security is murdered in broad daylight, LAPD detective Mark Meachum is recruited to a secret task force, alongside undercover agents from all branches of law enforcement, to investigate. But the hunt for the killer soon uncovers a plot far more sinister than anyone could have imagined, kicking off a race against time to save a city of millions.

title: Countdown to War
description: Following the German invasion of Czechoslovakia in 1939, European leaders plot strategies to determine the next moves of both their allies and enemies.

title: Counterplot
description: Hiding out in Puerto Rico from a murder rap and double-crossing lawyer in New York, Brock Miller Brock concocts a plan to catch the real killer.

title: Count Me In
description: This documentary features some of rock's greatest drummers as they come together in an inspiring rhythmic journey about the power of human connection.

title: Country Brawlers
description: A raw documentary following Appalachian boxers using the sport to fight addiction, poverty, and reclaim purpose.

title: Country Buck$
description: Starring the Busbice family who founded Wildgame Innovations, a small hunting gear business that has grown into a multi-million dollar wildlife sporting empire.

title: Country Christmas Album
description: A country singer who puts her family before her career opens her heart to new love through a Christmas collaboration with a former pop star.

title: Country Crush
description: When a small-town mechanic meets an aspiring country singer, is it love at first sight, or a fleeting attraction between people who are out of tune?

title: Country Gold
description: Rising 80’s country star Troyal Brux is invited by his idol George Jones to Nashville for one crazy night of conversation, gunslinging and body work.

title: Country: Portraits of an American Sound
description: Embark on a visual odyssey through the history of country music as told by legendary artists and captured by elite photographers over 90 years. From the Carter Family to Taylor Swift, the film chronicles country's rise from regional sound to international phenomenon as seen in the evolving image of the country singer—from rhinestone cowboy to pot-smoking outlaw to stadium-filling megastar. The film features never-before-seen photographs, footage and interviews with over 20 artists including Rosanne Cash, Merle Haggard, Lyle Lovett, Charley Pride, Kenny Rogers, LeAnn Rimes, The Band Perry, Tanya Tucker and Keith Urban. Featured imagery and commentary come from Grand Ole Opry photographer Les Leverett, iconic music photographers Henry Diltz and Raeanne Rubenstein, celebrity portraitist Leigh Wiener, documentarian Henry Horenstein, and contemporary shooters David McClister and Michael Wilson. The soundtrack includes songs and music by Hank Williams, Willie Nelson, Dolly Parton and more.

title: County Line
description: When his brother in blue is gunned down, a retired sheriff investigates the murder and finds himself ensnared in a deadly web of corruption.

title: County Line: All In
description: The murder of a crooked attorney on the county line forces two neighboring sheriffs to put aside their differences to take down the killer.

title: County Line: No Fear
description: In his last job before retirement, Sheriff Alden Rockwell teams up with a fellow lawman for a battle to take down a powerful criminal organization.

title: Coup de chance
description: Trouble awaits a young wife when she accidentally bumps into a former high school classmate and finds herself growing closer to him.

title: Coupled Up for Christmas
description: Hoping to reunite with her longtime crush, Tiffany joins forces with heartbroken Peter in order to win back the hearts of their respective soulmates.

Strangers at first, they form a practical partnership that slowly turns into deep love. As career ambitions and independence test their bond, they learn that love isn't just passion, it's endurance, choice, and growing together through life's challenges.

title: Coupling
description: Three beautiful women plus three sex-crazed men, equal one hot, sexy, comedy.  Sex is the main topic of conversation almost all the time!  And they discuss it in the funniest ways you can imagine. These thirty-something friends always seem to end up in some of the most embarrassing situations ever shown on television.

description: When a teenager's Italian boarding school falls to the Germans during World War I, she escapes her captors and flees through the war-torn countryside.

title: Courageous Love
description: A man experiences romance and intrigue while trying to save his struggling family business and falling for an employee while being an undercover boss.

title: Court Cam
description: From alarming outbursts to furious judges, this show gives an in-depth examination of some of the most emotional courtroom moments caught on camera.

title: Courting Anathi

description: A bumbling wedding party must fight like hell when the bride is possessed by Satan (her ex) the night before the wedding.

description: A portrait that shows the spectacular work of Thibaut Courtois to reach the decisive stretch of the season after the serious injury suffered just before the start of LaLiga. We will experience the uncertainty of undergoing surgery, the sacrifice he made to get back to his best, his day-to-day life with Mishel, his children and family, his intense schedule and other previously unknown facets.

title: Coven
description: A coven of young witches faces a power beyond their control when an ancient demon possesses one of them and must be stopped before hell breaks loose.

title: Cover Your Ears
description: A look at how the censorship of music has shaped, not only how we view art and how it’s made but, who we are as consumers and free thinkers.

description: In a broken world struggling to recover from the COVID-19 pandemic, a new super virus that escapes from melting permafrost threatens to destroy the remnants of mankind. An elite special forces group must transport the leading virologist to her lab, where she is on the verge of a groundbreaking discovery. But, the nail-biting journey is filled with danger, zombies and other threats much closer to home.

description: When a local mob boss tries to cheat a young woman out of the gold mine she's inherited, Roy and his pal 'Teddy' Bear ride out to help her.

Lindsay, their neighbor and a veterinarian, tends to Shane's injured horse and the emotional wounds of the father and son.

This proves to be difficult when the line between his fantasy life and reality becomes blurred, and he too finds himself seduced by the charms of Dragonfly.

In Crash Canyon, they meet an eclectic group of neighbours who ended up there the same way that the Wendell's did.

The ransom? The exact amount he is carrying right now. Is this even a real kidnapping—or an elaborate trap?

Discretion is appreciated.” Low on cash and full of naiveté, he decides to go for it. But as the day goes on, it becomes clear that Josef is not who he says, and his intentions are not at all pure. The directorial debut of Patrick Brice and produced by Jason Blum (Paranormal Activity, Insidious) and Mark Duplass (Safety Not Guaranteed), Creep's intense interplay between its two protagonists upends expectations at every turn.

description: A video artist who craves shocking stories realises she has made a mistake when she meets a serial killer in a cabin.

Saul's notoriety incites a mysterious group to unveil the next phase of human evolution.

description: The popular true-crime series featuring the most horrifying crimes Britain has endured, including victim and family interviews, plus new footage.

description: A determined Chicago detective fights to stop a young criminal’s brutal climb through the city’s underworld in this gripping crime saga.

Carroll's younger brother, Army Corporal Greg (Eric Linden) goes AWOL with a goal of locating his sibling's killer.  Greg is known to have had in his possession a list of other researchers involved in the development of the explosive who are in danger.  Both M.I. and a number of enemy agents are after him to obtain the list.

description: When a mountain biker is left injured in a remote valley after a hit-and-run, he awakens to find himself in an old cabin with a deranged young hiker.

title: Crucible of Horror
description: At their limit with the head of their family and his sadistic ways, a mother and daughter make a choice to murder him in cold blood.

After a brutal hazing incident threatens all of Greek Life, they’ll do whatever is necessary to preserve their power and reputation, even if that means seducing the daughter of the Vice President.

title: Cruel Intentions 2
description: In this prequel to the 1999 film, 16-year old Sebastian moves to New York where he first meets his manipulative and beautiful stepsister, Kathryn.

title: Cruel Intentions 3
description: Three ruthless students at a prestigious college take malicious pleasure in ruining the lives of their classmates through a series of sexual wagers.

title: Cruel Peter
description: After his wife's death, an archaeologist and his daughter restore an Italian cemetery, where her effort to reach her mother awakens a dark spirit.

title: Cruel Summer
description: An autistic teenager is tormented by a group of thugs after he ventures out alone for a camping trip after a local girl accuses him of a crime.

title: Cruel & Unusual
description: Wrongly condemned for killing his wife, a man finds himself in a mysterious institution where he is sentenced to relive her death for eternity.

title: Crumb Catcher
description: A newlywed couple’s marriage is tested when two weirdos desperate for business investors crash their honeymoon and won’t take no for an answer.

description: A former Jehovah's Witness investigates the JW claims to welcome those of all races and creeds, while protecting a secret culture of exploitation.

title: Crushed
description: Kate has a huge crush on Jason, her classmate. And as she tries to reunite with him during her senior trip, things get a little messy.
