description: Based on the timeless and much-loved novel by Daniel Defoe, this action-packed adventure follows the thrilling escapades of Crusoe, who embarks on a high-seas adventure and gets shipwrecked on a remote tropical island. As the days stretch into months, Crusoe and his new companion must brave formidable foes and violent marauders in this swashbuckling epic.

title: Crusoe
description: Marooned on a tropical island, a slave trader finds himself hunted by the people he once trapped and sold and whose gods demand a ritual sacrifice.

title: Crutch
description: Behind a facade of suburban perfection, David's home life is falling apart, making him grooming material for his has-been-actor-turned-theater-coach.

title: Massacre at Noon
description: WWII drama about a Serbian city at the epicenter of massacres as a Communist surge vows to kill 100 hostages for every death of German soldiers.

title: Crying Wolf
description: When a local girl meets a gruesome death, the little village of Deddington is descended upon those desperate to kill the werewolves responsible.

title: Cryo
description: Waking from cryosleep in an underground facility, five amnesic scientists face a horrifying truth: a silent killer lurks, potentially among them

title: Cry of Silence
description: Newlyweds' bliss shatters when Maggie disappears in a town haunted by a serial killer. As Frank's frantic search unravels dark truths about her past, Maggie must find her last strength to outwit her captor in a desperate fight for freedom.

title: Cry of the Banshee
description: A high priestess sends a banshee to kill a cruel and corrupt English magistrate leading a crusade to rid the countryside of her kind.

title: Crypsis
description: Friends make a bet to see who can survive camping overnight on an island, where a strange creature spreads terror, and sound is their biggest enemy.

description: Half-man, half-goat-all nightmare. The Goatman has haunted America's dark corners for decades, blamed for deaths, stalking, and terror. Now Eli Watson dives deep into the legend to find out if the killer still walks among us.

title: Crypto
description: In this cyber-thriller starring Kurt Russell and Beau Knapp, a Wall Street banker connects a small-town art gallery to a global conspiracy, putting his own family in grave danger.

title: Crypto Legacy
description: A young man fears his family's farm. He catches a strange shadow creature on video. Unwanted attention builds as the video becomes popular in the surnatural circle. A call is made to the Crypto Hunters, a specialized group of investigators. Will the Crypto Hunters get to the bottom of the mystery. Or will they bring more troubles with them.

title: Crypto Shadows
description: An investigation leads a game developer to face cyberattacks and ominous encounters, turning into a fight for her life and forcing her to take action.

title: Cryptz
description: Things go from bad to worse when aspiring rappers follow a stripper to a mysterious club where the ladies are vampires in disguise.

title: Crystal Skulls
description: It is 2020, and the apocalypse is inevitable. Only the 13th Skull can restore order before the Earth is destroyed from within by their power.

title: Cry Uncle!
description: Directed by Academy Award Winner John G. Avildsen (Rocky), Cry Uncle is a hilarious whodunnit starring Allen Garfield (Nashville) and Paul Sorvino (Goodfellas)!

title: Cry Wilderness
description: A young boy is befriended by a Bigfoot-like creature in the woods and tries to protect him just as his park ranger father looks for an escaped tiger.

title: Drought
description: Este documental explora un pequeño pueblo del norte de México, curiosamente llamado Cuates de Australia, que cada año se ve afectado por la sequía.

title: Castro's Revolution vs. The World
description: From the very beginning until today: an untold story. How, for 60 years, a small Caribbean island became a voice of its own, worldwide told by history's key players in person. 60 years of conflict, negotiations, moments of treason, moments of hope, reconciliation. How Cuba changed the world?

title: Cube
description: Totally unaware of how they got there, a group of strangers wake up in a cubed room inscribed with a cryptic code they must decipher to escape.

title: Cuckoo
description: The proud father of a Midlands family grapples with the chaos following his daughter's marriage to a crazy hippie traveler named Cuckoo.

title: Cuffs
description: A team of under-resourced law enforcers in the seaside city of Brighton, England face daily dangers and verbal abuse, all in the name of justice.

title: Watch Out for Love
description: En una apuesta se ganó una casa hipotecada que esconde un tesoro y se encuentra con que una señorita vive ahí con su madre. ¿Será el amor el tesoro?

title: Cul-de-sac
description: On a small island off the coast of England, two escaped convicts find their hide out in the dank castle of a recluse and his undersexed wife.

title: My Fault
description: Noah must leave her town, boyfriend and friends to move into her mom's new husband's mansion. There, she meets her new stepbrother Nick and their personalities clash from the very beginning. But the attraction they feel will lead them to live a forbidden relationship, where their rebellious and tormented tempers will turn their worlds upside down, making them fall madly in love.

title: Our Fault
description: Jenna and Lion's wedding brings about the long-awaited reunion between Noah and Nick after their breakup. Nick's inability to forgive Noah stands as an insurmountable barrier. He, heir to his grandfather's businesses, and she, starting her professional life, resist fueling a flame that's still alive. But now that their paths have crossed again, will love be stronger than resentment?

title: Your Fault
description: A sequel to the global hit Culpa Mia; the love between Noah and Nick seems unwavering despite their parents’ attempts to separate them. But his job and her entry into college open up their lives to new relationships that will shake the foundations of both their relationship and the Leister family itself. When so many people are ready to destroy a relationship, can it really end well?

title: Culprit
description: After being exonerated on a murder charge, Jack Harris teams up with Lucy, the victim's sister, to find the killer and prove his innocence.

title: Culte
description: In 2001, Isabelle, Raphaël, Karim, and their teams had less than four months to get a new show on the air: Loft Story, a French remake of the Big Brother format. In France, they are the first ones to produce a ‘reality TV’ show and have to invent everything from scratch. Culte is a fictional series inspired by real events.

title: Cult Following
description: When a cult expert and a cinematographer team up for a documentary project that involves unsettling material, hilarious chaos ensues.

title: Cult Girls
description: A young woman grapples with memories and trauma from growing up in an evil cult. She's pulled back into danger when she has to rescue her sisters.

title: Cult of Nightmares
description: In this conspiracy horror film, an insomnia medication with dark ties to the military causes nightmarish side effects with global implications.

title: Cupids on Beacon Street
description: Romance book editor Eve agrees to housesit for her bestselling novelists, sharing the home with Jake, a self-help coach who needs the space to host romantically themed workshops for Valentine's Day.

title: Cup of Cheer
description: A literal run-in between a big-city woman and a small-town grump triggers the start of a Christmas romance exactly like every one you've ever seen.

title: Cup of Love
description: Tasked with inventing a new coffee flavor, Zoe is sent to Colombia where she meets a dashing local grower who insists she help harvest coffee beans.

title: Cup of My Blood
description: A seemingly random accident leaves porn photographer Jack Fender in possession of Christianity's most Holy Relics. He must confront Evil's relentless assault of blood soaked murder, sex, and deceit for the preservation of an entire faith, and his own soul.

title: Cursed
description: In Cursed, viewers are treated to an array of stories -- supplemented by interviews and re-enactments -- told by real people who have been tormented by curses.

title: Cursed
description: An American drifter undergoes a supernatural transformation after stealing from a produce stand in a rural Romanian village.

title: Cursed Bloodlines
description: This series tells the stories of some of history’s most prominent families who seemed to have it all but were plagued by tragedy and misfortune.

title: Cursed: The Bell Witch
description: Cursed: The Bell Witch is a real life, unfiltered investigative series following John Ceallach as he tries to break the curse that promises that the first-born male of each generation will suffer an untimely death and his son is the next in line.

title: Cursed Waters: Creature of Lake Okanagan
description: Hundreds have claimed to see a monstrous form rise from Lake Okanagan's waters. Now, two researchers travel to the remote lake to explore the strange phenomenon-and discover what might still be waiting below.

title: Curse III: Blood Sacrifice
description: A curse that conjures up a machete yielding evil spirit has been placed on the wife of a sugar cane plantation owner who saved a goat during a tribal ceremony of sacrifice.

title: Curse of Aurore
description: A thumb drive uploaded from the Dark Web shows the horrifying fate of three American filmmakers in rural Canada trying to solve a child murder case.

title: Curse of Bigfoot
description: While searching for indigenous artifacts, a high school biology class accidentally unearths a murderous mummified monster and brings it back to life.

title: Curse of Crom: The Legend of Halloween
description: When high schoolers accidentally release an ancient Irish entity into their hometown, they have until midnight on Halloween to stop it.

title: Curse of Mardi Gras
description: A Mardi Gras vacation for three college women from LA becomes a black magic nightmare when they find themselves cursed and stalked by the grim reaper.

title: Curse of Mesopotamia
description: A recurring nightmare about a demon brings together five strangers with ancient doppelgangers for immersion therapy inside a castle in Kurdistan.

title: Curse of the Axe
description: An archaeological discovery threatens to fundamentally upend our understanding of life for Huron First Nations people before the arrival of Europeans.

title: Curse of the Black Widow
description: A private detective named Mark Higbie is on the trail of a murderer whose mutilated and predominantly male victims are found encased in silken cocoons. He eventually tracks the killer's path to Los Angeles, where he discovers her true identity: a woman who was bitten by black widow spiders as a child. However, that's only the beginning of the story.

title: Curse of the Blind Dead
description: Centuries after a satanic group of knights were executed, they return to the woods as undead killers chasing down a father and daughter for revenge.

title: Curse of the Crimson Altar
description: In search of his missing brother, Robert Manning is led to a remote country house that he believes may be tied to the legend of the Black Witch.

title: Curse of the Sin Eater
description: A poor construction worker makes a deal with a dying tycoon to inherit billions, only to discover that the man's terrifying sins have also cursed him.

title: Curse of the Swamp Creature
description: Somewhere in the backwoods swamps of Texas, a group of oil surveyors discover a mad scientist’s lab where he’s engineering a man-alligator hybrid.

title: Curtain
description: A burnt out nurse moves into a new apartment in search of a simpler life. But when her shower curtains begin to disappear through a mysterious portal she discovers there's no such thing as simple in this world, or any other.

title: Curtains
description: Six actresses have been called to an isolated mansion to audition for a movie, but there’s a killer who is determined to kill them all off first.

title: Custer's Last Stand
description: A mystical medicine arrow, the key to a lost gold treasure, is lost in one of many Indian attacks. It is recovered by the only two survivors, a Major and his daughter, who become the targets of those who wish to possess it.

title: Custodes
description: Tasked with appraising the antiques of an old house for her cousin, a young woman uncovers a dark secret during her stay on the estate.

title: Custody of the Heart
description: Claire Raphael (Lorraine Bracco), a successful business woman is suddenly sued for custody of her children by her stay-at-home husband. She soon discovers that in a modern courtroom there are still traditional biases against working mothers.

title: Custom
description: A pair of struggling art house pornographers encounter a mysterious client who offers life-changing money to perform strange rituals on videotape. Featuring Abigail Hardingham (Nina Forever), Rowan Polonski (Kingsman: The Secret Service), and Brad Moore (Gloves off). Official selection at Frightfest, Brooklyn Horror Film Festival and Razor Reel.

title: Cut Poison Burn
description: The 1999 brain cancer diagnosis of a four-year-old boy leads to a brutal battle between his family and the FDA for the right to a proven treatment.

title: Cut Throat City
description: In the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina, four boyhood friends reluctantly accept an offer to pull off a dangerous heist in the heart of New Orleans.

title: Cutting Class
description: When a series of murders occur, all eyes fall on two students: a freshly discharged psychiatric patient and a notorious troublemaker.

title: Cyber Bride
description: A grieving widower hires a tech company to replicate his wife as a cyber human. Their reunion goes awry when she starts to lethally malfunction.

title: Cyberbully
description: When 17-year-old Taylor receives a laptop for her birthday, she immediately signs up to a social networking site used by the students at her high school - only to become the victim of vicious online harassment and bullying that sap her self-esteem and drive her to the brink of suicide.

title: CyberTracker 2
description: Cyborgs who are posing as an agent and his wife start committing murders and are forced to go on the run.

title: Cyborg Soldier
description: A policewoman whose main objective is to apprehend a rebellious, genetically-engineered soldier ends up being  taken on the ride of her life.

title: Cyborg X
description: After a radical weapons manufacturer is taken over by a cyber virus, a group of survivors must fight to save humanity from an army of machines.

title: Cypher
description: "Shoonya Se Shikhar Tak" narrates the inspirational story of a man who was born without hands and overcame plethora of limitations to achieve great things in life. Must watch motivational family film.

title: Cyrano de Bergerac
description: In 1640 France, the charismatic swordsman and poet with the absurd nose sets up an innocent deception to help another woo the woman he loves.

title: Daddy Daughter Trip
description: A struggling inventor is forced to get more inventive than ever when he promises his daughter a spring break vacation that's way beyond his budget.

title: Daddy's Deadly Darling
description: The owner of a roadside diner and his new helper kill people and feed them to pigs.

title: Daft State
description: The mysterious psychological destruction of Easton, who is driven to the edge of sanity, and possible self-harm, by those that love him most... his wife and daughter.

description: The life of an antisocial and widowed grandfather takes on new meaning when he falls in love after being dumped by his family at a hotel for seniors.

And then, after a sold-out show at Chicago's Soldier Field, they called it quits. Now, decades later, the band members finally agree to reveal the truth. This is the story of how an iconic band imploded at the height of its powers.

title: Daisy of Love
description: Daisy De La Hoya has 18 hot guys to choose from, from all walks of life, as she allows them to move into a Hollywood Mansion and fight for her love.

title: Daisy Quokka: World's Scariest Animal
description: Unbearably adorable, eternally optimistic, meet Daisy Quokka (Angourie Rice- Spider-Man: Far From Home) as she prepares to enter the 'World's Scariest Games', a competition reserved for the fiercest creatures in the animal kingdom. With the help of a former champion, a grouchy Saltwater Crocodile (Sam Neill - Jurassic World: Domination) will Daisy prove that champions can come in all sizes?

title: Daisy Winters
description: An eleven year-old girl's unconventional, yet loving relationship with her mother is harshly broken as the girl sets out to find answers.

title: Da Kink in My Hair
description: This hilarious show based on the popular play follows the lives of women in a hair salon. The wonderfully cultural bent is a colorful experience with lessons about love, life and living in modern times.

title: Dakota
description: A passionate Dutch pilot does everything in his power to keep his Dakota plane up in the air when he gets involved with contraband.

title: Dakota Skye
description: A teen cursed with the ability to see the truth becomes apathetic toward life until her boyfriend's best friend arrives and catches her eye.

title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders
description: A magazine editor tries to save his job by planting a female reporter at tryouts for the famed cheerleading squad to dig up dirt for an expose.

title: Dam 999
description: A marine engineer returns to his native village looking for a cure for his son’s diabetes while an evil politician greenlights a sketchy dam project.

title: Damaged
description: When a sadistic murderer surfaces in Scotland; a Chicago police detective joins the hunt in hopes of stopping this ritualistic serial killer before he claims his next victim.

title: Damaged Goods
description: Amanda's life may be falling apart, but she's got it under control. Then her estranged father returns and she finds herself at a crossroads.

title: Damages
description: A rising star lawyer is taken under the wing of the cutthroat senior partner who stops at nothing to win her cases at New York’s Hewes & Associates.

title: Damascus Cover
description: After a mission to smuggle a chemical weapons scientist out of Syria goes wrong, a spy discovers he is a pawn in a much bigger plan.

title: Damon's Revenge
description: A weekend lake house trip brings a group of friends face-to-face with an escaped convict indigenous chief, a copycat killer and a masked stalker.

title: Dana Gould: I Know It's Wrong
description: Dana Gould takes on the absurdities of modern life through a pop-culture obsessed lens. Unapologetic and off-the-wall funny, there's no middle ground in this comedy special filmed at the Neptune Theater in Seattle, WA.

title: Dan August: Once Is Never Enough
description: Lt. Dan August (Burt Reynolds) is a homicide detective in his hometown of Santa Luisa, California. August and his partner Sgt. Wilentz investigate the slayings of two winos who died after drinking poisoned whiskey and the rape and murder of a young woman.

title: Dan Aykroyd Unplugged On UFOs
description: A UFO enthusiast interviews Dan Aykroyd on the subject of extraterrestrials visiting Earth.

description: After falling in love with a dance studio owner, an ex-con begins down the path to turning the wrongs of his past into a new beginning in life.

title: Dance Academy
description: Fifteen-year-old Tara has no idea of the physical rigor and social drama that await her when she's accepted into the dance academy of her dreams.

title: Dance Academy: The Movie
description: In this sequel, a ballet student destined for greatness suffers a crippling injury and embarks on a bold quest toward a near-impossible comeback.

description: Dance Life tracks the remarkable journey of Brent Street Academy students during their senior year, as they strive to become professional, commercial dancers. From perfectionists to prodigies, underdogs to the entitled, everyone's journey is unique.

description: A high school prom goes to hell when the undead rise to feast on teen couples whose only chance for survival are the students who couldn't get dates!

title: Dance Rivals
description: A young dancer relocates and gets noticed by a top dance squad but conflicts with the resident queen, leading to a dance-off between them.

description: This contemporary drama about a company of dancers explores their offstage romantic entanglements which, ironically, mirror the production of GISELLE they are performing.  This is a delicately woven story of love and betrayal.

title: Dance with Death
description: A beautiful society reporter goes undercover as a stripper to investigate a murderer stalking the girls at the strip club.

title: Dancing Pirate
description: When Jonathan Pride, a dance teacher from Boston, wants to visit his relatives, he is kidnapped by pirates and forced to work on their ship.

title: Dancing Through the Snow
description: Ballet teacher Olivia gets more than she bargained for when she casts Lily in The Nutcracker, and finds herself falling for Lily's father Michael. Will Olivia be able to make everyone's wishes come true this Christmas?

title: Dancin': It's On!
description: Against all odds, two rising stars attempt to overcome their own doubts and a number of obstacles to compete in and win a major dance competition.

title: Dan Cummins: Don't Wake The Bear
description: Cummins offers the audience his own brand of odd, featuring his trademark unusual, yet pointed observations, mixed with a slight twist of delusion. Unabashedly tackling any subject from gun control laws to raising a child that is clearly smarter than you, Dan Cummins unloads some of his funniest material to date!

title: Dan Cummins: Get Outta Here; Devil!
description: The podcaster shares outrageous stories of his sexual experience with a banana peel, his dislike of strangers, and how to fix the world.

title: Danger Close
description: Danger Close follows female war reporter Alex Quade's daring missions to tell soldiers' stories during a series of unprecedented embeds with Conventional Forces and US Special Ops Forces at the height of the Wars in Iraq and Afghanistan.

title: Danger! Danger!
description: On a remote island in 1985, adventurer Jonathan Danger is in a race against time and the Soviets to find a lost temple and its portal to the past.

title: Danger & Eggs
description: Danger & Eggs follows the endless adventures of a fearless, teal-haired girl named D.D. Danger (voiced by SNL's Aidy Bryant) and her ever cautious best friend, a giant talking egg named Phillip. Together, join this buddy system as they explore an underground laboratory, meet a tech-savvy raccoon, and find moments of heart in the smallest bite of broccoli.

title: Danger Man
description: John Drake is a special operative for NATO, specializing in security assignments against any subversive element which threatened world peace. The series featured exotic locales from all over the world, as his assignments frequently took him to Africa, Latin America, and the Far East.

title: Danger Mouse
description: Follow the adventures of Britain's greatest secret agent Danger Mouse and his bumbling assistant as they foil the evil plots of enemies and villains.

title: Danger of Entrapment
description: A social media post claiming the disappearance of 11 Black girls lights a fire under community officials to form a task force and uncover the truth.

title: Danger One
description: Two paramedics get a 911 call that leads them to discover a million dollars on a dying man, sending them on a whirlwind adventure through the night.

title: Dangerous Afternoon
description: A boarding house run by a former criminal who's made amends since she's become paralyzed is home to a group of older women - all whom also have criminal pasts. Word soon arrives that a former associate of the housemistress is looking for her - with plans of blackmail.

title: Dangerous Charter
description: The crew of a fishing boat discovers a deserted luxury yacht at sea with a dead body on board. They claim the yacht as salvage, not knowing that a drug smuggling ring has hidden $500,000 worth of heroin on the boat.

title: Dangerous Child
description: Quick to cover for her son's outbursts and disturbing acts of violence, a well-intentioned mother unwittingly sets herself up as the perpetrator.

title: Dangerous Game
description: An LA director working on his latest film, a tale of a crumbling marriage that mirrors his life and the lives of his actors, and pushes his cast to the brink of insanity for his art.

title: Dangerous Love
description: A maniacal killer with a camera begins murdering female members of a video dating club and tapes their deaths.

title: Dangerous Matrimony
description: Starring Emily O'Brien and Rob Mayes. A newly married couple's vacation is derailed when the husband, ultra-successful business tycoon David Dolan, is kidnapped and held for ransom.

title: Dangerous Worry Dolls
description: After finding a box of South American worry dolls, a woman brings them to life to seek revenge on the people who harmed her.

title: Danger Street
description: After the staff at a magazine encounters a revealing photo, they follow the clues, placing their lives in danger to solve a murder mystery.

title: Danger Zone
description: An American engineer, experienced with toxic waste spills, is duped into going to East Africa to try and prevent a potential catastrophic spill. What he doesn't know is that he's being used by unscrupulous businessmen to recover a hijacked load of plutonium for the North Koreans.

title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer
description: Daniel Boone lleva a los colonos a Kentucky, pero debe luchar contra los indios Shawnee, que creen que están allí para robar sus tierras.

title: Daniel Deronda
description: This sumptuous adaptation of George Eliot's last and most ambitious novel charts a love story set in Victorian high society.

title: Daniel Isn't Real
description: After surviving a violent family trauma, a college freshman develops an ill-fated coping mechanism that resurrects an imaginary childhood friend.

title: Daniel's Daughter
description: When a woman learns that her father has passed away, she must confront the past and town she left behind.

title: Daniel's Gotta Die
description: After his father's death, Daniel’s plan to reconnect with his family hits a snag when he discovers they all want to kill him to claim the inheritance.

title: Daniel Webb: Hoe's Parade Live at the Rose Bowl
description: The comic discusses his frustrations with ​​Karen Pence, his loving relationship with his dog, and how jazzed he is to perform at the historic venue.

title: Danika
description: A wife and mother of three lives a wonderful life, until her everyday worries begin to grow and manifest themselves in gruesome, horrific reality.

title: Dan in Real Life
description: A widower finds out the woman he loves is his brother's girlfriend.

title: Dan Levy: Lion
description: Dan Levy works his way from a zebra to a lion in his new special. From his personal trainer texting him at 4am, to watching the movie "Frozen" with his kids at 6am,  to even getting mugged in Beverly Hills, Dan is not afraid to talk about his exhausting life. He also shares his crippling HGTV addiction and what it's like raising a tiny Matthew McConaughey. Bonus: he'll also teach you how to cheat the massage parlor system.

title: Danny Bhoy: Subject to Change
description: The Scottish stand-up comic dazzles a Montreal audience with his one-of-a-kind style of storytelling and self-deprecating sensibility.

title: Danny Boy
description: A highly decorated German shepherd returns from World War II only to be kidnapped by an animal abusing farmer and later face the gas chamber..

title: DannyBoy
description: A stuttering teen struggles to save his demented family while caught in a love triangle between a playgirl and a nerd in 1981 small-town Ireland.

title: Danny Collins
description: An undelivered letter written to him 40 years ago by John Lennon sends a has-been rock and roll icon on a mission to launch his second act.

title: Danny Says
description: A documentary look at punk pioneer Danny Fields, who went from Harvard Law dropout to working with musicians like The Doors, Lou Reed and The Ramones.

title: Danny's Game
description: Out of prison and in debt, a poker pro cons his way into the game of a lifetime with his arch enemy while reuniting with his estranged brother.

title: In the Footsteps of the Roman Legionary
Dante's Hotel
description: When an assailant preys on the guests of a haunted hotel, an event planner teams up with a resident whose dark past is the key to lifting the curse.

title: Dante's Peak
description: Pierce Brosnan and Linda Hamilton star in this adrenaline-pumping adventure about a long-dormant volcano about to erupt with devastating force in the town of Dante's Peak.

description: This comprehensive cinematic portrait of Europe's second-longest river presents scenes of breathtaking beauty along the banks of the Danube and investigates the tension between humans and nature, civilization and wilderness. Dams and power stations alternate with sections of natural wilderness along this mighty river, which flows through great cities such as Vienna and Budapest.

title: Danur: The Last Chapter
description: Chanelle pushed her faithful husband Apollo into risky thrills, only to face the fallout when he builds a second life with a younger woman expecting his child. Torn between pride and investment, she must decide if sharing him is survival or self-betrayal.

title: Dan Vs.
description: A broke misanthrope, convinced the whole world is against him, will go to absurd lengths to take revenge on those that he believes have wronged him.

title: Daphne

It focuses on the most emotionally fraught yet creatively fertile period of the author's life: the years between the Rebecca trial and the writing of her short story The Birds.

title: Dard Divorce
description: What started with a routine divorce between Natalie Stein and her husband Tim, will soon take a turn into the unexpected and evolve into scenes of torture, bloodshed and slaughter.

title: Dare to Say Yes
description: Michelle's fired and dumped in one day. Best friend Sara convinces her to join the "Just Say Yes" wellness retreat.

title: Attack on Darfur
description: Three American journalists who witness atrocities in the Sudan must choose between returning home or staying to help the locals faced with genocide.

title: Dario Orsi - Me Quiero Quejar

description: Master illusionist Derren Brown makes a bet with an esteemed art collector that he can steal a painting — and does so using four law-abiding retirees.

description: Elia K. begins a fantastic journey into the depths of her imagination, where Elías, a playwright, is torn between writing his passion or the producers' pressure to write something with a commercial appeal.

The day she is about to get her dream job, a solar storm destroys all the geostationary satellites, and the world is left without Internet. She has to learn to survive offline and connect with her children.

title: Disconnected 2
description: Your favorite overstimulated family is back! Chile’s favorite manic mother Victoria has swung from one extreme to the other, and is now a full-on helicopter mom. At work, she also lands a coveted opportunity for her to take the kids with her for a new position in Miami. But Julian and Clara aren’t on board to leave their friends behind, and it’s a battle of the wits in this laugh out loud sequel.

title: From Within
description: When a former pro-runner begins working as a drugs mule to pay for her leg operation, she and her best friend are ambushed by two corrupt cops. Now all hell has broken loose and it's up to Doc, a cartel sicario and Sofia's lover, to save their lives.

title: Desire
description: Lucia and Ofelia, two sisters, finally meet after 7 years at Lucia's wedding. But when Juan, Lucia's husband, and Ofelia meet, they feel that a disturbing fantasy has enchanted their minds and bodies... A family story of jealousy, envy, reopened wounds, and forbidden desires.

Diana-mania gripped the crowds down under and the frenzy to see the new royal superstar were like nothing seen before. The initial thrill of it all began to fester into jealousy and disdain. This is the story of those six weeks where the Princess of Wales became the world’s most photographed woman."

Here are the features of a small continent, supporting one of the richest and most diverse ranges of native species on the planet.

description: A psychiatrist is drawn into a complex mind game when he questions a disturbed patient about the disappearance of a colleague.

title: Elephant White

description: In a remote town of Argentina, home remedies replace traditional medicine. All diseases are treated by the villagers except a mortal fear known as espanto, the dread. This rare illness can only be cured by an old man who very few dares to visit. The Dread is an investigative human interest documentary stuffed with strong humor and outstanding protagonists.

description: Patrick Stewart stars as professor Ian Hood, who investigates science related crimes and conspiracies involving deadly virus outbreaks, human cloning & more.

description: The brothers Nikolaj (12) and Emil (8) discover the ghost of a boy who inhabits the bedroom of their new home. With the help of their friend Ximena (12), they will try to help the ghost resolve his pending issue: deliver a love letter to a girl he stopped seeing more than 30 years ago.

description: After Santa Claus is kidnapped by New York mafia members, an eager elf must find the courage to save the most wonderful time of year!

description: Tamara, an edgy feminist philosopher, rediscovers a past she thought she had left behind.

description: Terminal patients, the mentally ill, the elderly, men and women who work facing death and children do not have much in common, but they offer us a different view of the everyday citizen, with such different valuations and perceptions, according to their experiences on what is the end of life for them.

title: Elf in the Hood
description: When a possessed doll wreaks havoc on a couple’s lives, their efforts to pawn it off to someone else prove to be unsuccessful.

title: Elf-Man
description: Super-hero “Elf-Man” helps some kids save their dad’s invention from a bumbling gang of thieves and have the best Christmas ever.

description: In a world where the inexplicable becomes real, this spiritual docu-drama reveals supernatural encounters tied to ancient prophecies, warning of an imminent global event that will change humanity forever.

title: The Man Who Killed Billy the Kid
description: An outlaw made by the act of defending his mother turns into a trigger-happy killer, and it takes a ladylove and a father figure to bring him back.

title: The Love
description: Moroccan-Dutch Karim returns to his family home and opens up to his parents about being into men. Their reaction inspires a journey of discovery.

title: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Justin Jefferson
Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Micah Parsons
description: Eli Manning recruits Micah Parsons to embrace his inner “unc” as he goes undercover as a waiter at a Dallas Cowboys fan event. Nobody knew it at the time, but this would be one of his final acts as a Cowboy.

title: The Boarding School: Las Cumbres
description: After a failed escape attempt, Manuel disappears in the woods at the hands of a mysterious man in a crow mask. Despite being subjected to strict discipline, Paul, Amaia and his other friends never stop looking for him. Their adventures lead to discovering that the old cult that inhabited the woods, the Crow’s Nest, is still committing crimes and Las Cumbres is more than just a school.

title: The Games Maker
description: Young Ivan's newfound love of board games catapults him into the fantastical and competitive world of game invention and pits him against enemies.

title: Eliot Ness vs. Al Capone
description: This doc traces the relationship between America's most infamous gangster and the determined prohibition agent set on taking him down.

title: Elite Force: B.R.I. - Body Recovery Immunisation
description: Homeless ex-soldiers, kidnapped and enhanced by a mad scientist, are sent on missions to destroy global corruption—but soon question their purpose.

title: Elizabeth & Margaret: Amor e Lealdade
description: Queen Elizabeth II and Princess Margaret are among the most photographed women in history. But what of the real women beyond the royal splendor?

title: Elizabeth's Gift
description: After the tragic death of their young daughter, a grieving couple are guided by their faith to a homeless girl in need of a miracle.

title: Elizabeth Smart: Autobiography
description: Elizabeth Smart provides previously untold details about her infamous abduction and nine-month nightmare in the grasps of her cruel captors.

title: Kill the Jockey
description: Argentine filmmaker Luis Ortega (El Angel) is back in the saddle with another offbeat marvel, in which the worlds of sports and crime devilishly collide. As a charmingly deadpan equestrian finds his life run amok, this surreal tale of transformation luxuriates in the unpredictability of life itself.

title: Ella and the Little Sorcerer
description: When Prince Alex gets trapped in the body of a mouse, Ella and her friends set off on a journey to find the magic potion that can change him back.

title: Elle
description: Before Elle Woods was a fish-out-of-water at Harvard, we meet her in 1995 in the tumultuous waters of high school where she encounters tricky friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. In this unexpected chapter of her adolescence, we learn about the experiences that shaped Elle into the iconic young woman we've come to know and love.

title: Elle: A Modern Cinderella Tale
description: Enter a modern fairytale about a girl with dreams of pop music stardom and the record label divas who will stop at nothing to prevent her success.

title: Sarah's Key
description: An American journalist is captivated by a mysterious story involving a little Jewish girl living in France during the height of WWII.

title: Ella Bella Bingo
description: Ella’s envy over her best friend’s desire to play with a new kid leads to his running away - and her bike ride adventure with the new kid to find him!

title: Ellie and Abbie (and Ellie's Dead Aunt)
description: A teenager tries to find the courage to ask her classmate to the formal with the help of a fairy godmother, who also happens to be her deceased aunt.

title: Elliot: The Littlest Reindeer
description: A small but determined miniature horse travels to the North Pole to compete for a spot alongside the famous reindeer that pull Santa’s sleigh.

title: Elliott Morgan: Holy S.
description: In one continuous shot, comedian Elliott Morgan, shares tales of betrayal, stupidity, and brainwashing from inside a historic Los Angeles dive bar.

title: Ellis
description: A British mystery in which Ellis, a top-notch homicide detective and Black woman, solves complex cases drawing on her exceptional insight and the confidence gained from her years of experience.

title: Lute: Forge On or Die
description: First part of the real history of "El Lute", a delinquent who became notorious in Spain for his prision escapes in the 60's, converting himself in a popular legend. Based on real events.

title: El Lute II: Tomorrow I'll Be Free
description: "El Lute" fights tirelessly for his life and his freedom. His dream of living a "normal life" is so powerfull that nothing can stop him. The reunion with his family after escaping from the Puerto de Santa María prison is the beginning of a continuous escape.

title: Ellyas Pical
description: Born on a remote island with economic limitations and physical limitations (due to his damaged hearing from fish bombing), Ellyas lost hope for his future. However, his fighting skills paved the way for Ellyas Pical to become a boxer, starting from an amateur champion to becoming a world champion.

title: Northern Skies Over Empty Space
description: Don Reynaldo is a famous hunter in decline. When his ranch and his father’s legacy are threatened, the dynamic of his relationship with his family, his employees, and land will be dangerously shaken.

title: El Novicio Rebelde
description: Rogelio arrives in the El Milagro neighborhood on the run from a dangerous criminal and takes refuge inside the parish church, where he is mistaken for the new seminarian. Taking advantage of the confusion and fearing for his life, Rogelio plays along, but when he tries to escape, he realizes that not only is it impossible, but he no longer wants to leave.

title: Eloise
description: Four friends break into an abandoned insane asylum in search of a death certificate which will grant one of them a large inheritance. However, finding it soon becomes the least of their worries in a place haunted by dark memories.

title: Elon Gold: Chosen and Taken
description: Elon Gold unleashes his sharp, biting humor in his comedy special Chosen & Taken. His manic wit transcends race and religion to celebrate the absurd things people do.

title: Elon Musk: The Real Life Iron Man
description: Get to know the visionary who changed how the general population thinks about electric cars, the Hyperloop, colonizing Mars, and so much more.

title: The Other
description: Curious Blippi and imaginative Meekah trick or treat at a Halloween house, where they meet a mysterious Halloween King with slimy tricks instead of candy. Now the best friend duo must complete three tricky challenges and restore the candy before Halloween night ends.

title: In the Country of Last Things
description: A young woman ventures into an unnamed metropolis that has collapsed into chaos and disorder to search for her missing journalist brother.

title: El Planeta
description: A daughter forced to return home after the death of her father reconnects with her eccentric mother.

title: El Presidente
description: The story of Jean-Marie Faustin Godefroid de Havelange, also known as João Havelange, one of the most corrupt figures in the history of football.

title: Django the Condemned
description: A gringo outlaw investigates a murder and must find the culprit amidst various suspects.

title: The Fist of Death
description: The masked wrestler Santo has his hands full when a woman steals a powerful star charm from a mystical jungle girl who she also kidnaps!

title: Elsa & Fred
description: After losing his wife, Fred (Christopher Plummer) moves into a nearby apartment building where he meets Elsa (Shirley MacLaine). Elsa bursts into his life like a whirlwind, teaching him that time is precious and that he should enjoy life--and love--to the fullest.

title: Else
description: A romance blossoms between an introvert and a confident woman, but their relationship faces a threat when a strange epidemic causes the infected to merge with their surroundings, trapping the couple in a shapeshifting nightmare.

title: Elsewhere
description: After being evicted from his beloved home, a man sets a desperate plan in motion to get it back, with very unlikely and life-changing results.

title: The Whistler: Origins
description: As in the popular folk tale, a phantasmagorical figure wanders at night, terrorizing the drunk, the unfaithful, and the children, whom he feasts upon.

title: The Silence of Marcos Tremmer
description: Marcos Tremmer is a successful publicist madly in love with his wife Lucía. One day he discovers that he has a cancer that will end his life in a few months

title: Mambo Dreams
description: Perez Prado, the King of Mambo, wakes up in Mexico City in 2020. He is looking for Magdalena, the love of his life. During his adventure he meets Lazaro, a young man who will guide him through the city. He will realize that the nightlife and his music are still alive while he finally finds Magdalena.

title: The Supreme Manuscript
description: An art collector and a literature graduate seek to recover a lost manuscript and are confronted with the secrets of Paraguay’s dark silent past.

title: Treasure of the Four Crowns
description: Adventure of a soldier sent on a dangerous mission to recover a long-lost key essential to unlocking the mystery of the ancient Visigoth crowns.

title: Elton John: A Life in Song
description: Elton John’s career has spanned decades, but his legacy is more than just his music.Reginald Dwight’s early debut was in the band Bluesology - there he would meet lyricist Bernie Taupin whom he would go on to write over 30 albums with. After parting ways with the band and his birth name, the Rocketman was born.

title: Elton John: Music Man
description: Sir Elton John is one of the most successful musicians of the past century, watch as we take a look at the story of one of the worlds greatest ever musicians... Elton John.

title: Elton John: Uncensored
description: Sir Elton John talks to Graham Norton, looking back at his extraordinary life and career of over 50 years. Recorded in Elton's home in the South of France, this film revisits Elton's life: from early days to global superstardom. This special features many classic performances that have soundtracked the unique life of the Rocket Man himself - still standing and on top of his musical game.

title: The Last Suit
description: An 88 year-old Jewish tailor leaves Buenos Aires for Poland where he attempts to find the friend who saved his life at the end of World War II.

title: The Lake Vampire
description: Desperate to find a subject for his next novel, an author follows the tracks of a mysterious killer obsessed with drinking blood and immortality.

title: The Bloody Vampire
description: Count Cagliostro, whose family has tried for generations to rid the world of vampires, instructs his daughter and her fiance to protect several valuable documents.

title: El Vendedor
description: Arturo, a talented salesman, unexpectedly becomes a widower with two kids and feels that all his magic and talent vanished with his wife. Shaken and nearly bankrupt, he'll do whatever it takes to provide for his children, regardless the consequences.

title: El verano que te vimos
description: Tras un año sin verse, un grupo de amigos se reúne para pasar el Año Nuevo en el campo donde aflorarán los problemas y tensiones del pasado.

title: The Night Guard
description: A night guard has to deal with a bizarre and improbable series of events in the most important night of his life.

title: Elvira: Mistress of the Dark
description: With dreams of performing in Las Vegas, a buxom former TV hostess finds herself in trouble when she travels to a small town to claim her inheritance.

title: Elvira's Haunted Hills
description: Spooky high jinks abound when Elvira finds herself spending the night in a mysterious castle en route to 1851 Paris.

title: Elvis & Nixon
description: On the morning of December 21st 1970 the world's biggest star, Elvis Presley (Michael Shannon) arrived on the White House lawn to request a meeting with the most powerful man in the world, President Richard Nixon (Kevin Spacey). Elvis & Nixon tells the astounding true story of this meeting between two men at the height of their powers.

title: Elvis Presley and Johnny Cash: The Road Show
description: Over 30 early performances of Elvis Presley and Johnny Cash as they were taking their first steps on the ladder to stardom.

title: Elvis Presley: From the Beginning to the End
description: Using 42 years of rare footage, this is a warm, moving and sensitive tribute that offers a comprehensive and detailed biography of the King’s life.

title: Elvis Presley: Shook Up
description: Behind the glitz and glamour of rock 'n' roll royalty is the haunting tale of Elvis Presley. Many question his moral fiber and notorious violent temper. Devilish charm dressed in angelic white had friends and fans fooled for too long.

title: Elvis Presley: The Early Years
description: From his humble beginnings in Tupelo, Mississippi, to his journey to international fame, we look back at the early life and rise of Elvis Presley.

title: Elvis & Priscilla: Conditional Love
description: Elvis and Priscilla are one of the most famous couples ever. But the story beneath the glamorous facade is more toxic than what first meets the eye.

title: Elvis: The Vegas Years
description: This documentary examines the complicated story of the King, from hometown glory to international stardom, where the price of fame is high.

title: Elvis' Women
description: The story of Elvis Presley and his legacy, as viewed through the eyes of the many women whose love for the man endures to this day.

title: Ema
description: A shocking incident that upends her family and marriage to a tempestuous choreographer sets a reggaeton dancer on an odyssey of personal liberation.

title: Emancipation
description: Dominik, a man who lost it all, enters a shelter for battered men in Berlin and starts to heal and love again with the help of those around him.

title: Embarrassing Bodies
description: The Embarrassing Bodies doctors offer an innovative way to raise health awareness and de-stigmatise 'embarrassing' body parts and medical conditions.

title: Embarrassing Pets
description: Experts help desperate owners from across the United Kingdom with their beloved pets' embarrassing and out-of-control behavioral issues.

title: Ember Days
description: In a war between spirit kingdoms, two fallen angels do battle on modern city streets and in forests, wreaking havoc to serve a Greek god and goddess.

description: Three children under the care of a new babysitter start to learn very quickly that she’s not there to take care of them and is up to something worse.

title: Emerald Falls
description: After a brutal divorce, a mother and her son relocate to the Blue Mountains to run a Bed and Breakfast.

description: From emotional turmoil in medical conflict to the intrigue of Sicilian mafia activity in collaboration with Mexican cartels, the varied relationships constructed by these engaging storylines make for a lively depiction of a man's exaggerated reality.

title: Emergency

title: Emergency
description: Close-up as the lead trauma services treat critically-injured patients across London

title: Emergency Helicopter Medics
description: Join the members of a medical crew on the biggest air ambulances in the U.K. as they work against the clock to save lives every single day.

title: Emerson Heights
description: An actor in L.A. tries to beat the long-distance relationship curse with his New York girlfriend, especially after he lands a blockbuster movie role.

title: PussyCake
description: A new tour meant to rekindle an all-female rock band’s waning popularity leads them into an abandoned town and down an undead trail of horrors.

title: Emily and the Magical Journey
description: A little girl enters a fantastic world where anything is possible after she finds a magic chest and faces her fears to protect her new world.

title: Eminem: A Shady Story
description: On top of the game since his debut album The Slim Shady LP, this is the story of how a poor white kid from Detroit rose to become a hip hop legend.

title: Eminence Hill
description: Mientras la policía los busca, un forajido y su pandilla se encuentran en una comunidad dirigida por un grupo despiadado de colonos fanáticos.

description: In this mini-series, self-proclaimed matchmaker Emma Woodhouse has much to learn about relationships, especially when she falls in love.

title: Emma
description: In this adaptation of the classic novel, a beautiful woman is happy to play matchmaker, but fails to notice that her own heart has been captured.

title: Emmageddon
description: Struggling screenwriter Emily pens a script about a struggling screenwriter named Emma who is secretly a superhero named Emmageddon.

title: Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas
description: Down-on-their-luck since Pa’s death, Ma and son Emmet both secretly enter a talent show with their eyes on a cash prize to make Christmas special.

title: Empathy, Inc.
description: A VR startup offers users the chance to experience a less fortunate life. But one investor is about to discover the company's true nature.

title: Empire of the Ants
description: An aggressive land developer takes prospective buyers to a reclaimed swamp in the southeast, where they are attacked by huge genetically-mutated ants.

title: Empire Queen: The Golden Age of Magic
description: In a kingdom where magic is forbidden, a charming trio of unlikely adventurers set out on a perilous and playfully lighthearted quest to recover the legendary Sovereign Wand, overthrow an evil queen, and restore magic for all.

title: Employee of the Month
description: Two ultra-competitive Super Club workers vie for the "Employee of the Month" title and to win the heart of the hot new cashier in this outrageous comedy.

title: Employee of the Month
description: After being fired from his new job and dumped by his fiancée (Christina Applegate, "Married with Children"), banker David Walsh (Matt Dillon, "There's Something About Mary") turns to his grave-robbing buddy Jack (Steve Zahn, "War for the Planet of the Apes") for moral support. Soon, heartbreak becomes the least of David's worries.

title: Empty Pocket
description: Two pickpockets take a job stealing from a psychopath for cash, but when the plan unravels, they find themselves hunted and desperate to survive.

title: Empty Space
description: An overweight young man staying with his grandmother after years of bullied rejection meets a young blind girl who shows him love and acceptance.

title: Waiting for Bojangles
description: Set in Paris and the South of France, a young boy recounts the epic love story of his parents, from madcap highs to heartbreaking lows.

title: Enchantimals City Tails Main Street
description: Sage and Patter are reunited with their friends in Wonderwood City, and they've just discovered a whole new place to explore in Main Street! Join the Enchantimals as they encounter a baking showdown, facing fears at the doctors office, baby besties on the loose, and an epic bestie balloon chase!

title: Enchantimals: Finding Home
description: Meet the Enchantimals, a group of lovable girls who share a bond with their animal besties. In "Finding Home," things get a bit wild when the girls discover a lost peacock Enchantimal and her bestie and decide to share their homes with the newcomers.

title: Enchantimals: Secrets of Snowy Valley
description: Pristina Polar Bear embarks on a harrowing search for her missing best friend, Glacier, which leads her to Snowy Valley. There, a freak hot cocoa factory accident threatens to destroy the endangered Key Glacier and Snowy Valley.

title: Enchantimals: Spring Into Harvest Hills
description: When a magical accident keeps Spring from arriving in Everwilde, a series of increasingly fantastical natural calamities threatens the land!  With things getting worse, and time quickly running out, the Enchantimals mount an epic quest for Harvest Hills where they must ask the heart of nature to restart Spring before Everwilde and everyone in it ceases to exist!

title: Enchanting Christmas
description: A father's ice sculpture of a princess magically comes to life and causes unexpected disruptions in the lives of everyone she meets.

title: Enchantment
description: Uncle Rollo finally retires to the house he was brought up in. Lost in thoughts of his lost love, Lark, he does not want to be disturbed in his last days. However, the appearance of his niece and the subsequent romance between her and Lark's nephew causes him to reevaluate his life and offer some advice so the young couple don't make the same mistake he did, all those years ago.

title: Rise
description: Elise thought she had the perfect life: an ideal boyfriend and a promising career as a ballet dancer. It all falls apart the day she catches him cheating on her with her stage backup.

title: Encounter
description: A decorated Marine goes on a rescue mission to save his two young sons from an unhuman threat. As their journey takes them in increasingly dangerous directions, the boys will need to leave their childhoods behind.

title: Encounter
description: A group of friends discover a crashed spacecraft in a rural field and realize the survivor inside holds secrets that could change everything.

title: Encounter Party
description: In this series, seven actors play a Dungeons & Dragons campaign and weave together a story of high fantasy and even higher stakes.

title: Encounters with Evil
description: From serial killers to cult leaders to kidnappers, this series delves into the minds of the perpetrators of the world’s most notorious crimes.

title: Endeavour
description: Spring 1972 brings with it a new start for Morse. His return to CID coincides with a gruesome discovery in a college garden. The investigation leads him and Thursday to a celebrated orchestra and when a second tragedy hits, they uncover a web of secrets at the company’s core. Meanwhile, grisly London business turns up on Oxford’s doorstep when a brutal murder is committed in a derelict warehouse.

title: Closed Season
description: Set in 1942, "Closed Season" tells the story of Fritz and Emma who are hiding Albert, a Jewish refugee at their remote farm in the Black Forest.

title: Ender's Game
description: A talented young man is selected to lead humanity’s fight against a dangerous alien race who is attempting to take over the Earth.

title: Endgame
description: A boy who learned to play chess like his grandfather, a champion in Mexico, joins his school team in Texas and tries to help them win the state title.

title: End Game
description: A secret service agent (Cuba Gooding Jr.) and a news reporter (Angie Harmon) investigate the conspiracy behind the assassination of the President of the United States.

title: Endings, Beginnings
description: En Los Ángeles, Daphne, una mujer de treinta y tantos, navega por el amor y el desamor a lo largo de un año y descubre los secretos de su vida.

title: Endless
description: A heart wrenching romantic drama about two young lovers who must learn how to let go after an unimaginable tragedy happens while they’re dating.

title: End of Loyalty
description: His best friend federal agent is all that’s standing between the son of a murdered crime family boss and bloody vengeance against his killers.

description: Newly widowed, Frank goes on a journey to honor his wife's last wishes of spreading her ashes in a remote lake and taking his estranged son with him.

description: Students uncover art's demand for suffering. As graduation nears, festivities morph into a twisted ordeal, all for in the name of art.

description: A Christian college student, unable to prove the existence of God to a philosophy club, makes plans to get even against the atheists.

description: Is the Great Recession over, or are we headed for a much bigger disaster? A deep dive into the long-term fallout of America’s flawed economic system.

description: Fingers point to a 22-year-old sociopathic farmhand after a family mysteriously disappears from the town of Schafer, North Dakota in the 1930s.

title: End of the World
description: After witnessing a man’s death in a bizarre accident, a priest embarks on a spiritual quest, where he encounters his power-hungry alien doppelganger.

By intercutting exclusive footage with intimate interviews of negotiators, investigators, fixers and even a used car salesman who are caught up in the confusion, we examine the leads that led to lies revealing the terrible consequence of misinformation.

title: End Times
description: An aging survivalist and his helpless suburbanite companion dodge throngs of the undead to reach a safe zone inside a virus-ravaged wasteland.

title: End Times: How Close Are We?
description: A biblical roadmap laying out the ancient prophecies and which ones are left to be fulfilled before the coming of the apocalypse.

title: In the Quarry
description: When a young woman brings her new boyfriend home and introduces him to old friends, tensions build into gender violence and spiral towards murder.

title: Enemies, a Love Story
description: A ghostwriter who survived the Holocaust finds himself romantically involved with his current spouse, a married woman, and his long-vanished wife.

title: Enemigos
description: Chimo turns 18 years and comes from a humble and supportive family. Since childhood he was bullied and even today, while working multiple jobs and dreaming of starting his own business, he continues to face his bully: El Rubio. When Chimo has the opportunity for revenge, he never imagines what begins as an act of retaliation could turn into an unexpected friendship that’ll change both their lives.

title: Enemy at the Door
description: A compelling drama series about life in the British Channel Islands under German occupation during World War II; passionate battles against restraint, pragmatic struggles with principle and internal conflicts rage as fiercely as those on the battlefield. Ultimately, both sides find they are compromised as much by the actions of their compatriots as they are by the enemy that is always at the door.

title: Enemy Lines
description: A group of Allied soldiers has to survive in Nazi-controlled Poland in order to rescue an important scientist who has fallen into German hands.

title: Enemy of the State
description: A man turns on the NSA after being targeted for assignation.

title: Enemy Within
description: In 1941, a Japanese pilot lands on a Hawaiian island. He’s greeted with hospitality, until it’s discovered he was part of the Pearl Harbor attack.

title: En Fin
description: After the Apocalypse doesn't happen, Tomas tries to recover his past life, with little success, while Julia sees in the Non-End of the World a second chance to change her life. Their paths, opposites, will have to converge in the only thing that unites them right now: their daughter Noa.

title: Drawn Together
description: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastián Moore as her bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites between them in a world where nothing is as it seems. Based on the novel by Mercedes Ron, author of the Culpables saga.

title: Once Aurora
description: An award-winning music documentary about Aurora Aksnes, an international pop star since age 16 who struggles with fame and creative demands on tour.

title: Engga Hostel
description: Following the stories of 6 students, Engga hostel explores the relatable and curious life inside a Tamil Nadu engineering hostel.

title: Engineering Giants (2012)
description: How does an oil platform work? What keeps a Boeing 747 up in the air? How big is the engine of a cross channel ferry? This fascinating series strips down and tears apart the world's largest and most powerful machines to probe their hidden secrets and to find out how they have changed our world in their own unique ways. These impressive works are a testament to the ingenuity of modern engineering.

title: Enhanced
description: In order to stop a mutant serial killer from hunting her down, a young woman with enhanced abilities must face impossible decisions to stop him.

title: Shake It All About
description: A man falls for his boyfriend’s sister-in-law. Soon, the two begin a passionate affair which is bound to end with someone’s heart getting broken.

description: When a boisterous Persian family, including a pregnant woman, moves next door to the neighborhood’s grumpy old man, unexpected love and kinship bloom.

title: Entangled
description: After a French woman suffers a miscarriage, she loses her sense of identity. Until one weekend, when a series of chance encounters inspires her.

title: Entanglement
description: In Atlanta, a down-on-his-luck radio DJ gets his heart broken on the air, then as his career rises, meets a caller whom he once gave romantic advice.

title: Enterrados

title: Entertainment

title: Flight from Death: The Quest for Immortality
description: Narrated by Gabriel Byrne (Usual Suspects, Vanity Fair, Miller's Crossing), this seven-time Best Documentary award-winning film (Silver Lake Film Festival, Beverly Hills Film Festival) is the most comprehensive and mind-blowing investigation of humankind's relationship with death ever captured on film. Hailed by many viewers as a "life-transformational film," Flight from Death uncovers death anxiety as a possible root cause of many of our behaviors on a psychological, spiritual, and cultural level. Following the work of the late cultural anthropologist, Ernest Becker, and his Pulitzer Prize-winning book Denial of Death, this documentary explores the ongoing research of a group of social psychologists that may forever change the way we look at ourselves and the world. Over the last twenty-five years, this team of researchers has conducted over 300 laboratory studies, which substantiate Becker's claim that death anxiety is a primary motivator of human behavior, specifically aggression and violence. Flight from Death features an all-star cast of scholars, authors, philosophers, and researchers including Sam Keen, Robert Jay Lifton, Irvin Yalom, and Sheldon Solomon culminating in a film that is "not only thought-provoking but also entertaining and put together with a lot of class" (Eric Campos, Film Threat). Three years in the making and beautifully photographed in eight different countries, Flight from Death is "a stimulating, ultimately life-affirming film, filled with big ideas and revelatory footage" (Jeff Shannon, Seattle Times). Noted author of Guerrilla PR, Michael Levine, called it "One of the best films of the year. Period."

title: Flight of the Conchords: Live in London

title: Flocking
description: A 14-year-old girl reports that she was raped, but is not believed. The entire village turns against her and her family. Inspired by true events.

title: Flora

description: A widowed doctor finds a path to a second chance after hiring one of his former patients as a nanny.
