description: Violence and Victorian gentility collide in this classic tale. Follow orphan Pip as he meets colorful characters who will shape the adult he becomes.

title: Great God Gold
description: Marcia Harper (Sleeper) sets out to send a group of racketeers, headed by villain John Hart (Blackmer), to prison after they cheat her out of a small inheritance from her father by claiming that her father owed them money. She is aided in her venture by industrious reporter Phil Stewart (Toomey), who acquires a mysterious old Roman coin that becomes the key to bringing down the racketeers.

title: Great Plains
description: After a woman escapes an abusive marriage, she runs to California with her son. Soon, her husband issues an Amber alert and she is hunted down.

title: Great White Summer
description: Tensions escalate and priorities are questioned after the first fatal shark attack in 80 years upends a New England seaside community.

title: Greece: Secrets of the Past
description: Exploring the ancient grandeur of the birthplace of democracy.

title: Greed
description: Desperate to earn enough money to help his parents in India, Jay plunges into Australia’s criminal underworld. Can he escape, or is he in too deep?

title: Greek
description: Greek follows the story of Casey and Rusty Cartwright as they navigate their way through Greek life at the fictional Cyprus-Rhodes University.  Casey has it all—good looks, popular boyfriend, sisterhood in the most elite sorority—but her party life is turned upside down when her younger brother Rusty arrives on campus and insists on rushing a fraternity.  Don’t miss even one episode of this exciting ABC Family original series!

title: Greek Mothers Never Die
description: Ella is a single late bloomer who dreams of becoming a singer but is pressured by her mother, even in ghost form, to run the family business.

title: Green Acres
description: A Manhattan attorney starts life anew on a run-down farm in a one-pig town full of oddballs, despite the protests of his city-loving socialite wife.

title: Green and Gold
description: A fourth-generation dairy farmer on the brink of losing his farm to the bank wagers everything on a bet with his beloved Green Bay Packers while his granddaughter pursues music to save what they've worked for their whole lives.

title: Greener Mountains
description: Greener Mountains is a family friendly, coming-of-age story about finding your place in the world.

title: Green-Eyed Monster
description: Marni and Liam are happily married and live in comfortable suburbia. But then Liam is killed in an apparently unmotivated attack by Ray. Before Marni has recovered, a stunning allegation is made: Ray's rage was provoked by an affair between Liam and Ray's wife, Deanna. As the suspense mounts, this chilling story forces one woman to look at those she trusts and find a way to the truth.

title: Greenfingers
description: A prison inmate with a green thumb goes on to compete in a national gardening competition. Based on a true story.

title: Green Ghost and the Masters of the Stone
description: A group of Mexican superheroes are forced to team up with a gringo to save humanity.

title: Green Is Gold
description: When his father is sent to prison, an adolescent boy is forced to live with his estranged older brother, who gets by as a marijuana dealer.

title: Greenland: Survival at the Edge
description: Greenland, the biggest island on the planet, is a beautiful and extreme environment dominated by ice. But a land that is under threat.

title: Green Paradise
description: Explore Earth's most beautiful places in this docuseries highlighting local efforts to preserve the environment and promote sustainable tourism.

title: Green Sails
description: When a young man determined to climb the corporate ladder realizes that his corporation is jeopardizing the lives of innocent people for profit, he joins a band of crusaders aboard a 70 meter-long green sailed ship, the Ethos, to fight social injustice.

title: Greg Fitzsimmons: Life on Stage
description: Greg Fitzsimmons, host of the Howard Stern-produced "Greg Fitzsimmons Show," is back in his hometown of Tarrytown to tell hilarious stories of life on stage.

title: Gregory K
description: Based on the true story of the boy who, after years of abuse, divorced his parents, with the aid of a lawyer and his wife, who decided to adopt him.

title: Greg Ware: Just Love Everybody
description: This special is a labor of love, written and performed by the multi-talented Greg Ware. He unveils the humor in relationships with unmatched acuity.

title: Greg Warren: Where the Field Corn Grows
description: Comic Greg Warren harvests the ridiculous and the absurd with his common-sense attempts to understand basic agriculture, home repair, and finances.

title: Betrayal
description: During the final months of World War II, a Nazi officer stationed in the Netherlands risks his life to protect a Jewish family hiding in a farmhouse.

title: Greta Thunberg: The Voice of the Future
description: When all hope is lost an unlikely voice of emerges from the darkness– Greta Thunberg. This is the incredible true story of how the actions of one Swedish teenager went on to inspire a global movement that has pushed the fight for real action against climate change further than ever before. No one is too small to make a difference and never before has that been clearer.

title: Grey Owl
description: Based on an incredible true story, a Canadian fur trapper becomes a conservationist claiming to be an aboriginal Native American.

title: Greyson Family Christmas
description: Active liberal progressive law student Maya brings her new boyfriend home for the holidays, neglecting to tell her family that he's white.

title: Gridlocked
description: An ex-SWAT leader, off-duty from a bullet wound, has to use an actor on a probationary ride-along to stop a vicious attack on a training facility.

title: Griefwalker
description: Follows the stories of three dying people and their end-of-life encounters with Stephen Jenkinson, the leader of a palliative care team at a hospital.

title: Griffin & Phoenix
description: A poignant romantic comedy about two people who face a seemingly insurmountable obstacle that may stand between them and a last chance at love.

title: Grimm
description: Portland detective Nick Burkhardt, who comes from a long line of warriors known as Grimms, defends his city from dangerous creatures known as Wesen.

title: Grimm
description: After being abandoned in the woods by their unemployed father, adult siblings Jacob and Marie end up going on an odyssey to a ghost town in Spain.

title: Grimy
description: An undercover cop who can get close to thugs who terrorize the streets with drugs and violence, is conflicted when assigned to his old neighborhood.

title: Grind
description: Skateboarder Eric Rivers and his best friends take one last roadtrip to follow their dreams to get noticed by the professional skateboarding world.

title: Grind
description: New episode every Friday!  Born to a single mother in the slum of Lagos, Tare-ela takes up the offer from her childhood friend Edesiri to become a stripper in order to feed her family and cover the fees of her 10 year old sister. We walk with them through relationships, the weight of family expectations, the failure of old dreams and the forging of new ones as they go about their grind.

title: Grinders
description: Matt Gallagher finds himself in Toronto's illegal poker clubs every night. They are a world of wild characters, fuelled by addiction and one-upmanship. Matt, out-of-work and with a new baby and wife to support, must put everything he has on the line to bring home the daily bread. But as the stakes rise ever higher, Matt soon discovers that the real meaning of risk lies far beyond the poker room.

title: Grindstone Road
description: After a car accident leaves her son in a coma, Hannah turns to antidepressants for comfort, making her husband question her sanity.

title: Gringo
description: A United States businessman finds himself at the mercy of local drug lords and a mercenary after travelling to Mexico. He crosses the line from law-abiding citizen to criminal as he fights to survive an increasingly dangerous situation.

title: Grizzly Man
description: A compelling documentary look at the life and death of wildlife preservationist Timothy Treadwell, who lived unarmed among grizzly bears in Alaska.

title: Grizzly Mountain
description: During a family camping trip in the Oregon wilderness, a pair of siblings stumble upon a mysterious cave that transports them back to the year 1870.

title: Grizzly Rage
description: A road trip for four buddies turns into a lesson in survival when they accidentally hit a bear cub and suffer the wrath of the mother Grizzly.

title: Grizzy & the Lemmings
description: Grizzy the bear just wants to relax in the ranger's house. Too bad a mob of absurd lemmings has declared war on his comfort, food, and sanity.

title: Grossology
description: Fraternal teenage twins Abby and Ty Archer work for the government's Grossology department solving crimes that are too stomach-churning for adults.

title: Grotesque 2
description: Mildred Moyer is back! This time, she unleashes her brand of vengeance on a corrupt religious organization that took advantage of her and others.

title: Grounded in Love
description: When a flight attendant loses her job, she returns to her grandma’s farm to replant her roots as feelings resurface with her childhood best friend.

title: Groundhog Dave
description: When a groundhog emerges to predict the weather, he is shocked to see his beloved flower field being ruined to make way for a polluting shopping mall.

title: Ground Swell: The Other Side of Fear
description: This documentary is an in-depth look at surfing and the 2021-2022 big wave season through the eyes of some of its most iconic athletes.

title: Ground Zero
description: A series of minor earthquakes sends a seismologist to investigate the epicenter in a remote forest, where she is surprised to find she's not alone.

title: Ground Zero
description: After the attack on the Indian Parliament in 2001, BSF Lt Commandant Narendra Nath Dhar Dubey embarks upon a 2 year long investigation leading to the encounter of Jaish-e-Mohammad’s chief and mastermind behind the attack- Ghazi Baba, enabling India’s most successful counter-terrorism operation in history

title: Grow, Cook, Eat
description: Did you know you can grow vegetables and fruit in a very small garden or apartment? This series makes creating healthy food accessible to all.

title: Growing Up Smith
description: Moving to the US in 1979, an Indian boy navigates crushes and pop culture as his dad tries to preserve their heritage while living the American Dream.

title: Grown Folks
description: Two blue-collar couples share a duplex in this sitcom, navigating life, love, and friendship while trying to keep their marriages afloat.

title: Guardian Angel
description: After a man’s wife tragically dies, he watches out for the safety of an aspiring model who is relentlessly targeted by a human trafficker.

title: Guardians
description: A team of mercenaries are called to eliminate interdimensional creatures, who are attacking a small town. Can they do it before the invasion spreads?

title: In the Name of God
description: When his wife falls gravely ill, 40-year-old Priest Theodor turns to his mentor, who convinces him he is chosen by God to purge sinners. Desperate, Theodor commits his first murder-and at that very moment, his wife begins to recover. Hailed by the congregation as a "miracle priest," he basks in divine praise, unaware that a skeptic is quietly tracing the bloody path behind his so-called miracles.

title: Guerillas in Pink Lace
description: An American expatriate gambler's luck runs from bad to worse. 27 days after the attack on Pearl Harbor, Murphy has lost his fortune in a poker game, gets beaten up by some of his many creditors and is trapped in the Philippines during the Japanese invasion. So Murphy takes his place on a plane that gets shot down and he finds himself on an island with five women who were also on the plane.

title: War of Likes
description: In order to advance her career in the dynamic world of publicity in Mexico City, Raquel tries to reunite with her high school friend Cecy who has become the queen of social media. But unlike followers, friendships do not come instantly.

title: Guerrilla: The Taking of Patty Hearst
description: Director Robert Stone chronicles the bizarre story of Patty Hearst, granddaughter of newspaper magnate William Randolph Hearst. In 1974, Hearst was kidnapped by a fringe domestic terrorist group known as the Symbionese Liberation Army while attending the University of California at Berkeley. She then joined the group, taking the pseudonym "Tania." Hearst would eventually be convicted for helping the group with a bank robbery, and become a poster child for Stockholm Syndrome.

title: Guess How Much I Love You
description: A beloved, award-winning animated series about a father hare and his son who live in a watercolor landscape of forests, rivers and warm life lessons.

title: Guest Artist
description: A bitter, hard-drinking New York playwright reluctantly travels to Michigan to fulfil an obligation to work with a local theatre company in a town called Lima. There he has to confront not just the young wannabe playwright who brought him out, but his own failures as an artist. The Guest Artist is written by, and stars, Golden Globe winner and Emmy nominee Jeff Daniels and based on his own play.

title: Guidance
description: When a vacationing couple tries out new tech designed to detect others' lies, they start trying to subvert the AI in order to save their relationship.

title: Guided by the Word
description: On a cross-country trek to fulfill his wife's dying wish, Joseph meets a mysterious hitchhiker who may hold the secret of the journey's end.

title: Guigo Offline
description: Guigo is the son of separated parents and one day, he and his friend Túlio travel with his father, Roberto, and his friend, Paulo. The trip would have everything to go well, if there was internet signal. The lack of communication makes Guigo anxious. Besides, he will have yet to deal with another situation: Paulo is, in fact, his father's boyfriend.

title: Guilt
description: The darker side of London is full of sex, murder and intrigue.

title: Guilty Conscience
description: While an unfaithful criminal lawyer played by Academy Award winner Anthony Hopkins considers killing his wife, his spouse develops some schemes of her own.

title: Guilty Minds
description: Guilty Minds is a legal drama involving a morally upright family on one side and a renowned top law firm that welcomes any and all cases on the other.

title: Guilty Until Proven Innocent
description: When a murder is committed and a troubled adopted teenager is falsely accused, his father is forced to fight the system to prove his innocence.

title: Guitar Lessons
description: Leland, a 15-year-old Metis boy, stops at nothing to receive guitar lessons from Ray, a 50-year-old oilfield contractor and retired rock star. After many attempts at pushing Leland away, Ray relents, and the two learn to grow up over guitar lessons.

title: Gulliver's Travels
description: A seafaring 18th-century Englishman returns home with extraordinary tales of fantastic lands, and must prove his sanity to rescue his wife and son.

title: Gulliver's Travels
description: A doctor washes ashore on an island inhabited by tiny people in this animated telling of Jonathan Swift's classic fantasy novel.

title: Gundala
description: Based on the Indonesian comic, an orphan raised on the streets becomes a hero after reaching his breaking point with the injustice surrounding him.

title: Gun Fight
description: A cavalry soldier returns home intending to work as a rancher with his brother. Tension erupts when he learns that his brother is a cattle rustler.

title: Gunfight at Cold Cross
description: A young outlaw’s quest for vengeance for the murder of his parents takes him to a frontier town where he unknowingly has a target on his own back.

title: Gunfight at Dry River
description: The arrival of a stranger in an Old West town threatens to upend the wicked Ryles family’s control over a Mexican border town’s only water source.

title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
description: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with a bloodthirsty outlaw gang that’s invaded their small East Texas town.

title: Gunfighters of Abilene
description: A gunman receives a request for help from his brother, but arrives too late to save him from the lawless rancher who wanted him dead.

title: Gunless
description: After his horse goes missing, a notorious American gunslinger is repeatedly thwarted in his efforts to mount a showdown in a friendly Canadian hamlet.

title: Gunpoint
description: A wealthy family living in a luxury apartment are held hostage as the father of the house is forced to watch his loved ones hurt and terrorized.

title: Gunpowder, Treason & Plot
description: Expect deceit, lust and betrayal, in this calculating historical drama, leading up to the notorious gunpowder plot of 1605. Tensions rise when Mary Queen of Scots is hailed the catholic Queen, threatening the protestant Queen of England, Elizabeth I. When Mary's son succeeds to the English throne, the rivalry becomes deadly. Starring Michael Fassbender, this brutal retelling is a must watch!

title: Gunrush
description: A mild-mannered suburban dad is driven to vigilantism and taking the law into his own hands after his daughter is gunned down in front of him.

title: Guns and Guitars
description: When a traveling medicine show lands amidst a Texas cattle war, the singing cowboy chases down the bad guys and their quarantined livestock.

title: Guns Don't Argue
description: The film takes the form of a docudrama in which Federal agents speak to camera about the war on gangsterism in the 1930s. Using contacts with gun molls, agents track down criminals.

title: Guns & Moses
description: A beloved small-town rabbi in the high desert becomes an unlikely gunslinger and uncovers a conspiracy after his community is violently attacked.

title: Gun the Man Down
description: Two bank robbers abandon their wounded partner to the posse and run with the loot, but their partner seeks revenge after serving time in prison.

title: Gurkha: Beneath the Bravery
description: The true story of a Nepalese rifleman who ventures behind enemy lines in the trenches of WWI, cementing his name among the legendary Gurkha warriors.

title: Gutta Mamis: Money Bag Tales
description: Two ride-or-die friends are in peril when a dead victim of their crime plot leads one of them to break “girl code” and tell all to a shady boyfriend.

title: Gutterbug
description: Crust punk Bug confronts homelessness, mental health issues, drug use, and toxic friendships in a raw struggle for survival and self-discovery.

title: Guy Manley: Super Spy
description: A notorious former spy is dragged out of booze-fueled retirement to kill the evil brother of his old boss and prevent him from being elected mayor.

title: Guy Martin: Last Flight of the Vulcan Bomber
description: In homage to the greatest engineering masterpiece of the Cold War, Guy Martin joins a group of volunteers tasked with nursing a 600mph Vulcan Bomber back to life in preparation of its final ever flight. Guy will learn about the incredible history and mechanics of this legendary machine - and of course have a test drive himself - before witnessing the final flight of a forgotten hero.

title: Guy Martin: World's Fastest Tractor
description: In this six-part series Guy Martin celebrates the workers of Britain's Industrial Revolution by getting stuck into six of the country's biggest restoration projects and bringing some of the 19th Century's most impressive engineering achievements back to life. Each episode focuses on the jobs of the unsung heroes of the time - ordinary men, women and children who worked 14-hour days for little pay.

title: Guys and Dolls
description: In this musical comedy, a slick gambler with a girlfriend and a high-roller debt makes a bet with his friend to get a chilly missionary on a date.

title: Gwen Rose: Emotional Cutting
description: Gwen Rose delights a packed crowd at The Den Theater in her adopted hometown of Chicago with stories about transitioning and her ability to kickflip.

title: Gypsy
description: Gypsy follows the dreams and efforts of Rose to raise two daughters to perform onstage, and casts an affectionate eye on the hardships of show business life. Bette Midler, stars as the ultimate pushy stage mother, Rose, who seeks stardom for her two young daughters at any cost.

title: Gypsy 83
description: Two goth misfits from Ohio, a singer and her younger queer protege, run off to NYC, so she can participate in the ultimate Stevie Nicks cosplay event.

title: H2O: Just Add Water
description: Rikki, Cleo and Lewis think they know everything there is to know about Mako Island, but when water attacks the girls in a full moon, they realise a new, potentially dangerous force is developing on the mysterious island. Thankfully they find an ally in Bella, a new girl in town who reveals an equally surprising twist; she too is a mermaid with extraordinary super powers.

title: H2O: The Intelligence of Water
description: Water is essential for all life on earth, but also holds many untold secrets.  Join scientists, authors, and healers as they explore the relationship between water, people, and the rest of the world. These experts discuss its healing effects, how it can capture positive and negative energy, and the importance of conserving this precious resource before it's too late.

title: Habermann
description: In 1937 Sudetenland, an apolitical saw mill owner, who employs both Germans and Czechs and has a half-Jewish wife, finds his life steamrolled by WW2.

title: The Little Traitor
description: A coming of age tale of the unlikely bond between a kindly British soldier and a spirited Jewish boy set against the backdrop of the birth of the State of Israel.

title: Hagazussa
description: A psychedelic horror trip about a woman who discovers evidence of a 15th century woman whose tortured life spawned a supernatural curse on humanity.

title: Sharks: Monster of the Media
description: Labelled monsters by the media, sharks are majestic creatures in their natural habitat and many species actually need help to beat extinction.

title: Hail to the Deadites
description: This documentary is about the rabid fans of the Evil Dead films and features a deep dive into the classic franchise's undying popularity.

title: Hair
description: An Oklahoma farm boy and Vietnam draftee arrives in New York City and embraced by a band of peaceniks in this film adaptation of the Broadway musical.

title: Hairbrained
description: 14 year old genius Eli is starting college and meets up with 41 year old loser Leo (Brendan Fraser), a gambler who has gone back to school. This mismatched pair put their heads together to turn their lives around and become unlikely friends. One thing's for sure - school isn't going to be boring anymore!

title: Heels in the Hay
description: Twelve city influencers trade their luxurious urban lives for the harsh reality of the Dutch countryside. No filters and no oat milk cappuccinos - just early mornings, dirty hands, and fierce competition. They discover that farm life holds more hidden challenges than they ever imagined. Which city dweller will hold their ground? One thing is certain: it won't be a picture-perfect scene...

title: Hakugei: Legend of the Moby Dick
description: A courageous young man embarks on a journey to find the only person who can save his planet from the most terrifying beast in the universe-the great white whale Moby Dick-in this futuristic anime adaptation of the literary classic.

title: Half Light
description: Grieving tragedy, a writer escapes to a village, where the ghost of her recently deceased son appears to save her life from a terrifying darkness.

title: Half of a Yellow Sun
description: “Westworld” and “Dreamgirls” stars Thandie Newton and Anika Noni Rose play glamorous twins in 1960s Nigeria who get caught up in a shocking civil war.

title: Half Pants Full Pants
description: Set in a small town in South India, before the internet & mobiles, the series is a nostalgic ride about imagination, adventures and the magic of childhood. A little boy from a railway colony strives to bring his modest family a modicum of glory through highly fanciful means while constantly being brought back to reality by his level-headed father. It is a universal story of Child Vs Man.

title: Half Sisters
description: Two half sisters who bitterly hate each other become trapped in a farmhouse during a storm as they look for their million-dollar inheritance check.

title: Half Songs
description: An online music reporter writes an article about an old music store closing down in Mumbai but—as the story of the shop ends—another begins.

title: Half the Picture
description: Featuring interviews with leading filmmakers, this insightful doc investigates gender discrimination in Hollywood's hiring practices for directors.

title: Halfway to Amarillo
description: Struck with a bout of writer’s block, Michael’s life is upended when the main characters from his Western novel leap off the page and come to life.

title: Hal & Harper
description: Hal and Harper and dad chart the evolution of their family.

title: Halifax f.p.
description: Jane Halifax is a freelance forensic psychiatrist (f.p.) a psychological super-sleuth immersed in a mire of crime and punishment: Jane is an expert of the human mind.

title: Hal King
description: Drafted into the Korean War, a man must choose between the woman he loves and carrying on his father's political legacy.

title: Hallowed Ground
description: When her car breaks down in a small town, Liz Chambers (Jaimie Alexander) meets journalist Sarah Austin (Hudson Leick), who tells her about the town's bloodthirsty past. A hundred years ago, the town preacher nailed people to crosses, sacrificing them as living scarecrows

title: Halloween Hero
description: Contemplating suicide after losing his wife in a violent attack, a retired cop finds unexpected purpose with a knock on his door on Halloween night.

title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
description: An evil toymaker plans to sell millions of masks that will kill all children who wear them on Halloween.

title: Halloween Party
description: A seemingly innocent Halloween meme awakens tortured souls inside a college dorm that once served as a hospice for dying and disfigured children.

title: Halo 4: Forward Unto Dawn
description: UNSC Cadet Thomas Lasky must conquer his inner fears and join forces with super-soldier John-117 to take down a massive faction of the Covenant.

title: Halo Legends
description: The universe of the Halo video game series is expanded in seven short animated films from Japan's greatest anime directors and studios.

title: Halo: The Fall of Reach
description: Halo: The Fall of Reach follows the backstory of the shaping and creation of Spartan 117, The Master Chief.

title: Hal Sparks: Charmageddon
description: The stand-up comic discusses the perils of sexting, missed signals, and his hot takes on how to survive in our modern but uncertain times.

title: Halston
description: Halston rose from Southern roots to become America’s first superstar clothing designer, becoming a celebrity in 1970s social circles across the world.

title: Hamilton
description: A nuclear armed SS20 will be smuggled from Russia via Finland to Sweden unless spy commander Hamilton can stop them—and with no loose ends.

title: Hammer
description: A father faces a personal crisis when he reunites with his estranged son by chance as the young man is fleeing a drug deal gone horribly wrong.

title: Hammer House of Horror
description: Terror awaits in this anthology series from Britain's famed Hammer studios, featuring stories of haunted houses, demons and other macabre delights.

title: Hampton's Legion
description: Cuando la Confederación ya no puede financiar ejércitos, Wade Hampton III, utilizando su propio dinero, financió y suministró su propia infantería.

title: Couple Trouble
description: Couple Trouble is a love story - about Anders and Lise. A couple through which we experience the highs and lows of a modern relationships and the challenges of keeping it together.

title: Handle with Care: The Legend of the Notic Streetball Crew
description: Chronicling the rise, fall, and rebirth of The Notic, a Canadian streetball crew whose creative moves brought them global fame in the early 2000s.

title: Hand of God
description: After suffering through a tragic event, a judge with questionable morals suffers a breakdown and believes he can hear God speaking to him.

title: Hands of a Murderer
description: The partners in crime fighting are back on the trail of Professor Moriarty after he leaks British intelligence and puts the whole country at risk.

title: Hands of Hell
description: Bianca Cromwell and Zeke Jansen share a volatile, obsessive bond, and after fleeing a Texas institution, the dangerous pair leaves chaos behind them.

title: Hands That Bind
description: A hired hand’s plans to eventually take over his boss’ farm are shattered when the landowner’s son returns to claim his birthright.

title: Hands Up
description: Amid a national protest movement against police violence, a Black Chicago teenager fights for a way out of the murder capital of America.

title: Handyman Hal
description: Handyman Hal is a family friendly show that takes you on entertaining and educational adventures. Follow Handyman Hal as he makes repairs and learns how things work. Would you like to go behind the scenes at a fire station? Want to ride on a garbage truck? If so, join Handyman Hal for an awesome time!

title: Hangar 1: The UFO Files
description: On Hangar 1, for the first time ever, The Mutual UFO Network (MUFON) has granted access to their case files and physical evidence. Founded in 1969, MUFON is the most respected organization dedicated to investigating and classifying UFO activity, with field offices in 42 countries, over 800 local investigators and more than 30,000 case files.

title: Hangmen Also Die!
description: After assassinating a Nazi leader in occupied Czechoslovakia, a Czech doctor tries to evade the Gestapo in this noir-like espionage thriller.

title: Hang Time
description: Friends attempt to cheer up their heartbroken buddy during an epic wine tasting weekend at a vineyard after he was dumped days before his wedding.

title: Hank and Mike
description: Two blue-collar Easter Bunnies get fired and try their hand at an assortment of odd jobs, failing at each. Fighting depression, debt and eventually each other, their lives start to unravel.

title: Hank Chen: I'm Not Supposed to Be Here
description: Hank Chen holds nothing back in his debut comedy special, taking on dictators, confused racists, the Hollywood machine, his father, and himself.

title: Hank's Christmas Wish
description: A retired elf ready for some peace and quiet rediscovers the joy of Christmas with the help of cheerful townsfolk as they get ready for the holidays.

title: Hank's Christmas Wish 2: The Nutcracker
description: Hank the Christmas Elf aims to unite a charming town and revive the season's holiday cheer by organizing a community production of The Nutcracker.

title: Hank’s Christmas Wish 3: Elvis Lives
description: When a biker gang threatens Christmas, two friends join forces to protect their town while one of them searches for renewed purpose.

title: Hank Williams: The Show He Never Gave
description: On the night of his death, the country singer imagines a special performance in a roadside bar.

title: Hanky Panky
description: An oddball and his best friend, a foul-mouthed talking handkerchief, must confront an inter-dimensional evil to save the world and find true love.

title: Hanna
description: A young girl with extraordinary skills attempts to evade the relentless pursuit of an off-book CIA agent and tries to unearth the truth behind who she is.

title: Hanna Ranch
description: Cattleman Kirk Hanna struggled to protect a once prominent way of life in Colorado. Born into ranch life, Hanna became a leader in the environmental ranching movement, setting out to protect encroachment of development and misuse.

title: Hanna's Gold
description: Two sisters find themselves on the adventure of a lifetime when they discover a long-lost treasure map on their father's horse ranch.

title: Hanna's War
description: A Hungarian Jewish woman volunteers to go behind enemy lines during WWII to rescue others from deportation to the Nazi death camps.

title: Hannibal
description: Explores the early relationship between the renowned psychiatrist and his patient, a young FBI criminal profiler, who is haunted by his ability to empathise with serial killers.

title: Hannibal
description: At large ten years after his escape, the cannibal shrink lures a disgraced Agent Starling to Italy while a disfigured ex-patient plots his revenge.

title: Hannibal Hopkins & Sir Anthony
description: A captivating look at what destined a boy from Wales to win two Academy Awards and become evil incarnate, as cinema’s most notorious serial killer.

title: Hannibal Rising
description: Orphaned after his sister’s death during World War II, young Hannibal Lecter begins a path of violent revenge shaped by trauma and loss.

title: Hans Christian Andersen
description: When a cobbler’s popular fairytales begin distracting the village school children, he moves to the city where a dancer inspires him to write a ballet.

title: Haphazard
description: After a U.S. defense satellite containing missile activation codes crashes on an island off the coast of Thailand, three individuals race to find it.

title: Happily Ever After
description: Happily Ever After tells the story of Avani and Roneet, from their millennial romance to their big, fat wedding which captures the behind the scenes madness of a wedding that everyone will relate to. Will the couple get their dream wedding?

title: Happiness Continues
description: Life on the road with the pop band during its sold-out "Happiness Begins" concert in 2019.

title: Happiness Is a Four-Letter Word
description: A perfectionist engaged to be married, along with a perfect house and job, ends up at a crossroads with only her friends and her will to be happy.

title: Happy 40th
description: Happy 40th is an engrossing, festival-winning drama about Sophia, a woman turning 40. Sophia invites her three best friends over for her first weekend of celebration and reunion, since her self-imposed two year isolation after a car accident left her paralyzed. During the party these lifelong friendships and her marriage will be taken to the breaking point due to revelations of betrayal and Anger.

title: Happy Anniversary
description: Misunderstanding a family conversation, daughter Patty Duke believes that her parents (David Niven and Mitzi Gaynor) are breaking up. Family havoc breaks loose when she announces this "fact" on national television.

title: Happy Birthday, Toby Simpson
description: A man getting pushed around in his life has to take a shuttle to a music festival that changes his life over the course of two days with a stranger.

title: Happy Face Killer
description: This Lifetime Original Movie follows the grisly true-crime story of a truck driver who, during his work travels across the country, kills numerous women and leaves a confession.

title: Happy Go Lucky
description: A singer (Venable) believes her marine pilot husband, accused of treason, has died in the Pacific. She decides to take a singing job in Shanghai, and finds a man who looks exactly like her husband dancing in a club act. Realizing it is her husband, and thinking he must have amnesia, she sets out to help him recover his memory and clear his name.

title: Happy Holidays
description: On her first trip home since college, Clarissa faces the inevitable collision between her first love, her new fiancé and her life’s passion: painting.

title: Happy Hunting
description: An alcoholic drifter passing through the small town of Bedford Flats must battle withdrawal and psychotic rednecks after he becomes the target of a deranged sporting event.

title: The Commoner
description: Four part series. For nine years, the Norwegian Crown Prince Harald and commoner Sonja Haraldsen fight for their right to marry, but the decision lies with King Olav. The Norwegian constitution bars Harald from marrying without royal consent, risking the monarchy’s collapse. Defying tradition, the couple stands against the royal court, government, and press—all for love.

title: Harbinger Down
description: While studying at sea, a group of graduate students dredge up wreckage from space and inadvertently release a deadly—and quickly mutating—organism.

title: Hardball
description: Keanu Reeves stars as a desperate gambler forced to coach a lousy inner-city little-league baseball team for cash.

title: Hard Bounty
description: After a bounty hunter buys a saloon and one of his prostitutes is murdered, he and the other women saddle up to seek justice.

title: Hard Cash
description: A thief on the road to redemption can’t resist an offer to mastermind a robbery but soon finds the money is marked and he is in the sights of the FBI.

title: Hardcore Henry
description: A half-human, half-robotic hybrid embarks on a bloody rampage through Moscow to save his kidnapped wife (Haley Bennett) from a madman (Danila Kozlovsky) and his army of thugs.

title: Hard Miles
description: A determined social worker at a youth prison assembles a cycling team of teenage convicts and takes them on a transformative 1000-mile ride.

title: Hard Ride to Hell
description: On a lonely stretch of Texas highway, a group of campers witnesses something horrifying and are forced to run from a pack of devil-worshipping bikers.

title: Hard Sun
description: After the death of her parents, a young woman assumes primary guardianship of her special needs brother. As she attempts to balance her new life and her own blossoming romance, it becomes painfully clear that life will only make room for one.

title: Hard Target
description: A woman hires a drifter as her guide through New Orleans in search of her father, who has gone missing. They discover a deadly game of cat and mouse behind his disappearance in the process.

title: Hard Target 2
description: A disgraced mixed martial arts fighter is forced into a deadly game in which he is hunted in the jungles of Thailand.

title: Hard Times
description: An adaptation of Dickens' satirical novel about a man whose extreme devotion to rationalism deprives his children of a moral compass to guide them.

title: Hard to Forget
description: Private investigator Max Warner is convinced that the death of Sandra Applewhite was no accident but that her domineering husband John Gilman murdered her. When he meets Sandra's twin sister Nicky, he enlists her help in a scheme that would trap Gilman.

title: Hard to Get
description: When an enigmatic, beautiful stranger walks into a rural township tavern and demands a beer, a charming local lothario sets out to seduce her.

title: Hardwired
description: After losing his wife in a horrific car accident, Luke Gibson (Academy Award ® Winner Cuba Gooding Jr., Best Actor in a Supporting Role for Jerry Maguire, 1996) wakes up in the hospital to find his once idyllic life on the brink of destruction. Implanted with a lethal microchip and monitored closely by a Hope Industries executive (Val Kilmer), Gibson is plagued by strange visions and haunted by...

title: Harichandra
description: "Viswamithran employs various tactics to corrupt Harishchandra's heart and make him lie. However,Harishchandra remains true to his word and ends up leading an impoverished life.

title: Harina
description: The Lieutenant and Ramírez face a "serial killer", whose aim is to finish all the influencers. They'll try to catch the criminal, battling at the same time with the Mexican judicial system.

title: Harlan Coben's Lazarus
description: Forensic psychiatrist Dr Joel ‘Laz’ Lazarus is forced to confront long-buried demons after his father Dr L dies in suspicious circumstances. At first assured his dad’s death is a suicide, Laz is soon sucked into a world of murderous conspiracy, and a race to find the killer, by strange visions of people he knows to be dead.

title: Harlan Coben's Shelter
description: Based on the bestselling series by Harlan Coben, Shelter follows the story of Mickey Bolitar after the death of his father leads him to start a new life in suburban New Jersey. When another new student disappears, Mickey finds himself tangled in a web of secrets. With the help of two new friends, Spoon and Ema, they reveal a dark underground that may hold the answers to decades of disappearances.

title: Harlem
description: From writer Tracy Oliver (Girls Trip), a new comedy following four stylish & ambitious best girlfriends in Harlem NYC: a rising star professor struggling to make space for her love life; a savvy tech entrepreneur always dating someone new; a no-filter singer; and a hopeless romantic fashion designer. Together, they level up into the next phase of their careers, relationships & big city dreams.

title: Harlow
description: A biographical drama based on 1930s Hollywood starlet Jean Harlow as she begins her climb to stardom.

title: Harlow's Haunt
description: A group of friends who dabbled in the occult as children reconnect after a tragedy for a harrowing visit to a haunted house on Halloween night.

title: Harmony
description: A girl born with the power to absorb the pain and fear of others has to maximize it to save the man she loves while being guided by those she’s saved.

title: Harmony From The Heart
description: Musical therapist Violet and doctor Blake butt heads.

title: Harmony with A. R. Rahman
description: Exploring the roots of India's musical heritage with the "Mozart of Madras."

title: Come to Harm
description: In this stylish Icelandic thriller, 20-year-old Oliver must navigate Reykjavik's criminal underworld in search of his kidnapped younger brother.

title: Harpoon
description: Rivalries, dark secrets and sexual tension emerge when three friends get stranded on a yacht in the middle of the sea under suspicious circumstances.

title: Harriet the Spy: Blog Wars
description: In the running for the title of official class blogger, Harriet makes the unwise decision to cull material from her secret spying missions.

title: Harry and Meghan: What's Next?
description: Once Upon a Time, there was a starlet who met a Prince. Their Royal Wedding was one for the history books. But a year and a half later, a right Royal bust-up with the Palace, and the fairy tale couple decide they want to be royals of a different kind. They blame the press. Others blame Windsor family feuds. While the British media blames Duchess Meghan. But now what?

title: Harry Benson: Shoot First
description: A documentary that charts the illustrious career of the renowned photographer behind intimate portraits of The Beatles, Winston Churchill and more.

title: Harry & Meghan: A Modern Royal Romance
description: The newest royal couple, Prince Harry and American actress Meghan Markle, begin their unconventional romance, which leads up to their engagement.

title: Harry & Meghan: Royal Rebels
description: The world eagerly anticipates the nuptials of Prince Harry and Meghan Markle.

description: On January 8th 2020 The Duke and Duchess of Sussex made a shocking announcement that sent ripples around the world... they were leaving the Royal Family.

title: Harry & Meghan: The Revelations
description: Follows the newly independent former Duke and Duchess as they left royal life for Los Angeles, mounting tensions between the two households.

title: Harry & Snowman
description: Harry & Snowman is the Cinderella story of Dutch immigrant Harry deLeyer and his friendship with Snowman, an Amish plow horse he rescued off a truck bound for the glue factory. Within 2 years they would win the Triple Crown of show jumping, beating the nation's blue bloods and traveling the world as media darlings. Their meeting at a horse auction began a friendship that would last a lifetime.

title: Harry Styles: Are You Curious?
description: A look at Harry Styles' remarkable journey, from teenage boy band heartthrob to fashion icon and one of the most distinctive artists of his time.

title: Harry Styles: The Finishing Touch
description: This music documentary looks at pop and fashion icon Harry Styles and his self-expression, which rejects the traditional confines of masculinity.

title: Harry Tracy, Desperado
description: The last survivor of the Wild Bunch pulls off a string of robberies before making his way West in search of the judge's daughter who stole his heart.

title: Harsens Island Revenge
description: Set in the roaring 1920s, Harsens Island Revenge follows WWI veterans defending their community from the notorious Purple Gang's illegal booze trade and extortion-an action-packed tale of loyalty, bravery, and justice during Prohibition.

title: Hart of Dixie
description: Hart of Dixie follows the story of New York surgeon Dr. Zoe Hart who unexpectedly finds herself a general practitioner in tiny BlueBell, Alabama -- a place where she will learn to be a better doctor, a better person and maybe even fall in love.

title: Harts of the West
description: A salesman follows his dream of being a cowboy after surviving a heart attack, yet challenges of the ranch he buys are more than the brochure showed.

title: Harvard Man
description: After a tornado destroys his parents' home, a desperate college basketball player tries to fix a game in exchange for $100,000 from the mob.

title: Hassam: Why Me?
description: Why did I get a mother who scolds me for everything? A wife telling me what to do? And even a disease that has no cure? Those are some of Hassam’s existential questions. This great Colombian humorist gave life to famous characters like Rogelio Pataquiva and Próculo Rico and now he faces the challenge of using humor to get the best out of his adverse circumstances.

title: Christmas Is Cancelled
description: The relationship of our protagonists, Manuel and Lidia, is in crisis and they face an uncertain future, forcing them to spend Christmas apart. A flashback takes us to know the chaotic Christmas of the previous year, when their families met for the first time, where family secrets and exaggerated decorations cause a fun disaster.

title: Mother's Day Is Cancelled
description: Lidia and Manuel are a newlywed couple whose families have only met once. Now, they get together again to celebrate Mother’s Day. But there is a secret in the family that as soon as it explodes, will change it all. Esmeralda and Rosa must lean on each other to get through the day that seems to have something against them. They both will realize that maybe it is better to send everything to hell.

title: The Day of the Dead Is Cancelled
description: A sudden death reunites the García and San Román’s families. Lidia and Manuel try to keep the romance alive, but Francisco moved in with them. Lidia gets a job promotion that means moving to Monterrey. Rosa deals with her husband’s memory while finding a place for Jaime in her life. Both families welcome their death in their day and prepare for a life that will never be the same.

title: Hatchback
description: A failing would-be journalist desperate for a story thinks he’s found one in a teen girl with a missing father who’s living out of her Toyota Tercel.

title: Hatchet II
description: A ferocious and exceptionally gory dose of splatterific entertainment offers an even bloodier, darker, and more twisted ride than the first film.

title: Hatchet III
description: The murderous Victor Crowley takes on an entire police department, paramedic team, Marybeth, and a heavily armed S.W.A.T. unit, in an epic showdown.

title: Hatchetman
description: A law student by day and stripper by night uses her criminology study and detective boyfriend’s clues to stop a serial killer in her social circle.

title: Hate Crime
description: A middle-class gay couple find their lives turned upside down when the outspoken son of a fundamentalist preacher moves in next door.

title: Hate Crime
description: As a killer is executed for murdering a young gay man, two sets of parents struggle to deal with the consequences of fear and repression.

title: Hatfields and McCoys:  Bad Blood
description: On his way home from the Civil War, a Union soldier from the McCoy family has a run-in with a couple of Hatfield family Confederate sympathizers.

title: Hats Off to Christmas!
description: A widowed mother loyal to her job expects a promotion when the boss plans to retire, but he instead hands the shop over to his reluctant son.

title: Hatton Garden: The Heist
description: Five aging criminals come together to mastermind one of the most audacious robberies in British history: the Hatton Garden safe deposit heist.

title: Haunted
description: When an aspiring author house-sits for his sister while she is out of town, he discovers something more terrifying than any story he could ever write.

title: Haunted History
description: Go on tour to some of the spookiest and unexpectedly haunted places in cities like Washington, D.C. and London.

title: Haunted Trail
description: A group of friends receives the surprise of their lives when they realize there’s a bonafide killer on the scene of a local haunted house attraction.

title: Haunting Fear
description: A woman is tormented by visions of being buried alive while her greedy, adulterous husband and his mistress plot to murder her for her money.

title: Haunting of the Mary Celeste
description: A researcher sets out to prove that the disappearance of the infamous Mary Celeste was due to supernatural reasons. Her theory proves horrifyingly true as her boat breaks down and the crew begin to vanish one by one. This terrifying tale of haunting on the high seas proves that some mysteries are best left unsolved.

title: Haunting of the Queen Mary
description: A psychological horror, Haunting of the Queen Mary explores the mysterious and violent events surrounding one family’s voyage on Halloween night in 1938, and their interwoven destiny with another family onboard the infamous ocean liner present day.

title: Haunting on Fraternity Row
description: A fraternity house throws their final party of the year, a massive Luau extravaganza, but when fraternity brothers and co-eds begin dying horrible deaths they discover an evil entity has taken over the house.

title: Haunting Sarah
description: After her young son dies in an accident, a woman receives signs that he may still be contacting her twin sister's daughter—and that he may be reborn.

title: Hauntology
description: In this queer horror anthology, two siblings embark on a road trip as the older sister shares a collection of interconnected ghost stories.

title: Haunt Season
description: A masked maniac turns a suburban Halloween haunt attraction into a nightmarish reality, turning staged injuries into real murders.

title: Havana Darkness
description: Three friends are thrust into a terrifying game of cat and mouse when they're trapped inside an abandoned building in Havana. As time runs out, the threesome must maneuver a maze of deadly traps and escape... before they're hunted down.

title: Haven
description: Crime series with supernatural shadings as an FBI agent assigned to a case in Maine finds herself on the trail of unexplained and spooky occurrences.

title: Haven
description: Fritz owes money to a dangerous drug dealer and tells him about the fortune Carl has. One night, their lives entwine in a chain of tragic events.

title: Haven
description: A U.S. official escorts Holocaust refugees from 1940s war-torn Europe to temporary shelter in America.

title: Havenhurst
description: When a young woman mysteriously disappears from the gothic Havenhurst apartments, her alcoholic friend moves in to discover just what happened.

title: Haven's End
description: There's nowhere to hide when the enemies may be amongst you!

title: Haven't We Met Before?
description: Un detective investiga las supuestas vidas pasadas de un paciente psiquiátrico que acosa a una mujer que cree que lo agravió en una vida pasada.

title: Having It All
description: Thera no solo tiene dos líneas de moda diferentes, originarias de dos ciudades diferentes, sino que también tiene dos maridos diferentes.

title: Hav Plenty
description: A homeless aspiring writer seizes an opportunity to spend New Year’s Eve with his wealthy friend—and longtime secret love—at her family’s home.

title: Hawa
description: Hawa, a 15-year-old girl, lives alone with her severely ill grandmother and refuses all the "replacements" her grandmother offers her. Until one day she decides that the only woman who can adopt her is... Michelle Obama.

title: Hawaii Melting Pot: A Guided Tour
description: Comedian and local Kenny Kusaka explores Hawaii's unique food, culture, and history, uncovering what makes it such a coveted travel destination.

title: Hawkeye (The First Frontier)
description: Set during the 18th century French and Indian War, a woodsman teams up with a brave English woman whose husband is a prisoner of France.

title: Hawks
description: In this life-affirming, black comedy, two men - the devilishly handsome British lawyer Bancroft (Timothy Dalton), and rugged American football player Decker -- have absolutely nothing in common...except the struggle for survival. Both terminally ill with cancer but still equally red blooded, the duo form a warm friendship and are determined to live life to the fullest, ripping off an ambulance and heading for the brothels of Amsterdam for one final fling. Janet McTeer and Jill Bennett co-star.

title: Hawks Ridge
description: A Black ex-minister grieving the loss of his wife has a crisis of faith when faced with a life-or-death dilemma regarding the white man who killed her.

title: Hawk the Slayer
description: With only the aid of his companions behind him, a man seeks to take down his evil brother who has gone rogue and taken a nun hostage.

title: Haymaker
description: While working as a bodyguard for a seductive transgender entertainer, a retired Muay Thai fighter prepares for an unexpected return to the ring.

title: Hayseed
description: In a small Midwestern town, a church congregation launches their own investigation after their esteemed reverend is found dead.

title: Haywire
description: A black ops super soldier seeks payback after she is betrayed and set up during a mission.

title: Haywire: Gunslingers
description: In 1940s Europe, a lone American soldier and a quiet young girl stealthily move through occupied territory to thwart a diabolical Nazi experiment.

title: Hazard
description: In a Kentucky town gripped by opioids, a former addict turns dealer to save his family, risking everything in a fight for redemption.

title: Hazbin Hotel
description: This adult animated musical series follows Charlie, the princess of Hell, as she pursues her seemingly impossible goal of rehabilitating demons to peacefully reduce overpopulation in her kingdom. After a yearly extermination that was imposed by Heaven, she opens a hotel in the hopes that patrons will be "checking out" after proving their souls are redeemable.

title: Kill Me Tender
description: Hilarious comedy in which we will meet an older man who is fascinated by a young girl who can't bring him anything good, a slightly hoofed girl with a sinister past and a somewhat simplistic ex-legionnaire who works disguised as a rabbit for a debt agency. And with them fate has decided to play to make an explosive cocktail out of their lives.

title: Hazel's Heart
description: In March 1920, three children vanish in a whiteout blizzard, forcing a desperate father to race against time to find them alive before it’s too late.

title: Head Above Water
description: A peek inside the life of an Olympic swimmer through the eyes of reigning champion Kyle Chalmers, two-time Olympian Bronte Campbell, retired Olympic hero Ian Thorpe and aspiring Olympian and global music superstar Cody Simpson. Head Above Water chronicles the personal lives and athletic careers of these four Australian icons.

title: Head Count
description: On a trip to Joshua Tree, a group of teens find themselves falling prey to a supernatural beast that needs them to complete its savage ancient ritual.

title: Heading Out
description: In the face of success and popularity, a woman wrestles with revealing her sexuality to her parents under the pressure of her friends' ultimatum.

title: Headless Horseman
description: 'Ghost Rider' meets 'The Punisher'. When seconds from death, a nearly decapitated and desperate man makes a deal with the Devil to protect the love of his life and seek revenge on the drug dealer who almost murdered him.

description: The UK Prime Minister (Idris Elba) and US President (John Cena) have a public rivalry that risks their countries' alliance. But when they become targets of a powerful enemy, they're forced to rely on each other as they go on a wild, multinational run. Allied with Noel, a brilliant MI6 agent (Priyanka Chopra Jonas), they must find a way to thwart a conspiracy that threatens the free world.

title: Heal
description: Scientists and spiritual teachers discuss how thoughts, beliefs, and emotions impact human health and the ability to heal.

title: Hearing Is Believing
description: "Hearing Is Believing" introduces the world to the young musician & composer Rachel Flowers. Born premature, she soon lost her eyesight but had perfect pitch. The film illuminates the bonds of family and the divine mysteries of creativity.

title: Heartbeat
description: This drama series evokes the mood of the swinging 60s in a peaceful countryside setting. Based on the Constable books by Nicholas Rhea, Heartbeat combines humour, drama and compelling characters.

title: Heartbeats
description: From the creator of Step Up & Save The Last Dance comes the story of a feisty American hip hop dancer who travels to India and falls in love with a new style of dance, and with the determined young man who introduces it to her.

title: Heartland
description: A widow with a young daughter packs up their life and travels to a ranch in the unsettled frontier of Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher.

title: Heartland
description: An artist whose lover died moves in with her Mom, whose hopes that her daughter will go straight are disrupted by her brother’s intense girlfriend.

title: Heartland Homicide
description: It happens when you least expect it. Heartland Homicide chronicles stories of when horrible crimes visit quaint, small-town America.

title: Heart of a Champion
description: A drama centering around a 14-year-old girl from a divorced home, Charlie, who dreams of raising a horse and competing in a riding competition.

title: Heart of Champions
description: When an army vet takes over as coach, the lives of a dysfunctional rowing team are changed forever.

title: Heart of Dixie
description: Based on a novel by Anne Rivers Siddons, this film takes place at an Alabama college in the turbulent 1950s, when the old South collided with the new.

title: Heart of Hope
description: Iris wants to become a ballerina but her heart condition inhibits her ability to dance. With a little help from Grandma and her own imagination will she find a way to make her dream come true?

title: Heart of Midnight
description: While recovering from a mental breakdown, Carol inherits a seedy nightclub and her sanity is put to the test as she discovers its dark secrets.

title: Heart of the Country
description: With her husband jailed for fraud, Faith leaves her life of luxury to return to rural North Carolina and the family she'd left behind.

title: Heart of the Home
description: A cautionary tale for renters inspired by true events about two young women taking in a mysterious new roommate who makes wigs out of human hair.

title: Heart of the Rio Grande
description: Gene Autry tames a spoiled teenage shrew sent to a Dude Ranch for the summer and in the process humanizes her father into being a better parent. Action includes stampeding horses, and a bold rescue!

title: Heart of the Rockies
description: Cattle are being rustled and suspicion falls on a local mountain family.

title: Hearts Afire
description: An ambitious political insider and his fiery journalist wife butt heads often, but their clashes only make their marriage and family grow stronger.

title: Hearts Beat Loud
description: Before his daughter leaves for college, a father urges his daughter to take their weekly jam sessions and form an unlikely songwriting duo.

title: Heart's Creek
description: An event planner from the city gets lost and rescued by a mountain guide in the Rocky Mountains. Despite clashes, they learn they’re better together.

title: Hearts & Horses
description: A man is thrust into fatherhood when the daughter he didn’t know he had is delivered to his apple farm. With love and a horse, they may have a chance.

title: Hearts in Bondage
description: Best friends Kenneth Reynolds and Raymond Jordan are U.S. Navy officers, and Kenneth is engaged to Raymond's sister. But the eruption of the Civil War divides them, as Raymond stands by his native Virginia while Kenneth remains on duty as a Northern officer. Kenneth's uncle, John Ericsson, designs a new kind of ship, an ironclad he calls the Monitor. Eventually the war pits Kenneth, on board the Monitor, against his friend Raymond, serving aboard the South's own ironclad, the Merrimac (as it is called here). A naval battle ensues, one that will go down in history.

title: Hearts Under the Olive Tree
description: Looking for inspiration for her next fantasy book, a renowned author is taken to a farmland retreat, where something even more magical awaits.

title: Heathers
description: When a snobbish high school clique threatens to ruin her reputation, a teenage girl teams up with a sociopath and plots to kill the cool kids.

title: Heat Street
description: When his daughter is attacked by a ruthless biker gang, an aging boxer joins forces with a repo man to exact his revenge on the thugs.

title: Heatstroke
description: A hoard of alien dinosaurs are set to take over an Earth at risk from a rising heat index until a soldier and an ex-model step in to take it back.

title: Heavenly Deposit
description: A modern-day Atlas bearing the weight of the world comes face-to-face with the existence of God.

title: Heaven or Vegas
description: Rachel, a part-time call girl, dreams of leaving this world behind. After meeting Navy, a high-class gigolo, they search for a new life together.

title: Heavenquest: A Pilgrim's Progress
description: Inspired by “The Pilgrim’s Progress,” one ordinary man’s life is caught in the balance between  ageless struggle between the forces of evil and good.

title: Heaven's Door
description: A girl mourning the loss of her grandparents and suffering from her parents’ divorce finds a portal to Heaven and is granted miraculous powers.

title: Heaven Sent
description: Some confusion in heaven gives a 14-year-old juvenile delinquent help from a beginner angel and three days to clean up his life and save his mom.

title: Heaven's Gate
description: This ambitious frontier epic features a lawman (Kris Kristofferson) and a hitman (Christopher Walken) who fight in a tragic class war between ranchers and starving immigrants.

title: Heavy Mental: A Rock-n-Roll Blood Bath
description: The story of a garage band rock star named Ace who receives a guitar as a gift that once belonged to the god father of heavy metal, Eddie Lee Stryker. Ace soon realizes that this guitar is possessed by the spirit of Eddie and that the rock god was murdered by Mrs. Delicious (the beautiful and deadly Detroit crime boss).

title: Heavy Petting
description: An entertaining and salacious exploration documentary about sex in 1950s through the eyes of a generation that lived through the Sexual Revolution.

title: Hector and the Search for Happiness
description: A disillusioned psychiatrist's search for the key to his happiness takes him around the world.

title: Hedda
description: From Nia DaCosta comes a provocative, modern reimagining of Henrik Ibsen's classic play. HEDDA (Tessa Thompson) finds herself torn between the lingering ache of a past love and the quiet suffocation of her present life. Over the course of one charged night, long-repressed desires and hidden tensions erupt-pulling her and everyone around her into a spiral of manipulation, passion, and betrayal.

title: He Dreams of Giants
description: A pair of filmmakers capture Terry Gilliam’s 25-year creative obsession with adapting Don Quixote as his dream finally becomes a reality.

title: Heightened
description: After a mental breakdown, a young woman returns to Maine and finds unexpected solace alongside a neurotic Park Ranger with his own struggles.

title: Haunted Hospital: Heilstatten
description: When social media influencers try to go viral by filming paranormal events at a condemned asylum, they find out they may be uploading their funerals.

title: Wonderland
description: As a hurricane of catastrophic proportions is brewing over Switzerland, the country is thrown into disarray, facing its last days before destruction.

title: Heirloom: Guitar
description: Discover the history of the steel string acoustic guitar from its humble beginnings to becoming one of the world's most popular instruments.

title: Heir of the Witch
description: An underprivileged seamstress, haunted by her past, seeks love and acceptance in high society but is faced with the curse from her evil roots.

title: He Kills at Night
description: On Christmas Eve, Marie is stalked by a mysterious blood-soaked man as she drives home for the holidays. But is everything as it seems?

title: Held For Ransom
description: Wealthy candy businessman Herbert Scott is kidnapped and then held for ransom. Scott's son, Larry (Withers) pays the $50,000 ransom, but his father is not released. The FBI then brings in their best agent, the formidable Betty Mason (Mehaffey) to work with Detective J.J. Morrison (Mulhall) to track down the kidnappers. Betty ends up romancing both her partner Morrison, and Larry Scott, who is suspected to be behind the kidnapping. The pair finally discover the remote hideout where Herbert is being kept, leading to a climactic final shootout. A classic crime caper with an unusual twist for the time of having a woman be the lead detective.

title: Held Up
description: A wrong turn on a dream desert getaway with his fiancée leaves Michael dumped, car jacked, held hostage, and dodging bullets at the local Sip and Zip.

title: Helen Hong: Well Hong
description: The comedian and actor takes to the stage to confess she spent the Covid quarantine trying to date doomsday preppers and stealing her dog's Xanax.

title: Heli
description: A factory worker struggles to protect his family from a corrupt police force when his sister inadvertently lands them in the middle of a drug war.

title: Hell and Mr Fudge
description: Based on the true story of a young preacher in 1970s Alabama who comes under fire from his church after setting out to study the existence of Hell.

title: Hellarious
description: An anthology of seven shorts of pure comedic horror featuring amateur satanists, reverse werewolves, psychotic lunch ladies, and zombie spouses.

title: Hell at My Heels
description: Two men who were chained together and left to die in the brutal desert sun overcome hell on earth to get revenge on the sheriff who condemned them.

title: Hell Baby
description: In this horror-comedy, an expectant couple calls the Vatican's exorcism team for help delivering an evil child after they move into a haunted house.

title: Hellblazers
description: In the 1980’s Southwest, a satanic cult bent on unleashing hell on Earth conjures a demon that its members must feed with a small town’s residents.

title: Hellblock 13
description: In a haunted death-row cell block, a deranged female serial killer, Tara, reads a trio of twisted tales to her executioner.

title: Hell Bound
description: His scheme: to steal war-surplus narcotic drugs from a ship in the Los Angeles harbor. However, he requires backers--which he seeks with a 16mm promotional film shown to gangsters. They agree. Bad decision.

title: Hellbound: Hellraiser II
description: This brutal sequel follows Kristy, as she is brought to an institution. The facilities won't keep her safe from the return of a certain demon.

title: Hellbox

description: A woman suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder following an attack moves to a new city seeking a fresh start, but her past seems to follow her.

title: H Is for Hawk
description: After the sudden death of her father (Brendan Gleeson), Helen (Claire Foy) loses herself in the memories of their time birding and turns to the ancient art of falconry, training a wild goshawk named Mabel to navigate her profound loss.

title: His, Hers and the Truth
description: Alan and Tanya have been acquaintances for years but have not become romantically involved. Until now, that is. What could go wrong?

title: His Majesty King Charles III
description: Leading up to his coronation in May 2023, interviews from those who know him examine the life of the longest heir apparent to the throne.

title: His Only Son
description: His Only Son recounts one of the most controversial moments in the Old Testament—when Abraham was commanded by God to sacrifice his son Isaac on the mountain of Moriah.While traveling to the place of the sacrifice, alongside Isaac and two servants, Abraham is flooded with vivid memories from the years he and Sarah spent longing for the son they were promised—the son he must now lay upon the altar.

title: His Secret Past
description: The suspicions of a bestselling crime novelist are raised when she starts to question if her assaulted daughter’s new boyfriend was behind the attack.

title: The Story of Drug Trafficking
description: There are few commodities as global as drugs. How this trade influenced relations between states, global financial interests, secret diplomacies, secret special forces and mafias, on all continents over a century in a half.

title: History of the Occult
description: For its final broadcast, a legacy investigative news show preps for a guest who claims to be a warlock with devastating top-level government secrets.

title: Historias lamentables
description: In four interconnected stories a young man inherits an empire, a sickly vacationer visits the beach, an immigrant pursues his dream, and a businessman is mired in despair.

title: History in the Making
description: Reveals the addictive and endlessly entertaining process of making historically significant items using the original, time-honored methods.

title: History's Greatest Hoaxes
description: This series focuses on the greatest hoaxes in history that have tricked people into believing things weren’t quite how they seemed.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description: Join host Laurence Fishburne as he explores the world's most enduring secrets, myths, and legends using new evidence and expert analysis.

title: History's Mysteries
description: Explore some of the mysterious questions Big History experts are still trying to solve.

title: Hit a Lick
description: Caught between the hustle of working for a local crime boss and managing his nephew’s music career, a man must make tough decisions.

title: Hit and Run
description: A college student discovers a man's nearly dead body impaled on her Jeep and makes a series of fateful decisions as he comes back to terrorize her.

title: Hit and Run
description: A cabbie grieving his wife’s death in a hit and run crash goes on the run for clues when he’s framed for murder after driving for a mysterious woman.

Hitler: Germany's Fatal Attraction tracks the birth, rise and ultimate demise of Hitler and the Nazi Party.
