description: Eva Braun. Hitler’s mistress and eventual wife. A woman with a passion for photography and film, documenting the daily ongoings among Hitler’s inner circle. Now, a haunting look behind closed doors, uncovering the Eva Braun tapes.

title: Hitler's bodyguard
description: The story of Adolf Hitler and his vast security detail, exploring the constant real and imagined threats that surrounded his rule.

title: Hitler's Defeat: Victory Against All Odds
description: This is the journey of British people’s courage, resourcefulness and ‘Keep Calm and Carry On’ attitude led to victory in the fight against Hitler.

title: Hitler's Engineers: Building the Third Reich
description: This series explores the lives of six of Hitler’s most crucial engineers, revealing how their work helped forge the Third Reich, promote the image of the regime to the German people, and facilitate the biggest war in history.

title: Hitler's England
description: John Nettles tells the story of the British Channel Islands under German occupation from 1940 to 1945. During the 1980s Nettles, having studied history before becoming an actor, played the lead in a long-running TV series set on Jersey.

title: Hitler's Holocaust Railways
description: Chris Tarrant goes on a personal journey to explore the darkest chapter in the history of the railways, their role in the Nazi Holocaust of WWII.

title: Hitler's Olympics
description: This documentary tells the story of the 1936 Berlin Olympics, held by pre-war Nazi Germany, which took advantage of the event for propaganda.

title: Hitler's Secret Missions
description: In this thrilling documentary series, "Hitler's Secret Missions" delves into the covert operations orchestrated by Adolf Hitler during World War II. With six politically sensitive and highly complex missions, including two successes, one abandonment, and three failures, the series unveils the shadows of history.

title: Hitler's SS: Portrait in Evil
description: German brothers come of age during Hitler’s rise to power and find themselves pitted against each other, until their bond and homeland stand in ruins.

title: Hitler's War
description: An account of Adolf Hitler's rise to power in Germany and the subsequent downfall of the Nazi Regime.

title: Hitler The Junkie
description: This special examines the medications Hitler was taking, how much he took and how often.

title: Hitler: The Making of a Monster
description: This documentary traces the life of the most notorious villain of the 20th century from his childhood in Austria to his reign of terror during WWII.

title: Hitler: The Rise and Fall
description: In this series, world-renowned experts investigate the man behind the monster - taking us into Hitler's mind and revealing what made him tick. Using the latest research across the course of Hitler's life, they will pinpoint the key moments in his meteoric rise and ultimate downfall.

title: Hitler: The Rise of Evil
description: Robert Carlyle stars as the German dictator during his rise to power in this television miniseries. After spending years as a frustrated artist in Vienna, Adolf Hitler enlists in the German army during the First World War. Embittered by Germany's defeat, Hitler begins his gradual rise to power in the ranks of the newly-formed National Socialist Party.

title: Hit List
description: A woman whose internet dates are awful writes in her anger management journal until it’s soon found by a handsome hit man who falls in love with her.

title: Hitman: Agent 47
description: Your number is up.

title: Hitters
description: Un respetado líder cívico se encuentra atrapado entre dos brutales familias criminales rivales del hampa al borde de una guerra sangrienta.

title: Hoarders
description: This series delves into the mental disorder of hoarding, as experts work to help individuals overcome obsessive collecting and reclaim their lives.

title: Hoax
description: An investigative team travels deep into Colorado’s remote wilderness, after a group of young campers are viciously murdered by what may be Bigfoot.

title: Hobbyhorse Revolution
description: Imaginative teens in Finland deal with growing pains of adolescence and find their voice through hobby-horse competitions similar to equestrian shows.

title: Hobo Heyseus
description: A penniless drifter breaks down in a small town and has to exchange his words and deeds of wisdom in exchange for help, but all doesn’t go smoothly.

title: Headhunters
description: Roger funds his luxurious life in Norway by stealing valuable art, but a risky heist involving a prized painting leaves him a hunted man.

title: Hogan's Heroes
description: The inmates of a German World War II prisoner of war camp conduct an espionage and sabotage campaign right under the noses of their warders.

title: Hogfather
description: Welcome to the Discworld, a parallel universe drifting through space perched on top of four elephants standing on the shell of a giant turtle, the Great A'Tuin. Here, reality is stretched to its limit, but it's still populated by humans, just like you and me. Almost.

title: Hola Frida!
description: Little Frida is a bright-eyed girl who loves exploring in her Mexican village and playing with friends. When a polio diagnosis casts a cloud over her spirit, she is forced into the solitude of her bedroom. There, she finds solace in her imagination, brimming with possibilities. Hola Frida recreates the early life of famed artist Frida Kahlo and highlights the saving power of imagination.

title: Hold Fast, Good Luck
description: With only a week and a half together, transient twenty-somethings Michael and Laura form a deep, intense connection before they have to part ways.

title: Hold That Woman!
description: A skip tracer repossesses a small radio from a deadbeat who's skipped payments. What he doesn't know is that a gang has stashed stolen diamonds inside the radio, and they start hunting for him.

title: Hold the Dream
description: Paula Fairley, now head of the Harte chain of department stores, has taken on the burden of preserving Emma's legacy. However, she suffers dissent within her extended family, in particular from her devious cousin Jonathan Ainsley. Her marriage to Jim Fairley is unhappy, leading her into the arms of her childhood sweetheart, Shane O'Neill, grandson of Blackie O'Neill.

title: Holes in the Sky: The Sean Miller Story
description: A shoot detailing the 2013 alien abduction of Sean Miller turns into a life-changing experience for everyone involved as events spiral out of control.

title: Holiday Breakup
description: A couple falls crazy in love, only to break up right before all the big holiday parties. It's Suckville, so they pretend to still be mad for each other instead of mad at each other. It's the perfect plan-if they don't fall back in love.

title: Holiday Engagement
description: Afraid to show up to Thanksgiving alone, Hillary hires an unemployed artist to pretend to be her fiancé. But this might not be a one-time engagement.

title: Holiday for Hire
description: Dumped the day before going home for the holidays, Katie hires a stranger to pretend to be her boyfriend during Christmas with her family.

title: Holiday Heart
description: The story of a gay drag queen (Ving Rhames) who begins to care for a girl, whose mother (Alfre Woodard) is fighting drug addiction, but a dealer (Mykelti Williamson) threatens everything.

title: Holiday Heartbreak
description: It’s a karma Christmas at the McCoy house when Mike’s playboy past catches up with his hopeless romantic daughter and threatens to ruin her love life.

title: Holiday Hell
description: On Christmas Eve, a woman enters a curiosity shop looking for a gift where the strange shopkeeper tells her the horrific stories behind four objects.

title: Holiday in the Hamptons
description: Time and distance can’t dim first love. When Jade returns to her grandfather’s Hamptons home, she reunites with the person who once had her heart.

title: Holiday Joy
description: After making a Christmas wish for the perfect family, a shy high school student learns that perfection might not be all it's cracked up to be.

title: Holiday Road Trip
description: Two feuding business associates employees fall for each other while escorting a celebrity dog on a Christmas promotional tour.

title: Holiday Twist
description: Tender thought provoking story of overcoming adversity through intertwining lives that ultimately ends on a magical journey to save Christmas and each other.

title: Holiday Wishes
description: Britney, a rich, spoiled child, and Rachel, an orphan, switch bodies after a visit to the mall with Santa Claus.  Each girl wakes up as the other - Britney is in the orphanage, and Rachel is at Britney's family's mansion.

title: Holland
description: In this wildly unpredictable thriller, Nicole Kidman is the meticulous Nancy Vandergroot, a teacher and homemaker whose picture-perfect life with her community pillar husband and son in tulip-filled Holland, Michigan tumbles into a twisted tale. Nancy and her friendly colleague become suspicious of a secret, only to discover nothing in their lives is what it seems.

title: Hollow Creek
description: A popular horror novelist heads to spooky Appalachia in search of inspiration, and becomes the prime suspect in a missing person case.

title: Hollow Reed
description: A doctor loses his wife and child custody when he comes out as gay, leading to a raw custody battle after his ex-wife’s new husband abuses their son.

title: Hollows Grove
description: A young filmmaker takes on a deadly project when he follows a ghost hunters on an investigation of an abandoned orphanage rumored to be haunted.

description: Hollow Water, in Central Manitoba, is home to 450 people, many of them victims of sexual abuse. Hollow Water chose to bring the offenders home to face justice in a community healing and sentencing circle. Based on traditional practices, this unique model is reuniting families and healing both victims and their offenders.

title: Holly and the Hot Chocolate
description: Stranded in a small town for Christmas, a big city food critic discovers a life-changing hot chocolate recipe and a charming truck driver.

title: Crossroads
description: Holly and her group of friends stumble through a turning point in their lives as they face tough decisions about their relationships and careers.

title: Hollywood Barn Dance
description: A country-western band heads to Hollywood to try to raise substantial money to rebuild their small-town church after it burns down.

title: Hollywood Chaos
description: A cub entertainment reporter must choose between furthering her career by exposing her celebrity friends or saving their images and her relationships.

title: Hollywood Dreams & Nightmares: The Robert Englund Story
description: This documentary looks at the life and career of Robert Englund, a classically trained actor and director who became a revolutionary horror icon.

title: Hollywood Ending
description: Just before a washed-up director is set to begin production on a blockbuster, he goes blind and must find a way to hide his ailment from the studio.

description: Brothers Martina and Luca travel from Las Vegas to Hollywood. Along the way they meet two convicts and Cherie a showgirl who flees his representative. The convicts kidnap Martina and force Luca to carry a 3 million bag.

description: After his daughter vanishes from a jazz club, a detective battles mobsters, starlets, and his own demons to uncover a dark truth in Los Angeles.

description: From Midwest dreamer to Hollywood fraudster, Zach Horwitz constructs an elaborate over $650 million Hollywood scam to finance his obsessive quest for stardom. His former inner circle recount how Zach preyed on their trust while living extravagantly, but when investors stop receiving payments, the facade crumbles, exposing the depths of his deception.

title: Hollywood Safari
description: It's a jungle out there when a deadly lion attacks a teenage boy deep in the woods. After jumping out of a truck on the way to a movie set, Kensho a trained mountain lion, is mistaken for the killer lion. Kensho wanders off into the woods leaving an unsuspecting team of animal trainers to arrive at the location only to find that she has escaped.

title: Hollywood's Dark Secret
description: Hollywood's casting couch is exposed as brave voices risk all to reveal shocking abuse by powerful figures, bringing long-hidden truths to light.

title: Hollywood Shuffle
description: Lampoons Hollywood's treatment of non-white talent through a Black actor’s endless rounds of insulting casting calls, hoping to catch his big break.

title: Holocaust 2000
description: Robert is in charge of constructing a nuclear power plant in the Middle East. Will it be instrumental in the prophecies of the Antichrist?

title: Holy Air
description: Adam and Lamia are a Christian Arab couple from Nazareth - members of a vanishing minority in the Holy Land. When Lamia gets pregnant, Adam decides it's time to make it big and provide for his family by entering the biggest local business - religion. He begins to sell... Holy Air. Official Selection of Tribeca Film Festival 2017, Mill Valley Festival, Palm Springs International Festival

title: Holy Cross
description: A drama about sectarian hatred in Belfast, based on real events in 2001. Conflict arises when Catholic girls walk through a Protestant area to get to the Holy Cross Primary School.

title: Holy Hell
description: This documentary looks at Buddhafield, a West Hollywood cult, through the eyes of a then young idealist who formed a part of it for twenty years.

title: Holy Land
description: A young musician-turned-writer sets out on a cross-country road trip across the United States to Virginia while working on a novel.

description: A look at the racism that sent an 89 year-old Lakota Sioux medicine man from South Dakota to prison for 17 years, for a crime he did not commit.

title: Holy Marvels with Dennis Quaid
description: The nonfiction series HOLY MARVELS WITH DENNIS QUAID illuminates the remarkable history, perplexing mysteries, and legendary journeys behind some of the worlds relics including objects of immortality, holy riches, revered monuments, and more.

title: Holy Rollers: The True Story of Card Counting Christians
description: Holy Rollers follows the rise of arguably the largest and most well-funded blackjack team in America-made up entirely of churchgoing Christians. While they succeed in taking millions from casinos, how will they manage to find a place for faith and God in the arena of high stakes gambling?

title: Hombre
description: A white man raised by Apaches faces numerous challenges from bigoted passengers when outlaws ambush their stagecoach in this taut western drama.

description: After suffering a tragic loss, a family in Nebraska welcomes a young orphan into their home, but the young boy has trouble adjusting to rural life.

description: Melanie's afternoon babysitting gender-questioning Johnny takes a strange turn when her body is inexplicably inhabited by the 9-year-old's spirit.

title: Homeboy
description: A small-time boxer with a brain injury falls for a cute carnival owner, but also befriends a shady character, who aims to use him for a big score.

description: A caseworker at a facility that helps soldiers transition back to civilian life leaves to start a new life, living with her mother and working as a small-town waitress.

description: Star quarterback Mike returns home from uni at Christmas with a new girlfriend, Elizabeth. Everyone is surprised, especially his ex, Shelby, who wants her out of the way. When a freak car accident leaves an injured Elizabeth at the mercy of Shelby, all breaks loose.

description: After being abandoned by her distraught mother, 13-year-old Dicey is determined to get her three siblings to the home of their Aunt Cilla.

description: When her cultist father dies, a homeschooled teenage girl kept in seclusion by her iron-fisted mother becomes convinced of his feasible resurrection.

description: A trip back to her hometown, where she left heartbroken years earlier, finds a travel writer having to decide between her ex and a charming new beau.

title: Home Invasion
description: When the victim of a home robbery kills her intruder in self defense, his girlfriend sets out to destroy her life by infiltrating her support group.

title: Home in Wyomin'
description: Radio star Gene Autry must solve a murder mystery at the Frontier Days pageant in Wyoming that involves a newspaper photographer, Chicago gangsters, a deserted mine, and a surprise ending.

title: Home Is Where The Killer Is
description: A woman discovers the previous tenant of her new apartment died under mysterious circumstances that were caused by the landlord and a sinister plan.

description: A teenage boy and his father migrate to a small town where they meet a young woman who’s suffering from the horrific attacks of her abusive parent.

description: Featuring interviews with people living on the streets of Los Angeles, this vivid documentary shines a light on the harsh realities of homelessness.

description: Every year, an ambitious young woman uses the weeks leading up to Christmas to become the ultimate holiday freelance assistant for hire, helping with any Christmas related tasks for extra income. But when the opportunity arrives to save a Christmas party and dazzle her crush, she must choose between the man of her aspirations and Mr. Right.

title: Home of the Brave
description: Two young men, a war veteran and a cop, are on a dramatic collision course despite their good intentions to help an underprivileged community.

title: Home on the Prairie
description: Livestock inspectors (and a friendly elephant) uncover the truth about a rancher’s cattle that appear to have hoof and mouth disease.

description: Film adaptation of Eto Mori's novel, Colorful. “Blank,” a soul chosen by the mysterious “Guardian,” homestays in the body of Makoto, a deceased high school student. But a glimmer of light and large darkness intersect in the truth.

description: Don Champagne seems to have it all. But when his wife learns of his affair, she'll stop at nothing to preserve their storybook life.

description: A social butterfly barista pretends to be a “church person” in order to win the heart of a guy who runs a ministry that builds affordable housing.

description: A selfish man with a past full of mistakes learns some humility when he's forced into coaching a down-on-their-luck children's soccer team.

description: Una cirujana regresa a casa para celebrar que su padre se convierta en alcalde y conoce al único médico de la ciudad que es el soltero más elegible.

description: A couple comes to regret listing their remote lake house on a vacation rental app, especially after their recent guests create a house of horrors.

description: Hear stories behind famous shots captured in major conflict zones by war photographer Christopher Hondros until his death documenting the Arab Spring.

We meet Colby [King David] who is dealing with the death of his father; returning to his childhood home after four years of being away. And next door lives the infamous Mark [Donta Hensley], a man who is known up and down the block for his temper and violent ways. Then there's JT [Tripp Ali].

title: Honest Thief
description: Action-packed thrills, edge-of-your-seat car chases and high-stakes explosions are up for grabs! Starring Liam Neeson (Taken) as a career criminal turned good-guy who is double crossed by a corrupt FBI agent (Jai Courtney) and framed for murder. Directed by Mark Williams (Ozark), Honest Thief follows Tom (Neeson), a bank robber who tries to turn himself in after falling for Annie (Kate Walsh).

description: After discovering he was misdiagnosed with a terminal illness, a family man must make good on the promises he made to be a better Christian.

description: In the hopes of turning their marriage around, a young couple on the rocks is prescribed a no-holds-barred weekend of truth-telling and chaos.

HONEY BOY follows two threads of time, watching father and son's contentious rela..

description: A camping-trip-gone-wrong sends a young couple to seek shelter at a ramshackle farmhouse where they’re soon gripped by carnivorous cravings.

title: Honeymoon From Hell
description: Young newlyweds Julia and Rivers find themselves stranded at a coastal bed and breakfast during a dangerous hurricane. At first they try to make the best of it and get to know the other trapped travelers, but as events start to get odd, and then suspicious, Julia begins to believe they are being haunted by a legendary ghost.

title: Honeymoon Limited
description: Discouraged and unsuccessful writer Dick Gordon (Hamilton) concocts a plan to earn money and get publicity by walking from New York to San Francisco in six months, then writing a book on his experiences. Along the way, a horrible storm forces Dick to take refuge in what he believes to be a deserted, remote cabin. However, he finds a runaway and her two sisters also hiding out there. But all are placed in danger when the cabin's owner shows up, along with his gangster pals, to retrieve their stolen money, which is hidden in the cabin. Never one to miss an opportunity, Dick is ecstatic to finally find an exciting true story worth writing about, but will he survive long enough to pen his book?

title: Honk
description: While recycling in a local park, actress Cheryl Allison develops an unlikely friendship with a mourning goose who then becomes a viral sensation.

title: Honor Amongst Men
description: A day in the life of a veteran cop juggling a turbulent home life and stressful job with an inevitable biker war that's about to engulf his hometown.

As the friends fight for their lives they are faced with the impossible task of escaping their prison and eliminating the ghost incarnate.

description: After a lawyer’s brother is murdered, she follows the clues to a deadly underground basketball league, where violence is just part of the game.

description: When a basketball player collapses on the court and undergoes risky surgery to remove a lethal brain tumor, his will and faith meet the ultimate test.

description: Enjoy the classic gun-slinging Western adventures a well-meaning fellow and his loyal band of cowboys, who hail from the Bar 20 ranch.

But after the death of her military father, she and her mother are in danger of losing their family ranch too.  With a little help from friends and their majestic white horse, they hatch a plan to raise enough money to save the ranch while learning to never lose hope, despite all odds.

description: The first ever series based on the well known books of the same name published by Scholastic. Originally produced for CiTV, ABC and Discovery and now available exclusively to Amazon Prime. Horrible Science is a spoof of a TV science show with behind the scenes and shiny floor drama starring Ben Miller.

title: Horror Candy
description: Presents nine eclectic tales of terror, each a unique nightmare ranging from dystopian futures to haunted space stations.

description: Guests at a motel find they have trouble sleeping while sharing quarters with aliens, ghosts, killers and other things that go bump in the night.

title: Priceless
description: Through a set of wacky circumstances, a young gold digger mistakenly woos a mild-mannered bartender thinking he's a wealthy suitor.

title: Out of this World
description: A troubled taxi driver and frustrated musician with a dark secret finds himself in a precarious romance with a mesmerizing deaf dancer.

title: Hustling America
description: TV conman Alexis Conran travels across America, he wants to see if his skills in deception and magic will allow him to pull off the hardest cons of all: the so-called Proposition Bets - outlandish sounding wagers that are almost impossible to win unless you know the cunning secret behind them. He's on a personal mission to measure himself against the greatest hustlers in the country.

title: Hybrid
description: After a young man is blinded in an explosion, he becomes the first human subject for a cross-species organ transplant that bears unexpected results.

title: Hydra
description: Strangers are confronted by a mythical, multi-headed serpent after finding themselves in a remote place with no idea how they got there.

title: Hydra
description: After retiring as an assassin, Takashi leads a quiet life as a chef where he secretly watches over the daughter of a former mark. His peace is short-lived when he is recruited for a final job that he can't refuse.

title: Hyena Road
description: A jaded sniper, an intelligence officer without any combat kills, and a reluctant Afghan warrior called back to war come together to save lives.

title: Hyenas
description: A man, Gannon, whose family was brutally murdered, returns to the scene of the crime to find justice for his family while seeking out his revenge. With the recruitment of the town’s hunter Gannon learns of this growing breed that hunts in packs waiting to eat you alive. Together they will stop at nothing to bring this growing breed to extinction.

title: Hype!
description: This documentary chronicles the frenzy surrounding "grunge music" in the 1990s, as Seattle's underground music scene exploded into the mainstream.

title: Hyperdrive
description: At the forefront of this expeditionary force is the HMS Camden Lock, helmed by the irrepressible, if a little tetchy, Commander Henderson. Ably assisted by a crew of misfits - the further they are from Earth the better, quite frankly - the Commander steers his ship through the stars, giving orders from his big swivelly chair.  His crew? Well, you wouldn't wish on your worst enemy... or maybe you would...  Experience the highs, the lows, the anti-gravity failures, the annoying talking mops, and, of course, the wars with alien races. Lots of wars. Always in the national interest, of course.

title: Hypnotic
description: Determined to find his missing daughter, detective Danny Rourke instead finds himself spiraling down a rabbit hole while investigating a series of reality-bending bank robberies where he will ultimately call into question his most basic assumptions about everything and everyone in his world. Aided by Diana Cruz, an unnervingly gifted psychic, Rourke simultaneously pursues and is pursued by a le...

title: Hypothermia
description: Two families’ idyllic ice fishing vacation at a cabin on a frozen lake turns deadly when they awaken the mysterious creature just below their feet.

title: I Accuse
description: A woman faces brutal criticism, as she accuses a respected physician of raping her while she was sedated under his care. Based on a real story.

title: Iain Stirling Failing Upwards
description: BAFTA-winning comedian, “the voiceover of a generation” (Evening Standard) voice of ‘Love Island’ and co-creator & star of “zippy, gag-dense” (Guardian) ‘Buffering’, Iain Stirling explores topics including his inability to function in the most basic of public settings, the pressures of being in the public eye and that one time a man stole his shoes. Live from London’s Alexandra Palace Theatre.

title: I Am an Addict
description: A self-help guru makes use of his surreal public access show as an aversion therapy to scare the monkeys off the backs of his addicted viewership.

title: I Am Bruce Lee
description: Bruce Lee expert John Little tracks down the real world locations of some of Lee's most iconic action scenes, largely unchanged nearly 50 years later.

title: I Am Burt Reynolds
description: I Am Burt Reynolds follows an iconic career from its beginnings in Old Hollywood through to breakout roles in Deliverance and The Longest Yard, to the smash hit, Smokey and the Bandit and on to Boogie Nights, revealing how Southern charm combined with a progressive attitude towards women, race and sexuality made Burt Reynolds a hero to all.

title: I Am: Celine Dion
description: Directed by Academy Award nominee Irene Taylor, I Am: Celine Dion gives us a raw and honest behind-the-scenes look at the iconic superstar’s struggle with a life-altering illness. Serving as a love letter to her fans, this inspirational documentary highlights the music that has guided her life while also showcasing the resilience of the human spirit.

title: I Am Chris Farley
description: Friends, family and colleagues discuss the life and career of comic Chris Farley, the popular star of "Saturday Night Live" and numerous films.

title: I Am DB Cooper
description: Two bounty hunters embark on a modern-day treasure hunt when a criminal on his way to jail tells them about a stash of money he buried 50 years prior.

title: I Am Dina
description: Little Dina accidentally causes her mother's death. Dina grows up wild and unmanageable, with her only friend being the stable boy, Tomas. She summons her mother's ghost and develops a strange fascination with death as well as a passion for living.

title: I Am Evel Knievel
description: The Inside story of the original daredevil, Evel Knievel. Weaving archival footage along with celebrity interviews, get to know the one who gave birth to the culture of extreme with his death defying feats which astonished the world.

title: I Am Gabriel
description: Just when things are at their darkest in Promise, Texas, a mysterious boy wanders out of the wilderness and shows its residents a path to salvation.

title: I Am Heath Ledger
description: I am Heath Ledger depicts an extremely gifted and versatile artist whose talents span a broad array of mediums.

title: I Am Here
description: A magnetic South African woman and one of the oldest living Holocaust survivors celebrates her 98th birthday by unpacking her staggering life journey.

title: I Am Jackie O
description: Exploring the character of a woman living through tragedy in the public eye and remaking her life, I Am Jackie O explores a legacy that transcends her role as president's wife and national widow, cementing her as one of the most important cultural icons in American history.

title: Jack's Apocalypse
description: An addict ex-politician gets his shot at redemption when it’s up to him to keep his sister-in-law and niece alive during the apocalypse.

title: I Am JFK Jr.
description: An inside look at the life of JFK Jr, featuring interviews with friends and associates that knew him well.

title: I Am Joe
description: A quantum physics professor is forced to take action after being drugged by the leader of jewish cult who wants him to come back home and become the man he once was.

title: I Am Joe Frazier
description: A feature documentary celebrating the rise of a humble but driven boxing perfectionist who triumphantly emerged from Muhammad Ali's long shadow.

title: I Am Lisa
description: After being brutalized by a sadistic local sheriff, Lisa is bitten by a wolf and awakens with mystical abilities that empower her to settle the score.

title: I Am Living Proof
description: A compelling and intimate look into the lives of three individuals who face an extraordinary life-altering event during their darkest hour when they meet a traveling preacher, Mario Murillo, who brings his iconic tent revival to town.

title: I Am Luke Perry
description: Celebrating the life of a generational acting talent who emerged from small-town obscurity to become a Hollywood heartthrob and a pop culture icon.

title: I Am MLK Jr.
description: I Am MLK Jr. is a feature-length documentary telling the story of American icon Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. while celebrating his life from an engaging contemporary perspective structured around seminal events in the Civil Rights Movement.

title: I Am Norman
description: A young man damaged by conversion therapy who’s been living out of his car for years leads a filmmaker into the woods to share a dark secret.

title: I Am Not a Hipster
description: A San Diego singer-songwriter grapples with the meaning of creativity and his newfound success while coping with the death of his mother.

title: I Am Not a Rapist
description: Tells the dramatic story of three young men falsely accused of rape and the devastating consequences the allegations have had on their lives.

title: I Am Patrick Swayze
description: I Am Patrick Swayze is a documentary exploring the 1980’s most recognizable leading man, who challenged Hollywood’s notions of masculinity and redefined what it meant to be the Sexiest Man Alive. Featuring never-before-seen home videos, photos and original interviews with those who knew him best.

title: I Am Paul Walker
description: I Am Paul Walker is a feature-length documentary film exploring the life and legacy of actor Paul Walker, the Southern California native who cut his teeth as child actor before breaking out in the blockbuster Fast and Furious franchise.

title: I Am Rage
description: An ancient cult embroiled in a sinister blood trade makes the deadly mistake of abducting a young woman with a violent, shocking past.

title: I Am Raquel Welch
description: Celebrating the life of an actress and single mother who redefined the idea of a sex symbol.

title: I Am Richard Pryor
description: I Am Richard Pryor tells the life story of the legendary performer and iconic social satirist, who transcended race and social barriers by delivering his honest irreverent and biting humor to America's stages and living rooms until his death at 65.

title: I Am Sam Kinison
description: Exploring a life that ranged from the restrained to the excessive, the comic to the tragic, and the sublime to the ridiculous; candid stories from family and friends go over Kinison's upbringing and rise to fame.

title: I Am Soldier
description: A military chef undergoes intense physical, psychological, and emotional testing to join the United Kingdom’s Special Air Service.

title: I Am Somebody's Child: The Regina Louise Story
description: The journey of a young Black girl who navigates over 30 foster homes and psychiatric facilities before age 18, and the counselor who believes in her.

title: I Am Syd Stone
description: While shooting a film in a small town, a famous actor jeopardizes his personal life and career by starting an intense affair with another man.

title: I Am Thor
description: A decade into retirement, theatrical rock band THOR returns to finally achieve gold-record status, nearly killing its frontman in the process.

title: I Am Vengeance: Retaliation
description: Former special forces soldier John Gold agrees to retrieve the foe who betrayed his team several years ago in exchange for an expunged record.

title: I Am Watching You
description: Nora’s life is at a stand-still when she gets writer’s block for her new book deal, but that quickly dissipates as she catches glimpses of her neighbor’s love life through the window. And when the two finally meet, their physical affair gives Nora inspiration for her book.

title: I Am What I Play
description: I Am What I Play is a feature-length documentary about the heyday of rock radio. The film profiles four rock radio disc jockeys from four different markets, while exploring the changing nature of radio.

title: Ian Bagg: Conversations
description: The Canadian comedian, shares his sharp, biting wit on topics such as immigration, transgender bathrooms, and women's obsession with yoga pants.

title: I Beheld His Glory
description: This film celebrating the inspiring events of Jesus' last days is an adaptation taken directly from The New Testament. Cornelius is a Roman Centurion who, upon orders from the Apostle Thomas, is sent to proclaim the glories of Christ. Cornelius recounts the story of Jesus' arrival in Jerusalem, the Last Supper, the crucifixion, and his appearance before Mary Magdalene.

title: I Can
description: A girl born with one arm defies the odds to become a skilled softball player as her father wrestles with guilt over the affair that led to her birth.

title: I Can't Breathe (God Forgive Them)
description: An overzealous police officer kills an innocent man who relies on his faith to overcome many hurdles and struggles after God brings him back to life.

title: I Capture the Castle
description: Follows the fortunes of 17-year-old Cassandra Mortmain and her eccentric family as they struggle to survive in a decaying castle in 1930’s England.

title: ICE Agent
description: A fearless ICE Agent must plunge deep undercover into a criminal syndicate filled with ruthless felons. His main mission is to stop the human trafficking of young women and will stop at nothing to bring those responsible to justice. Starring Michael Madsen

title: Ice Breaker
description: A young man hitchhikes to Austin, Texas with the goal of pitching his brilliant new app. Soon, he meets two women who challenge his expectations.

title: Ice Cream in the Cupboard
description: After a series of unsettling incidents, including a physical attack, Pat is ready to face the unimaginable: his wife has early-onset Alzheimer's.

title: Icefall
description: A young Indigenous game warden arrests a notorious poacher, only to learn he knows the location of a plane full of cash that crashed in a frozen lake. When criminals and corrupt cops close in, the unlikely pair must fight to survive and escape across the melting ice.

title: Ice Girls
description: Una patinadora artística sufre una lesión durante una competición. Un entrenador la ayuda a rehabilitarse para que pueda cumplir su sueño.

title: Ice Guardians
description: As their position in the league becomes more uncertain, on-ice “police” struggle to keep their jobs while enforcing the rules to keep players safe.

title: Ice House
description: What starts a harmless ice fishing outing on a frozen Minnesota lake slowly devolves into a murderous plot between two men with hidden agendas.

title: Iceman: A George Gervin Story
description: The true story of Richard Kuklinski. The Iceman, an American murderer and hitman for hire.

title: Ice Pilots NWT
description: Su pasión son los aviones antiguos y la explotan piloteándolos con todo tipo de carga y pasajeros en uno de los lugares más inhóspitos del planeta.

title: Ice Road Truckers
description: For two months out of the year, a group of exceptional men find their way to the Canadian tundra to undertake one of the most dangerous jobs on Earth.

title: Ice Storm
description: When a devastating winter storm slams into North Carolina with the lowest recorded temperatures in history, the whole state starts to freeze over. As temperatures turn even colder, climatologists and disaster relief experts race to save lives and stop the storm before it freezes the entire East Coast.

title: Ice Vikings
description: This docuseries explores the wild and perilous world of commercial ice fishing on Lake Winnipeg, one of Canada's largest lakes.

title: Love on the Rise
description: A baker mistakes a wealthy bachelor for a waiter and the two quickly fall in love, not realizing his company is trying to evict her bakery.

title: Wild Team
description: A mining company out to exploit mineral resources gives a South American rebel leader in exile in Miami one last chance to overthrow his successor.

title: Five for Revenge
description: After bandits murder their friend and rape his wife, a group of cowboys set out to find those responsible and bring them to justice.

title: Ick
description: An unlucky high school science teacher (Brandon Routh), a sarcastic student (Malina Weissman), and her mother (Mena Suvari) must deal with a parasitic alien entity known as "The Ick" that is encroaching upon their small town.

title: Icons Unearthed: Batman
description: The story of the Batman's journey to the screen through false starts, accidents, big personalities, and endless reinventions. A visionary director, two upstart producers and an unlikely star overcome a troubled production to deliver a hit. After the sequel fell flat, it would take a director with a vision grounded in reality to resuscitate it.

title: Icons Unearthed: Fast & Furious
description: It all began with a magazine article that exposed the world of illegal drag racing in cities across America. Creatives at Universal would make a modest action film featuring drag racing, car modification - and of course, family - from its pages. What should have been a one-off popcorn summer flick followed by a straight-to-video sequel became one of the largest film franchises of all time.

title: Icons Unearthed: Harry Potter
description: J.K. Rowling's orphan boy wizard took the world by storm, but before the first book was even published Warner Brothers had their eye on a franchise. But how to make it soar? Get behind the wand to hear the secrets of the trials, threats, and near-death experiences from the people who made the magic happen on Icons Unearthed: Harry Potter.

title: Icons Unearthed: Lord of The Rings
description: In 1930 J.R.R. Tolkien wrote the words that would change the fantasy genre forever: "in a hole in the ground there lived a hobbit." Little did he know it would become one of the best-selling books of all time. The trick was, how to adapt it for the screen? It would take an out of the box director from the other side of the world to bring Tolkien's vision to life.

title: Icons Unearthed: Spider Man
description: To get Stan Lee and Steve Ditko's iconic webslinger to the big screen, Marvel had to give up control of their flagship hero to another studio. Icons Unearthed: Spider-man tells the story of the tug of war between Marvel and Sony and how two studios found a way to share the character and the profits.

title: I Cover the Waterfront
description: El tórrido romance de una mujer con un periodista pone en peligro el supuesto negocio paralelo de su padre de contrabando de inmigrantes.

title: I Curse This Land
description: After unwittingly awakening a dark curse, Alison and a handyman team up with quirky villagers to uncover secrets before a witch unleashes her revenge.

title: ID2: Shadwell Army
description: A sequel to the 1995 cult classic, this film follows Mo, a young cop who goes undercover to infiltrate a gang that is linked to a local football club.

title: Ida
description: A novice nun about to take her vows uncovers a family secret dating back to the German occupation and begins to question her long-held beliefs.

title: Idaho Fallen
description: When a stranger robs the corrupt family controlling a remote Idaho town, his only guide to escape is the family patriarch's headstrong granddaughter.

title: Idaho: The Movie
description: The great state of Idaho is rich with raging rivers, placid lakes and stunning mountains, all of which are on full display in this scenic documentary.

title: Romance of Ida
description: 1920s. Promising a generous dowry, a father finds a husband for his daughter through a want ad. Can the arranged marriage turn into true love?

title: Ideal Home
description: A bickering gay couple’s self-indulgent lifestyle is turned upside-down, when the 10-year-old grandson they never knew existed crashes their party.

title: Identical Love
description: When a doctor volunteers abroad, she  discovers that her ex-fiancé’s cute twin is also there. Can she love him for himself and not see him as her ex?

title: Identity Crisis
description: A college science prodigy battling confidence issues clones herself to forge a flawless identity and face her fears through her “better self.”

title: Identity Theft: The Michelle Brown Story
description: The true story of Michelle Brown, who accrues over $50,000 of debt after her identity is stolen, traces her journey and how she helps change laws.

title: I'd Give My Life
description: Gangster Buck Gordon hopes his son Nick will follow in his criminal footsteps, but his efforts are foiled by his ex-wife, who has married Governor Bancroft (Standing). Furious, Buck blackmails his ex-wife, threatening to expose her shady past to her new husband. Nick comes to his mother's aid by shooting and killing his father, but refuses to give a motive, even when he is sentenced to hang for the crime. Based on the play, "The Noose."

title: I Do
description: A gay Brit loses his immigration status and risks losing his family and life in the U.S. so he marries his lesbian best friend to remain in the country.

title: I Do (but I Don't)
description: It's wedding planner Lauren's job to work miracles on other people's weddings. But when it comes to her own life, she's hit a few snags.

title: I Don't Know How She Does It
description: A career-driven mom tries to keep her head above water juggling work and family while enduring bake sales, head lice, and many unsolicited opinions.

title: I Do, or Die: A Killer Arrangement
description: When 18-year-old Sonya refuses to participate in the marriage arranged by her Romanian parents, she finds herself captive of her spurned groom-to-be.

title: I Eat Your Skin
description: In search of new material, a novelist ventures to a remote Caribbean island and discovers that a scientist is turning the locals into a zombie army.

title: I Escaped from Devil's Island
description: Sentenced to life on a brutal prison island, a group of inmates stage the ultimate escape. They learn that getting out of jail is only the beginning.

title: I Escaped My Killer
description: I Escaped My Killer follows the true stories of would-be murder victims who escaped a serial killer's grasp...not only with their lives but also with the information needed to break the case. While a single serial killer can murder dozens and strike fear into the hearts of thousands, it only takes one person to bring a monster's reign of terror to an end.

title: I Escaped: Real Prison Breaks
description: This series describes some of the most daring prison escapes in history. Meet the prisoners who refused to surrender to incarceration and instead concocted elaborate and unimaginable plots to gain freedom by escaping their prison confines.

title: If I Can't Have You
description: An attractive radio host is targeted by an unknown stalker who launches a campaign of terror and intrigue against her and her meddling friends.

title: If I Could Ride
description: An unlikely friendship blooms between Bridgett—an experienced rider recovering from an injury—and Jodie—who dreams of the day she can ride a horse.

title: Children of the Night
description: Two misfits at an elite Italian boarding school escape to a secluded nightclub, where they uncover the school's twisted role in a dark experiment.

title: If I Had Wings
description: A blind teenager’s dream comes true when he finds an unlikely running partner who helps him join his school’s competitive cross-country team.

title: If I Were You
description: To keep tabs on her husband’s affair, Madelyn secretly befriends his young mistress and accidentally stars alongside her in a very amateur King Lear.

title: If Not Now, When
description: Four friends who met in high school and are bonded by an event, are suddenly forced back together when one of them suffers a crisis. It's a story of love, forgiveness and the incredible bond between women.

title: If Only
description: After a tragic accident claims his girlfriend’s life, a man gets a second chance to make things right when he relives the fateful day all over again.

title: I Forgive
description: Targeted in a gang war and shot and left for dead, a selfless man turns to God to learn forgiveness and, by doing so, is miraculously healed.

title: I, Frankenstein
description: Frankenstein’s monster becomes caught in a long-running war between two immortal clans.

title: If the Shoe Fits
description: A dressing-room assistant wins the attention of a high-end designer when she disguises herself as a supermodel in this modern Cinderella story.

title: If You Give a Mouse a Cookie
description: Mouse and his favourite human, Oliver, set out on a series of thrilling adventures as one thing always leads to another.

title: Giants of Rome
description: After word of an enemy’s powerful secret weapon leaks out, a group of soldiers is handpicked by Julius Caesar to destroy the machine at all costs.

title: Days of Violence
description: When his brother is unjustly killed during the final days of the American Civil War, a ranch hand joins a band of Southern rebels to get revenge.

title: Day of Anger
description: Classic Italian Western about a famed gunfighter who snaps and terrorizes a town, only to face a duel with the local scruffy boy he trained to shoot.

title: iGirlfriend
description: When a nerdy teenager creates his own phone app to be his girlfriend, she miraculously comes to life and soon tries to kill him.

title: Igor
description: A mad scientist’s hunchbacked lab assistant enters the Evil Science Fair, dreaming of becoming a mad scientist himself. Can he create a monster?

title: Warriors of the Year 2072
description: In 2072 Rome, the ruthless, ratings-hungry CEO of a TV network plots to stage a modern series of gladiator games using convicts as contestants.

title: I Had A Bloody Good Time At House Harker
description: This brilliant retro-style vampire tale promises a "Bloody Good Time"! For generations the Harker family have protected the cursed skull of the last master vampire- the source of all vampire power. When their home and legacy comes under fire, the Harkers hire a fake vampire to scare the town. But they sure are in trouble when a real vampire turns up...An unmissable comedy horror with a nasty bite!

title: I Hate Kids
description: A famous author, whose key message is how kids mess up romantic relationships, has a teen boy claim to be his son just when he has found perfect love.

title: I Hate New York
description: Four transgender women activists from New York City's underground share the stories of their fierce struggles for identity and community.

title: I Hate the Man in My Basement
description: Struggling to cope with the loss of his spouse, a seemingly ordinary man tries to move forward despite his nagging need for revenge.

title: I Heard Sarah
description: In a desperate attempt to confront his deepest demons, young and troubled rockstar Ian Ford escapes mandated rehab and decides to visit old friends.

title: Iké Boys
description: During the final days of 1999, two Japan-obsessed friends and a foreign exchange student are transformed into superheroes by a magical anime DVD.

title: I Killed John Lennon
description: By killing the iconic founder of The Beatles, Mark Chapman immediately joined the pantheon of the most notorious killers of the 20th century.

title: I Know That Voice
description: Go behind the scenes of your favorite animated films and TV shows with the legendary performers who gave these characters their voices. From their own role models to encounters with their biggest fans, find out what makes actors from the Simpsons, Star Wars, Futurama and hundreds of other franchises step into the recording booth and get animated.

title: I Know What I Saw
description: The most credible UFO witnesses from around the world tell stories that challenge reality in "I Know What I Saw," a documentary guaranteed to change the way we see the universe. Award Winning Film Director James Fox brings together the testimony of Air Force Generals, Astronauts, Military and Commercial Pilots, Government and FAA Officials from seven countries; their accounts reveal the truth.

title: I Know What You Did Last Christmas
description: Estranged friends reunite for a Christmas party at a remote house—only to find themselves hunted for a deadly secret from last year.

title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
description: In a town full of secrets, a group of teenagers are stalked by a mysterious killer a year after a fatal accident on their graduation night.

title: I Know Who Killed Me
description: Returning home from an abduction with a new persona, a young woman must unlock family secrets to unmask a mysterious killer with a deadly obsession.

title: Ikonophile Z
description: An aspiring revolutionary grapples with his ideologies and debates with a photographer while trying to connect sincerely with his on-and-off partner.

title: Ik Sandhu Hunda Si
description: To fight the corruption in Punjab university, senior student Sandhu (Gippy Grewal) announces his candidate as Grewal (Dheeraj Kumar) for the election, the revolt doesn't go well with Mla Jagtar singh alias Jagga (Pawan Malhotra) and his notorious brother Kala (Vikramjit Virk), the tussle between them triggers further when Kala learns that his sister Simran (Neha Sharma) is in love with Sandhu.

title: The Bohemian
description: Aspiring opera composer Il Boemo, mentor to Mozart, pours his heart into his music while embracing his sexuality in this lush 18th-century biopic.

title: Inspector De Luca
description: In Italian with English subtitles. Against the backdrop of Italy's political upheaval, Fascism and chaos during the  tumultuous post-war period between 1938 and 1948, Detective De Luca investigates crime in the war-torn city of Bologna and along the Adriatic coast with little regard for those in power. The episodes are based on the best-selling crime novels by Carlo Lucarelli.

title: J.S. Bach: The Music, The Life, The Legend
description: French biographical drama about the life and works of classical composer Johann Sebastian Bach, delving into his passionate devotion to music

title: Son of Django
description: A vengeful son seeks his father's killer, becoming entangled in a fierce war between two rival factions led by familiar faces from his father's past.

title: The Cat & the Moon
description: A man is found dead in an office. Sonia, a charming 55-year-old woman, has abandoned her family for a love affair with a younger man. The two stories end up intertwining but nothing is as it seems.

title: The Executioner of God
description: This spaghetti western follows a former gunman-turned-priest, who seeks vengeance on three bandits masquerading as law-abiding citizens.

title: The Grand Duel
description: A grizzled ex-sheriff helps a fugitive framed for murdering an Arizona bigwig to confront the powerful trio of brothers who want him dead.

title: I Like Movies
description: Awkward cinephile Lawrence, 17, finds work at a video store, where he navigates a complex friendship with his enigmatic older female manager.

title: I Literally Just Told You
description: Jimmy Carr hosts the game show where paying attention pays off, as players answer questions that have just been written, about things that have just happened during the show, in a bid to win £25,000

title: I Live Here Now
description: In the surreal landscape of I Live Here Now, struggling actress Rose (Lucy Fry) finds her life upended by unexpected news. Things spiral further when her casual boyfriend, Travis (Matt Rife) brings his overbearing mother (Sheryl Lee) into the fold, pushing Rose to the brink. She flees to The Crown Inn, a crumbling motel at the edge of nowhere, where time fractures and reality bends.

title: Iliza Shlesinger: A Different Animal
description: Acclaimed comedian Iliza Shlesinger debuts on Amazon Prime with a no-holds -barred, explosive and relentlessly funny hour special where she covers everything from shower sex, ugly wives and the ideal man to the truth about the ONE thing no woman wants… in this special, nothing is off limits.

title: Iliza Shlesinger: Over & Over
description: A hilarious and practical documentary about comedian Iliza Shlesinger’s preparing for her fourth Netflix special, plus rules of comedy and travel.

title: Iliza Shlesinger: War Paint
description: Her innocent good looks are just a cover for Last Comic Standing winner Iliza Shlesinger's acerbic, stream-of-conscious comedy that she unleashes on an unsuspecting audience.

title: Iliza's Locals
description: Iliza Shlesinger's "Iliza's Locals" is a three part comedy special featuring the best up-and-coming comics in Los Angeles.

title: I'll Be Home For Christmas
description: A small-town mayor desperate to replace the local doctor may just find a Christmas miracle when her high school boyfriend comes home for the holidays.

title: I'll Be Right There
description: A woman tries to find love and happiness while contending with a pregnant daughter, a wayward son, an absent ex-husband, and a hypochondriac mother.

title: I'll Be Seeing You
description: Tras ser llamada por la policía, una joven llega a la escena del crimen y descubre que la víctima es una joven idéntica a ella en muchos aspectos.

title: I'll Be There
description: A washed-up pop star must snap out of his downward spiral, when he discovers he has a daughter in Wales, who is the result of a weekend love affair.

title: I’ll Be Watching
description: When her tech genius husband leaves on a work trip, a woman mourning her sister’s death gets trapped at home and must fight her fears to stay alive.

title: Illegal Aliens
description: Three alien bombshells land on Earth to battle evil in this sci-fi spoof with shades of "Charlie's Angels" and "Men In Black." Guided by their holographic mentor Syntax, they use every trick and outfit to protect Earth. Starring Anna Nicole Smith, Illegal Aliens blends wild action, sexy style and a fun twist on classic Hollywood tropes.

title: I'll Find You
description: When two young lovers, ROBERT, a tenor and RACHEL, a violin virtuoso get torn apart by the outbreak of WWII, Robert vows to find Rachel, no matter what.

title: Ill Gotten Gains
description: A gripping tale of twenty-four Africans held captive in a slave ship after slavery is outlawed. Spurred on by a spector that lives in the ship, the captives are moved to a tragic and bloody uprising.

title: I'll Meet You There
description: Three generations of a Muslim-American family try to unravel secrets while one goes against custom as they struggle to connect with each other.

title: I'll Never Forget You: The Last 72 Hours of Lynyrd Skynyrd

Steven Russell (Jim Carrey) leads a seemingly average life – an organ player in the local church, happily married to Debbie (Leslie Mann), and a member of the local police force. That is until he has a severe car accident that leads him to the ultimate epiphany: he’s gay and he’s going to live life to the fullest – even if he has to break the law to do it. Taking on an extravagant lifestyle, Steven turns to cons and fraud to make ends meet and is eventually sent to the State Penitentiary where he meets the love of his life, a sensitive, soft-spoken man named Phillip Morris (Ewan McGregor). His devotion to freeing Phillip from jail and building the perfect life together prompts him to attempt (and often succeed at) one impossible con after another. Told with an uncanny sense of humor and a lot of heart, “I Love You Phillip Morris” is an oddball tale of what can happen when the legal system, a daredevil spirit and undying love collide.
