description: The Old West is no peaceful place for a woman who joins forces with her ex-lover to keep a violent gang from killing her outlaw husband.

title: JANET JACKSON.
description: On this week’s That Time When we’re recounting the moment when a simple wardrobe malfunction nearly ended the career of Janet Jackson.

title: Extremely Analytical
description: The stand up reveals her perspective on marriage, Millennial dating, and the challenges of finding people to connect with in Los Angeles.

title: Janie Jones
description: Ethan must change his rock-n-roll lifestyle to make room for the unexpected arrival of his 13-year-old daughter, who shares his passion for music.

title: Janis: Little Girl Blue
description: With Janis: Little Girl Blue, Oscar-nominated director Amy Berg examines Joplin’s story in depth for the first time on film, presenting an intimate and insightful portrait of a complicated, driven, often beleaguered artist.

title: Janosik
description: The story of Janosik, a legendary "Central European Robin Hood", based on a real XVIII century documents and on a romantic legend, operating with a subjective, original lyricism.

title: Japa!
description: Mezu discovers he's trapped in a time loop in Nigeria. To his surprise, his colleague Kamsi is in the same predicament. Together with friends Tobe, Wasiu, and Sola, they unite to break free from the time loop.

title: Japanese Story
description: Sandy (Toni Collette), a geologist, finds herself stuck on a field trip to the Pilbara desert with a Japanese man she finds inscrutable, annoying and decidedly arrogant. Hiromitsu’s (Otaro Tsunashima) view of her is not much better. Things go from bad to worse when they become stranded in one of the most remote regions on earth. Japanese Story is a journey of change and discovery.

title: Jappeloup
description: The beat-the-odds true story of a young man in the 1980s who leaves a career in law for show jumping and the flawed horse that earns him Olympic gold.

title: Checkmate
description: Duque, an international undercover operative who retired years ago after a traumatic event, is forced back into action when a commando operative kidnaps his niece, forcing him to steal a prized scientific formula as part of the ransom.

title: Jason and the Argonauts
description: The banished son of a king sails uncharted seas with the legendary band of Greek heroes to find the Golden Fleece and reconquer his kingdom.

title: Jasper Mall
description: A dying Alabama mall is maintained by a well-intentioned man, who reflects on how American culture has shifted away from his business.

title: Jasper Redd: Jazz Talk
description: Straight from the Folly Theater in Kansas City, polyrhythmic comedian, Jasper Redd breaks it down with a set that's sure to blow your top.

title: Jasper, Texas
description: True account of a black man who accepted a ride from three white men who cuffed him to a truck and dragged him to death.

title: Jaspreet Singh: Koi Load Nahi
description: Jaspreet Singh takes on "mundane" topics like the ever-growing motivation market, godmen, serious parenting to the "tough" bouncers like his door bell, the salad he made and the absurdity of the teenage. His first comedy special is a perfect amalgamation of his niche observations, signature laid back attitude with quick paced punchlines.

title: Jaws of Justice
description: Filmed in beautiful Lake Tahoe, California, a mountie comes to the aid of a woman and her mute friend, who are being terrorized because of a treasure hidden on their land. Kazan the dog is the only one to recognize the murderer of the woman's father. After they learn the secret of the whereaouts of the gold, thanks to an Edgar Allan Poe novel, the villain escapes but Kazan tracks him down. A great mountie and hero dog actionier!

title: Jay and Silent Bob Reboot
description: After inadvertently signing away the rights to their names, Jay and Silent Bob return to Hollywood to stop a reboot of a movie from getting made.

title: Jayanti
description: Santosh (Ruturaj Wankhede) is a directionless young chap, who is being misused by MLA Gondane (Kishor Kadam) for his political gains. However, social activist Ashok Mali (Milind Shinde) and Pallavi (Titeeksha Tawde) help Santosh in finding his true.

title: Jayde Adams: Serious Black Jumper
description: Proud Bristolian and multi-award-winning comedian, Jayde Adams brings her latest stand-up show to the screen. If you want to be a ‘successful independent woman person’ you better have something to say and you better be wearing the feminist wardrobe staple; the Serious Black Jumper™.

title: Jay Mohr: American Treasure
description: The popular comedian tells deeply personal stories from his fascinating life and presents his famously funny celebrity impressions and observations.

title: Jayne Mansfield's Car
description: In 1969 Alabama, the death of his estranged ex-wife leads a Southern patriarch and his kids into the lives of the British family she left them for.

title: Jay Nog: Something From Nothing
description: Comedian Jay Nog takes to the parking lot of a diner in Queens, New York when the COVID pandemic leaves him with nowhere to perform.

title: Jay Pharoah: Can I Be Me?
description: Saturday Night Live cast member Jay Pharoah trots out his greatest celebrity impressions, from Chris Rock to Kanye West to Barack Obama and many more.

title: Jean
description: To find her ailing grandfather, a young girl and her dog set out on an epic adventure into the wilderness, where she must summon her inner strength.

title: Jean-Claude Van Johnson
description: What if I told you that Jean-Claude Van Damme - yes, THAT Jean-Claude Van Damme - was, in fact, a secret agent? That his entire film career was built solely as a front for his black ops? Would you believe me? No? Well then that’s egg on your face because that’s what this show is about.

title: Jeanne du Barry
description: Johnny Depp stars as King Louis XV in the story of the entrancing Jeanne du Barry (Maïwenn), a French peasant woman whose meteoric rise through the royal court to become the King's last mistress creates a scandal of epic proportions. Based on a true story.

title: Jeannette
description: A queer Puerto Rican single mom and bodybuilder navigates life amid crises as the Pulse nightclub shooting and Hurricane María affect her communities.

title: Jeevan Ek Sanghursh
description: Widowed Sulakshana Devi has three children; they live in a rented house and have troubles with the landlord.

title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing with Myself
description: A comedy event that will set the new standard for how truly awesome a comedy special can be.  Join Jeff and his outspoken-often-edgy characters: Walter, Peanut, José Jalapeño (on a steeek!), Bubba J and Sweet Daddy Dee for a live show that will have you on the floor laughing!

title: Jeff Dunham: Controlled Chaos
description: Ventriloquist and comic Jeff Dunham takes to the stage to provide fresh comedic material with his classic puppets; Walter, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño and Achmed, as well as with two never-before-seen characters with their own unique quirks.

title: Jeff Dunham: I'm with Cupid
description: In a Valentine's Day special, ventriloquist and stand-up comedian Jeff Dunham tackles love and relationships with help from his favorite characters.

title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
description: Jeff Dunham returns with a haunted house full of his hysterical entourage, and each character stars in its own horror movie trailer.

title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
description: Jeff and his felt friends Walter, Melvin the Superhero Guy, Peanut, and others share their latest and greatest thoughts about our times.

title: Jeff Dunham's Scrooged-Up Holiday Special
description: As the holidays approach, Jeff has the inspired idea to create his version of “A Christmas Carol” by casting his characters in the classic roles. Walter is obvious – there’s only one man who can play Scrooge! But when Jeff assigns Bubba J, Peanut, Little Jeff and Achmed their thespian parts, they don’t quite agree and his plan spins hilariously out-of-control in this stand-up comedy special.

title: Jeff Dunham's Very Special Christmas Special
description: Jeff Dunham invites Walter, Peanut, Bubba J, José Jalapeño and Achmed the Dead Terrorist to join him on his first holiday special.  Unfortunately, his suitcase posse doesn't quite share the same Christmas spirit -and the result is a one-of-a-kind live event unlike any Yuletide celebration you've ever seen!

title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
description: The comedian and his puppets perform in the gorgeous Dolby Theatre, featuring hilarious sketches with surprise guests and lots of laughs.

title: Jeff Leeson: Off The Cuff
description: In his debut comedy special, Jeff Leeson leaves the audience in stitches with his masterful crowd work and signature improvisational style.

title: Jeffrey
description: This romantic comedy centers on the chaotic love life of Jeffrey, a gay man who swears off sex only to fall in love with his ideal man.

title: Jekyll and Hyde
description: When Dr. Henry Jekyll is accused of a gruesome murder, his close friend’s investigation leads to a shocking discovery inside the killer’s mind.

title: Jellyfish
description: Sarah, a young teenager, is her family's sole caretaker. While working hard to make ends meet, Sarah discovers her hidden talent for stand-up comedy.

title: I Have Never Forgotten You: The Life & Legacy of Simon Wiesenthal
description: A documentary about the life of Nazi hunter and humanitarian Simon Wiesenthal, through never-before-seen film footage and interviews with intimates.

title: Jennifer Aniston: More Than Friends
description: There are multiple levels to global superstar actress Jennifer Aniston. Yet, the road to success did not come without its challenges. Aniston radiates a vulnerable warmth both on and off screen that keeps her audience loyal.

title: Jenny McCarthy's Dirty Sexy Funny
description: Jenny McCarthy’s brand of naughty comedy gets a boost from popular female comedians, including Tiffany Haddish, on the realities of being a woman.

title: Jenny Slate: Seasoned Professional
description: Jenny Slate is alive on planet earth, and apparently this is what it's like for her. In her second romantic, electric and naughty little stand-up special, the acclaimed comedian, actress and author proves being brave for love is worth it — even when exploding a baby out of your vagina, stalking your therapist, or trusting your partner to not destroy you. Because being chill is a fool's errand.

title: Jeremiah
description: Based on a successful European comic book, the series is set in a post-apocalyptic world where Jeremiah is one of the oldest survivors of a deadly virus that wiped out the adult population.

title: Jeremiah Tower: The Last Magnificent
description: The story of celebrated chef Jeremiah Tower who rose to prominence at the famed Chez Panisse and later founded the legendary Stars. After Stars crumbles he goes into decades of exile, emerging to take on a fabled New York restaurant.

title: Jeremy Scott: The People's Designer
description: Charts the meteoric rise of a Missouri farm boy to fashion’s club kid with his own celebrity following as Creative Director of Italian brand Moschino.

title: Jericho
description: In 1870s Yorkshire, a widow and her children start a new life in Jericho, a lawless shanty town brought together to build an enormous railway viaduct.

title: Jericho
description: Brilliant and haunted by the past, Detective Chief Inspector Michael Jericho of Scotland Yard investigates high-profile murders in 1950s London.

title: Jerico
description: The story of best friends who set out on a dangerous, but comedic journey that challenges the restrictions of a Jim Crow South to fulfill their dreams

title: Jermaine Fowler: Give 'Em Hell, Kid
description: Comedian Jermaine Fowler performs his first ever stand-up special, poking fun at his life in hilarious detail. From being raised by his young parents to growing up with a brother his family thought was mentally challenged.

title: Jerry Lewis: The Man Behind the Clown
description: Since the early days, Jerry Lewis had the masses laughing with his visual gags, pantomime sketches and signature slapstick humour. Celebrating his 90th year, Jerry Lewis candidly reflects back on his remarkable life and decades-long career - from his legendary partnership with crooner Dean Martin, to his incredible rise to fame, to his great love affair with filmmaking.

title: Jerry Powell & the Delusions of Grandeur
description: Jerry Powell is a gas-huffing thief with memory distrust syndrome. At the brink of insanity, Powell finds himself chased by a pulpy gang of criminals as he attempts to deliver a mysterious package for a money-launder.

title: Jerry's Last Mission
description: Jerry's Last Mission is a documentary about fighter pilot Jerry Yellin who flew the last combat mission of World War II over Japan. Jerry returned home a hero but led a dark life of survivor's guilt and daily thoughts of suicide. Married with four sons, Yellin was forced to face his enemy once again when his youngest son moved to Japan and married the daughter of a Kamikaze pilot.

title: Jersey Shore Massacre
description: Young friends looking to party during a weekend of fun and sun fall directly into the path of a ruthless serial killer who is ready to pick them off.

title: Jeruzalem
description: While visiting the ancient walls of the Holy City, two American young women and an anthropology student must survive a biblical apocalypse.

title: Jesse James Unchained
description: After escaping captivity, one of the greatest Old West outlaws finds himself on the run with one more score on his mind before disappearing for good.

title: Jessica
description: The women of a small Sicilian village, jealous of a beautiful widowed midwife, plot her ruin by refusing to have anything to do with their husbands.

title: Jessi's Girls
description: When a band of marauding outlaws murders a man and rapes his wife, the woman gets her hands on a six-shooter and sets out in pursuit of revenge.

title: Jess + Moss
description: Two cousins embark on a journey in which their secrets, dreams, and fears of an unknown future form an unbreakable bond between them.

title: The Glitch
description: A seemingly perfect suburban housewife's life collapses as she starts to increasingly malfunction, revealing her true android nature.

title: Jestination Unknown
description: Vir Das travels across India with his friends to answer the question: "What does India find funny?" In Patiala, they explore comedy and clichés. In Lucknow, the hasya kavis give a masterclass. In Jodhpur, the city welcomes new jesters. In Mysore, a Mysore joke is written. In Kumarakom, comedy after tragedy is explored. In Leh, even the people in the harshest region of the country laugh.

title: Je Suis A Stand-Up: Eddie Izzard Abroad
description: The rambling, whimsical monologist performs a tour including in her "hometown" of Eastbourne and culminating in New York’s East Village.

title: Jesus
description: This miniseries traces the life, work, and death of Jesus, as told in the Bible, from humble start as a carpenter to the fulfilment of divine destiny.

title: Jesus in India
description: A seeker's quest across 4000 miles of India in search of answers about where Jesus was during the "Hidden Years" from ages 12 to 30.

title: Jesus Thirsts: The Miracle of the Eucharist
description: Through discussions with Catholic leaders and heartfelt personal narratives, this film unveils the Eucharist as Jesus Christ Himself, eagerly desiring to fulfill our spiritual thirst

title: Je te veux moi non plus
description: Best friends since childhood, Nina and Dylan have no secrets from one another. When Nina visits after a break-up, something finally clicks and she realises the perfect man for her may already be in her life.

title: Jethica
description: When Jessica's lipsy stalker surprises her after a spontaneous road trip to Santa Fe, she seeks help from beyond the grave to banish him for good.

title: Jewel
description: A loving mother and wife in 1940s Mississippi focuses her undivided attention on her newborn child who has Down syndrome.

title: Jewtopia
description: Childhood friends reunite to win over their dream women, with one trying to marry a Jewish girl and the other seeking true love instead of settling.

title: JFK: The Ultimate Conspiracy
description: Decades after one of the darkest days in American history, Kennedy’s assassination is still a global mystery that confounds the world to this day.

title: JFK X: Solving the Crime of the Century
description: As the 60th anniversary of the assassination of President Kennedy approaches, this film uncovers the final proof of what happened that day in Dallas.

title: The End Will Be Spectacular
description: Zilan is a young woman who returns to her hometown looking for the memory of her dead brother, to find herself involved in a violent fight against the state. Ji Bo Azadiye explores universal concepts such as hope, friendship, sacrifice and loss in the struggle for freedom of a group of young people. The war feature was shot in the Kurdistan of Syria, in the middle of a real armed conflict.

title: Jigsaw
description: An art-class project turns lethal when a mannequin, infused with students’ deepest fears, awakens and starts picking them off one by one.

title: Jikirag
description: The last surviving elder of a village in the heart of ancient Eden battles madness and the macabre to save her people from the monstrous judgment.

title: Jill-Michele Meleán: White / Latina
description: Jill-Michele Melean has finally filmed her one-hour standup special. From Miami to L.A. She's half Bolivian, half Irish but raised in Miami so Cuban by association. Not white enough to play the Stepford wife or Latin enough to play the gangsta but relatable to all ethnicities. From impressions, to family to dating, this special has her last 15 years of hilarious stories.

title: Jill Rips
description: A tough guy goes undercover on a personal mission of vengeance into the world of S&M to find out who's responsible for the death of his brother.

title: Jim Breuer: And Laughter for All
description: Marriage and parenthood won't keep die-hard metalhead comedian Jim Breuer from losing his manic sense of humor in this hilarious live show.

title: Jim Breuer: Let's Clear the Air
description: You may remember Jim as the infamous Goat Boy from SNL, or his stoner persona from the cult hit "Half Baked." Now he's clearing the air with his concert event, chronicling his transformation from childhood to ultimate family man.

title: Jim Gaffigan: Dark Pale
description: Considered one of the most prolific and relatable stand-up comedians of today, Jim Gaffigan explores the post Covid emotional landscape in his newest comedy special Dark Pale.

title: Jim Gaffigan: Noble Ape
description: Comic Jim Gaffigan proves that laughter is the best medicine when he talks about a family medical crisis and other topics during his hilarious stand-up routine.

title: Jim Gaffigan: Quality Time
description: The comedian discusses why we aren’t honest about not wanting to attend events, lying to children, and so much more in this hilarious special.

title: Pajanimals
description: Pajanimals is a musical series that centers on a quartet of cuddly critters who use stories and songs to explore their feelings and frustrations about bedtime. With the help of these adorable lovies, preschoolers will come to see that there's no shame in facing worries like being afraid of the dark or anxious about separating from a parent.

title: Jimi Hendrix: The Uncut Story
description: Hailed as "the greatest instrumentalist in rock history," this series explores the life and legacy of legendary artist Jimi Hendrix.

title: Jim Button and the Wild 13
description: To protect Morrowland from a notorious pirate gang, Jim Button and his best friend make Emma airworthy and set off on a dangerous journey.

title: Jim Button and Luke the Engine Driver
description: An adventurous duo embarks on a thrilling quest through fantastical realms to liberate a captive princess from the unassailable Dragon City.

title: Jimmie & Stevie Ray Vaughan: Brothers in Blues
description: A documentary unfolding the story of iconic blues rock musicians Jimmie and Stevie Ray Vaughan, told by those who were closest to them.

title: Jim Morrison: The Wild Child
description: It follows the short life and career of the acclaimed poet, thinker, and quintessential rock star who treads a fine line between existence and death.

title: Jimmy
description: A mentally disabled teenager, who sees people who aren't there, gets caught up in a courtroom trial that hinges on his testimony.

title: Jimmy and Judy
description: A pair of rebellious teenagers evade the police while documenting their wild adventures using a digital camera, but things soon take a dark turn.

title: Jimmy Dore: Sentenced To Live
description: Comedian and author, Jimmy Dore has been Sentenced To Live. His outrageous political humor promises to make you think, while you laugh. From the President, to the media, to his dog - he covers it all. Filmed live in Los Angeles, CA.

title: Jimmy O. Yang: Good Deal
description: The Silicon Valley star uses his debut stand-up special to discuss tall women, disappointing his parents, and how he learned English from rap videos.

title: Jimmy O. Yang: Guess How Much?
description: The Silicon Valley actor is better than ever in his follow-up special that unpacks love languages, loser friends, and negotiating with Asian parents.

title: Jimmy's Jungle
description: After losing his father, 12-year-old Jimmy goes to live with his grandfather for the summer, where he discovers a special animal sanctuary next door.

title: Jim Norton: Please Be Offended
description: The caustic comedian goes after jaw-dropping laughs not intended for the faint of heart. Among his targets: the national hypersensitivity epidemic.

title: Jingle Bell Ranch
description: Divorced and penniless, a high-powered CEO embarks on a journey with her offbeat assistant to save her grandma’s failing ranch before Christmas.

title: Jinkx Monsoon: Red Head Redemption
description: Jinkx Monsoon recounts some of the crazier tales from her sex-addicted, alcoholic past, a journey that led her to find her true self.

title: Jinn
description: When a newlywed receives a cryptic message alluding to an ancient family curse, he enlists the aid of a priest and a shackled mental patient.

title: Jiro Dreams of Sushi
description: Hidden in a Tokyo subway station is a world-renowned sushi restaurant and a master chef whose culinary skills draw visitors from around the globe.

title: JK's House
description: Life lessons and family drama are doled out in song and dance in this family-friendly musical about a single doctor raising a young family.

title: Joan
description: Joan is a fiery and uncompromising woman in her twenties who is deeply scarred and vulnerable, is a devoted mother to a six-year-old daughter but is trapped in a disastrous relationship with a violent criminal Gary. When Gary goes on the run she seizes the opportunity to create a new life for her and her daughter.

title: Joanna Lumley's Nile
description: Joanna Lumley is embarking on the trip of a lifetime; to travel and explore the River Nile, the longest river in the world, from sea to source. Travelling upstream, in the direction of the earliest explorers she will journey along Africa's life line, visiting the people who live and work along this famous river today.

title: Jobe'z World
description: When Jobe, a middle-aged rollerblader, gets blamed for the overdose of an A-list actor, he spends a bizarre evening skating across Manhattan.

title: Jobs
description: The story of Steve Jobs' journey from college dropout to the Apple Inc. co-founder who ushered in a world-changing revolution in personal computing.

title: Joe
description: An ex-con, who is the unlikeliest of role models, meets a 15-year-old boy and is faced with the choice of redemption or ruin.

title: Joe & Joe
description: Two likeable underachievers named Joe mow lawns in Cape Cod for cash, but when a mysterious woman tells of a buried treasure nearby, all bets are off.

title: Joel McHale: Live from Pyongyang
description: Fan favorite Joel McHale shines in his first stand-up special with jokes on being mistaken for Daniel Tosh, feeding alligators in the South, and more.

title: Joe Somebody
description: Tim Allen is Joe, a guy whose life has been steadily changing for the worse.  When the office bully goes too far, Joe decides it's time to turn himself from a nobody into a somebody.

title: Joe Strummer: The Future Is Unwritten
description: An ode to The Clash’s legendary frontman, whose influence persists after his death, featuring early recording sessions and interviews with bandmates.

title: Joey Coco Diaz: Sociably UnAcceptable
description: It's been 25 years in the making and now...'Uncle Joey Diaz' is at Seeso for his 1st MotherF*cking Special...Sociably Unacceptable. Prepare yourselves savages.

title: Joey: The Man Who Conquered the TT
description: On May 26 2000, supremo of road racing Joey Dunlop won the Isle of Man TT race for a staggering 26th time. Less than one month later he would be dead, killed in a freak accident. This is the incredible story of how one determined middle aged man of almost 50 years old beat the odds, only to be cut down in tragic circumstances. This is the story behind Joey Dunlop, told by those that were there.

title: John Apple Jack
description: When John discovers his sister's fiance is his childhood crush, his life spirals out of control and he loses everything before rushing to the altar.

title: John Candy: I Like Me
description: From director Colin Hanks and producer Ryan Reynolds comes John Candy: I Like Me. Those who knew John best share his story, in their own words, through never-before-seen archival footage, imagery, and interviews. It's a documentary of the life, career, and loss of one of the most beloved actors of all time.

title: John Cena: Champion of the Ring
description: The man that sat on top of the professional wrestling mountain for over a decade. John Cena has done it all. From bodybuilding to football and from pro wrestling to the big screen, he has always proven that hard work pays off.

title: John Crist: I Got Questions
description: I Got Questions, the debut comedy special from award winning standup comedian John Crist, is a joyride of non-stop merriment. Crist's undeniable wit combined with his feel-good comedic sensibility will have you in tears. Poking fun of the government, helicopter parents, gamers, fast food cashiers and even himself...if you've ever thought it, Crist will say it. So sit back and buckle up, because John Crist has questions.

title: John Heffron: Middle Class Funny
description: The Michigan comedian discusses his deep frustrations in marriage, loathing for when people are passive-aggressive, and other relatable subjects.

title: John Hron
description: The story takes place in the summer of 1995 outside of Gothenburg, Sweden, during the rise of Neo-Nazi violence that was sweeping across the country. The film 'John Hron' is the true story about a teenager, his friends and family. John is caught up in defense of a student being bullied in school. As the conflict with the bully escalates it soon causes strain between John and his friends. While John is trying to win back his friends, the bully joins a violent Neo-Nazi gang. This also casts a long shadow over John’s plans of a future motorcycle vacation with his girlfriend and his efforts in persuing to win the national canoeing championships. For his fearless and heroic actions John Hron becomes a well-known icon and has had a great impact on Sweden even to this day.

title: John Kincaid Unleashed
description: Fast-paced fight sequences heighten this tale of a martial artist and special agent who must fend off a returned killer out for his loved ones’ lives.

title: John Laurens' War
description: A stirring tale of the South Carolina abolitionist who went against his slave-owning father to fight for liberty and freedom for all in America.

title: John Lennon: The Dreamer
description: Relive the story of one of the greatest songwriters to have ever lived, starting in the clubs of Liverpool to packed-out stadiums across the globe.

title: Johnny
description: Five business partners of a popular club learn about a profitable deal and decide to go for it. However, one of them plans to loot the money and leave the country with his girlfriend.

title: Johnny Cash: American Rebel
description: An epic tribute to this gifted artist, social activist and legendary entertainer, "Johnny Cash: American Rebel" celebrates the life and artistry of the Man in Black through the unique perspective of twelve of his greatest songs.

title: Johnny Frank Garrett's Last Word
description: When a young man from the wrong side of the tracks is executed for a hideous crime, he leaves a letter pronouncing a curse upon those who wronged him.

title: Johnny Got His Gun
description: After a shell leaves his body mangled on the final day of World War I, young Joe Bonham lies trapped in a hospital bed.

title: Johnny Gruesome
description: Killed while on a drunken joyride, a rebellious high school student returns as a murderous, wisecracking zombie hellbent on revenge.

title: Johnny Mysto: Boy Wizard
description: Un joven mago fracasado se convierte en dueño de un anillo encantado que le otorga grandes poderes, como la capacidad de viajar en el tiempo.

title: Johnny Was
description: Follows a former Irish thug as he navigates questions of race and morality in an attempt to avoid war with West Indian Yardies in a Brixton safehouse.

title: Johnny Z
description: Half-human and half-zombie, Johnny trains under a martial arts master in order to seek vengeance against the evil corporation that created him.

title: John Wayne - America at All Costs
description: A look at a man who climbed Hollywood’s ladder, one rung at a time, follows him to the top, where he was the most popular American actor of his era.

title: John Wynn's Playhouse
description: What was billed as a lusty getaway soon becomes an unwanted therapy session where hidden memories are unclothed by a doctor and his peculiar methods.

title: Jolt
description: A bouncer with a slightly murderous anger-management problem that she controls with the help of an electrode-lined vest she uses to shock herself back to normalcy whenever she gets homicidal. After the first guy she's ever fallen for is murdered, she goes on a revenge-fueled rampage to find the killer while the cops pursue her as their chief suspect.

title: Jonah
description: A journalist's childhood trauma resurfaces during an investigation into a mother's claims that her son was abducted by aliens.

title: Jonathan
description: Two brothers live very separate lives – inside the same body. Once content, they find their delicate balance upset, when one attracts a girlfriend.

title: Jonathan & Jesus
description: Actor Jonathan Roumie plays 'Jesus' on the largest crowd-funded show of all time; "The Chosen". This is the role of a lifetime; and as a devout Catholic; is an opportunity with huge personal significance. As "The Chosen" explodes in popularity; Jonathan is thrust into the limelight in a way he's never experienced before. This newfound popularity comes with being recognized in public all over th...

title: Jonathan Strange & Mr Norrell
description: Set in England during the Napoleonic Wars at the beginning of the 19th century, the series presents an alternative history where magic is widely acknowledged but rarely practiced. Two men of destiny, the gifted recluse Mr. Norrell and daring spellcasting novice Jonathan Strange, use their magic power to help England. So begins a dangerous battle between two great minds.

title: Jonesing: When Love Is a Habit
Jonestown: Paradise Lost
description: This feature length film, a hybrid of documentary and drama, tracks the final, 5-day build up to a horrific doomsday - the infamous mass murder/suicides of Jim Jones' People's Temple on November 18th, 1978. By the end of that day, 918 men, women and children will die.

title: Jongo
description: The course of Eli King’s life is forever changed when the discovery of a crystal at the site of his dad’s murder imbues him with an array of powers.

title: Joni
description: The true story of a woman, paralyzed at age 17 from a swimming accident, portrays how she learned to paint with her mouth and find strength in faith.

title: Jon Reep: Ginger Beard Man
description: North Carolina comedian Jon Reep performs a comedy set in Chicago about his plans to make his own beer, outdated state laws, and being a redhead.

title: Jordan
description: A five-year-old found wandering in shock from a car crash is reunited with her mother by a Sheriff, but she claims the woman isn't her mother at all.

title: José
description: José, un joven de 19 años, conoce a Luis en una aplicacion de relaciones sexuales casuales que lo lleva a un plano de pasión, dolor y reflexión.

title: Jose Canseco: The Truth Hurts
description: Legendary baseball player and whistle blower Jose Canseco speaks out.

title: Josep
description: 1939. Spanish republicans are fleeing from Franco's dictatorship to France, where the government imprisons the refugees in concentration camps, with barely any access to hygiene, water, and food. In one of these camps, separated by barbed wire, 2 men will become friends. One is a guard, the other is Josep Bartoli (Barcelona 1910 - NYC 1995), an illustrator who fights against Franco's regime.

title: Josh Blue: Delete
description: With an undeniably unique world view, Blue explores preconceived notions of disability and how the community feels about being called “inspirational.”

title: Josh Blue: Freak Accident
description: After his crushing defeat on America's Got Talent, Josh Blue is back in his fifth comedy special with laugh-a-minute takes from being on a reality show to being a single dad of pre-teens. Oh, and cerebral palsy-he's still got that!

title: Josh Blue: Sticky Change
description: Quipster Josh Blue hits the stage where he turns his cerebral palsy and cross-cultural marriage into comedy gold.

title: Josh Gondelman: People Pleaser
description: The comic who just wants everyone to have a good time explores the pressures of appearing in his friends’ dreams and choosing the right wedding DJ.

title: Josh Hasty's Candy Corn
description: When a local outcast is murdered by bullies on the night before Halloween, he is resurrected and sets out to take revenge on those who wronged him.

title: Josh Kirby... Time Warrior: Journey to the Magic Cavern
description: Time-traveller Josh Kirby travels to a planet occupied by a race of mushroom people on his quest to keep the Nullifier away from evil Dr. Zoetrope.

title: Josh Wolf: Father of the Year
description: In his comedy special, Josh Wolf hilariously tackles father-son battles, iPad photo mishaps, and the quirky origin of Reese's Peanut Butter Cups.

title: Josh Wolf: The Campfire Special
description: Josh Wolf's stand-up special "Four Stories" provides a funny and honest look at life's unexpected moments in a relatable and humorous style. He touches on themes of growing up, youth, and the surprises life brings.

title: Josie
description: Tattooed, sweet-talking Josie develops a relationship with loner Hank, but her true intentions are far more sinister as her dark past comes to light.

title: Josie & Jack
description: Homeschooled and isolated by their abusive professor dad, two teenage siblings run away to New York City where familiar patterns begin to emerge.

title: Journey's End
description: Old classmates cross paths once again as grown men during World War I. With German soldiers approaching, they support one another on the battlefield.

title: Journey to Bethlehem
description: Celebrate the timeless story of Mary and Joseph and the birth of Jesus in an epic Christmas musical.

title: Journey To Paradise
description: A TV news director struggles to recapture her Christmas joy after a traumatic incident. But a mysterious stranger's arrival changes everything.

title: Journey to Royal: A WWII Rescue Mission

title: Keyhole

A gangster and deadbeat father, Ulysses Pick, returns home after a long absence. He is toting two teenagers: a drowned girl, Denny, who has mysteriously returned to life; and a bound-and-gagged hostage, who is actually his own teenage son, Manners. Confused, Ulysses doesn't recognize his own son, but he feels with increasing conviction he must make an indoor odyssey from the back door of his home all the way up, one room at a time, to the marriage bedroom where his wife Hyacinth awaits, full of cancer, grieving over the deaths of her three children, and wooed by Ulysses' arch-rival, Chang. The house is haunted by countless dead relatives. Ulysses eventually reaches his goal and vanquishes his enemy, but the equilibrium of the house has been disturbed. Perhaps this has all been a dream that is dreamt every night by Manners himself or by the ghosts he loves so much.

title: Khali the Killer

title: Koch Brothers Exposed
description: Koch Brothers Exposed is a hard-hitting investigation of Charles and David Koch, two of the world's richest and most powerful men, and how their billions and influence have changed the landscape of America.

title: Kofa
description: Eight people suddenly awaken in a decrepit room stripped down to their underwear. Besides their names, they have no memories of who they are, where they are and why they are there. Confusion and mutual suspicion escalate their predicament. When an armed man starts taking them out, one after the other, they struggle to remember, believing that their memories hold the pathway to their escape.

title: Coyote
description: Después de heredar una casa en un remoto pueblo húngaro, un joven se ve envuelto en un conflicto brutal con el magnate local al que desafía.

title: Kombu
description: When a group of people venture into a haunted house, paranormal activity unfolds and evil is unleashed from deep within.

title: Wolfkin
description: After discovering her estranged family's darker nature, Elaine finds herself in a desperate fight against time for her son's future.

title: Konga TNT
description: When an alien serum causes an escaped lab gorilla to swell to a massive size, only two young boys can save him from the army trying to take him down.

title: The King's Choice
description: On April 9, 1940, the German war machine arrived in the city of Oslo and the Norwegian King faces a choice that will change his country forever.

title: Konrad
description: When a factory-made 8-year-old boy named Konrad is shipped by computer error to the wrong family, he fights the company recall in order to stay.

title: Kon-Tiki
description: Despite a fear of water and inability to swim, a Norwegian explorer and his crew embarked on an epic journey across the Pacific on a balsa wood raft.

title: Confidence Queen
description: In a world full of sly villains and silent victims, three con artists fight greed with style. They take only from the wicked and never seek revenge. What if crime becomes a game and justice a clever trick? Welcome to the world of Confidence Queen. Meet Yi-rang, the charming leader, James, the seasoned pro, and just Gu-ho. But remember: never trust what you see and never fall for a con artist.

title: Krampus Origins
description: In 1918, a team of American soldiers discover a mysterious artifact that has the ability to summon the ancient evil spirit of the Krampus.

title: Krampus: The Reckoning
description: An odd little girl summons a legendary demon spirit, Santa’s dark counterpart, and unleashes him to punish those she deems naughty at Christmastime.

title: Kratt
description: When left at Granny's without their phones, two siblings find instructions on building a devilish creature. The only missing puzzle is one soul.

title: Krispr
description: Dr. Elijah Roelof brings his lab creation home for Christmas, unknowing the horrors his genetically enhanced super-clone has in store for his family.

title: Kristin Key: Lesbian Army
description: Armed with a guitar and an offbeat, razor-sharp wit, Kristin Key delivers a fearless debut packed with heart, identity, and glorious human chaos.

title: Fertile Floods: Croatia's Wetlands
description: Every year, the snowmelt in Croatia forms the country’s vast wetlands. Discover the abundant wildlife that inhabits this stunning landscape.

title: Chronology
description: The truth behind a young architect couple’s seemingly perfect marriage begins to emerge when Nihal suddenly disappears and Hakan goes looking for her.

title: Kronprinz Rudolf
description: Unhappy and isolated, Crown Prince Rudolf begins a tempestuous affair that could threaten his future as heir to the Habsburg monarchy.

title: The Day We Died
description: Throughout an icy cold Europe, people are slowly moving on after the shocking terrorist attack on Charlie Hebdo, unaware of their common destiny.

title: Kruel
description: They all scream for ice cream when they become the objects of a psychotic murderer's desires when he disguises himself as a friendly ice cream man.

title: Kryptic
description: Sometimes when you go hunting for a monster, the monster finds you first. In Kourtney Roy's debut feature Kryptic, a woman's search for a missing cryptozoologist leads to her own riveting cosmic quest for identity. A horror unlike any other.

title: Krzyk: Losing Control
description: While driving on a highway Lena sees a burning car and hears a scream. She needs to find out who the deceased woman, Nina, was. Slowly Lena becomes Nina. Stuck between her unresolved past and not her own future she tries to become herself again.

title: KSI: In Real Life
description: An access-all-areas look at the life of global megastar KSI as he goes through the most momentous year of his life. At the height of his fame, spurred on by a break-up, the multi-millionaire YouTuber, boxer and rapper starts to re-evaluate his priorities. How did JJ Olatunji, a nerdy kid from Watford become so successful and at what cost?

title: Kubrick by Kubrick
description: Journey into the life and films of Stanley Kubrick via a treasure trove of unearthed interview recordings from the master director himself.

title: Kuessipan
description: Mikuan and Shaniss, two girls growing up in a Quebec Innu community, have been inseparable since childhood. Their plans to stick together no matter what are put to the test as they approach adulthood.

title: Kuldip Patwal: I Didn't Do It!
description: Kuldip Patwal (Deepak Dobriyal) is a young educated man in need of a good job. All his attempts to earn a living fail because of different policies introduced by the Chief Minister. One fateful day, the CM is shot down and Kuldip is thrown into jail on suspicion of murder. Did he actually commit the crime?

title: Kumpania
description: The mysterious pull of an old Spanish 'Gypsy' art on contemporary musicians in Los Angeles is the essence of KUMPANIA.

title: Kumu Hina
description: A transgender Hawaiian teacher handles her personal life at home while professionally inspiring a young girl to lead the school’s male hula team.

title: Kunal Rao: Done
description: Comedian Kunal Rao narrates his personal experiences from the point of view of a cynical, awkward, introverted person stuck in a world filled with people who are chasing all the wrong things.

title: Kung Fu Masters 2
description: A young boy trains with a master for the kung fu battle of his life in order to defeat an evil spirit in an ancient world that wants to destroy peace.

title: Kung Fu Panda 4
description: Jack Black returns as the most unlikely kung fu master, Po, to take on a wicked, magic-wielding enemy that reminds him that heroes can be found in the most unexpected places.

title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
description: Follows the adventures of hungry and enthusiastic panda Po, as he continues his martial arts training and takes on new responsibilities in the palace with the Furious Five.

title: Kuntergrau
description: After coming out to his parents, Lukas is kicked out of his home over night. Soon after he finds himself in a big city full of opportunities and interesting people. One of them is the 17-year-old Leopold, who's growing relationship with Lukas is shortly after put to the test. Meanwhile their new friends Jan and Noah have problems of their own: Jan is struggling with his boyfriend's fetish fantasy.

title: The Resistance Fighter
description: The motto ‘Every man fights his own war’ is dramatically shown in this true World War II account of a Polish war hero who worked with the Resistance.

title: Kurt Cobain: About a Son
description: Recorded interviews and impressionistic visuals tell the story of the life of Nirvana frontman Kurt Cobain, who ended his life in 1994 at age 27.

title: Kusama: Infinity
description: Artist Yayoi Kusama fought through enormous deterrents to see that her installation Infinity Mirror Rooms got out into the art world.

title: Well
description: After their van breaks down, four women become stranded at a gas station in the middle of nowhere, and soon realize they've fallen into a deadly trap.

title: Cattle Hill
description: A young cow who dreams of becoming a big pop star travels to the countryside to visit her father, whom she has not seen for many years.

title: Kyle Kinane: Dirt Nap
description: Back in another stand-up special, Kyle Kinane's biggest target is once again himself, with his only heckler being his own moral compass.

title: The Fifth Title Team - Under-21 EURO
description: A generation of young footballers led by Dani Ceballos, Fabián and Mikel Oyarzabal, amongst others, faced a tough challenge: Achieving a fifth U21 title. A defeat in the first match and a number of injuries increased the difficulty of their goal. Enjoy an inside view of how this group led, by Luis De la Fuente, overcame all obstacles to become Euro Champions.

title: Laakhon Mein Ek
description: All that 15-year-old Aakash wants to do is make mimicry videos and post them online. Instead, he finds himself in an IIT coaching institute called Genius Infinity, where he is a misfit, unable to cope with the syllabus, and placed in the notorious section D. Now, along with roommates Bakri and Chudail, Aakash will learn to answer life's multiple-choice questions.

title: The Hidden Battle
description: The secret story of the relationship between Nazi Germany and the Franco regime has come to light as a result of the declassification of a series of documents in the USA, Great Britain and Germany.  The battle for wolfram began when the Nazis started to extract this strategic mineral in Spain for their weapon factories and the Allies decided to bid for it too in the Spanish market.

title: The Legend of the Christmas Witch
description: When a teacher by day, holiday sorceress by night is kidnapped by a vengeful toymaker, her students set out on a mission to rescue her and Christmas.

title: Beauty and the Beast
description: Award-winning version of the fairy tale where a beautiful daughter of a merchant boldly takes her father’s place after he steals from an angry beast.

title: How to Be a Good Wife
description: A dutiful wife running a homemaker institute in 1968 France has her first fling with freedom when she’s suddenly made a widow facing financial ruin.

title: Labor Pains
description: A young woman with reason to be worried about her professional future hatches a plan where she pretends to be pregnant to avoid being fired.

title: Labou
description: While on an adventure to find ghost pirates and treasure, three young kids get lost in a swamp and befriend a bizarre, whistling creature.

title: Kitchen Brigade
description: Ambitious sous-chef Cathy takes a job helming the kitchen of a migrant hostel, where she teaches the young residents the art of French cooking.

title: L.A. Burning: The Riots 25 Years Later
description: This documentary explores the lives of the people at the flashpoint of the LA riots, 25 years after the uprising made national headlines and highlighted the racial divide in America.

title: Labyrinth
description: Two women, separated by centuries, embark on a quest to find and protect the Holy Grail in this epic, two-part historical miniseries.

title: The Head of Joaquín Murrieta
description: [Original audio in "Español Latinamerica"] Greed took over California because of the gold rush. It made people thirsty for wealth and land. There, in the newly drawn border between Mexico and the US, a lawless war for control, fueled by the anger and xenophobia of the past war, is led by a group of immigrants who join forces to create the myth of the Latin Robin Hood: Joaquín Murrieta.

title: Inspector Rojas: In Cold Blood
description: Norte de Chile, fines de los 90. La misteriosa desaparición de doce jóvenes en Alto Hospicio desencadena una investigación para encontrar la verdad.

title: La Cadena
description: El introvertido Ricardo Pérez prefiere pasar desapercibido para no molestar ni causarse problemas. Para su sorpresa, Dios tiene otros planes para él.

title: DIVE
description: Mariel (Karla Souza) is a veteran competitive diver who has one last chance at the Olympics. However, when a terrible truth surfaces, Mariel has to confront her biggest personal dilemma yet: is winning really her ultimate dream?

title: Cavalry Charge
description: The Royal Canadian Mountain Police tries to stop an evil fur trader who wants to provoke the Native Americans to attack people in the Canadian wild.

title: La Casa
description: Based on a true story, a cop working in Chile during its 1980s political upheaval gets trapped in a cursed house by evil and hateful spirits at work.

title: The House at the End of Time
description: A family matriarch’s release from jail, 30 years after killing her husband, turns terrifying when the supernatural secrets that possessed her return.

title: Cathedral of the Sea
description: Arnau shelters in the church of the Virgin of the Sea, which is under construction, and is taken under the wing of the "bastaixos" or porters, who accept him into their brotherhood. From that moment on, Arnau's life is linked to the building of the church.

title: The Cause
description: Current and former inmates from one of the most dangerous prisons in Venezuela reveal the inner workings of a corrupt system.

title: The Accident
description: A community is torn apart in the aftermath of an explosion.

title: Laced
description: A woman's plot to poison her abusive husband backfires, leading to suspicion, while an unexpected visitor risks exposing her deadly scheme.

title: La Chana
description: La célebre gitana bailaora vuelve al tablao flamenco después de 23 años y revela el secreto de su desaparición estando en la cúspide de su carrera.

title: La chica del lago
description: El 7 de julio, cada cien años en el lago encantado, una misteriosa niña usa sus encantos para ayudar a los de buen corazón y castigar a los corruptos.

title: Alex's Strip
description: Una chica se entera de que tiene un padre. Recién salido de la cárcel acusado de yihadismo, quiere que lo acompañe a un viaje de negocios a Ia India.

title: L.A. Confidential
description: Three detectives from Los Angeles Police Department investigate multiple homicides. While unearthing the evidence and the suspects, the trail leads to corruption in their own department.

title: Cairo Conspiracy
description: When the Grand Imam at a prestigious Cairo university suddenly dies, a student finds himself a pawn in a ruthless battle between religion and state.

title: The Surge
description: Buscando rehacer su vida tras un pasado delictivo, Matía llega a una zona marginal de islas del río Paraná y se consigue trabajo como peón.

title: Lacuna
description: A mother and daughter living together in a dense and fragmented environment deal with the dark secrets of their past after a severe accident.

title: The Dark Dance
description: A well-respected mayor running for higher office causes a stir when he pits populism against artistic expression in an effort to preserve the culture.

title: Non-living
description: When returning to the home where they lost their son, two parents find a message from him that leads to an exploration that could alter their futures.

title: Dangerous Moves
description: In this Academy Award-winning film, an aging Soviet chess champion faces off against his former student, a Soviet defector, in a World Championship.

title: Ladies in Lavender
description: Two sisters befriend a mysterious foreigner who washes up on the beach of their 1930's Cornish seaside village.

title: Ladies of the Lake
description: Behind the gates of the exclusive community of Avalon, dark secrets begin to be revealed, as murder and power struggles show the true nature of the glamorous citizens who live there. Nominated for a 2018 Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Digital Daytime Drama, Ladies of the Lake is adapted from the novel by Ken Corday, Executive Producer of Days of Our Lives.

title: The Double Hour
description: An ex-cop and a chambermaid embark on a passionate love affair, but shadows fall on their romantic getaway when past secrets begin to emerge.

title: Christmas Thieves
description: A pair of petty criminals dressed as Santa and his elf try to convince two children that they aren’t thieves at all, but are in fact babysitters.

title: The Man Who Cracked the Nazi Code: The Story of Alan Turing
description: 6 June 1944. D-Day. The biggest land and sea operation in history. On this pivotal moment in history when the outcome of the Second World War was at stake, much has been recounted, analyzed and examined and yet, the D-Day landings were only possible thanks to a socially-awkward, antimilitarist mathematician named Alan Turing and his field was the most fundamental branch of mathematics: logic.

title: Lady Bloodfight
description: Upon arriving in Hong Kong, an American woman is beaten up and mugged by thugs. She's taken in by a martial arts master who trains her into a fighter.

title: Lady Buds
description: Six women come out of the shadows of the cannabis underground and risk everything to succeed in the newly legal market.

title: Lady Chatterley's Lover
description: After a crippling injury leaves her husband impotent, Lady Chatterly is torn between her love of her husband and her physical desires. With her husband’s consent, she seeks out other means of fulfilling her needs.

title: Lady Cocoa
description: A singer who played casinos is freed from prison for one day of freedom, so she can turn state’s evidence and help take down her mobster boyfriend.

title: Lady Detective Shadow
description: A detective armed with exceptional kung fu skills brings criminals in the badlands of ancient China to heel with her own masterful brand of justice.

title: Lady Di: Before Royalty
description: In 1980, an innocent nursery school teacher would go from anonymity to worldwide superstardom practically overnight. Everyone knows the story of Lady Diana Spencer, the naive girl that became a Princess and almost became a queen. In this documentary we take a look at the story of the country girl before Buckingham Palace, meet her friends, the people who knew her and visit the school where she spent her childhood. This is the story of Lady Di, Before Royalty.

title: Lady Gaga: Glory
description: This 2022 documentary gives you the best of Lady Gaga in all her glory, with a special emphasis on her music that has amassed her millions of fans.

title: Lady Ice
description: Paula Booth is Lady Ice, the beautiful, sophisticated power behind a gang of jewel thieves.

title: Lady in a Corner
description: The founding editor of a high glamour fashion magazine in New York tries to save her magazine from being taken over by a huge media conglomerate of questionable ethics.  In the process, she is forced to ally with an irreverent young female associate editor, who also seeks control.

title: Lady in the Death House
description: As a woman walks the "last mile" to her execution she remembers back to the incidents that got her framed for murder.

title: Lady in the Locket
description: Darcy inherits her aunt's old house, only to find the spirit still lingers. With help from the town's widowed sheriff and his daughter, she uncovers a buried family secret-and an unexpected romance.

title: Lady in White
description: While locked in his classroom closet, an inquisitive 10-year-old is confronted by the ghost of one of the victims of a child rapist and murderer.

title: Lady Killer
description: A married woman indulges in a brief affair with a handsome young surgeon, but when she ends it, he exacts a brutal and terrifying form of revenge.

title: Lady Lawman
description: The true story of Francis Miller, the first deputy marshal in the Old West. Hoping to find her husband’s killer, she must prove she can hold her own.

title: Lady Like
description: The fairy-tale life of RuPaul's Drag Race star, Lady Camden, shines in Luke Willis' intimate and joyous documentary. As she soars to international fame, the filmmakers dive into the dark past that drove her to seek the fantasy of the performing arts.

title: Lady of Guadalupe
description: An ambitious reporter assigned to write an article on faith discovers the legend of Our Lady of Guadalupe who appeared to a humble villager and performed miracles over 500 years ago. The reporter's faith is tested when his wife is injured in a car accident and his personal journey takes him from cynic to true believer as he witnesses the power of divine miracles in his own life.

title: Lady Rider
description: A detective chasing down rogue cops sets out to prove that his sergeant has been framing area murders on a pair of motorcycle gang members.

title: Lady Valor: The Kristin Beck Story
description: Former U.S. Navy SEAL Christopher Beck comes out to the world as Kristin Beck in this heartfelt doc about transformation in the face of adversity.

title: Lady, You Shot Me: The Life and Death of Sam Cooke
description: Uncover the mystery surrounding the death of Sam Cooke, the most influential black pop star of his time.

title: The Strategy of Silence
description: A media blackout and wall of silence triggers a nine-year battle between the victims’ families of a 2006 Valencia subway disaster and the government.

title: The Fox Badger Family
description: Dad Edmund, his two twin boys Woodsy and Scoutbadger and their baby sister Berry all lived peacefully in their burrow. So when Edmund falls in love with the beautiful fox Margaret, of course he asks her and her daughter Rosie to move in to form one big Fox-Badger family. What a great change for the Badgers! Luckily, when love is involved, the house is filled to the brim with happiness and smiles!

title: The Woman in the Fifth
description: After traveling to Paris only to be rejected by his estranged wife, a man strikes up an affair with a mysterious woman who may not be what she seems.

title: The Lady Musketeer
description: The daughter of a renowned swordsman rides with the sons of the Three Musketeers to defeat a sinister cardinal in this swashbuckling adventure.

title: The Girl with Two Faces
description: Clarisse meets Marc, a young surgeon. She spends the night with him in his mansion. In the morning, she realizes that she has been fooled. She's now held against her will. Marc forces her to play the part of his deceased wife. He operates on her to give her a new face. Clarisse becomes Hélène. But can an identity be erased so easily?..

title: The Girl Next Door
description: Upon her father's release from jail after being convicted for her mother's murder, Nina starts looking for the truth, placing herself in danger.

title: The Rose Maker
description: Three inexperienced ex-cons team up to rescue the rose business of one of France’s greatest artisanal horticulturalists from the brink of bankruptcy.

title: Max & Leon
description: Max & Leon is the first feature film from the stars of the French TV sensation The Palmashow: the creation of stand-up comedians Grégoire Ludig and David Marsais. In this epic WW2 comedy—in the vein of La Grande Vadrouille (which was for 40 years the most popular French film in the history of France)—our two heroes, Max and Léon, will try by all means possible to avoid going into battle… which leads the duo into a series of demented and wild adventures.

title: The Ice Forest
description: When a technician arrives in the Italian alps to repair a power plant, he is shocked by a sinister discovery and an unexpected disappearance.

title: The Funeral Home
description: For an undertaker and his unusual family, supernatural entities are just part of the daily routine. Until they decide to do something about it.

title: Turu, the Wacky Hen
description: A misfit hen who can't lay eggs comes to discover she can talk, sing and dance and takes her talents on the road as a world famous circus act.

title: Antarctica: Ice & Sky
description: The story of how the research of French glaciologist Claude Lorius in Antarctica led the first call to attention to man-made global climate change.

title: La Gorda Fabiola: Model 63
description: Health problems, overweight, children and the age difference in her marital relationship are the raw material for the humor of La Gorda Fabiola. She will share with us the secret behind her good health and her big heart, one of the largest and most resistant in Colombia.

title: The Harlem Hellfighters' Great War
description: The 15th regiment of the New York National Guard was exclusively made up of black soldiers. Nicknamed the Harlem Hellfighters, this American unit was to be the most decorated of the Second World War.  It was not only liberty and democracy that they came to defend with fieriness in France, but also racial equality.

title: Snowtime!
description: When winter break comes to a small village, an 11-year-old boy and girl lead opposing teams of kids and engage in a long and epic snowball fight.

title: Quest for Fire
description: Anthony Burgess created the primitive language for the early humans in this prehistoric adventure about a trio of warriors who travel the savanna, encountering sabre-toothed tigers, mammoths and cannibalistic tribes in search of a flame that would replace the fire their tribe has lost.

title: La Gunguna
description: Tremenda pistolita calibre .22 es esta que deja una estela de eventos desafortunados y mala suerte a quien entra en posesión de ella.

title: L.A. Heat
description: L.A. Heat follows the cases of homicide detectives Chase McDonald and August Brooks. Chase enjoys the thrill of adrenaline and is always seeking action. August, a seasoned police veteran, acts as the voice of reason for his young partner. Together, they clean up the streets of Los Angeles to try to make the city a safer place.

title: The Mission
description: The Mission follows four American teenagers from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints who travel to the frozen, forested lands of Finland. As these wide-eyed, impassioned teens are pushed beyond their limits, they fall deeper into their faith.

title: The Bastards' Fig Tree
description: Al ver los ojos vengativos del chico a quien le mató a su padre y hermano, un falangista se vuelve un ermitaño obsesionado con cuidar una higuera.

title: Night of the Bloody Apes
description: After a sick patient gets a heart transplant from an unlikely donor, it quickly proves to have very dangerous effects on the young man.

title: Island of Lost Souls
description: This harrowing drama is based on the memoir by Costa Rican author José León Sánchez Alvarado, who survived 20 years of brutal imprisonment.

title: The Reunion
description: Based on Guillaume Musso’s bestseller, this gripping thriller series focuses on a high school reunion in the south of France where three former friends are still bound by a tragic secret from 25 years ago. Ioan Gruffudd leads an international cast.

title: Lake Effects
description: With the guidance of their father's spirit, two women and their mother finally discover what being a family truly means.

title: Lake Fear
description: Four girls go to a cabin in the woods, which is inhabited by evil, ensnaring them in a labyrinth of macabre as they battle their way out.

title: Lake Lavon
description: This romantic comedy charts the relationship of a young couple who find faith—and each other—as the world tries to keep them apart.

title: Lake Los Angeles
description: A middle-aged Cuban man and a ten-year-old Mexican girl bond over being away from home in the hopeless backdrop that is Lake Los Angeles.

title: Lake Michigan Monster
description: All aboard! The combined spirits of H.P. Lovecraft, early Sam Raimi and Mystery Science Theater 3000 inhabit this action-packed tale of nautical derring-do and monster mayhem - winner of the Audience Award for Best International Feature at the 2019 Fantasia Film Festival.

title: Lake Placid: Legacy
description: When a group of young explorers venture to a mysterious lake, they discover an island harboring an abandoned lab facility with a horrific legacy: the island is home to a deadly predator.

title: Jungle Raiders
description: Two partners running a scam selling jungle expeditions to rich tourists unwillingly guide a Colombian museum curator on a search for a legendary ruby.

title: The Legend of the Titanic
description: A grandpa mouse recounts the ‘real’ tale of the Titanic to his grandkids, featuring himself, evil sharks, a giant octopus and a sinister whaling plot.

title: Battle of the Commandos
description: After his platoon is massacred by German soldiers, a colonel for the Allied forces leads a band of brigands on a deadly mission against the Nazis.

title: The Legend of the Nahuala
description: Leo San Juan, un niño introvertido y lleno de miedo a la vida, se arma de valor para entrar a la casa de la Nahuala y rescatar a su hermano.

title: The LIberation
description: Three women join forces to prevent a sexual harassment complaint against a renowned movie director from coming to light. This controversial mission will take them to the doors of a feminist group named La Aldea, which will take them on an inward journey to heal their patriarchal wounds.

title: The Line
description: A US government assassin targets the unstable kingpin of a Mexican drug cartel and gets entangled with a Tijuana woman with a war to wage.

title: The Sweet Sound of Death
description: A young man is visited by his late girlfriend's ghost. Initially pleased by her return, he soon realizes she's trying to lure him to his death.

title: La Longue Marche
description: After a decade of working side by side trying to protect nature, a young Norwegian woman and her two Ju/’hoansi bushmen friends set out on a journey of self-discovery and survival as they walk 1490 Km across the wilderness of Namibia to reach the Ocean.

title: Incident Light
description: Struggling to put her life back together after the sudden death of her husband, a single mother of two meets a charming older man in 1960s Argentina.

title: L.A. Macabre
description: Filmmakers interview a former member of the defunct cult "The New Family," leading them down a path of mystery, kidnapping and murder.

title: The Mansion of Madness
description: Based on an Edgar Allan Poe story, this outrageous horror/fantasy will surely blow your mind!

title: The Bride Wore Black
description: The incandescent Jeanne Moreau stars as a bride seeking revenge for the murder of her husband on their wedding day in director François Truffaut's passionate and haunting tribute to the films of Alfred Hitchcock.

title: Black Sunday
description: A vengeful witch and her servant return from the grave and begin a bloody campaign to possess the body of the witch's beautiful look-alike descendant.

title: Lamb
description: "Lamb" focuses on the relationship between Brother Michael Lamb (Liam Neeson), a teacher in a Roman Catholic-run institution for troubled boys in Ireland, and 10-year-old Owen Kane (Hugh O'Conor), the school's most unruly pupil.

title: Under the Same Moon
description: After the death of his grandmother, a young Mexican boy traverses the border in search of his mother.

title: Love Is Not Perfect
description: Elena's well-ordered life is thrown into chaos when finds herself in a love triangle with a passionate younger woman and a much older but stable man.

title: Death in the Soul
description: A man admits to killing his beloved son without explanation. His lawyer, determined to uncover the truth, reveals dark family secrets.

title: Death Does Not Exist
description: After a failed attack scatters her militant group, Hélène retreats deep into a remote forest, where isolation forces her to confront what remains.

title: Just the Two of Us
description: When Blanche and Gregoire's passionate marriage grows deeply possessive and dangerous, she looks for ways to escape his threatening affections.

title: The Moustache
description: What would you say if I shaved my moustache? Asks Mark to Agnès. I don't know. I love you with it, but I've never known you without it. Alone in front of the bathroom mirror, he does it. Just like that: as a game, to change a little something in their happy, uneventful life. She walks in and seems to notice nothing. Neither do the others.

title: The Woman I Lost
description: When Pedro kills the son of an influential lawyer to save his girlfriend, he's forced to flee and receives help from a peasant woman.

title: The Music of Silence
description: Based on the extraordinary true story of Andrea Bocelli, a blind boy who, against all odds, becomes one of the most world-renowned opera singers.

title: Lamya's Poem
description: A young Syrian refugee tumbles into a dream world and meets 13th-century poet Rumi, helping him write a poem that will save her life 800 years later.

title: Lancaster
description: Through the words of the last surviving veterans, this film tells the story of WWII's iconic Lancaster Bomber, which helped turn the tide of the war.

title: Lancaster Skies
description: A Spitfire Ace pilot,  shattered from his duties in the Royal Air Force, makes it his mission to join the Bomber Command to fight the Nazis by air.

title: Lancelot: Guardian of Time
description: Arthur and Lancelot are sent to Los Angeles during the end of the 20th century, where they must defeat evil Wolvencraft and get home safely.

title: Lance Woods: Undeniable
description: Comedian Lance Woods brings his direct and unique takes on race relations, what he thinks about slave movies, and more on dating and modern life.

title: Landfill
description: When a little girl begins to see the ghost of another girl her age shortly after finding a necklace at a landfill, she embarks on a journey to help the ghost discover the mystery behind her death.

title: Landline
description: When two sisters suspect their father (John Turturro) may be having an affair, it sends them into a tailspin that reveals cracks in the family façade. For the first time, older sister Dana (Jenny Slate), recently engaged and struggling with her own fidelity, finds herself bonding with her wild teenage sister Ali (Abby Quinn). The two try to uncover the truth without tipping off their mother (Edie Falco) and discover the messy reality of love and sex in the process. Set in 1990s Manhattan, Landline is a warm, insightful and comedic drama about a family united by secrets and lies, co-written and directed by Gillian Robespierre (Obvious Child).

title: Landmine Goes Click
description: Trapped standing on an armed landmine,  an American tourist is forced to watch helplessly while his girlfriend is terrorized and brutally assaulted.

title: Land of Doom
description: Traveling through a wasteland ravaged by a nuclear apocalypse, two survivors search for a rumored paradise while evading a metal-faced villain.

title: Land of the Blind
description: A soldier recounts his alliance with a famous political prisoner, who draws him into an attempt to overthrow their country's authoritarian government.

title: Land of the Dead
description: The last of humanity battles to survive the unspeakable truth: the ravenous zombie hordes besieging their fortified city…are evolving!

title: Land of the Lost
description: A widowed father, Tom, and his two teen children, Kevin and younger sister, Annie, find themselves trapped in a parallel universe when their jeep falls into the time portal while exploring the countryside. Together, they must learn to survive in this strange new world filled with dinosaurs, monkey-like people, and aliens.

title: Land's End
description: A former LAPD cop moves to Cabo San Lucas to work as a private investigator, solving crimes beachside with the help of his two middle-aged buddies.

title: Landslide
description: A construction site turns the face of a mountain into a rolling avalanche of soil, timber, and rock, destroying everything—and everyone—in its wake.

title: Language Arts
description: A collaboration with a student on a project about youth autism and senior dementia forces a withdrawn high school teacher to face his own limitations.

title: The New Eve
description: A liberated woman revels in Parisian nightlife until a chance encounter with a politically committed, married man disrupts her debaucheries.

title: The Bride
description: A tale of unappeased desires, forbidden yearnings and conflicted choices begin to unfold as a couple prepares for their wedding in the pale desert.

title: Lansky
description: A reporter working as an FBI operative entraps an aging Meyer Lansky into divulging the truth about his life as boss of the National Crime Syndicate.

title: The Art Dealer
description: Art Dealer follows a Jewish woman who embarks on a journey to recover family paintings stolen by the Nazis; and discovers some family secrets are best kept hidden.

title: The Night Eats the World
description: What seems like a nightmare is a horrifying reality for a man who wakes up in Paris as apparently the only survivor of a swarm of killer zombies.

title: The Night of the Long Knives
description: The Night of the Long Knives is considered the first act of horror committed by the Nazis. What happened in Germany that led to this purge in 1934?

title: Piranhas
description: Based on Roberto Saviano’s book, a teenager and his friends, who crave the lush life, enter the violent, power-hungry culture of the Neapolitan mafia.

title: The Shadow Side
description: During 2020's global pandemic, a girl from Buenos Aires begins to experience supernatural events that push her to the limit.

title: Beatrice
description: In Medieval France, a warrior returns home after four years of war and captivity. It is his delicate daughter who must deal now with his rage and frustration.

title: The License
description: "The License" is a modern-day ensemble comedy revolving around the lives of two Roman slackers. Rolando works at his future father-in- law's driving school, and Sergio is a waiter at the corner café as well as a small-time drug dealer. Thanks to the unexpected death of the elderly owner, they end up taking control of the driving school during the pivotal week before the final driving test.

title: Patience Has a Limit, We Don't
description: An Irish corporal in a U.S. army camp steals and hides the military's treasure chest. When he dies, his two half-wit sons set out to find it.

title: The Skin of Sorrow
description: Rafael estaba a punto de lanzarse al río Sena para suicidarse cuando un tendero le ofrece una piel que le concederá todos sus deseos.

title: The Fishbowl
description: As her cancer spreads, Noelia ultimately decides to return to her native Vieques, Puerto Rico, and claim her freedom to decide her own fate. She reunites with her friends and family, who are still dealing with the contamination of the U.S. Navy after 60 years of military practices.

title: The Man from Rome
description: A  hacker sends an urgent plea to the Pope's computer concerning a crumbling church in the heart of Seville that apparently "kills to defend itself". Father Quart, from the Vatican intelligence, is dispatched to investigate the mystery that will challenge his loyalty, vow of chastity, and faith.

title: The Red Door
description: In this supernatural crime thriller from Italy, a Trieste cop has a vision of the future moments before his death; now, he must stay on Earth to find his killer.

title: Princess in Love
description: In an interview, Lady Diana Spencer tells the failure of her marriage to Prince Charles, sthocking the monarchy and the world with their infidelities.

title: Next Time I'll Aim for the Heart
description: The real-life hunt of a serial killer of women in late 1970s northern France who managed to evade police for so long because he himself was a cop.

title: Troubled Waters
description: When a diver vanishes after discovering a statuette of Medusa, it's up to police detectives to unravel the mystery of the potentially cursed artifact.

title: Child Machine
description: During a family trip in the country, a 9-year old girl gets trapped in a vacant wartime bunker-turned-tech startup lab with its super intelligent AI.

title: Lapwing
description: An isolated group of salt farmers arranges illegal passage to Europe for a family in hiding, but a love affair threatens to destroy both communities.

title: Lara and the Beat
description: When their glamorous, fast-paced lifestyle comes to a screeching halt, two sisters try to rebuild their fortunes through music and enterprise.

title: The Round Up
description: Rose Bosch recounts the true story of the infamous Vel 'D'Hiv Roundup, a mass arrest of Paris Jews at the behest of the German occupation authorities.

title: The Girl Who Knew Too Much
description: A mystery novel-loving American tourist witnesses a brutal murder in Rome and soon finds herself and her suitor caught up in a series of killings.

title: Larceny
description: When the CIA enlists a professional heist man to rob a Mexican prison, the thief gets caught in a war between corrupt authorities and a drug cartel.

title: One Life of Two Women
description: A woman who appears to have the perfect life tries to escape a prison of sadistic manipulation.

title: The House That Screamed
description: Set in 19th-century France, when Teresa arrives at a boarding school for troubled girls run by an evil headmistress, students start to disappear.

title: The Orphanage
description: A principios del siglo XX, la espeluznante verdad que se esconde tras un orfanato sale a la luz cuando sus niños comienzan a rebelarse.

title: The Revolt of the Slaves
description: During the later years of the Roman Empire, the daughter of a wealthy patrician falls in love with a Christian slave.

title: The Silk Road
description: The great reporter Alfred de Montesquiou follows the footsteps of Marco Polo, from Venice to China. An interesting journey on the lookout for the secret dialogue of cultures, between East and West.

title: Larry Gaye: Renegade Male Flight Attendant
description: It’s up to a male flight attendant to save the day when his airline starts replacing its flight attendants with robot in an effort to reduce costs.

title: Larry the Cable Guy: Health Inspector
