description: A bumbling big city health inspector is paired with a no-nonsense rookie partner to investigate a series of fine dining food poisoning incidents.

title: Larry the Cable Guy: It's a Gift
description: It's A Gift is a standup comedy special featuring Larry the Cable Guy at his best, delivering all new jokes with his signature rapid fire wit. Filmed at the historic Capitol Theater in Clearwater, Florida, this high energy show is packed with laughs and classic Larry charm. Buckle up-It's A Gift you won't want to return.

title: Larva
description: When a veterinarian moves to a small Missouri town, he discovers a disturbing parasite that poses a threat to the entire community.

title: The Tall Women
description: Siete mujeres son las únicas supervivientes de un ataque a una caravana y deben cruzar el desierto a pie para escapar de los indios que las persiguen.

title: Tad, the Lost Explorer
description: A case of mistaken identity turns a bored construction worker into an insta-famous archeologist and sends him to a lost Inca city to find hidden gold.

title: The Unknown Woman
description: Haunted by a horrible past, a young Ukrainian woman calculatedly insinuates herself into the life of a rich Italian family, to uncover a hidden truth.

title: Laserblast
description: When an outcast teenager finds an alien weapon left behind in the desert and goes on a rampage, each laser blast transforms him further into an alien.

title: Laserhawk
description: A group of teenagers battle an alien invasion with the aid of a mysterious patient in a psychiatric hospital and a comic-book artist.

title: L.A.'s Finest
description: Two very different female detectives team up to take on crime in the City of Angels. Although they have very different lifestyles, but are both at the top of their game.

title: The Legacy of elBulli
description: Spanish chef Ferran Adrià begins his career as a hotel dishwasher and becomes a global success, with his restaurant elBulli earning three Michelin stars.

title: La Sincérité
description: In an effort to seduce Louise, a young actress, Jean decides to make a movie, bringing together a team to imagine the script of the film.

title: The Stendhal Syndrome
description: A beautiful detective in pursuit of a savage serial killer-rapist who has been terrorizing Italy. When his trail leads Anna to Florence's famed Uffizi Museum, the investigation takes a violently psychotic turn.

title: Mississippi Mermaid
description: A plantation owner falls hopelessly in love with his mail-order bride, despite the fact that she is not what she seems and intends to deceive him.

title: The Clouds
description: Pablo Prieto is a man marked by violence starting in his childhood when he killed his brother. He leads a gang of thieves targeting small towns when he saves the life of a young student during a robbery. Facing betrayal from his partners, being hunted by a Judge, Pablo looks for a way to escape his fate.

title: The Killer Is on the Phone
description: When a beautiful actress returns from a short trip to London, a mysterious man begins to stalk her. As she slowly turns the corner, she sees him and faints. Hours later she awakens, unable to recognize her own husband an friends.

title: Lassie
description: Lassie and Jeff Miller become best friends and enjoy family adventures in the American countryside, teaching each other about love and commitment.

title: Lasso
description: A tour group visits a small town rodeo festival. All seems to be going well until they aren't allowed to leave, and are picked off by evil cowboys.

title: La Stagiaire
description: During her internship in Marseille with judge Frederic Filiponi, Constance finds her resolve tested. Her empathy and sense of justice are not always welcome, and she misses her family. From Walter Presents, in French with English subtitles.

title: Last Call
description: Slacker cousins Danny and Phil take over running the bar from their wacky Uncle Pete, starting with a brilliant scheme to avoid foreclosure.

title: Last Call
description: Three apartments in an old converted loft building set the stage for three bizarre love triangles. Nico, enjoys his older brother's top floor loft, while he is away on business. Downstairs, on her second floor loft, Helena, prepares for a dinner with her lover, who never shows up. In the basement, three expatriates are waiting for a phone call to carry out a dirty job.

title: Last Chance Cafe
description: After discovering that her ex-husband and corrupt cops murdered her stepfather, a woman and her daughter flee to a small farm town, as danger follows.

title: Last County
description: An alcoholic with a marriage on the rocks finds an ally in a wounded drug mule when she’s forced to defend her home from a siege of corrupt cops.

title: Last Days
description: Based on a true story, Last Days follows John Allen Chau on a dangerous adventure across the globe to share his faith with the isolated tribe of North Sentinel Island, while a detective races to stop him before he does harm to himself or the tribe.

title: Last Days of the Nazis
description: This new limited series that takes viewers inside the minds of the Germans themselves and sees the events of WWII from their perspective.

title: Last Exit to Brooklyn
description: The lives of a closeted union leader, a prostitute, her pimp, and a striking factory worker intertwine against the grim backdrop of 1950s Brooklyn.

title: Last ExMas
description: Ex-girlfriends whose bitter breakup led them down different paths find themselves rekindling their spark during a hometown visit over the holidays.

title: Last Flag Flying
description: Former Navy Corpsman Larry "Doc" Shepherd re-unites with his old buddies, former Marines Sal Nealon and Reverend Richard Mueller, for a roadtrip that will reignite old bonds and heal new wounds.

title: Last Gasp
description: Después de masacrar a una tribu mexicana por sus tierras, un promotor inmobiliario finalmente siente los efectos de una maldición colocada sobre él.

title: Last Hour
description: In his last film, DMX is lured to a sinister home in with the promise of meeting his estranged father and finds himself in a deadly web of secrets that could kill him.

title: Last Hours in Suburbia
description: When Grace is accused of being involved in a deadly accident, her best friend's ghost reaches out to unveil the truth behind what actually happened.

title: Last Knights
description: Set in a nameless feudal society, Commander Raiden (Clive Owen) and his band of warriors wage battle against the corrupt ruler Geza Mott to avenge the unjust death of their honourable leader Lord Bartok (Morgan Freeman).

title: Last Known Location
description: Three kidnapped women from different backgrounds form a bond as they fight to survive while detectives race to find the connection.

title: Last Man Down
description: After his wife’s murder, an elite soldier lives in isolation in the woods until a wounded woman arrives unannounced, pursued by his wife’s killer.

title: Last Man Standing: Suge Knight and the Murders of Biggie and Tupac
description: Evidence detailing L.A. gang rivalries and their associations with dirty cops sheds light on Suge Knight and the murders of two hip hop icons.

title: Last Moment of Clarity
description: After mobsters murder his girlfriend, a man goes on an intense mission of truth when he sees a Hollywood actress onscreen who is identical to her.

title: Last Night
description: Right before a model is about to finally move in with her  long-time boyfriend, she meets an attractive stranger out of the blue and is sidetracked.

title: Last Night in Rozzie
description: When a New York City lawyer returns to his Boston hometown to come to the aid of a dying longtime friend, he must first confront a childhood trauma.

title: Last Night on Earth
description: A couple, faced with impending doom from a planet-killing asteroid, flees to the hills of Tennessee to spend their last days together.

title: Last of the Grads
description: At an annual school lock-in, a group of seniors celebrating their last night together instead find themselves facing a legendary killer.

title: Last of the Pony Riders
description: Gene Autry tries to set up a stage line to carry government mail, but is faced with schemers who are trying to get the contract for themselves.

title: Last of the Summer Wine
description: Unencumbered by wives, jobs, or any other responsibilities, three elderly men who never really grew up explore their world in the Yorkshire Dales. Catch up on the classic sitcom and binge hours of the boys’ youthful misadventures

title: Last Rampage
description: The true story of the infamous prison break of murderer Gary Tison and cellmate Randy Greenwalt from the Arizona State prison in the summer of 1978.

title: Last Resort
description: Tanya, young and naïve, leaves Moscow with her street-wise 10-year-old son Artiom to meet her English fiancé. But after he fails to turn up at the airport, Tanya and her son find themselves virtually imprisoned in a dead-end seaside resort where all refugees are forced to live. Desperate to escape their nightmarish world, Tanya forges an unusual alliance with amusement arcade manager Alfie.

title: Last Resort
description: When a failing salesman books a family vacation through a spurious travel company, they end up at a sleazy resort set in a banana republic war zone.

title: Last Resort
description: To lessen the impact of their death, two hospice residents try to set their spouses up, but things go awry when they themselves fall in love.

title: Last Ride
description: On the run after committing a violent crime, an ex-con takes his ten-year old son on a survival trek through the punishing Australian outback.

title: Last Sentinel
description: In a world ravaged by high sea levels, a skeleton crew of soldiers considers their next move while marooned on an outpost in the middle of the ocean.

title: Last Shoot Out
description: A brave gunman rescues a runaway bride—but must face the violent wrath of the groom’s angry, vengeful family.

title: Last Shot
description: A young man is released from prison with a chance to turn his life around but the streets haven't changed since he left and the same hate, regret, and fear waits for him on the other side of the wall.  It's tough to play it straight when his world is so crooked and it's hard to see who's good and who's bad when all the lines are blurred. Can he ever really be free?

title: Last Stop Garage
description: A team of mechanics at CRB Automotive in North West River, Labrador, use backwoods ingenuity and mechanical wizardry to fix and build just about anything for anyone.

title: Last Straw
description: A gritty neo-noir thriller set over one long night at a dusty roadside diner. When a series of chaotic events spiral out of control leaving a late-shift waitress in the middle of a blood-soaked murder spree, she soon realises all she has is her wits and luck to survive the night.

title: Last Summer
description: In rural Wales, four boys roam free, until a tragic, life-shattering crime sets them apart from the world of adults, and loyalty and friendship rule.

title: Last Summer of Nathan Lee
description: 18-year-old Nathan Lee finds out he has brain cancer and asks his best friend Dash to document his remaining life, which he vows to live with passion.

title: Last Swim
description: It's a sweltering A-Level results day in London. While secretly grappling with a life-changing decision, Ziba, a promising British-Iranian teen, leads her friends on an eventful journey across the city on their final day of freedom.

title: Last Testament
description: Born into the infamous Children Of God cult, Ricky Rodriguez (Dominick Alesia) was subjected to years of sexual abuse while also being groomed to one day lead the cult. He was finally able to escape the cult with his wife, Elixcia (Anna Roemer), but he remained haunted by his past and the weight of feeling responsible for the other survivors. As the suicide rate for victims of the cult increases, Ricky reaches a breaking point and he vows to take down the cult by any means necessary.

title: Last the Night
description: During the pandemic, a burned-out teacher on the verge of a breakdown overhears his students making fun of him in a zoom class and vows revenge.

title: Last Words
description: Last Words is a story of the last five people on Earth in 2085 and their human tenderness and creativity in the face of ecological catastrophe.

title: Let the Right One In
description: A lonely 12-year-old boy befriends a mysterious girl whose nightly visits coincide with a string of murders, revealing a dark and deadly secret.

title: Late Bloomers
description: Eleanor B. Roosevelt Hight is an ordinary school and doesn't seem to be the best place for love. But when Dinah, the Geometry teacher, and Carly, the school secretary, fall madly in love, all the community is confused and horrified.

title: Late Bloomers
description: After drunkenly breaking her hip, 28-year-old Louise meets a cranky, elderly Polish woman in the hospital. Despite her reluctance, she takes on a job as her caregiver. Neither likes it, but both need to confront the fact that it's time to grow up sometime.

title: The Vineyard
description: The Vineyard is the story of Mauro Larrea and Soledad Montalvo, two strangers whose destinies will cross in the second half of the 19th century, leading to their lives changing forever. A history of glories and defeats, of silver mines, family intrigues, vineyards, wineries, and fascinating cities whose splendor faded over time.

title: Late Night
description: A late-night talk show host's world is turned upside down when she hires a female staff writer with the hope of breathing life into the stale male-centric writers room.

title: Late Phases
description: Following the vicious attacks of a beast, a jaded veteran investigates what an isolated retirement community knows about the killings.

title: Lives of the Saints
description: Vittorio Innocente, a young man, estranged from the tragedies of his Italian immigrant family, has spent his adult life denying his past. When his estranged father starts to stalk Vittorio's sister, Rita, with murderous intent, Vittorio is moved to return to his family and uncover the decades-old secrets that have torn his family apart.

title: Latin Flow
description: Latin Flow is the story of 9 Colombian women. They are singers, who driven by urban music and female empowerment, seek to open their own space in a very competitive world.

title: The Truce
description: Based on Primo Levi's autobiographical "The Reawakening".

title: The Nutcrackers
description: A group of friendly animals all live together in a beautiful treehouse in the mountains.

title: Laughing at the Moon
description: An eccentric, generous woman comes to share a loft apartment in the city with a compulsive, selfish snob who might be changed by unconditional love.

title: Laundry Day
description: Welcome to the French Quarter of New Orleans, where a 24-hour bar/club/laundromat becomes the sight of a brutal fight between four desperate souls.

title: Laura Davis: If This Is It
description: Multi-award winning Australian comedian Laura Davis is a newcomer to the NextUp family with her show Live at Easey Street. Smart, original and full of black humour, Davis brings it all to the table with a combination of well crafted jokes, dark, observational story-telling and provocative themes.

title: Laura Pausini – Pleased to Meet You
description: Laura Pausini: Pleasure to Meet You—it's the movie that retraces the Laura’s life in a wholly original way. Through never-seen-before footage of her real and fictional life, the artist shows us her essence, giving an honest and bold analysis of her life and how it could have been without that victory at Sanremo that, in 1993, changed her destiny forever.

title: Laurel Canyon
description: A free-spirited LA record producer welcomes her newly graduated son and his wealthy fiance to her hedonistic lifestyle - one the son rejects but his prospective bride finds attractive. With Kate Beckinsale.

title: Lauren Lake's Paternity Court
description: Paternity is in dispute, and Judge Lauren Lake is ready to rule using DNA results and testimony from deadbeat dads, cheating spouses, and more.

title: Black Heaven
description: A breakout selection of the midnight section of Cannes in 2010, BLACK HEAVEN is directed by an exciting new French filmmaker called Gilles Marchand.

title: Voyage of the Continents
description: This extraordinary series is a sweeping account of the rise of Earth's continents. They are the product of a grand waltz of plate tectonics and the continual evolution of Earth's crust. As landmasses assemble and separate, they fuel volcanoes and spark earthquakes, building mountains and tearing valleys. We see the Earth, eons in the making, through the eyes of geologists and other scientists.

title: Lavell Crawford: Home for the Holidays
description: Lavell Crawford’s Showtime comedy set includes funny tales of roaches eating Christmas garland, family trips to Disneyworld, and growing up chunky.

title: Lavell Crawford: The Comedy Vaccine
description: The Saul Goodman heavy takes his fifth stand-up special to Tempe, Arizona and he’s not holding back about anything—especially COVID-19.

title: Lavell Crawford: THEE Lavell Crawford
description: Live from New Orleans, Lavell Crawford is back with a new comedy special, riffing on everything from white neighborhoods to getting blessed with impossibly good deals on chicken.

title: Lavender
description: Under a psychiatrist’s care, a woman with memory loss returns to her childhood home, and the massacre of her family there begins to come into focus.

title: Black and White in Color
description: An Academy Award-winning film about French colonists who get lost in West Africa and find themselves at war with their German neighbors.

title: Back to Reality
description: Back to Reality tells the story of Marcela, an organized and protective school teacher who makes the decision to participate in a reality show. Without her at home, her family faces the harsh reality of everyday life, and her friend Laura, who has always been a support for her, takes charge of their home going through difficult situations.

title: The Red Virgin
description: Based on a true story. By age 16, Hildegart was an expert on female sexuality and one of Spain’s brightest young minds in the 1930s, molded by her mother to be the ideal woman of the future. But when Hildegart begins to experience the world and rebel against those strict expectations, her mother will do everything possible to prevent her from breaking free.

title: Life Is Tough, Eh Providence?
description: In the Old West, bounty hunter Providence captures the bandit Hurricane Kid and sets him free multiple times to earn the reward in as many states as possible...

title: A Family For 1640 Days
description: When 6-year-old Simon is set to meet his widowed biological father, the adoptive mother's world is shaken as custody hopes resurface.

title: LAW
description: There are umpteen stories that involve crime and investigations. Sometimes, the case even gets dismissed due to lack of evidence and the accused are set free. However ‘Law’ is a paradigm shift from the rest in this genre. Nandhini, a law student who is caught in a precarious situation fights for justice for a gruesome crime that took place.

title: L.A. Without a Map
description: A Scottish undertaker, who wants to be a screenwriter, becomes smitten with a young actress and pursues her to Hollywood, on a quest to win her heart.

title: Lawless: Dead Evidence
description: A private investigator and an ex-undercover cop team up to stop a killer believed to be behind bars.

title: Lawn Dogs
description: An antisocial young girl forges an odd friendship with the reclusive 21-year-old lawn caretaker, who lives in the woods near her suburban community.

title: Lawnmower Man 2: Beyond Cyberspace
description: They thought they had destroyed him. What they didn’t count on was the simple gardener-turned-superkiller finding a way to reboot himself.

title: Law of Attraction
description: While trying to impress her law firm’s partners with her first big case, Allison unexpectedly stumbles into a romantic conflict of interest.

title: Layover
description: When a spoiled hotel chain heiress is kidnapped by sex traffickers, a company exec, the FBI, and her just-fired assistant must come to the rescue.

title: Lay the Favorite
description: Private dancer turned waitress Beth falls for Dink, an aging sports gambler, and along the way, discovers she has the gift for gambling herself.

title: Lazarus
description: After a man is revived from death by murder, he finds that he has otherworldly powers to help avenge the crime ring out to destroy him and his city.

title: Lazarus: The Awakening
description: A vigilante resurrected from the dead hunts a drug empire in Jackson, clashing with a kingpin, a reporter, and a city consumed by fentanyl.

title: Lazy Susan
description: Susan is a spectacularly unmotivated woman for whom doing nothing is exhausting. When she realises that her relationships have tanked and her family is estranged, she has to stumble out of her self-absorbed shell and into the real world.

title: League of Legends: Learning to Lead
description: Worldwide game players are taking it to the next level, taking the game beyond their bedrooms.

title: League of Super Evil
description: Four supervillains won’t stop until they achieve total neighborhood domination—regardless of how many schools, playgrounds or kids they must destroy.

title: Learning to Drive
description: As her marriage dissolves, a Manhattan writer begins taking driving lessons from a Sikh instructor with relationship troubles of his own.

title: Learning to Love Again
description: After losing her job and her man, a woman’s return to her hometown is interrupted by a stranger who shows her that love is still worth believing in.

title: Learning To See
description: Journey through the vanishing Amazon rainforest in search of insect species never before recorded and experience a magnificent world unseen by most.

title: Lease on Love
description: Poppy is a marketing specialist whose life is turned upside down when she fakes an engagement with her boss's handsome new client Milo, to win over her strict building manager and get Milo the penthouse suite.

title: Leatherface
description: See how a young man is transformed into a chainsaw-wielding, skin-mask-wearing maniac in this horrifying Texas Chainsaw Massacre prequel.

title: Leatherheads
description: Oscar® winners George Clooney and Renee Zellweger star with John Krasinski (The Office) in Leatherheads, a fun-filled football comedy USA Today's Claudia Puig cheers as "a real winner!"

title: Leave It on the Floor
description: A young man becomes involved in the Los Angeles ballroom world when he meets the ragtag members of the struggling House of Eminence

title: Leave It to Beaver
description: Beaver hopes that his father will buy him a new bike if he tries out for the football team. Based on the TV series.

title: Leave It to Beaver
description: The adventures of Theodore "Beaver" Cleaver at home, school and around his suburban neighborhood with his family, Ward, June and Wally.

title: Leave of Absence
description: When a married man learns that his mistress is dying of cancer, he informs his family and decides to move in with his lover for her final months.

title: Leaves of Grass
description: An Ivy League professor returns home, where his twin brother, a small-time pot grower, entangles him in a mad scheme to take down a local drug lord.

title: Leaving Circadia
description: A group of guys living in a Brooklyn brownstone find their way through the harsh realities of life as they enter into their 30's.

title: The Mad Women's Ball
description: [French Audio, English Subtitles] Eugenie has a unique gift: she hears and sees the dead. When her family discovers her secret, at the end of the 19th century, she is taken by her father and brother to the neurological clinic at La Pitié Salpêtrière with no possibility of escaping her fate. Her destiny becomes entwined with that of Geneviève, a nurse at the hospital.

title: The Wolf's Call
description: A young man possesses the rare talent of being able to identify every sound he hears. Aboard a French nuclear submarine, everything depends on him. He is the "Golden Ear." His reputation for infallibility takes a knock after a mistake puts the lives of the whole crew in danger. His determination to win back his comrades' trust drags them into an even more dramatic situation. In the world of...

title: A Monkey's Tale
description: Two monkey tribes are divided by centuries of fear and prejudice. When curious teenager Kom plummets from his home, his family consider him lost forever. Below, however, his life is spared, and he soon becomes the King's favourite - which angers the Chancellor, who plans seize power for himself. Kom and loyal maid, Gina, uncover the plot, plan to reunite the two tribes and save the day.

title: The Confessions
description: After receiving the secret confession of a powerful economist at a G8 conference, an enigmatic monk becomes the prime suspect in his death.

title: The Last Romantic Lover
description: The editor-in-chief (Dayle Haddon) of a New York women's magazine is organizing the "Last Romantic Lover" contest to find out if men still have a sense of romance. One of the winners is a circus lion-tamer (Gérard Ismaël), whose's prize is to spend 10 days with her.

title: Two Faces of the Dollar
description: A teacher, a hero, an ex-colonel and a beautiful woman hatch a plan to rob Fort Henderson, and it’s only when they succeed that their troubles begin.

title: Led Zeppelin | Whole Lotta Rock
description: Follow iconic rock band Led Zeppelin through their journey, from formation in 1968 to becoming one of the most influential bands in history.

title: Lee'd the Way
description: An autistic man running for President of the United States joins forces with a Native American woman to find solutions to the country's problems.

title: Lee Mack: Live
description: The story of the making of The Joshua Tree is told here, via interview and archive film footage, with contributions from band members Bono, The Edge, Adam Clayton and Larry Mullen. U2's long-time manager Paul McGuiness reveals how the album catapulted the band into the category of rock superstars, and there are contributions from re-mix producer Steve Lillywhite, co-producer Brian Eno and Elvis Costello among others.

title: Racer and the Jailbird
description: When Gino meets young race car driver Bénédicte, it's love at first sight. But Gino has a secret, the kind that can endanger your life.

title: A Kid
description: When the father he never met dies, 30-something Mathieu travels to Montréal for the funeral and learns none of his family was aware of his existence.

title: Left Behind
description: A commercial pilot and a reporter are among a small group of survivors left after millions suddenly vanish and the world is plunged into chaos.

title: Left Behind
description: After the prophesied Rapture takes all believers in Christ from the Earth, a reporter left behind learns that the Antichrist will soon take power.

title: Left Behind II: Tribulation Force
description: In the wake of the Rapture, a band of converts tries to warn the world that the leader who has been embraced as a savior is really the Antichrist.

title: Left Behind: Rise of the Antichrist
description: After millions of people vanish across the world, a charming leader with a mysterious agenda rises amid the chaos to the top of the United Nations.

title: Left Behind: World at War
description: As the post-Rapture world falls into chaos, a journalist and a band of converts try to stop a dangerous world leader they believe is the Antichrist.

title: The Strange Life of Dr. Frankenstein
description: The story of Mary Shelley's seminal horror story. At 19, young Mary Shelley, wife of the English poet, Percy Bysshe Shelley, was well versed in the scientific research of the time, impressing even scientists by her masterpiece.  This documentary does Mary Shelley justice by exploring her novel and its eternal theme: man's quest for the secret of life.

title: Legacy
description: Durante un viaje de caza en el desierto aislado, un padre y su hijo adolescente adoptivo se convierten en presas de asaltantes desconocidos.

title: Legacy
description: When three gangs threaten to kill him and steal his family's cash, Rob Saviour must take action to safeguard his family and protect their legacy.

title: Legacy of Lies
description: A Ukrainian journalist pulls a grieving ex-MI6 agent back into espionage to uncover the truth behind a series of Russian covert operations.

title: Legal Action
description: A lawyer uncovers big corruption in a small town, when he defends his shady former brother-in-law, who has been accused of murdering a local DA.

title: Legally Blonde 2: Red, White & Blonde
description: Now a rising young lawyer, Elle Woods is about to make partner at her firm, but when she finds out her Bruiser's canine relatives are being used as cosmetic test subjects, Elle heads to D.C. to fight for animal rights.

title: Legally Blondes
description: Elle Woods's twin cousins deal with student politics, school uniforms, boys, and being framed for cheating at an elite California prep school.

title: Legend of a Warrior
description: In an attempt to reconnect with his a modern day superhero father, Corey Lee steps back into martial arts, something he'd left behind 25 years ago.

title: Legend of Earthsea
description: When an amulet that’s kept the peace between humans and dragons for centuries is broken, a neophyte wizard must restore balance and stop an evil king.

title: Legend of the Muse
description: The life of a painter is permanently changed when a mythical and lethal spirit from Celtic folklore becomes his muse and passionate lover.

title: Legend of the Superstition Mountains
description: In "Legend of the Superstition Mountains," Wayne Tuttle is partnering with a team of experts to follow a newly revealed clue that could finally solve the 500-year-old mystery of America's most famous and deadliest buried treasure: the Lost Dutchman gold mine.

title: Legends of Hockey: Greatness Calling 2000-2020
description: This 11-part series honors and celebrates the players inducted into the Hockey Hall of Fame in the first two decades of the 21st century.

title: Legends of Oz: Dorothy's Return
description: A continuation of one of the world's most popular and beloved fairy tales, Legends of Oz finds Dorothy waking to post-tornado Kansas, only to be whisked back to Oz to try to save her old friends the Scarecrow, the Lion, the Tin Man and Glinda from a devious new villain, the Jester. Wiser the owl, Marshal Mallow, China Princess and Tugg the tugboat join Dorothy on her latest magical journey.

title: Legends of Sleepy Hollow
description: Sleepy Hollow is the home of America's original horror story: the tale of the headless horseman. But horror doesn't just disappear. Now, filmmakers from the area have tackled the new legends of terror in this iconic area.

title: Legends of The Court
description: How some of the biggest stars from the NBA managed to transcend the sport to become icons with influence far outside the world of basketball.

title: Legionnaire
description: After refusing to fix a boxing match, a 1920s boxer attempts to avoid a brutal mob boss by joining the ranks of the Foreign Legion in Morocco.

title: Legions
description: In 1914 at the dawn of World War I, a deserter-turned-warrior and an intelligence agent sacrifice everything to secure Poland's sovereignty.

title: LEGO DREAMZzz
description: Kids join a secret agency to use their imagination in the Dream World and stop the evil Nightmare King from invading the Waking World.

title: LEGO Friends: The Next Chapter
description: School's back! The lovable students of Heartlake High face a year of fun adventures and exciting challenges that bring them closer together.

title: Lego Friends: The Next Chapter: New Beginnings
LEGO Monkie Kid: A Hero Is Born
description: After the release of the Demon Bull King, MK accidentally grabs Monkey King's magical staff and goes on a journey to return the staff to Monkey King

title: LEGO Ninjago: Dragons Rising
description: With the Ninja scattered and their powers weakened, a hidden enemy unleashes a horde of Elemental Monsters, threatening to tear their lands apart.

title: The Horla
description: After his family moves to a new home, a man questions his sanity as he's increasingly disturbed by an inexplicable presence no one else can sense.

title: Leitis in Waiting
description: The story of an intrepid group of native transgender women fighting a tide of religious fundamentalism and intolerance in their South Pacific kingdom.

title: The Young Karl Marx
description: At the age of 26, Karl Marx embarks with his wife Jenny on the road to exile. In Paris in 1844 they meet young Friedrich Engels, son of a factory owner, who’s studied the sordid beginnings of the English proletariat. Engels, somewhat of a dandy, brings Karl Marx the missing piece to the puzzle that composes his new vision of the world. Together, between censorship and police raids, riots and political upheavals, they will preside over the birth of the labor movement, which until then had been mostly makeshift and unorganized. This will grow into the most complete theoretical and political transformation of the world since the Renaissance – driven, against all expectations, by two brilliant, insolent and sharp-witted young men from good families.

title: Far from Home: Venezuelan Exodus
description: Samuel, a young Venezuelan, emigrates from his country to seek a better life without knowing the difficult situations he will face as an immigrant.

title: The Magnificent One
description: François Merlin is an espionnage-book writer. He likes to mix every-day character he can met in his book. In his book, he is Bob Saint Clar, his neighbour Christine appears as Tatiana and his editor Georges Charon as Colonel Karpoff.

title: Le Mans: Racing Is Everything
description: The 24 Hours of Le Mans is a motor race like no other. Taking place in France each year, it is an endurance test for drivers and cars that literally takes 24 hours to complete. Travelling from Kuala Lumpur to the Côte D’Azur, shot in breathtaking 4K and with unprecedented access to six of the teams competing for glory, Le Mans: Racing is Everything is motorsport as you’ve never seen it before.

title: Lemon
description: The end of a 10-year relationship sends Isaac into a downward spiral that bottoms out with his unhinged stage production of Chekhov’s “The Seagull.”

title: Lemonade Stand Romance
description: When a little girl's lemonade stand gets shut down over an outdated bylaw, Trish McTavish, an ambitious young PR rep with the nation's largest lemonade chain, is tasked to return to her hometown to fight the ban.

title: Lena: My 100 Children
description: Un relato basado en hechos de los esfuerzos de Lena Kuchler-Silberman para ayudar a decenas de huérfanos judíos a encontrar una nueva vida en Israel.

title: Lennon & McCartney: Hello From Liverpool
description: Lennon and McCartney took the world by storm when they toured the world with the monumental band The Beatles. Their song writing completely changed the music industry, changing peoples lives and evolving the sound of the 1960's.

title: Leo Da Vinci: Mission Mona Lisa
description: Set in Italy during the Renaissance, young inventor Leo Da Vinci sets out to find a sunken treasure with his friend Lorenzo and the girl he loves.

title: Leona
description: Ariela, a young artist in Mexico City from a Syrian Jewish family is pressured into finding an appropriate partner. She develops feelings for a non-Jewish man, Iván. This presents her with a dilemma as she weighs up the relationship against the disapproval of her family and community.

title: Leonardo Da Vinci: The Universal Man
description: Explore the story of Leonardo da Vinci in this bio doc. 500 years after his passing, da Vinci's life is explored by historians.

title: Leonie
description: Witness the life story of Leonie Gilmour, editor to renowned Japanese poet Yone Noguchi, and fiercely independent mother to artist Isamu Noguchi.

title: Leon's Fantasy Cut
description: Sharing the same cramped Brooklyn studio they grew up in, two bickering first-generation Ukrainian-American brothers reconcile dreams with reality.

title: Leo the Truck
description: Leo is a dump truck who is very curious and inquisitive. He loves to build things & see how they work. Enjoy these educational garbage truck videos for kids.

title: Brotherhood of the Wolf
description: In 18th-century France, the Chevalier de Fronsac and his friend Mani are sent to investigate the killings of hundreds by a mysterious beast.

title: Bullets Don't Argue
description: Rivertown Sheriff Pat Garrett must abandon his young wife in the same church where they just got married in order to catch a couple of dangerous bank robbers.

title: Leprechaun: The Beginning
description: After discovering a box of gold, a family's dream come true turns into a nightmare as they're stalked by a mischievous and deadly leprechaun.

title: The Jungle Bunch
description: The Jungle Bunch follows a gang of misfit animals on a mission to protect their jungle home. In their big screen adventure, the Jungle Bunch fight to protect the jungle from a gang of silly baboons lead by Igor the evil Koala.

title: The Adventures of Bernie
description: After a failed attempt to help Zig eat Marina, Bernie finds himself lost at the ocean's bottom in a hostile environment with wacky neighbors.

title: The Extraordinary Adventures of Adèle Blanc-Sec
description: A popular novelist in 1912 must deal with a prehistoric monster roaming the streets of Paris. Will she be the one to discover its secret?

title: Lesbian Space Princess
description: Living a sheltered existence inside her royal orbit, a young space princess is suddenly propelled into the wider cosmos when her bounty‑hunter ex‑girlfriend is captured by the authoritarian Straight White Maliens.

title: Stalin and the Katyn Massacre
description: Exposes the truth behind the 1940 executions of 22,000 Polish prisoners of war, and the Soviet NKVD's role in a crime long attributed to the Nazis.

title: Red Rooms
description: The allure of the serial killer is explored in this deeply unsettling and unforgettable exploration of the impact of extreme violence.

title: History Uncovered
description: Myths die hard, and the history of the 20th century is no exception. This series examines the major events of the 20th century through a new lens.

title: Other People's Children
description: In a touching and graceful tale of modern motherhood and romance, Virginie Efira plays a woman of boundless compassion—and is as radiant as ever. Embracing love in various heart-stealing guises, Rebecca Zlotowski’s fifth feature also has a delightful cameo from adoptive Parisian, Frederick Wiseman!

title: Female Agents
description: May 1944. After the assassination of her husband, Louise flies to London. Being engaged in the French Resistance, she was immediately recruited by the secret intelligence and was entrusted with her first mission: the exfiltration of a British agent who was preparing the landing on the Normandy beaches. Louise decides to form a commando of women specially recruited for the needs of the mission.

title: The Guardians
description: Emotions run high for the women at Paridier farm when the sons return from war and a mysterious stranger becomes the center of a family disturbance.

title: The Infallibles
description: When a gang of robbers provokes chaos in Paris and humiliates the police, the Minister of the Interior wants new blood at the helm of the investigation: Alia is from Marseille, fiery-tempered and unmanageable, Hugo is Parisian, valedictorian and meticulous. In short, they have every reason to hate each other. A forced alliance, for better or for worse, or maybe blossoming into something else?

title: The Innocents
description: Warsaw, December 1945. While a doctor is treating French survivors of German camps, what she finds is shocking: a holy sister about to give birth.

title: The World Petanque Tour
description: The announcement of an international petanque tournament reawakens Momo's dreams of becoming a champion that life's ups and downs had long ago buried.

title: Nazi Death Marches
description: In the final months of World War II, the Nazis forced concentration camp prisoners on a deadly march that claimed hundreds of thousands of lives.

title: Rabid Grannies
description: Two little old ladies with a big inheritance and a greedy family fall victim to an ancient curse that transforms them into cannibalistic killers.

title: Les Misérables
description: In this adaptation of Victor Hugo’s classic tale, a woodcutter is sentenced to jail for stealing a loaf of bread he took to feed his starving family.

title: Blood Money: Inside the Nazi Economy
description: How did the Nazis set off the turmoil of WWII with a weak economy? Historians take an economic, industrial, and financial approach to the Third Reich.

title: The Red Shadows
description: Set in the spectacular French Riviera, this suspenseful crime drama follows a female detective whose life is upended when a case leads her to suspect her long-lost sister may be alive and well.

title: Perfumes
description: A master perfumer hoping to revive her stagnant career meets her match in a divorced chauffeur who is desperate to maintain custody of his daughter.

title: Crimson Rivers II: Angels of the Apocalypse
description: Chief Niemans and his officer Reda face the threat of an apocalypse while investigating a series of ritual murders connected to a mysterious group.

title: Less
description: Could the fastest route to enlightenment be straight into the gutter? In Less we see the world through the eyes of an atypical homeless man, in an unusual pursuit of freedom.

title: Seasons
description: This documentary showcases the wonders of the natural world through the eyes of the incredible creatures that inhabit a vast green forest.

title: The Smurfs
description: Little blue people embark on rousing adventures as they battle the scheming Gargamel.

title: The Witches of Hollywood
description: A study of the witch archetype in Hollywood cinema from the 1930s to modern day with an emphasis on the “danger” a woman having such power presents.

title: Less Than Kind
description: A 15-year-old outcast tries to blend in with his peers, but his self-destructive driving instructor father and pyromaniac mother aren’t much help.

title: The Hottest Summer
description: Each year Lucia volunteers at a Summer Camp in Sicily. This summer however, will be the hottest on record, not just because of the crazy weather, but also because of Nicola, the new soon-to-be-priest deacon who, besides being extremely handsome, hides a tormented and idealistic soul. His arrival sows panic in this seaside community, upsetting Lucia's plans forever.

title: The Three Musketeers: D'Artagnan
description: After learning that the future of France is at stake, D'Artagnan aligns himself with Athos, Porthos, and Aramis, three musketeers of the King.

title: The Three Musketeers: Milady
description: D'Artagnan and the three musketeers find themselves forced to join forces with Milady to save Constance, while a new war marches on.

title: Christmas with the Tuches
description: After resigning from his position as President of France, Jeff is happy to return to the village of Bouzolles with his family. Things are going well until Jeff and his brother-in-law clash once again, this time about Christmas. This family row, which should never have gone beyond Bouzolles, ends up in a mighty power struggle between Jeff and a global online retailer.

title: Savage State
description: Tras el estallido de una guerra civil, una familia de colonos franceses intenta abandonar su hogar en Missouri y regresar a París.

title: The Time of Secrets
description: Marcel Pagnol spends his last summer before high school in the hills of Provence, where childhood adventures turn to first love and hidden truths.

title: The Test
description: Annie is surprised to find a positive pregnancy test in the bathroom. Does it belong to her teenage daughter, her son’s girlfriend, or someone else?

title: Let Go and Let God
description: When two people from vastly different worlds experience family tragedy, their resulting spiritual crises lead them both on an unexpected path.

title: Lethal Seduction
description: Mark is preparing for college when he meets Carissa, a beautiful older woman who pulls him into her luxurious world. His mother, Tanya, has noticed changes in him. In confronting Carissa with concerns, Tanya is met with threats. Carissa's claws are in deep, and she refuses to let go.

title: Lethal Weapon
description: LETHAL WEAPON, a TV reboot of the classic film franchise of the same name, features two mismatched police detectives working together to solve crimes in and around Los Angeles. Damon Wayans plays Roger Murtaugh, an uptight Los Angeles detective, husband, and father who has just returned to work after suffering a major heart attack. He is partnered with Martin Riggs (Clayne Crawford), a former Navy Seal struggling with a major personal loss and who is willing to break the rules and take personal risks to get the bad guys. Working together has its challenges, as Captain Brooks Avery (Kevin Rahm) will attest to, but somehow they find a way to make it work.

title: Let It Snow
description: Alone, stranded in sub-zero temperatures and hunted by a crazed killer. Mia and her fiancé are headed to Black Ridge, a challenging mountain range that has claimed the lives of many. When Mia is separated from her fiancé she finds herself face to face with a relentless killer. With time running out will nature be the final nail in the coffin or will this masked killer have his pound of flesh?

title: Let Love Grow
description: Romance blooms between a landscape architect and her new client, an inflexible archaeologist whose daughters are eager to help their dad find love.

title: Let Me Be Frank
description: After an aspiring rapper moves to L.A. in search of opportunity, he finds himself spending most of his time with his world-weary apartment manager.

title: Let's Dream
description: Let, a reclusive, insomniac photographer, is hired to photograph a mysterious client in the forest late one night, and soon finds himself pulled into a bizarre, otherworldly quest.

title: Let's Get Married
description: Gowtham and Meera, an intertwined couple who share both a workplace and a romantic bond that has flourished for a span exceeding two years, stand at the precipice of a transformative moment.

title: Let's Kill Grandpa
description: Strapped for cash and out of options, a man and his brother-in-law scheme to bump off the filthy rich patriarch on their wives' side of the family.

title: Let's Kill Ward's Wife
description: A colorful group of friends detests their pal’s dreadful wife and dream of her demise, until a fortuitous accident presents a new set of problems.

title: Let's Make a Deal
description: Costumed contestants compete for cash and prizes.

title: Let's Not Meet
description: A pizza delivery driver on her last stop of the night is lured into a trap where she finds a group of campers enduring a nightmare of their own.

title: Let's Ruin It with Babies
description: A young woman is satisfied with her lifestyle the way it is, but her husband wants a baby — and she’s not so sure she ever will.

title: Let's Spend the Night Together
description: Director Hal Ashby (Shampoo) and his film crew follow The Rolling Stones on their record-breaking 1981 arena tour. This rockumentary features 25 of the biggest songs from the Rolling Stones' first 20 years together.

title: Let's Start a Cult
description: After missing out on a long-awaited mass suicide, a cult member teams with his former leader to rebuild their group, gathering a gang of outcasts determined to fulfill their destiny.

title: Letters From the Heart
description: When Hope travels to a small town for her grandmother’s funeral, she learns that she’s inherited two million dollars, under one condition.

title: Letters to Juliet
description: Finding a poignant love letter in a wall dedicated to Shakespeare's Juliet Capulet, a young woman (Amanda Seyfried) sets out to help its aged author find her long-lost beau.

title: Let There Be Drums!
description: The world's greatest drummers reflect on the art of drumming and how it has shaped their lives.  Features interviews with Ringo Starr from The Beatles, Taylor Hawkins from Foo Fighters, Stewart Copeland from The Police, Mickey Hart from the Grateful Dead, Chad Smith from the Red Hot Chili Peppers, and more.

title: Let There Be Light
description: A group of scientists are approaching the final steps of a machine decades in the making: an artificial star that could provide millions of years of clean energy. Are scientists about to crack nuclear fusion, or chasing a delusion?

title: Let the Wrong One In
description: Matt may be a sucker, but when his brother becomes part of a growing vampire problem in Dublin, he’s faced with the dilemma of saving or slaying him.

title: Let Us Prey
description: A man brought to a police station possesses everyone's darkest secrets.

title: Level 16
description: At a prison-like boarding school, two old friends turned foes are reunited and embark on a quest to unearth the horrifying truths of their captivity.

title: Leverage
description: A crew of high-tech crooks attempt to steal from wealthy criminals and corrupt businessmen.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description: The Hitter, the Hacker, the Grifter and the Thief are together again, this time with help from a new tech genius and corporate fixer, to take on a new kind of villain. From the man who created an opioid crisis from the comfort of his boardroom to the shadowy security firm that helps hide dangerous secrets for a price - when someone needs help, they provide… Leverage.

title: Leviathan
description: An underwater exploration team is trapped five miles beneath the ocean's surface with a creature that cannot die and exists only to kill.

title: Fanny's Journey
description: Set in 1943, this is the tale of a 13-year-old girl who must lead a group of children as they escape from Nazi-occupied Italy to the Swiss border.

title: The Prince’s Voyage
description: An old prince runs aground on an unknown shore. Wounded and lost, he is found by young Tom and taken in by his parents, two researchers forced into exile... The prince, guided by Tom, discovers with enthusiasm and fascination a society that is however frozen and sclerotic .

title: Lewandowski - Unknown
description: "Lewandowski - Unknown" is the first documentary film about Robert Lewandowski. Providing an unprecedented insight into his life on and off the pitch, this is the story of how a young player from Poland became one of the best footballers of all time. Robert's family, and close friends, including world-class footballers and coaches explain how he continues to define the game today.

title: Le Week-End
description: A long-married couple hope to spark their romance by revisiting Paris for a second honeymoon, where they discover the highs and lows of their love.

title: Lewis Black: Black to the Future
description: More a pissed-off optimist than a mean-spirited curmudgeon, Lewis Black performs live in New York with a post-show Q&A that brings on an epic rant.

title: Lewis Black: Thanks For Risking Your Life
description: Filmed in the midst of his tour and on the last night before America’s national lockdown due to COVID-19, Lewis Black delivers a searing comedy set.

title: Cop Secret
description: Iceland's toughest cop will stop at nothing to solve a string of violent bank robberies. But pressures mount when he's forced to take a new partner.

title: The Story of Adèle H.
description: Young Frenchwoman Adèle, daughter of Victor Hugo, travels to Halifax in search of an English soldier with whom she has become hopelessly obsessed.

title: The Man in the Basement
description: Simon and Helen live in Paris together, they decide to sell a basement in their building. The man who buys it has a troubled past and the couple's life is turning upside down.

title: Liam Gallagher: As It Was
description: The honest and emotional story of how one of the most electrifying rock’n'roll frontmen went from the dizzying heights of his years in Oasis to living on the edge, lost in the musical wilderness of booze, notoriety and bitter legal battles.

title: Liar's Moon
description: High school sweethearts from different sides of the tracks elope to Louisiana, where 17-year-olds can marry, and suddenly face grown-up crises.

title: Liar: The Fake Grooming Scandal
description: Twenty-two-year-old Ellie Williams was jailed for lying about being trafficked and raped by a vicious Asian grooming gang. Now, for the first time, the truth is laid open.

title: Liberty
description: A young park guide holds six people captive, treating them as caged animals, to deliver his chilling message of freedom.

title: Liberty's Kids
description: Two teenage reporters cover the events of the Revolutionary War for Ben Franklin's newspaper, The Philadelphia Gazette. Ben's teenage reporters confront the real, physical dangers of the conflict, forced to choose between their friendship and their countries, their understanding of good and evil, and the moral dilemmas of war.

title: Licorice Pizza
description: "Licorice Pizza" is the story of Alana Kane and Gary Valentine growing up, running around and falling in love in the San Fernando Valley, 1973. Written and Directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, the film tracks the treacherous navigation of first love.

title: Lidia's Kitchen
description: Join chef Lidia Bastianich as she conjures simple, seasonal, and economical dishes, and helps viewers cultivate a sense of home in the kitchen.

title: Lidsville
description: After sneaking backstage at a magic show, Mark accidentally falls into a top hat and finds himself in a new dimension filled with talking hats.

title: Lie Hard
description: To impress his girlfriend's parents, a man buys a mansion with $4 million that he borrowed from a crime syndicate, who expects to get it all back.

title: Lie Low
description: After witnessing a stabbing, a frightened young man escapes to the French countryside, but he must confront his demons before they take over.

title: Lies Before Kisses
description: When a wealthy publisher is accused of murder, his wife battles blackmail to clear his name, complicated by their son's damning testimony.

title: Lies Between Friends
description: 14 years after graduating, college friends reunite for a bridal shower, but the celebration takes a turn when an unexpected death opens old wounds.

title: Lies & Illusions
description: When his fiance is abducted, a popular self-help author is hunted by international killers and spies, who believe he possesses a fortune in diamonds.

title: Lies My Babysitter Told
description: La contratación de un niñero para su pequeña hija, revela secretos oscuros en el matrimonio de Carnie y Nick. Carnie ha vivido con la sospecha de que su marido la engaña, y la llegada de Matt a su casa, confirma lo que temía.

title: Lies We Tell
description: A chauffeur to a billionaire has a final job when his boss dies: clear all evidence of his affair with a woman hiding a dark and violent past.

title: Lies We Tell
description: A newly orphaned heiress battles her scheming uncle to save her inheritance—and life—during a tense, Gothic manor showdown in 19th-century Ireland.

title: Life
description: After serving time (12 years!) for a crime he didn't commit, Det Charlie Crews returns to his job at the LAPD but gets a cool reception from his new partner, Det Dani Reese, and their tough boss. Constance is the attorney who finally managed to get Charlie sprung from prison after DNA evidence exonerated him of the murders of which he was accused. Charlie's former cell mate, Ted Earley (formerly the CEO of a powerful company), is now Charlie's housemate and financial adviser. Charlie's post-prison police work incorporates some quirks he acquired while serving time - a Zen philosophy and a fixation with fresh fruit.

title: Life
description: Inspired by a true story, LIFE charts the friendship that developed between Magnum photographer Dennis Stock and actor James Dean when Stock was commissioned to photograph the actor for Life magazine in 1955.

title: Life 101: Angel's Secret
description: After spending a night with her boyfriend, a naive teenager learns that the consequences of her actions are more dangerous than she realized.

title: Life After Fighting
description: A martial arts instructor is confronted with the disappearance of two of his students, leading him to uncover an international child-trafficking ring.

title: Life After Life
description: When Ursula Todd dies and is reborn one night in 1910, she embarks upon a cyclical journey of birth, death, and rebirth.

title: Life After People: The Series
description: What would happen if every human being on Earth disappeared? This is the story of what happens to the world we leave behind. Examine how the landscape of planet Earth would change in our absence in Life After People - The Series, a stunningly graphic journey to a world wiped clean of humanity.

title: Life and Dirt
description: A man’s desire to make it quick leads him to a race against time to preserve his life while hiding his dirt.

title: Life, Animated
description: The inspirational story of a young man, unable to speak as a child, who learned to communicate through the world of classic Disney animated films.

title: Lifeboat
description: In this tense Alfred Hitchcock thriller, based on a John Steinbeck novella, American and British civilians who have survived the sinking of their ship by a German submarine struggle to reach land in a crowded lifeboat. When a German officer is rescued from the water, the group allows him to board, but his presence only increases the tensions on the boat. Soon treachery ensues, and the population of the vessel gradually decreases as conflicts come to a head.

title: Lifechanger
description: Taking the form of his victims, a shapeshifting serial killer must reevaluate his bloodthirsty habit when he becomes obsessed with a young woman.

title: Lifeforms
description: After traveling 17 years into the future to the far side of Saturn, an unexplained anomaly leaves an astronaut trapped in time on a new planet.

title: Life in a Day 2020
description: A family is murdered by an unseen assailant shortly after moving into their newly purchased house. Some months after the tragic event, a group of teens decide to break into the now vacant house to investigate. Will these unsuspecting friends become the next victim of the "Unlisted Owner"?

title: Life in a Walk
description: Yogi Roth never wanted to say,"I wish I'd spent more time with my dad." So he invited his father on a journey along the Camino De Santiago that would change both of their lives forever.

title: Life in Color
description: Two depressed loners stuck house sitting together have 3 weeks to turn their lives around.

title: Life Inside Jail: Hell On Earth
description: Life Inside Lockdown reveals the reality of life in the American prison system. In America, before you are convicted of any crime, you are sent to one of the nation's 3,000 county jails. Conditions are seriously tough, innocent people mix with petty thieves, serial killers and violent gang members while they wait for their cases to go to court.

title: Life Inside Out
description: When a mother returns to her musical roots, she rediscovers the passion of her youth, and finds a way to connect with her troubled youngest son.

title: Life in the Doghouse
description: The inspiring story of two men who have dedicated their lives and home to rescuing dogs and fostering them until they find an adoptive family.

title: Life Is Not a Fairytale: The Fantasia Barrino Story
description: A single mother’s American Idol audition helps her rise above a history of poverty, sexual abuse, and illiteracy to achieve national prominence.

title: Life Itself
description: As a young New York City couple goes from college romance to marriage and the birth of their first child, the unexpected twists of their journey create reverberations that echo over continents and through lifetimes.

title: Life Like
description: A young couple acquires a life-like android to help around the house, but as they all grow closer, the line between human and robot begins to blur.

title: Life Love Dogs
description: The intense, emotional bonds between dogs and their owners comes through as three riveting stories highlight the love of man’s best canine friends.

title: Life of a King
description: A former felon looking for redemption tries to steer inner-city kids away from crime by forming an unconventional chess club in Washington, DC.

title: Life of Crime
description: A pampered housewife is kidnapped by a pair of blundering ex-cons in an effort to extort money from her sleazy real-estate tycoon husband.

title: Life Off Grid
description: A two-year journey meeting Canadians in every territory who’ve made the choice to build their lives around renewable energy with surprising results.

title: Life of Significant Soil
description: An unhappy young couple discovers the depths of their animosity when they are forced to relive the last day of their relationship over and over again.

title: Life on the Line
description: With a huge storm barreling down on their hometown, a team of brave linemen risk it all to make sure essential services stay online.

title: Life on the Rocks
description: FIVE DIRECTORS tell FIVE STORIES Meet their "characters" at a local bar - where they find love, misfortune and redemption.

title: Life Partners
description: Two co-dependent best friends use their bond to keep out of the dating world. When one of the pair starts seriously dating, their friendship shifts.

title: Lifepod
description: Based on Hitchcock’s "Lifeboat,” a group of survivors adrift in space discover a deadly saboteur in their midst, and all their lives are in danger.

title: Life's a Beach
description: Darren Fields (Darren Geare) gets stood up on the day of his wedding and uses his vacation tickets with his best friend, R.J. (R.J. Knoll), to spend his "honeymoon" at a Club Med-style resort.

title: Life’s a Bit
description: A stand up comedian and mother of two shares her parenting fumbles and gives her hilarious takes on the difficulties of being a mom.

title: Life's an Itch
description: Just as Roger is starting to stare down a midlife crisis, his wife takes the kids on vacation and leaves him at home with her sexy yoga teacher.

title: Life to Afterlife: Death and Back
description: In this episode of Life to Afterlife, Craig McMahon sits down with four people who have had near-death experiences.

title: Life with Derek
description: Life with Derek is a half‐hour comedy series about a modern blended family, which has forced together two wilful teenagers, Casey (Ashley Leggat) and Derek (Michael Seater), each used to being in charge and each determined to keep it that way.

title: Life with Elizabeth
description: A young newlywed couple plays out the day-to-day highs and lows of both marital bliss and bickering in a series of short, unrelated vignettes.

title: Life with Father
description: In 1880s New York, a curmudgeonly stockbroker demands the strictest order in his household. But his wife and four sons have demands of their own.

title: Life Without Hope
description: All Hope has ever wanted was to be a lawyer, until she met Life, a handsome criminal on the run. Their passionate affair changes her.

title: Light
description: Survivors of an interstellar transport ship crash band together to fight the monstrous hosts on the inhospitable planet they now find themselves on.

title: Light in the Dark
description: A terrifying home invasion shatters a married couple's happy family life and brings their marriage to the edge as a painful fallout unfolds.

title: Light in the Water
description: West Hollywood Aquatics was the first openly gay masters team. This doc chronicles the Gay Olympics in ‘82, through the AIDS epidemic, and beyond.

title: Lightning: Bolts of Destruction
description: When waves of violent lightning strikes ravage the world, a meteorologist devises a bold plan to save the planet from a cataclysmic superstorm.

title: Lightning: Fire from the Sky
description: An amateur teenage weather tracker is all that stands between his town of Rutland, Missouri and a catastrophic collision of two violent storms.

title: Lights, Camera, Romance
description: Actress Emma Hutton is determined to help find her friend Hope a perfect match but, in doing so, she accidentally tramples on several hearts.

title: Lights Out
description: A drifting ex-soldier turns underground fighter with the help of a just released ex-con, pitting them both against corrupt cops and hired killers.

title: Like a Country Song
description: A country singer who ruins his budding career with hard-partying works to rebuild it while winning back an old flame and getting to know his father.

title: Like a Dragon: Yakuza
description: Based on the best-selling global video game franchise by SEGA, the story unfolds across two intersecting timelines—1995 and 2005. In 1995, four friends eager to escape their restrictive lives in an orphanage dive into the yakuza-controlled underworld of Kamurocho. Meanwhile, in 2005, their friendship is deteriorated, as tensions between the Tojo Clan and the Omi Alliance are at a boiling point.

title: Like Dogs
description:
Abducted and treated like animals, two university students become unwilling participants in a
behavioral experiment that produces deadly results.

title: Like Father Like Son
description: A young man whose father is a murderer on death row discovers similar terrifying triggers in himself and goes to extreme lengths to end his family's brutal cycle of violence.

title: Like Love
description: After a series of (un)fortunate circumstances prompts a two twenty-somethings to become roommates, a friendship is born. Yet their closeness inevitably sends the boy down the rabbit hole of attraction, pushing the girl to make a choice: force herself to fall in love, or risk losing her best friend. This story is a love letter to anyone who found the strength to say "I don't."

title: Likemeback
description: Three young women embark on a summer boat trip along the Mediterranean coast, but a social media scandal soon tests their friendship.

title: Like Minds
description: A forensic psychologist is tasked with determining whether or not a student at a boy’s school should face murder charges for killing his schoolmate.

title: Like Sunday, Like Rain
description: Amidst breaking up with her slacker boyfriend and losing her job, a woman is hired to be the nanny for a 12-year old cello prodigy.

title: Like You Mean It
description: A man’s decision to fall in love again with his boyfriend forces him to take a look at his own actions and feelings in a courageously honest way.

title: Li'l Abner
description: The first live-action adaption of the beloved American comic strip follows the residents of smalltown Dogpatch as they live and fall in love.

title: Lila & Eve
description: Dos madres, cuyos hijos fueron asesinados a tiros en un tiroteo, se unen para vengar sus muertes después de que las autoridades no toman medidas.

title: Lilies Not for Me
description: A gay novelist and his nurse bond over dates meant to cure him, as he recounts a past love shattered by a desperate attempt to become heterosexual.

title: Lilith
description: Lilith could have been the first woman of humanity but, instead, she was expelled from heaven and doomed forever for opposing the patriarchal system of the kingdom of heaven. Now she is back - with her servants and her thirst for vengeance to destroy the order created by God and the Devil.

title: Laban the Little Ghost
description: Laban lives in the Morningsun Castle with his family, Mother and Father Ghost and his younger sister Labolina. Laban wants to sound scary just as his father, but no matter how hard he tries, he sounds cute.

title: Lillie
description: Follows the life of British blueblood Lillie Langtry who defied societal convention to become an internationally renowned stage actress.

title: Lillith
description: After catching her long-term boyfriend cheating, Jenna turns toward elements she doesn't fully understand to get revenge. Her vengeance comes in the form of a succubus named Lillith, who embarks on a bloodthirsty, sex-fueled rampage.

title: Lilly's Light: The Movie
description: With the help of their enchanted lighthouse beacon, Lilly and her crew escort a newly orphaned boy on a fun-filled magical journey.

title: Lil Rel Howery: RELevent
description: In Lil Rel Howery's first hour-long special, he talks about everything from his upbringing to raising his own children to getting roasted by teenagers on public transportation, all with his signature high-energy delivery. A natural performer, Lil Rel proves that he can hold his own when it comes to all the relevant issues.

title: Lil Wayne: Non-Compliant
description: This music documentary looks at the life and career of Lil Wayne, universally celebrated as one of the most prolific hip-hop artists.

title: Lily Is Here
description: After a stint in prison, a recovering heroin addict struggles to piece his life back together and earn back the trust of his estranged family.

title: Lima: Breaking the Silence
description: La historia de los rebeldes peruanos que secuestraron a 400 diplomáticos del gobierno en un intento de liberar a los prisioneros políticos.

title: Limbo
description: Jaded detective Travis Hurley reopens a 20-year-old outback murder case, exposing an Aboriginal family's enduring pain and systemic injustice.

title: Limelight
description: The king of the New York City club scene for years sees his empire crumble when DEA agents, ecstasy investigations, murder, and club culture collide.

title: Limerence
description: A free-spirited painter moves to Venice, California and falls for a charismatic gallery director, but their rapidly growing bond puts her to the test.

title: Limited Partnership
description: Richard and Tony are the first legally married same-sex couple. This is the story of their 40-year fight for equality and the movement it launched.

title: 22 Bullets
description: Having been left for dead with 22 bullets in his body after being shot by a former childhood friend, a retired mobster sets out to get his revenge.

title: Mr. Superinvisible
description: He's just about the nicest man you never saw! A scientist who lives alone with his shaggy dog, becomes invisible after he swallows a potion with supernatural properties. Starring Dean Jones (The Love Bug, The Ugly Dachshund).

title: The Final Inquiry
description: In 35 AD, the Roman emperor sends a warrior to visit Jerusalem to investigate the death and disprove the rumored resurrection of Jesus of Nazareth.

title: Lincoln and Lee at Antietam: The Cost of Freedom
description: Historical documentary on the Battle of Antietam in 1862, the bloodiest day of the Civil War, that claimed nearly 4,000 lives and wounded over 17,000.

title: Linda and the Mockingbirds
description: Linda Ronstadt, Jackson Browne, and a group of younger musicians take a road trip to Banámichi, Mexico to experience local musical traditions.

title: Linda Ronstadt: The Sound of My Voice
description: A musical biography of one of the most successful female singers - and one of the most successful recording artists - of all time. Featuring Dolly Parton, Bonnie Raitt, Jackson Browne, and more.

title: Line of Duty
description: Set in the fictional police anti-corruption unit AC-12, Line of Duty is a cat-and-mouse thriller that takes a probing look into modern policing and corruption.

title: Linlang
description: Victor “Bangis” Lualhati has always been a fighter. As a former boxer, he gets used to overcoming obstacles through tough times. However, when he finds a suspicious message on his wife's phone, he will be faced with a challenge he never saw coming. As Victor investigates, he discovers there is more at play than just a cheating spouse. The deeper he digs, the more shocking realizations he makes.

title: 15 Minutes of War
description: Inspired by the 1976 Somalian rebel hijacking of a school bus of 21 French children and their American teacher and the rescue operation that followed.

title: The Intruder
description: A doctor saves a girl from suicide and marries her out of pity. Soon the evil man who had pushed her to the limit taking advantage of her re-enters her life. The ensuing crisis will help the newlyweds overcome their differences and start a fresh, better new life.

title: Lionheart
description: After his brother's murder, a tough soldier goes AWOL and enters the underground world of bare-knuckle fighting to support his widowed sister-in-law.

title: Lion Killer
description: A jiu-jitsu instructor struggles after the death of his mentor, then meets a domestic abuse survivor. Both face their demons and learn to love again.

title: Lisa Lampanelli: Back to the Drawing Board
description: The brash comedian talks candidly about her personal experiences, including body image and divorce. She includes more of her famous insult rants.

title: Lise Meitner: The Mother of the Atom Bomb
description: This documentary film is the story of the endowed physicist, Lise Meitner, who deserves placement on a par with Einstein, Heisenberg, and Otto Hahn.

title: Little Alien
description: They're alive because they fled. But in the lands that offer shelter from war and persecution these young asylum seekers face an existence spent in life's waiting rooms. This intimate portrait follows them as they try to negotiate a complex and contradictory legal system and carve out a life in the no-man's-land they inhabit.

title: Little Big Awesome
description: Little Big Awesome follows Gluko and Lennon, the two best friends ever of all time in the history of everything. While having weird and wonderful adventures around Townopolis, these besties help the citizens live their best lives, even if helping sometimes causes more problems than it solves.

title: Little Bi Peep
description: Directionless, Emma is going nowhere. The men and women she has been sleeping with think she's a waitress, an artist, or a teacher. In reality, she works in a porn shop, dressing up as sexy characters. One night, Emma meets Mason, a transgender IT guy who seems to have it all. Soon, Emma finds her web of lies unraveling when she encounters something new: sincere feelings for another person.

title: Little Bitches
description: A group of friends vow to open their college acceptance letters together during the big end-of-year party that a local cop is desperate to bust.

title: Little Boy
description: An imaginative young boy in 1940s California becomes determined to do good works so that God will bring his father home safely from World War II.

title: Little Charmers
description: In Charmville, Hazel and friends hone their magic. Hazel leads adventures, often misusing powers, but Posie and Lavender are always there to help.

title: Little Cooper
description: Foster kids Kat and Zee team up and run away from home with their beloved pony on an epic journey to save a very special horse from slaughter.

title: Little Dead Rotting Hood
description: After her grandmother dies, a young woman is tasked with protecting her small town from vicious wolves and an unspeakable evil lurking in the forest.

title: Little Dieter Needs to Fly
description: Werner Herzog directs this award-winning documentary about German-American Dieter Dengler, which inspired his later film Rescue Dawn. Here the American naval pilot shares his experience escaping from a POW camp in the Vietnam War.

title: Little Dixie
description: Frank Grillo and Eric Dane star in this action-packed revenge thriller. When a deal goes wrong, an ex-Special Forces Operative will do whatever it takes to protect the one good thing in his life - his young daughter, "Little Dixie".

title: Little Dorrit
description: A young seamstress caring for her father in a debtors’ prison falls in love with her employer’s son in this gripping adaptation of Dickens’s novel.

title: Little Foot
description: Join a tiny Bigfoot and his animal pals as they try to stop a wanna-be ringmaster, and encounter an array of amazing characters along the way.

title: Little Ghost
description: El fantasma de una joven une fuerzas con un niño para asustar a un desarrollador codicioso que planea renovar el castillo del fantasma.

title: Little Heroes
description: A typical summer for five young friends becomes the adventure of a lifetime when they notice that something is amiss at their favorite swimming spot.

title: Little House: Bless All the Dear Children
description: During a Christmastime visit to Mankato, Almanzo and Laura Ingalls Wilder find themselves in a frantic search when their young daughter Rose is kidnapped. With Mr. Edwards' help, can they make their family whole again before the holy day?

title: Little House on the Prairie
description: Charles and Caroline Ingalls, together with their daughters Mary, Carrie and Laura, the narrator, struggle to survive in 1870s Minnesota.

title: Little House: The Last Farewell
description: Charles and Caroline Ingalls return to Walnut Grove and lead the opposition to a land-grabber looking to develop territory in Hero Township.

title: Little Italy
description: Two childhood friends, whose families are both pizzeria owners, become young sweethearts and must protect their romance from petty family rivalries.

title: Little Jar
description: In isolation and with no one to talk to, Ainsley finds a dead mouse in a jar and, with a pinch of imagination, learns a lesson about friendship.

title: Little Loopers
description: When a misbehaving golf pro is forced to perform community service, he gets a second chance to get on course, instructing a motley group of teens.

title: Little Lord Fauntleroy
description: Frances Hodgson Burnett has delighted children and adults around the world with this much-loved fable of the little boy who wins the love and respect of all who meet him. Set in the 1880's it is a story for all times and all ages.

title: Little Lunch
description: Little Lunch is a mockumentary comedy series that takes place during fifteen highly significant minutes of a child's life - snack time in the primary school playground.

title: Little Man Tate
description: The director of a school for exceptional children takes the 7-year-old multi-gifted child of a single, working-class mother under her wing.

title: Little Men
