description: Set in rural Massachusetts, the series chronicles the heroic struggles of Jo Bhaer (the Jo March character of Little Women) as she attempts to manage Plumfield, a boarding school for boys, after the tragic death of her husband Fritz.

title: Little Murder
description: In post-Katrina New Orleans, a disgraced detective gets a second chance when the ghost of a murdered woman wants to help him identify her killer.

title: Little Pink House
description: A small-town nurse emerges as the reluctant leader in a battle that goes to the Supreme Court to save her neighborhood from pharma giant Pfizer.

title: Little Savages
description: Visiting the charming lake town of Culver, a boy genius and his sister race against bullies to find a treasure hidden by an eccentric philanthropist.

title: Little Secrets
description: Emily Lindstrom, a gifted 14-year-old violinist, skips summer camp in order to prepare for an audition with the prestigious San Francisco Youth Orchestra. Emily has also set up a side business as a "secret keeper", charging a 50-cent fee to share and keep the neighborhood children's secrets. She soon discovers, however, that there is a price to keeping secrets that can't be measured in coins.

title: Little Stones
description: Four inspiring women use rap, graffiti, dance and fashion to fight for women's rights around the world in this testament to the power of art.

title: Littlest Pet Shop
description: Her new home above a day camp for pets bewilders Blythe at first, but a fun-filled adventure begins when she discovers she can talk to animals!

title: Little White Lie
description: Lacey Schwartz grew up convinced she was white. She has copper skin, black curls, and full lips - features which distinguish her instantly from her Jewish parents. But it wasn't until she was 18 that she learned the truth: her real father was black. Eight years in the making and put together by Lacey herself, Little White Lie tells the compelling story of an uncomfortable, unacknowledged truth.

title: Little White Lies
description: After the sudden death of her beloved husband, a distraught widow learns that he was having an affair with a neighbour.

title: Little Women: Dallas
description: A group of friends living in the Lone Star State proves that, when it comes to drama, ambition, and attitude, everything is bigger in Texas!

title: Live at the Foxes Den
description: Bobby Kelly, a promising young lawyer at a corporate law firm, is fed up with the path his career has taken, practicing the very type of law he has always resented. After singing on a whim at an old cocktail lounge one night, he suddenly quits his job, seemingly throwing his life away, and becomes the singer at The Foxes Den. There, Bobby meets a unique group of people, all of whom help him discover what it is he’s truly meant to do with his life.

title: Live Italian
description: Jack Whitehall, Maya Jama and Lawrence Dallaglio take time out of their hectic lives to discover what it means to slow down, Live Italian and enjoy life's simple pleasures.  Together with local Italian experts Lodovica Comello, Chiara Maci and Martin Castrogiovanni, each celebrity embarks on a personal journey to reconnect with their passions of food, music and sport... Italian style!

title: Live PD Presents: PD Cam
description: Ever wonder what it's like to pursue a fleeing suspect at breakneck speeds or exchange gunfire with a violent gang member? In each heart-pumping episode, host Sargeant Sean "Sticks" Larkin uses the latest surveillance technology to highlight police officers' perspectives in the craziest chases, standoffs, and interactions across the country.

title: Living Among Us
description: When vampires go public, a documentary crew move in with a family of bloodsuckers to see how they live. They quickly realize their mistake.

title: Living in Bondage: Breaking Free
description: Mentored by an enigmatic tycoon, an ambitious young man faces a crisis when his rise in power draws him deep into the occult.

title: Living in Delusionville
description: Raised on capitalist iconography, Godfather of Street Art Ron English unpacks the effect of corporate messaging through art and cultural co-optation.

title: Living in Fear
description: Una mujer casada descubre que la gente del pueblo donde creció su marido sospecha que él es el responsable de un asesinato ocurrido hace veinte años.

title: Living in the Future's Past
description: With narrator Jeff Bridges, scientists and thinkers explore eye-opening concepts about humanity's past and present-day environmental challenges.

title: Living Life
description: A 17-year-old with a great life and future makes the most of it when he’s diagnosed with cancer and decides to reconnect with estranged loved ones.

title: Living on One Dollar
description: Four American college kids are about to find out if they have what it takes to battle hunger and parasites for two months on $1 a day in Guatemala.

title: Living Space
description: A holiday in Germany turns into a nightmare when a couple discover that their lodgings are haunted by the ghost of a Nazi officer convicted of murdering his family. Trapped by this terror, they must escape the house or suffer the same fate.

title: Living with Chucky
description: An in-depth look at the groundbreaking movie Child's Play from the perspective of a filmmaker who grew up inside the killer doll franchise.

title: Living with Hitler
description: This docuseries examines how the German population and the people of the occupied countries lived through and survived the Nazi era.

title: Living with the Enemy
description: After falling in love and marrying a billionaire software developer, Allison begins to suspect he could be responsible for his previous wife's death.

title: Liz & Dick
description: Starring Lindsay Lohan and Grant Bowler. A chronicle of the fiery, legendary on-again off-again romance between Hollywood stars Elizabeth Taylor and Richard Burton.

title: Liz in September
description: Every year, Liz, a hardcore party girl and womanizer, celebrates her birthday with her friends at a Caribbean beach retreat. This year is different. She is sick but hates pity, so she hides her terminal illness. When a young woman outsider arrives, Liz’s friends dare her to seduce her. But the ingénue is deeply wounded by the recent death of her young son, and nothing turns out as expected.

title: Liz Stewart: I'm Crowning
description: Comedian Liz Stewart tackles ghosts, drugs, and motherhood in her debut comedy special, filmed while she was 8 1/2 months pregnant.

title: Liz: The Elizabeth Taylor Story
description: The story of Elizabeth Taylor's life, from her early rise to stardom in Los Angeles during the 1940s, through her many love affairs and divorces.

title: Lizzie
description: Based on the infamous 1892 murders of the Borden family, young Lizzie befriends the new Irish maid, while her relationship with her parents unravels.

title: Lizzie Lazarus
description: During Summer Solstice 1990, two strangers trek through woods with a corpse, seeking a mythical zone to revive it, unaware of dangers lurking ahead.

title: Lizzo's Watch Out for the Big Grrrls
description: Multi-platinum Music Icon Lizzo is in search of her next BIG GRRRL dancers as she heads into her 2022 tour. 13 hopefuls arrive in Hollywood, CA, to leave it all on the floor for a chance to be chosen to take center stage at the Bonnaroo music festival. The stakes are high for the hopefuls and Icon herself as this will be her first time performing in front of a stadium crowd in two years.

title: Lizzy Hoo: Hoo Cares!?
description: Hoo Cares!? is a show from Lizzy Hoo about life, family and following your dreams, but only if they’re worth it. With tales about her former office life, her brother’s backyard trout-farming dreams, and father-daughter trips to Malaysia with her larger-than-life father Chan. Lizzy’s show is an hour of big laughs and good times from a comedian whose profile has exploded in a few short years.

title: Looking for an Angel
description: A wrong phone call unites three characters who do not know each other, but who respond to the same name: Ángel Flores Fuentes. The three men, confused by the desperate message of love they receive, make decisions that will irretrievably change their lives.

title: Take Me for a Ride
description: An outcast teen spends her lunches on smoke breaks behind her school. She meets a new girl there and their love affair soon meets homophobic outrage.

title: Loaded Dice
description: Zane is a gambler who's in over his head. With thirty-six hours to pay his debt, he ends up in the middle of a high-stakes game against the mafia. He must find out who wants him dead and why.

title: Loan Shark
description: In this film noir, an ex-convict, now on the right side of the law, infiltrates a group of loan sharks that  preys upon desperate factory workers.

title: Lobster War
description: Award-winning documentary about the climate-driven conflict between the U.S. and Canada over mutual water rights both have claimed for over 200 years.

title: Local Color
description: A successful artist reminisces about a formative summer in 1974, when he befriended an elderly, alcoholic painter who had turned his back on art.

title: Crazy for Change
description: Paula and Paulina are like night and day. Paula is rich, famous, and annoying, while Paulina goes the extra mile every day for her family. One day, after a fight at their high school reunion, their life changed forever: Each one woke up in the other one body. While Paulina enjoys Paula’s luxurious lifestyle, Paula won’t stop until she gets back her body, her life, and her billionaire fiancé.

title: Locas y atrapadas
description: Five women trapped in an elevator confess their bitter life experiences caused by evil men and society in Dominican Republic. Fun, family valued comedy for everyone. Starring acclaimed Miss Universe, Denisse Quiñones.

title: They Call Me Jeeg
description: When a crook from a poor Italian town falls into the Tiber River and gains special powers, he plans to be a super-criminal, until he falls in love.

title: Loch Ness
description: A discredited research scientist is bundled off to Loch Ness to disprove Nessie's existence and finds something he never expected: unconditional love.

title: Lockdown
description: When a good cop is framed for murder and sent to prison, he must fight to survive and find a way to enforce his own brand of justice.

title: Locked In
description: Starring Josie Davis, Ryan Paevey, and Kaleigh Rivera. After her father's murder, Taylor cares for her agoraphobic mother and the family farm-until a stranger and a looming storm threaten both.

title: Locked in My House
description: When Caris is hurt by Dr. Marrick during IVF treatment, her world comes crumbling down. She finds him on the train tracks and traps him in her basement, determined to get justice - even if it means risking her life.

title: Locked Up: A Mother’s Rage
description: Following a divorce, a woman meets a dream man who asks her to stash his cash. When he turns out to be a criminal, she’s indicted too.

title: Lock & Load
description: Two security guards probe their friend's disappearance after a botched undercover sting, putting them in the crosshairs of a dangerous arms dealer.

title: Loco Love
description: When Donald’s wealthy wife leaves him and takes his restaurant with her, help comes in the unlikely form of a recent lottery winner: his gardener.

title: Locusts
description: A young man and his estranged brother who’ve reunited for their father’s funeral find themselves the targets of a local extortion racket.

title: The Odyssey
description: Pioneering conservationist Jacques Cousteau embarks upon an aquatic adventure spanning thirty years and achieves profound milestones along the way.

title: Swimming with Legends
description: This documentary explores the art of silent diving and features Belgian free-diver Fred Buyle as he swims alongside the largest creatures on Earth.

title: Let Me Fall
description: This portrait, drawing on true stories, follows Stella and Magnea through the decades as precarious teenage years morph into perilous adulthoods.

title: The Offering
description: Jan, a mysterious character haunted by a deep feeling of guilt, tries to get Violeta back, a youth love he lost 20 years ago, with a sickening plan.

title: Loft
description: Five best friends make a pact to share a secret loft for their extramarital affairs. Their scheme unravels when the body of a young woman is found.

title: Logan's War: Bound by Honor
description: An Army Ranger infiltrates a mob syndicate by posing as a hitman. With the help of his uncle, he plots his revenge for the murder of his family.

title: LOL
description: Anne (Demi Moore) deals with life as a working mother and raising her teen, Lola, (Miley Cyrus) who seems to be growing up faster than expected.

title: LOLA
description: Two sisters invent a machine that intercepts broadcasts from the future. With World War II on the horizon, they use it to change history.

title: LOL: Australia
description: Hosted by Rebel Wilson, 10 of Australia’s finest comedians battle it out to see who can keep a straight face while simultaneously trying to make their opponents laugh. Comedians who laugh will be eliminated one-by-one, until a single comedian remains. With $100,000 on the line, who will Rebel crown the Last One Laughing?.

title: Lola & Virginia
description: The brainy and unglamorous teacher's pet Lola goes head to head with her schoolmate and arch-nemesis Virginia , the bratty rich girl used to getting everything her way, as they race for fame and popularity in this witty animated series for all ages.

title: LOL Talent Show: Mexico
description: In the first season of LOL Talent Show: Mexico, everything is a surprise. Eugenio Derbez, Michelle Rodríguez, Capi Pérez, and Adal Ramones travel across Mexico in search of comedians with the "LOL gene." From Monterrey to Mérida, the hopeful face unexpected challenges and extreme tests. Only the best will win a spot inside the LOL house, in a stiff competition of who can get the most laughs.

title: LOL: Chi ride è fuori
description: In the first season of LOL, 10 comedians - Caterina Guzzanti, Frank Matano, Elio, Lillo, Katia Follesa, Angelo Pintus, Ciro and Fru from The Jackal, Michela Giraud e Luca Ravenna - face off for six hours in a row to keep a straight face, trying everything to make their opponents laugh. Whoever makes it to the end wins €100,000 to turn over to charity. Fedez presents together with Mara Maionchi.

title: LOL: Last One Laughing Denmark
description: In season 2 of “LOL – Last One Laughing,” a new comedic dream team competes for 100,000 kroner for charity. Host Sofie Linde monitors the comedians with 36 cameras. With new challenges and surprises around every corner, it’s harder than ever to keep a straight face. So who will avoid Sofie’s yellow and red cards and win the prize?

title: LoliRock
description: The adventures of Iris, a teenage girl who must divide her time between gigs with her rock band and life as a princess from a faraway kingdom.

title: LOL: Last One Laughing
description: Michael "Bully" Herbig presents LOL – "Last One Laughing," the first German comedy game show on Amazon Prime. Ten top stars of German comedy join in the ultimate battle to find out who laughs last! Who will be able to stay serious? Which performance won't leave a dry eye in the house? And who will be the last one standing?

title: LOL: Last One Laughing
description: Eugenio Derbez pits ten of the best comedians in Mexico against each other in this celebrity showdown. As the clock counts down in this six-hour competition, their objective is to eliminate others from the house by making each other laugh. The last comedian who stays in the house, without laughing, wins the grand prize of one million pesos.

title: LOL: Last One Laughing Canada
description: Jay Baruchel hosts this epic first season, where he’s assembled 10 of Canada’s best comedians in the ‘Late Night’-themed studio for 6 hours in a warped competition where laughing gets you eliminated and being the Last One Laughing gets you $100k for charity.

title: LOL: Last One Laughing Colombia
description: For the first time in Colombia, LOL opens its doors to 10 of the best comedians to compete against each other to win the LOL trophy while they dare to make comedy free of censorship and limits. In this crazy extreme experiment, comedians will reveal much more than their repertoire of jokes. What will be their challenge? Make each of their opponents laugh while keeping a straight face.

title: LOL: Last One Laughing Naija
description: Basketmouth hosts 10 of the funniest and craziest Nigerian comedians in a room for six hours. They will do anything possible to make each other laugh except laugh themselves. The last one laughing wins the game and 40,000,000 Naira for a charity of their choice.

title: LOL: Last One Laughing Nederland
description: Amazing comedians and harder laughs! Philippe Geubels and Jeroom Snelders present LOL: Last One Laughing the Netherlands. Ten talents: Tineke Schouten, Ruben van der Meer, Henri van Loon, Alex Ploeg, Roué Verveer, Rayen Panday, Henri van Loon, Soundos El Amhadi, Stefano Keizers, Alex Ploeg, Nienke Plas and Bas Hoeflaak have six hours to make the others laugh. Who will be the last one laughing?

title: LOL: Last One Laughing South Africa
description: Trevor Noah hosts 10 of South Africas greatest comedic talent in this rollercoaster of a season! As gags fly left, right and centre, who will have the smarts to dodge this comedic onslaught and keep from cracking up? In the words of Trevor: “Even if something smells funny, I’m on it!”

title: LOL: Last One Laughing UK
description: 10 comedians. One rule. Do not laugh. Jimmy Carr has assembled ten of the UK's funniest people in one room and set them the challenge of making each other laugh, without laughing themselves. Over the course of the series, they will try any means necessary to try and break their opponents...but can they do it all with a straight face?

title: LOL (Laughing Out Loud)
description: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree with a French teen and her single mom who both find themselves luckless in love, and their own relationship.

title: LolliLove
description: Saving the world, one sucker at a time!  Jenna Fischer (NBC's "The Office") and James Gunn (Universal's Slither) star in this critically acclaimed mockumentary about a wealthy LA couple who start a charity to give lollipops to the homeless.  Co-starring Linda Cardellini (Scooby Doo) and Jennifer Greer (13 Going on 30)

title: Lolo
description: The course of true love has never run smoothly for Parisian Violette, a 40 year old workaholic whose romantic life is continually challenged by possessive teenage son, Lolo. Enjoying a long holiday in Biarritz, fashion exec Violette is surprised to find herself falling for fellow divorcee Jean-Rene, a clueless but highly persistent local computer programmer. When Jean-Rene announces he’s due to move to Paris for a work opportunity, the unlikely relationship is given a chance to continue. However he must first attempt to win the trust and respect of troublesome 19 year old Lolo, a challenge that the endearingly naïve Jean-Rene is not at all prepared for. When Lolo returns to live with Violette, and his playful schemes evolve into more serious set-ups, Jean-Rene is faced with a decision; is he willing to compete with Lolo’s obsession to remain Violette’s one and only favourite?

title: LOL: Last One Laughing... or Screaming France
description: They're back! For Ahmed Sylla, Audrey Fleurot, Fadily Camara, Hakim Jemili, Kyan Khojandi, Camille Lellouche, Bérengère Krief & Gérard Darmon, the danger is everywhere: in this edition, screaming can sometimes be as fatal as laughing! The last person who holds out against their opponents' attacks and the scare-themed, booby-trapped arena will get 150,000 euros donated to a charity of their choice.

title: LOL: Last One Laughing Quebec
description: Patrick Huard invites 10 comedians to this unique experience that borders on torture. They will spend six hours together in an enclosed space where it is forbidden to laugh. The last one to laugh will win the contest, as well as $100,000 for the foundation of their choice.

title: LOL : Qui rit, sort !
description: Ten comics are locked together for six hours to see who can keep a straight face while simultaneously trying to make their opponents laugh.

title: LOL: Last One Laughing Sweden
description: Once again, Eva Röse gathers ten of Sweden's best comedians in the fight to make each other laugh, without bursting into laughter themselves. Anyone who can't keep up is out of the competition, where a large amount of money for charity is at stake.

title: L.O.L. Surprise! Winter Disco
description: After being stuck in a snowstorm, a young woman tells the tale of a group of toy friends venturing out to attend the coolest party in the land.

title: In the Shadow of Women
description: A married Parisian couple working on a documentary film encounters various issues in their marriage when the husband takes a lover.

title: Uncle Charles
description: In New Zealand, wealthy French businessman Charles Doumeng sees his world fall apart when he finds out he has an incurable disease. In his sixties, with no family or heirs and only a few weeks to live, he’s hit by a sudden resurgence of affection and decides to track down his sister in the west of France who he hasn’t seen for 50 years. In Mauprivez, a little village near Nantes, 35-year-old Corinne, a solicitor’s clerk with money problems, stumbles on the ad Charles has placed to find his sister with the promise of a vast reward. She sets out to seek the missing woman, but when her efforts are unsuccessful, she decides to create a bogus family with the help of those around her. The ruse works brilliantly. On the other side of the world, Charles is delighted to have found his rightful heirs. But life can be full of surprises and one good thing often leads to another. Charles learns he was given a mistaken diagnosis and is not sick at all! Overjoyed, he decides to come to France to meet his new family. And that’s where the problems begin...

title: London Mitchell's Christmas
description: London Mitchell, known as a Scrooge, has lived an unscrupulous lifestyle. Suddenly, London faces the diagnosis of prostate cancer, forcing him to rethink his outlook on life during the Christmas holiday.

title: Lonely Boy
description: While seeking answers to a past he cannot remember, a schizophrenic must find the strength to control his mental illness as he tries to build relationships with those he pushed away. Winner of multiple festival awards.

title: Lonely Boys
description: Two buddies try to escape their woes and failures by going on a bender and stagger through a weekend trying to cling to each other and their sanity.

title: Lone Samurai
description: In the 13th century, a lone samurai finds himself stranded on a desert island with nothing but his regrets to keep him company. Just as he is ready to give up and give in, a violent cannibal tribe sparks the survival instinct within.

title: Lonesome Dove
description: Set in the late 19th century, this sprawling Western epic tells the story of the last defiant frontier, a daring cattle drive, and an undying love.

title: Lonesome Soldier
description: Based on a true story, this harrowing look at PTSD's effects on soldiers and their loved ones follows a man's journey from dreamer to haunted veteran.

title: Lone Star Shark
description: A group of virtual hunters unleash a deadly shark in a Texas lake, causing a young couple to fight for their lives during a peaceful fishing trip in a secluded cove.

title: Lone Wolf
description: In a near-future Melbourne ruled by corruption and constant surveillance, a group of small-time activists hatches a plan to disrupt the G20 summit.

title: Lone Wolf
description: Nick and Derek are trying to have a quiet holiday, but their day unravels when a man escaping a drug lord hires them as emergency security personnel.

title: Long Gone Heroes
description: A battle-hardened special forces soldier is forced back into combat, risking everything to save the one person he still cares about.

title: Long Lost
description: A man gets a mysterious invitation to a weekend at a remote country mansion, unaware that the people in the house know more about him than he does.

title: Long Nights Short Mornings
description: James, a young man living in New York City, navigates love and relationships in the city, encountering both fleeting and meaningful connections.

title: Long Shadows
description: A young drifter haunted by tragedy seeks vengeance in the Old West, only to find love and redemption in a land defined by blood and grit.

title: Long Strange Trip
description: For 30 years, the Grateful Dead were the most unlikely success story in rock and roll. At the peak of their popularity, they were the highest-grossing concert act in America, but they did it by breaking all the rules.

title: Long Weekend
description: A romantic camping getaway for a couple hoping to mend their marriage turns into a life-or-death battle when their surroundings turn against them.

title: Citizens of the World
description: Three Italian pensioners in their seventies decide to leave their lifelong, comfortable neighborhood in Rome behind for the unfamiliar abroad.

title: Look Away
description: Tired of being bullied, a tormented teen unleashes her darkest dreams by switching places with her sinister alter ego who lives in the mirror.

title: Looking for Dr. Love
description: A recently divorced hairstylist on a mission to reconnect with her college sweetheart is shocked to learn he’s the DJ she listens to on the radio.

title: Looking for Her
description: When her family guilt-trips her into bringing her girlfriend home for the holidays, Taylor concedes. But there is one little problem: they broke up.

title: Looking for Rembrandt
description: Rembrandt's art is much loved and admired, but his remarkable life is less well known. 350 years after his death, his surprising story is told from an unusual perspective, his own.

title: Looking for the Jackalope
description: A disenchanted New York writer embarks on a comically ill-fated odyssey from New York to Ohio in an attempt to reunite with his old college girlfriend at their 20th class reunion. (Stephen Root) The Jackalope.

title: Looking Glass
description: After a family tragedy, a couple buys a motel in the Arizona desert that comes with a secret two-way mirror, a seedy clientele and a gruesome past.

title: Looking Through Water
description: William McKay is called by his estranged father to compete in a father-son fishing tournament that re-opens old wounds and sparks new understanding. Decades later, William recalls that pivotal trip as he tries to connect with his angry, distant grandson.

title: Look Into the Fire
description: A neuropsychology graduate student seeks to impress his professor by concocting an experiment that unwittingly unlocks repressed horrific memories.

title: Lookout
description: A young woman escapes her chaotic life to work at a remote fire tower, but her peace unravels as eerie, otherworldly events begin to unfold.

title: Looks and Smiles
description: Two well-meaning friends, fresh out of school, with dreams for their future, wake up to reality amidst Thatcher’s Britain and troubles in Ireland

title: Looks That Kill
description: A teenage boy lives out the hilarious and often tragic consequences of being lethally attractive, until he meets an unexpected kindred spirit.

title: LooLoo Kids
description: At LooLoo Kids we believe that kids need to laugh, learn and play, and that kid songs can be both entertaining and educational. The best English learning lessons for kids are now the Musical Adventures of Johnny & Friends. They sing, dance and learn while having a lot of fun. Children are learning to count, to recognize colors, to spell the Alphabet. Rhyming is the new flavor of learning!

title: Loon Lake
description: A Minnesota legend of a haunted cemetery, where falsely accused witches were beheaded and buried, wreaks paranormal havoc on a grieving man’s life.

title: Loop
description: In this sci-fi drama, Daniel, a desperate physicist, becomes obsessed with time travel in an attempt to save his murdered girlfriend.

title: Loopers: The Caddie's Long Walk
description: Meet the unsung heroes of golf: caddies. This documentary introduces you to the inspirational figures who hold the game together.

title: Loop Track
description: A man on the verge of a nervous breakdown ventures into the New Zealand bush. As he hikes, he can’t shake the feeling that something is stalking him.

title: Loose Shoes
description: Hilarious and outrageous parodies of movie trailers / coming attractions, featuring Bill Murray and other comedians.

title: Lord Love a Duck
description: Roddy McDowell, Tuesday Weld, Harvey Korman and Ruth Gordon star in this deliciously offbeat comedy that satirizes 1960s Southern California teen culture.

title: Lord Lucan: My Husband, The Truth
description: The case of Lord Lucan, a British aristocrat who killed the family nanny in 1974, is set straight by his wife, filmed months before her suicide.

title: Lord Montagu
description: The fascinating inside story of Lord Edward Montagu, one of England's most controversial and iconic aristocrats of the Twentieth Century.

title: Lord of Illusions
description: While on assignment in LA, a New York private eye stumbles into a case full of supernatural intrigue when a cult leader and illusionist is murdered.

title: Lord Shango
description: A desperate mother (Marlene Clark) unwittingly awakens a vengeful spirit when she turns to a cult for help in Ray Marsh’s religious horror.

title: Lore
description: From an executive producer of The Walking Dead and the executive producer of The X-Files, this anthology series brings to life Aaron Mahnke’s “Lore” podcast and uncovers the real-life events that spawned our darkest nightmares. Blending dramatic scenes, animation, archive and narration, Lore reveals how our horror legends - such as vampires, werewolves and body snatchers - are rooted in truth.

title: Lore
description: Germany, 1945. Five siblings, abandoned by their Nazi parents and succumbing to hunger, trek across their war-torn country in search of a safe haven.

title: Lorelei
description: Fresh out of prison, an ex-con gets a second chance at love when he reconnects with his high school sweetheart, now a single mother of three.

title: Lorena
description: Executive producer Jordan Peele takes a look at the 1993 case of Lorena and John Bobbitt, which made headlines around the world.

title: Dear Mother
description: When Jean-Louis' heart stops beating, he must confront his Oedipal issues — and ask his mother an unthinkable question — or he'll be dead in three days.

title: Los Angeles
description: God’s calling to save the Baby Jesus sends a young mute woman on the road to Tampa where she hooks up with an escaped convict running from the FBI.

title: The Billis
description: Inspired by real events, Los Billis narrates the coming of age of a group of friends in the 80's in Bogotá. The series follows a generation's search for identity through the unlikely friendship between David and Leo, the younger brother of Andrea, one of the group's leaders.

title: And the Crows Will Dig Your Grave
description: Un banco contrata a un pistolero para proteger sus envíos de oro de un famoso forajido llamado Glenn Kovacs y le encarga localizarlo y matarlo.

title: Los Cuatro Juanes
description: The Four famous "Juanes": Juan Colorado, Juan Sin Miedo, Juan Pistolas, and Juan Charrasqueado, embark on dangerous adventures to transport an important shipment of weapons and ammunition from Veracruz to a town under siege by government forces.

title: The Two Rivals
description: El heredero y la heredera de sus respectivos ranchos, con una rivalidad de años, se disfrazan del sexo opuesto para resolver sus problemas de dinero.

title: Los Farad
description: SERIES FROM SPAIN - The day Oskar, a typical local boy, crosses paths with the mysterious and wealthy Farad family, his life changes forever. Oskar enters a winner-take-all game, the world of international arms trafficking. In Marbella where the Farads live, luxury, adrenaline and intense emotions await him... But also a backside of violence and cynicism that tests his will.

title: Los Frikis
description: In 1990s Cuba, where Fidel Castro has outlawed all rock music, a group of impoverished punk musicians dream of a life beyond oppression. Desperate for a way out, they seize on a shocking and dangerous escape—one that could grant them the freedom they crave but at the ultimate cost. Inspired by true events, Los Frikis is a gripping story of rebellion, sacrifice, and the unbreakable human spirit.

title: Losing Addison
description: After living his entire life in his twin’s shadow, Les loses his brother and his own sense of self when their psychic connection is severed.

title: Losing Chase
description: A man hires a young caretaker to help his wife as she recovers from a nervous breakdown. Soon the women’s close bond threatens his relationship.

title: Losing Our Religion
description: Without a deity to worship, non-believers embrace humanism and strive to find a different kind of personal fulfillment through community.

title: The Initiated
description: Inspired by acclaimed Colombian author Mario Mendoza’s literary universe, comes this edge-of-your-seat suspense thriller. In a near future plagued by water shortages, Frank Molina, a gruff journalist, must face his demons to get to the bottom of a gruesome murder. The investigation drags him into the depths of a dark and mysterious city, where he learns firsthand nothing is what it seems.

title: The Initiated: Written from the Shadows
description: The formerly revered journalist Frank Molina finds himself in hiding, with his career shattered. However, he continues to write anonymously hidden in the shadows. Frank’s sense of calm is abruptly interrupted when a pair of severed eyes and a blood-soaked note appear at his door. As the number of victims increases, Frank will need to unblock his traumatic past if he seeks to find the killer.

title: Wednesdays Don't Exist
description: Tres hombres y tres mujeres se cruzan en diferentes momentos y lugares de Madrid durante su vida cotidiana y sus quehaceres amorosos.

title: The Gaze of the Sea
description: Una mujer se embarca en un viaje para reunir testimonios y recuerdos de la tripulación de un barco de pesca que desapareció años atrás en Veracruz.

title: Los reyes del volante
description: Capulina dejó sus zapatos y los de su colega taxista en la ventana y, al amanecer, en vez del lechón que le pidió a los Reyes Magos, hay una bebé.

title: The Three Wise Men: The Truth
description: While they prepare for the Three Wise Men's Cavalcade, Melchior, Gaspar and Balthazar open the doors to their palace for the first time for the filming of a documentary about their daily lives.

title: The Survivors: Colonia Dignidad
description: Colonia Dignidad ('Dignity Colony') was a unique case in the world. It was a sect and an evil empire based upon sexual abuse and exploitation.

title: Lost and Found
description: An Irish train station connects 7 strangers, including a new employee, a beggar, and a woman ready to have a wedding, despite unusual circumstances.

title: Lost at Christmas
description: When each of their Christmas plans go devastatingly awry, two strangers get stranded at a train station in the snow-covered Scottish Highlands.

title: Lost Bayou
description: An addict travels to Louisiana to make amends with her faith healer father, but her journey takes a dark turn when she finds a dead body.

title: Lost Child
description: Una mujer en el ejército regresa a casa para encontrar a un niño perdido en el bosque y descubre un mundo de folclore mientras busca su identidad.

title: Lost Creek
description: On Halloween night, three elementary school kids venture into the woods to confront a terrifying monster born from their nightmares.

title: Lost Fare
description: Based on a true story, a disabled 11-year-old girl is saved by a suicidal cabbie after being routinely forced into prostitution by her mother.

title: Lost for Words
description: With a staggering 43% of Australian adults missing the necessary literacy skills needed for everyday life, Lost For Words is an uplifting series that shines a light on Australia's low literacy rates and showcases how easy it is for people to fall through the cracks.

title: Lost Girls & Love Hotels
description: Searching for meaning, an American English teacher at a Japanese flight attendant school explores love and lust with a dashing gangster in Tokyo.

title: Lost Gully Road
description: Lucy travels to an isolated house in the forest to wait for her sister. They have worked out a risky scheme for their future and all she needs to do is sit it out. However, a sinister presence may have something different in mind.

title: Lost Holiday
description: After Margaret meets her ex-boyfriend's fiancé, she goes on an adventure with Henry and Sam. What starts as a search for LSD quickly puts them at the center of an heiress's disappearance that she is determined to solve.

title: Lost Holiday: The Jim & Suzanne Shemwell Story
description: An estranged couple is forced to face a life-or-death ordeal when they get trapped in a blizzard during a snowmobile trip. Based on a true story.

title: Los Tigres Del Norte: Stories to Tell
description: In their amazing career, Los Tigres del Norte have recorded more than 600 songs, sold 60 million albums, won 7 Grammy Awards and 9 Latin Grammy's. Throughout this voyage through their musical journey, Don Jorge, Hernán, Oscar, Eduardo and Luis share exclusive concert stories, photos, videos, and invite us to enjoy some of the most intimate moments of their life throughout their rise to stardom.

title: Lost in Africa
description: Two young lovers, lost in the African wilderness, are rescued by an elephant, yet face mortal dangers from wildlife and a tribe of enraged warriors.

title: Lost in Austen
description: A modern London woman obsessed with the romance in Jane Austen’s work discovers that she’s switched lives with a character from Pride & Prejudice.

title: The Tinellis
description: Marcelo Tinelli opens the doors of his mansion in Punta del Este to welcome his family and friends. He takes the opportunity to introduce them to his girlfriend, Milett, 30 years younger than him. However, the reaction of his daughters is not as expected, and it causes an emotional imbalance in the group a few months before a transcendental event: the wedding of Cande, Marcelo's second daughter.

title: Lost in Florence
description: A heartbroken ex-college football star gets deeply involved with a dangerous Florentine sport and an alluring local woman.

title: Lost in Love
description: Two tourists get left behind during a bus tour in Turkey. Without any of their belongings, the strangers must join forces to get back to Istanbul.

title: Lost in Oz
description: After being transported from Kansas to Oz on a magical tornado, 12-year-old Dorothy Gale finds herself lost in a strange new land with her trusty dog Toto. With the help of some new Ozian friends, Dorothy and Toto search Oz for the magic they need to get back home. Follow their adventure with 10 new episodes.

title: Lost Inside
description: An agoraphobic shut-in and former rock star feels pressured to return to his old life after meeting a nosy new neighbor and an imaginary friend.

title: Lost in the Barrens
description: An orphaned white teen and a Cree Indian boy must put their differences aside to survive when they get lost together in the Canadian wilderness.

title: Lost in the Maze
description: Lost in the Maze is a gripping true story of two men navigating the Uraricoera River in the Amazon jungle. Their journey takes a harrowing turn when their boat capsizes in wild rapids, leaving them stranded in one of Earth's most remote and unforgiving regions.

title: Lost in Tomorrow
description: Bullied at school and unfairly punished at home, Haper’s wish for a new life is granted on overdrive when she wakes up every day in a different body.

title: Lost: MH 370
description: An in-depth investigation reveals shocking new information about the sequence of events in the minutes and hours following the disappearance of flight MH370, whose signal went off the radar in 2014.

title: Lost on a Mountain in Maine
description: The inspiring true story of 12-year-old Donn Fendler who, separated from his family by a fast-moving storm, must fight to stay alive while lost for nine-days in the remote wilderness of northern Maine. Donn's disappearance captures national headlines and sparks a massive search effort attracting hundreds of volunteers, including his own father who fears he may never see his son again.

title: Lost Outlaw
description: A thrilling gold rush tale centering on an outlaw gang who takes over a gold mining camp, where a member meets a young Christian woman.

title: The Strange Vice of Mrs Wardh
description: A diplomat’s wife strays from her loveless marriage and is blackmailed by a mystery man while a razor blade-wielding serial killer terrorizes Vienna.

title: Lost Soul: The Doomed Journey of Richard Stanley's Island of Dr. Moreau
description: A look behind the scenes of the 1996 critical failure. Hollywood’s biggest stars and producers bet on this movie, so what went wrong?

title: Lost Treasures of the Silk Road
description: China - the "Middle Empire" has long been thought to have developed completely independently of the West. Recently this understanding of China's history has been called into question due to some surprising discoveries. New archaeological findings seem to support the theory that there had been contact between the East and West much earlier then originally assumed.

title: Lost Voyage
description: Resurfacing after sinking years ago in the Bermuda Triangle, a salvage team boards a ship and finds a mysterious force has returned along with it.

title: Lost Worlds
description: Teaming with archaeologists and using cutting edge visual technology, Lost Worlds brings back to life lost civilizations and cultures. Join us on the quest to rebuild what was lost and is now found.

title: The Unseen
description: En un mundo post-apocalíptico en plena guerra del agua, una muchacha, al saberse embarazada, huye con su pareja rumbo al mar buscando un mejor futuro.

title: Lou
description: A tender story about 11-year old Lou and her befuddled grandfather who comes to live with her family and teaches her the healing power of love.

title: Louisiana Story
description: Young Alexander Napoleon Ulysses LaTour (Joseph Boudreaux) is a Cajun boy who lives with his family and his beloved pet raccoon in the Louisiana bayou. When his father (Lionel Le Blanc) allows an oil barge to drill on the family's land, the boy has questions about the process and its safety. Although directed by noted documentary filmmaker Robert J. Flaherty and sometimes misidentified as a true story, this is a scripted film commissioned and paid for by a major oil company.

title: Louis Theroux: America's Most Hated Family in Crisis
description: Louis Theroux returns to the hugely controversial Westboro Baptist Church in Topeka, Kansas, and revisits current and former members.

title: The Bear
description: Follows the story of a young orphan cub and an adult grizzly as they join forces to survive being hunted down by humans in their mountain habitat.

title: Lov3
description: Siblings SOFIA (24), BETO (24) and ANA (33) refuse to experience love and sex like their parents. And that feeling grows stronger when their mother decides to end a 30-year-long marriage. The separation is the event that makes the three of them reevaluate their own emotional choices — and their ability to take care of each other while, at the same time, trying not to stifle their own identities.

title: Love
description: Stranded for years on a space station, a man passes time reading a Civil War soldier's journal. Produced by Angels & Airwaves and Tom DeLonge.

title: Love Across Time
description: Mientras inspecciona una antigua mansión británica, Chelsea descubre un portal del tiempo que la conecta con el propietario a fines del siglo XVIII.

title: Love Addicts
description: Due to her sexcapades, Zoé's sentenced by her boss to join the self-help group for Anonymous Love and Sex Addicts, where she meets romance addict Nele, relationship-challenged Ben, and people-pleaser and yes-man Dennis. Together, they're all looking to find a healthy way to deal with their love and sex lives.

title: Love Afloat
description: When Lorelei inherits a shabby sailboat, she hires laid-back Rob to help fix and sail it from its present location in the Caribbean to Miami.

title: Love All You Have Left
description: After her daughter is slain in a school shooting, a mother struggling to cope finds a teenage girl who claims to be Anne Frank living in her attic.

title: Love Amongst the Stars
description: Heidi, a professor of astronomy at a prestigious university, is convinced that a rare planetary alignment, which occurs every couple thousand years is the key to getting an observatory for her students. But AUGUST, a hotshot archaeologist and the newest history professor, might be either the answer or the downfall of her research.

title: Love and a Bullet
description: Assigned to kill the girlfriend of his crime lord boss, a cold-blooded hitman has a change of heart when he starts falling for his target.

title: Love and Betrayal on the Force
Love and Hate Crime
description: An exploration of hate crimes committed across the United States against those declared different. These crimes expose the deep-rooted prejudices permeating American society.

title: Love and Hostages
description: Following a one-night stand, two strangers awaken with no memory of the night before, now trapped together due to a police lock-down.

title: Love and Love Not
description: Nicky, a cynical player, goes home for the holidays and finds himself entangled by the woman who utterly broke his heart years ago.

title: Love and Love Only
description: A rich college student from India and a blue-collar Australian woman fall in love and have to figure out how his parents’ disapproval will play out.

title: Love and Marriage
description: It’s trouble for the Paradises when matriarch Pauline, who has spent her life taking care of others, decides what she wants for herself is a break from her family.

title: Love and Penguins
description: A manager for The Animal Discovery Institute travels to an Australian penguin sanctuary to help the lead zoologist and staff save the sanctuary.

title: Love and Support
description: A man whose girlfriend just left him meets a man with girlfriend issues at a support group. Together, they hilariously try to win their ladies back.

title: Love at Large
description: When investigator Harry is hired by a mysterious client to follow her lover, he’s caught in an intricate case, and tailed by a fellow detective.

title: Love at the Bootcamp
description: When a scattered marketing exec is tasked with helping an unpopular small-town bootcamp turn its image around, she finds that the strict, regimented ways of its owner might just be the perfect 'fit' for love.

title: Love at the Christmas Contest
description: Angie enters a Christmas tree contest to honor her mom’s memory only to learn she’s competing against her newly widowed high school flame and his kid.

description: Chris Holmes, the famed guitarist from W.A.S.P., mounts a comeback in his mother’s basement after beating addiction and losing his publishing rights.
