description: At one time, Yuri was a hero, a military assassin with 57 confirmed kills. But when an old friend dies under mysterious circumstances, the young son he left behind becomes the target of a manhunt, and she's determined to keep him safe.

title: Look Back
description: Fujino, a fourth-grader, serializes a four-panel manga strip in the school newspaper receiving rave reviews from her classmates. But one day, her teacher tells her that Kyomoto, a truant student, wants to publish her own manga in the newspaper. The two girls' shared passion for manga brings them together until one day, an event shatters everything. A heart-wrenching coming-of-age story unfolds.

title: LUPIN THE 3rd vs. CAT'S EYE
description: Hitomi, Rui, and Ai are sisters and cat burglars. They steal a painting from a museum around the same time Lupin the 3rd appears to steal another painting himself. Both paintings are part of Michael Heinz’s series titled the Girl and the Flowers. To the girls, the paintings are clues for their missing father's whereabouts. When they learn Lupin is after the same target, a fire lights inside them.

title: Lupin the Third: Is Lupin Still Burning?
THE LEGEND & BUTTERFLY
description: Oda Nobunaga marries Lady No, who wants him dead. But when her father dies, he gives her a reason to live again, and when in a predicament, she listens to his doubts. Together, they win the Okehazama battle and the unification of Japan becomes their dream. However, he’s turned into a “Demon King” and the Honno-ji Incident is imminent. What did they really dream of during their 30 years together?

title: Romance Doll
description: Tetsuo is keeping a secret from his wife, Sonoko. The secret? He makes sex dolls. Meanwhile, his relationship with Sonoko becomes sexless.

title: Romance Storm Zone
description: Art teacher Tamio, feeling unfulfilled, tries a love hotel and meets Serika. Love blossoms, but secrets lurk beneath Serika's surface.

title: There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless...
description: Determined to become an extrovert, a shy high schooler befriends a popular girl who wants something more in this heart-fluttering girls' love story.

title: Evangelion: 2.0 You Can (Not) Advance
description: NERV introduces two new pilots - the mysterious Makinami Mari Illustrous and the intense Asuka Langley Shikinami. Gendo Ikari and SEELE proceeds with a secret project that involves both Rei and Shinji.

title: SuperDragon: The Bruce Lee Story
description: From his pre-fame days of delivering newspapers, to his profession as a martial artist, this film traces Bruce Lee’s career until his untimely death.

title: Kung Fu Jungle
description: After a martial arts instructor kills a man by mistake, he is imprisoned, until the police need his help taking down a vengeful killer.

title: But Always
description: A man and a woman unexpectedly reconnect after many years apart. Much to their mutual surprise, the feelings they had come rushing back.

title: Forever and Ever
description: This story is about Shi Yi, a gentle pleasant and low-key but industry's top voice actress, who ran into the elegant returnee chemistry professor Zhou Sheng Chen at the airport one day. They gradually develop a mutual understanding in getting along with each other, and overcome many storms as they decide to accompany each other for the rest of their lives...

title: Shoplifters
description: Japanese maestro Hirokazu Koreeda took the Palme d’Or at Cannes for this heart-wrenching drama about a family living on the margins of society. Told with peerless humanity and compassion, Koreeda’s intimate and engrossing masterwork is a quietly devastating indictment of Japan’s class divide.

title: Nothing But Thirty
description: Esta serie sigue la historia de tres mujeres que han cumplido 30 años y la presión social que esto ejerce sobre ellas en la China moderna.

title: Three Kingdoms: Resurrection of the Dragon
description: In 228 AD, a time when China was plagued by constant war and divided between three kingdoms, a hero would arise. Zhao Zilong was a common man who rose from humble roots to commander of the army charged with liberating the land from an evil warlord. He ensued numerous battles of strength and wit, but now; he must fight back against the impossible to defy the fate of his nation.

title: Monster SeaFood Wars
description: Gigantic mutated sea monsters arise from the ocean’s depths and begin to wreak havoc upon an awe-stricken Tokyo, as a colossal crab monster appears.

title: The Lonely Warrior
description: It tells the story of an interrogation accident that sent detective Cheng Bing of the Third Brigade to prison to serve his sentence. His teammates were implicated, dismissed from the police. The former elite Third Brigade of the police fell apart. After ten years in prison, Cheng Bing regained his freedom. He lost everything, but Wang Da Yong, the suspect in the case, is still at large...

title: Sword Master
description: Cuando los enemigos amenazan su plan de vivir en paz, un maestro espadachín debe entregar su poderosa arma una vez más para destruir este nuevo mal.

title: Once Upon a Time
description: A story of epic battles, deep passion, and the powerful forces that drive mortals and Gods alike toward revenge, loyalty, and eternal love.

title: Lucky With You
description: When Shen Tiao Tiao (Zhu Li Lan) was just a young girl, she was severely injured and left for dead in a forest. But then fate intervened – in the form of a wandering gambling drunkard who saved her life and nursed her back to health. Now, many years later, she has become his apprentice as he continues his gambling misadventures. She is streetwise, supremely athletic...and very sure of herself. When she decides to punish a powerful local bully for trying to exploit his creditors, she quickly realizes she has bitten off more than she can chew. During the fracas, she (literally) falls into the arms of Lin Qing Lan (Huang Tang Qi). The latter is the male heir of the rich and powerful Lin family. Although he is incredibly handsome, he is also believed to be a halfwit. But the Lin family has attracted a whole host of plots from scheming hangers-on. While languishing in jail, Shen Tiao Tiao receives an unusual offer – if she agrees to be the daughter of a rich and powerful family, Lin Qing Lan’s fiancée, she will be rewarded for her efforts with an enormous amount of money. She agrees and becomes his wife. But she soon discovers that when it comes to her new husband and those close to him, nothing is quite what it seems… “Meet You” is a 2021 Chinese drama series that was directed by Chen Yi.

title: The Rebel Princess
description: The play tells the story of the princess Wang Xuan (played by Zhang Ziyi) She became her father's chess piece and married Lord Yuzhang, Xiao Qi (played by Zhou Yiwei), from a humble background. The couple fell in love with each other because of a blessing in disguise. In the end, the couple joined hands to create a new era and guard their homeland's people.

title: Mr. Unlucky Has No Choice but to Kiss!
description: Tensions sizzle when a student with horrible luck joins forces with another boy with chronic good luck in this charming romance based on a hit manga.

title: The Fatal Raid
description: Veinte años después de una operación secreta en Macao, una misión de escolta trae a los sobrevivientes a la escena para una reunión no deseada.

title: Mumu
description: Mu Mu, a joyful 7-year-old, grows up in a loving deaf community with her father, Xiao Ma. Their peaceful life is disrupted when her estranged mother, Xiao Jing, returns, pushing Mu Mu into the hearing world. As Mu Mu struggles to connect, she discovers that love and communication go beyond words.

title: Previously Saved Version
description: In the year 2200, a couple resides in an idyllic space colony, living a blissful married life. The wife is actually an android, her physical form preserved, while her memories have been repeatedly recreated by her husband in an attempt to revive their previous happiness. As he continues to reconstruct her, suppressed memories begin to surface, unveiling the hidden secrets of their marriage.

title: China's Van Goghs
description: In Shenzhen, China, a farmer-turned artist evolves from making van Gogh replicas to forging his own style combining Chinese calligraphy with painting.

title: LEGO Monkie Kid
description: Teenager MK must come to terms with his mission to save the world, setting out on a difficult journey.

title: Duckweed
description: A young man steps into the past to see his father's life and bring the two closer together by seeing events that led the family to where it is today.

title: The Invincible Dragon
description: A rival of a trigger-happy detective is his last hope to find the killer of his fiancée after he loses a vital battle of wits with a serial killer.

title: Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In
description: In Kowloon Walled City, a skilled fighter defies a feared Triad boss, igniting a deadly chase as a bounty threatens his ties to the enclave's leader.

title: Dear Missy
description: Story of the two women Lu Ke and Shen Si Yi, who despite having contrasting personalities are each other's closest friend. Their relationship broke down during graduation but nine years later they meet again and reconcile. The two encourage each other, face difficulties, and overcome the setbacks in work and life together.

title: Stigmatized Properties: Possession
description: Unable to give up on his dream of becoming a star, Yahiro Kuwata (Shota Watanabe) moves from Fukuoka to Tokyo and unexpectedly begins work as a "Haunted Property Talent." Chasing content for TV and social media, he moves through cursed rooms, eerie inns, and ghost filled share houses. But his kind heart and high spiritual sensitivity invite terrifying events that lead to a shocking truth.

title: My Journey To You
description: The series tells the story of Yun Wei Shan, a spy longing for freedom, who infiltrates the Gong residence to complete a mission. In the eerie and treacherous Gong residence, she encounters love and friendship, embarks on a journey of self-discovery, and finds the determination to move forward. Together with the rebellious nobleman Gong Zi Yu, they grow and mature through their shared experiences.

title: The House That Never Dies II
description: A century after the mysterious murders of the entire Zhisheng household, a cultural relic restorer experiences strange events at the ancient mansion.

title: Requiem from the Darkness
description: Momosuke meets a strange group of outlaws, Mataichi, Ogin and Miminaga on one stormy night. Darkness hidden inside human minds, and the people who battle the wickedness inside human nature. With amazing skills of illusion and art, Mataichi Group sheds light to the darkness in human minds to liberate the spirit from evil.

title: Human Specimens
description: The bodies of young boys were found in six cases. Shiro Sakaki, a professor considered Japan's leading expert on butterflies, turns himself in. He has recorded everything in a report published on the Internet, from his motive to the process of his creation. The interrogation proceeds as if tracing his distorted record, leading to a sensational suspense story where beauty and madness intertwine.

title: Kyo Kara Maoh!
description: After being flushed down a toilet, 15-year-old Yuuri is transported to an alternate world where he must learn to rule as the new Demon King.

title: I Belonged to You
description: A group of wild friends look for love in modern-day China, and soon find themselves on separate paths in life. Until one voice guides them back.

title: Kamen Rider Black Sun
description: The year is 2022. It is an era of chaos, half a century after the government announced the coexistence of humans and kaijins. Aoi Izumi, a young human rights activist calling for the elimination of discrimination, meets a man named Kotaro Minami, the one called "Black Sun", who is a candidate for the next Creation King.

title: Ninja Wars
description: A fortune teller’s prophecy mounts a rivalry among clan leaders to wed the beauty Ukio in order to rule the world—and only ninja Jotaro can stop them.

title: The Romance of Tiger and Rose
description: Chen Xiaoqian, an unknown screenwriter who's been single since birth, worked really hard and finally finished a grand drama of a heroine. It was planned to started filming, but stopped because the actor Han Mingxing questioned a lot about the script. One day, she accidentally got stuck in her own script and turned into the third princess of DongLiang, a country where females dominate.

title: The Trough
description: Undercover police officer Yu Chau (Nick Cheung) has successfully apprehended many criminals in the city of full of evil. Because a child abduction case, Yu's identity is starting to be brought to light, attracting the hunt from criminal groups. In order to adhere to justice within his heart, Yu does not hesitate to risk his life to start a life and death battle of wits against the leader of the mysterious criminal group.

title: The Oath of Love
description: A budding cellist's world comes to a grinding halt when her father is diagnosed with cancer until she starts to fall in love with his doctor.

title: Last Letter
description: A man trying to solve the shocking tragedy of his sister’s untimely death follows the only clue available to him – the last letter that she wrote.

title: A Samurai in Time
description: After being struck by lightning, a samurai awakens on a modern-day film set and begins a new, strange life as an extra in samurai movies.

title: Realm of Terracotta
description: A Terracotta army soldier teams up with a mysterious woman to seek a legendary creature, uncovering secrets that lead to a greater crisis.

title: A Chinese Ghost Story III
description: A monk and his exorcist master come to the aid of Lotus, who is stuck in a haunted temple, and at the mercy of an entity known as the Devil Tree.

title: The Village of No Return
description: Villagers forget their past after a Taoist priest erases their memories, unaware of Squire Shih’s conspiracy and their false happiness.

title: My Undead Yokai Girlfriend
description: College student Tadashi “Hachi” Inukai (Hayato Sano) is tired of feeling like a loser. But that all changes one day when he accidentally conducts a mysterious ritual he finds online, summoning a demonic yokai to the mortal plane, nicknamed Izzy (Ai Yoshikawa). Bonded by magic, Hachi and Izzy must figure out how to navigate life, love and murder.

title: I Don't Love You Yet
description: Mitari Yo (Adachi Rika) is a manager at a company that makes shoes, while Ishida Ren (Shirasu Jin) works in urban redevelopment. They have been best friends for years, and their close platonic friendship dates back to their high school days. But on Mitari Yo’s 29th birthday, they make a fateful wager – whoever marries first will receive a 300,000 yen (approx USD 2,780) cash gift from the other, providing the wedding takes place before Mitari Yo turns 31. However, the duo soon discovers that love can be very unpredictable – and that Cupid can strike at the most unexpected moment. A young junior employee in Ishida Ren’s company appears to be developing feelings for him, while things get even complicated for the friends when Mizusawa Ryusei (Asaka Kodai) – Mitari Yo’s ex-boyfriend – reappears on the scene. Who will claim the 300,000 yen prize? Will new admirers and old flames win the day? Or will Ishida Ren and Mitari Yo discover that their feelings actually go beyond friendship after all? This drama is based on the Taiwanese series of the same name, which first aired in 2011. “In Time With You” is a 2019 Japanese drama directed by Izuru Kumasaka.

title: Full Strike
description: A publicly shamed ex-badminton champ joins unites with three ex-cons who have their own reputation problems to challenge a gangster and his team.

title: The Eight Masters
description: After growing up in the Shaolin Temple, a budding martial artist studies the importance of patience and mercy and takes on the Eight Masters.

title: Your Sensibility My Destiny
description: A quirky jianghu heroine meets a lonesome lord who has no emotions and no senses. Through a mixup, a "sweet" destiny begins when he finds the woman with the ability to make him feel. After getting lost again due to her poor sense of direction while on a run from the people after her, Lin Chi mistakenly gets on the carriage owned by Mo Qing Chen.

title: Duel of the 7 Tigers
description: En Shaolín lo derrotaron en un combate y, años después, los discípulos de su propia escuela de karate do regresan a desafiar las escuelas de kung fu.

title: A Dog Barking at the Moon
description: Una saga familiar china, contada en diferentes épocas, que comienza con el descubrimiento por parte de la esposa de la homosexualidad de su marido.

title: Woman of the Photographs
description: A talented photographer with a solitary streak begins a twisted romance with a beautiful model suffering from body dysmorphia.

title: Iceman: The Time Traveler
description: Un talentoso guerrero emerge en los tiempos modernos después de haber estado atrapado en el hielo durante siglos, y depende de él corregir el pasado.

title: Iceman
description: Después de cuatrocientos años, un Guardia Imperial y sus tres amigos traidores son descongelados para reanudar la batalla que dejaron atrás.

title: First Love
description: Throughout a single night in Tokyo, Leo, a young boxer, and Monica, a sex worker, meet in a whirlwind of romance and accidental drug smuggling.

title: Love with a Case
description: They work for the police, but have no investigative authority! Even so, suspended detective Suzunosuke Shikahama, pacifist administrator Haruhi Mabuchi, blunt public safety officer Sesuna Tsumiki, and imaginative accountant Ruka Kotori all gather for one purpose. They seek the truth using their unconventional methods, even if it that truth turns out to be bigger than anyone expected. ©NIPPON TV

title: The Last Women Standing
description: While her mother fixates on finding her a proper husband, an independent Shanghai woman in her 30’s is drawn to her handsome, free-spirited coworker.

title: Theatre: A Love Story
description: Nagata (Yamazaki) is the writer/director of an unpopular theatre troupe. One day, he meets Saki (Matsuoka), a young woman who had come to Tokyo to become an actress, and they fall in love. While Saki sees Nagata's talent and indulges him, he believes that the only way he can make her happy is to succeed as a playwright. But as he struggles to hone his craft, the distance between them grows.

title: Tomorrow's Joe 2: The Movie
description: Joe, one of the top ranked boxers in the world, no longer has the yearning or desire to enter the ring again after killing his previous opponent by landing a wicked left jab to his temple. His confidence and competitive spirit is restored when he decides to overcome his fear by facing the uncrowned king from Venezuela, Carlos Rivera.

title: Ultraman Geed the Movie: Connect! The Wishes!!
description: Ultraman Geed’s hasty actions put the Ultraman team in danger when they face off against an army intent on wiping out intelligent lifeforms.

title: Haikara-san: Here Comes Miss Modern Part 1
description: Adapted from Waki Yamato's manga, this film is a heartfelt—and sometimes comical—tale of love surviving through the perils of war and separation.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen 0
description: Yuta Okkotsu witnessed the death of his childhood sweetheart in a traffic accident.Rika was turned into a cursed spirit. Haunted by her spirit, Okkotsu wanted to end his life.But he was taken to the Jujutsu High by the most powerful Jujutsu Sorcerer, Satoru Gojo.There, he made a decision to break Rika's curse at Jujutsu High.

title: Nintama Rantarō: Invincible Master of the Dokutake Ninja
description: At the Ninjutsu Academy, Doi teaches young ninjas known as "Nintama." One day, he goes out for a battle against a ninja from the rival clan, but vanishes without a trace. The Nintamas worry for Doi's safety. At the same time, the Academy receives troubling news that their rivals at Dokutake Castle may be scheming something.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Bonds Beyond Time
description: For the first time, Yugi, Jaden and Yusei fight together against when a time traveler comes to destroy the Duel Monsters game!

title: Sound! Euphonium The Movie: May the Melody Reach You!
description: As a high school band vigorously trains for a national competition, one of the key players considers quitting music for other pursuits.

title: Sound! Euphonium the Movie - Our Promise: A Brand New Day
description: In her second year, euphonium player Oumae Komiko is asked to mentor the high school band’s new players, who all have their own problems to solve.

title: Ghost Theater
description: Japanese horror-meister Hideo Nakata (The Ring, Dark Water) is among the directors for this supernatural anthology series starring AKB48 J-pop idols Yui Yokoyama and Nana Okada. Across ten chilling episodes, the curtain rises on terror as horrible, strange and unsettling stories unspool.

title: Kung Fu League
description: Fei Ying Xong convoca a los mejores maestros de kung fu de la historia para que lo ayuden a derrotar a todos los que se interponen en su camino.

title: Fist of the North Star: HOKUTO NO KEN
description: In the year 199X, the world was engulfed in nuclear fire!! Yet...humanity somehow survived!! A lone man with seven scars on his chest emerges. His name is Kenshiro, heir to Hokuto Shinken. In a world where only the strong survive, Kenshiro forges a path with his iron fists! ©Buronson&Tetsuo Hara/Coamix, HOKUTO Committee

title: Crossroad Bistro
description: About five women opened a restaurant named Bei Zhe Nan Yuan in Beijing; in the process, they matured and attained love. As the biggest shareholder in their restaurant, You Shan Shan single-handedly brought her best girlfriends together. Bao Xue, an optimistic little-known actress, and Dai Xiao Yu who returned from overseas are cousins.

title: 13 Assassins
description: Incredible action sequences mark this thrilling tale of an elite samurai force who get assigned a secret mission to take down a sadistic overlord.

title: Ancient Love Poetry
description: Ancient Love Poetry follows Shang Gu, once a leader of the four immortals, who falls into a deep sleep after sacrificing herself in a trial that lasted 60,000 years. Shang Gu wakes up many years later, and memories of what happened 300 years ago were completely wiped. But her former lover, Bai Jue, never forgot about her.

title: Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon
description: Twins Towa and Setsuna reunite after ten years of not seeing each other and discover they are the half-demon daughters of the great demon Sesshomaru.

title: The Secret Rivals 2
description: El hermano gemelo del Zorro Plateado intenta vengar la muerte de su hermano y conseguir un tesoro escondido utilizando el 8 Diagrama.

title: Counterattack
description: Security expert Lu Zi Ming is framed during an oil plant bidding event and must outwit his enemies to clear his name and expose the true culprits.

title: Mutant Python
description: In the wake of a wedding day massacre, a quiet and secluded mountain village in northern Fujian becomes terrorized by a vengeful python king.

title: The Day of Becoming You
description: The Day of Becoming You tells the romantic love story between Yu Sheng Sheng, a reporter, and Jiang Yi, a leader of a famous boy band.

title: Only Cloud Knows
description: Dongfeng (Huang Xuan) is a middle-aged man living in New Zealand. He has been suffering from sorrow and loneliness ever since the death of his beloved wife, Yun (Yang Caiyu). Unable to overcome his grief, Dongfeng instead decides to retrace the journey he shared with Yun and fulfill a dream that she never had the chance to fulfill. Over a decade ago, Dongfeng arrived in New Zealand from Beijing. While renting a room in Mrs. Lin's home, Dongfeng met Yun. The two began their friendship as another awkwardly odd couple, but they eventually fell in love and married, sharing many happy and funny moments together over the course of their courtship. To improve their lives in New Zealand, Dongfeng and Yun opened a Chinese restaurant in a small town. They hired Melinda, a friend of theirs, as a waiter. Even though making a living can be difficult, they worked hard together to create a happy life for themselves. Over a decade later, a fire destroyed the restaurant, forcing Dongfeng and Yun to find new jobs. One day, Dongfeng learned the news of Yun's illness… On his journey to retrace the past, Dongfeng reunites with the mechanic that once helped them and thanks him for his help; he returns to the small town where Yun and he founded their restaurant; he sees the blue whale that Yun longed to see; he visits Mrs. Lin and Melinda; he even goes to Beijing to visit Yun's parents and learns about a different side of Yun that he'd never known about.

title: Race 1
description: A racing team gets hit hard at the beginning of the season when they lose their main driver, and must find a way to keep their sponsorships alive.

title: Ip Man
description: In the throes of the second Sino-Japanese war, a Chinese kung-fu master challenges the Japanese karate-kicking invaders that terrorize his town.

title: Rattan
description: Many years ago, the plant-alien hybrid Si Teng was hunted down by a Xuanmen hunter. Chased across Shanghai, Si Teng fled for her life but escaping the relentless hunter proved impossible. With Qin Fang by her side, Si Teng learns what it means to live and love but the fragmented memories of her past continue to torment her.

title: Love Contractually
description: When strict CEO Ye Jin decides she wants to have a baby, she begins a hunt for a suitable sperm donor under the guise of a cushy personal assistant job. Enter Bo, a hunky, free-spirited delivery guy in desperate need of cash. Can she keep their pro-creation professional, or is this unlikely couple destined for more?

title: A Sword Named Revenge
description: Two swordsmen from separate sects band together to kill Ruthless Chi, head of another sect. But did he really die? Events show that the ruthless killer still controls the strings and its up to the swordsmen to reveal his true identity.

title: Our Times
description: With the development of information in the early 1990s, two IT guys started out secretly making Chinese character cards. They catch the attention of the director of the computer science institute and go on to become a major force in the industry.Xiao Chuang and Pei Qing Hua are students at the Institute of Computer Science of Yenching University.

title: The Whistleblower
description: A Chinese expatriate working in an Australian mine discovers a new technology being used on-site by his company may be putting everyone's health at risk.

title: JUJUTSU KAISEN
description: A boy fights... for "the right death." Hardship, regret, shame: the negative feelings that humans feel become Curses that lurk in our eve-ryday lives. Itadori Yuji is a boy lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a friend who has been attacked by Curses, he eats the finger of the Double-Faced Specter, taking the Curse into his own soul.

title: The Screaming Tiger
description: A Chinese soldier returns to his fishing village to find its residents massacred and goes to Japan on a vengeance-fueled kung fu killing spree.

title: Detective Chinatown
description: When a mob kingpin's gold goes missing, a bumbling detective accused of murder must clear his name with the help of his nephew and find the true killer.

title: Lion-Girl
description: In 2045, a swarm of meteor strikes usher in the age of ANOROC when humanity becomes open season to horrific beasts hunting them for their life force.

title: Bullet in the Head
description: In 1967 Saigon, three friends who fled Hong Kong after a gang scuffle are swept into war and imprisoned by the Viet Cong before planning their escape.

title: The Four
description: When counterfeit bills appear in the capital city of the Song Dynasty, a government department known as the Six Panels appoints an undercover agent, Coldblood, to infiltrate a special force called the Divine Constabulary to sabotage their investigations. Coldblood soon befriends other constables Life Snatcher and Iron Hands as well as the beautiful Emotionless and together they soon discover the Divine Constabulary’s real plans- not to flood the capital with fake money, but with a powerful army of the undead...

title: Summer Blooms
description: Hatsumi, 27 years old, has a secret. Three years after her boyfriend had died, she receives a letter from him. After encountering her former student, and a young artist, she confesses her past in the night of summer.

title: Library War
description: In a dystopian future where armed forces fight over the censorship of books, a young librarian dreams of finding the man who changed her life forever.

title: Pretty Proofreader
description: [With ENG Subtitles] Etsuko's lifelong dream is to become an editor for a fashion magazine. She finally bags an offer from a large publishing house, only to find out that she's been assigned to the least glamorous department in the company--the Proofreading Department.

title: Underground Monster
description: In the belly of a toxic dump, a construction crew disturbs the nest of a mutated cave monster that rises above ground to wreak havoc on a remote town.

title: Hell Teacher: Jigoku Sensei Nube
description: At a school plagued by supernatural beings, Nube, a teacher with a demon’s hand, secretly serves as an exorcist to protect his students.

title: On Summer Sand
description: In parched Nagasaki, grieving Koura drifts after losing his son. When his sister leaves her daughter in his care, an unexpected life together begins.

title: Little Big Soldier
description: Two opposite survivors of war between kingdoms in China, a royal general and an old soldier, bond when the soldier escorts the other to get a reward.

title: Ming Dynasty
description: After the battle of Jing Dynasties, the royal priest Jing Qing and his wife are killed. Their oldest daughter Sun Ruowei (Wei Tang), is saved by the vice-general Sun Yu. She tries to avenge her parents but meet Zhu Zhanji (Yawen Zhu). After she sees the dark side of Ming politics, she decides to give up on her revenge and help Zhu Zhanji become the Emperor to save Ming Dynasty.

title: Dream Journey 3: The Land of Many Perfumes
description: In a land haunted by vengeful spirits, souls of a slaughtered nation refuse reincarnation, ensnared by a cunning plot. Tang Seng and his apprentice arrive, uncovering the truth. Despite opposition, Tang Seng endeavors to save the tormented souls, transcending their tragic tale.

title: Qin Dynasty Epic
description: This series follows a relentless monarch who overthrows six kingdoms and successfully establishes the first centralized state in Chinese history.

title: Snake 3: Dinosaur vs. Python
description: Xiao Nan and her son Xiaokai, along with other visitors, go on an adventure to a remote island, unaware of the terror that lurks in the jungle.

title: Snow Monster
description: A gene research company sends a group into a mysterious snowy area on the edge of the Arctic where they get attacked by unknown giant creatures.

title: Dragon Blade
description: Jackie Chan, John Cusack and Academy Award winner Adrien Brody star as warriors battling over the lucrative Silk Road in this epic action adventure.

title: Shaolin Drunkard
description: An evil demon escapes from a Shaolin temple when the drunken sorcerer guarding him leaves his post for a drinking spree. Magical kung-fu chaos ensues.

title: Skyfire
description: The impossibly beautiful paradise of Tianhuo Island is lost when warnings about an eruption in the world-famous Pacific Rim volcanic belt go unheeded.

title: Being Natural
description: Takashi, a 50-year-old bachelor, has no dreams, no job, and no home. He is staying at his uncle's house on condition that he takes care of his uncle who suffers from dementia. When his uncle dies, his son Mitsuaki returns home. The three old friends reunite with their childhood friend Sho. Takashi and his family's life goes by happily while running his uncle's fishing pond.

title: Dance of the Sky Empire
description: The story is set against the backdrop of the prosperous Tang Dynasty in an era where humans have defeated the Great Dragon king. Moyun Academy is the number one academy in Great Tang. However, it is said that a student of the school will become the catalyst for the return of the dragon king as well as the clan Kunwu.

title: Sakra
description: Starring and directed by international action star Donnie Yen. When a respected martial artist is accused of murder, he goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origin story and the unknown enemies working to destroy him.

title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils
description: During the reign of Emperor Zhe Zong of the Song Dynasty, three men who become sworn brothers face struggles with self, family and society.

title: God of Lost Fantasy
description: Qin Wentian is born as a sickly child and his adopted parents are forced to send him to the Bai's famiy to marry their daughter. However the Bai family tries to back out of the marriage proposal and kill Wentian.

title: Tai Chi Zero
description: Traditional villagers are torn between a traveler, who teaches a powerful new form of Tai Chi, and a man who plans to build a railroad on their land.

title: Tai Chi Hero
description: Lu Chan solidifies his place in Chen Village by marrying Angelababy. Meanwhile, his powerful mutant horn is slowly destroying him.

title: A Star Brighter than the Sun
description: Sae Iwata, a slightly tougher-than-average girl, falls for the gentle smile of Koki Kamishiro, a delicate boy, back in elementary school. By the time they enter junior high school, Koki has grown into a charming and popular teen who now feels out of reach. When they are assigned to the sports festival committee together, Sae’s long-hidden first love begins to stir once more.

title: Lost and Love
description: A determined farmer searching for his missing young son takes a road trip with a mechanic searching for his parents after a long-ago kidnapping.

title: Run for Love
description: This anthology film follow five stories of love and heartbreak, as each couple faces a change that will forever alter their lives. From missing children, to thousand mile road trips, to returning home and more, "Run for Love" explores the challenges, and the depths, of the heart.

title: Caution, Hazardous Wife
description: Nami Isayama, played by Haruka Ayase, is a well off full time housewife admired by many. Hoping to restart her life and find peace, she marries a man she met at a mixer and moves to a quiet upscale neighborhood. Soon she discovers the hidden troubles behind other housewives' lives. Though bad at housework, Nami has a strong sense of justice and rushes into danger without hesitation. ©NIPPON TV

title: Winter, Grasping Love
description: Hikaru, a successful career woman with a devoted fiancé, finds her heart unsettled when a former boyfriend suddenly reappears in her life.

title: A Girl & Three Sweethearts
description: [With ENG Subtitles] A hardworking patissier, Misaki’s life is turned upside down when she's fired from her job. She meets Chiaki, her first love, who invites her to work at his restaurant in Shonan. Will this seaside town be the place where love blossoms once again?

title: Ruyi's Royal Love in the Palace
description: After becoming empress, former consort Ruyi navigates intrigue, betrayal, and fading love as she rises and falls in Qing Dynasty court politics.

title: City Cops
description: In Hong Kong to bring down a criminal organization, a tough American FBI agent high kicks her way to a final showdown with a Chinese mafia boss.

title: American Force: The Brave Platoon
description: A group of expertly trained soldiers go deep behind enemy lines in order to stop a Soviet warmonger from arming and training terrorists.

title: Bloody Romance
description: Qi Xue (Li Yi Tong) is a beautiful 16-year-old whose life takes a horrific turn when her father sells her to a brothel. There, she undergoes unspeakable abuse that nearly breaks her spirit. But when Qi Xue enters a mysterious new city, she is given a new identity of Wan Mei and undergoes training to become an assassin. Now able to use her beauty as a weapon.

title: The Devotion of Suspect X
description: Tensions brew as a cold case murder intensifies and the lead detective starts to believe that his former classmate knows what really happened.

title: Lone Wolf and Cub
description: Hai Itto and his young son Daigoro seek vengeance against the Yagyu clan in this tale of swordsmanship and wandering in 17th-century Japan.

title: Message from Space: Galactic Wars
description: Centuries after the people of Earth master interstellar travel, humanity is thriving across the galaxy. But this all changes when the Gavanas Empire arrives, as the merciless despot Roxair XIII quickly conquers the 15th Solar System and enslaves all life there to his cause!

title: Perfect Adultery
description: Takuya Yoshioka loves his wife Chiharu. But when his friend tells him they've entered the great age of infidelity, he checks Chiharu's phone. Finding nothing suspicious, he regrets doubting her. But it turns out, it was all a trap. She has affairs to love her husband. He loves his wife despite her betrayal. Can you detect the hidden clues? ©NIPPON TV

title: Adoring
description: In this heart-warming ensemble rom-com, pets play match-maker as their humans learn to find connect with family, friends, and lovers through their furry friends.

title: Your Home Is My Business
description: [With ENG Subtitles] There isn't a house Machi cannot sell. She sticks her nose in the personal issues of her clients and uses a vast range of tactics to help solve their problems, and she sells them a house while she's at it!

title: I'm Mita, Your Housekeeper
description: A family almost broken by grief hires a cold, mysterious housekeeper, whose surprising and unorthodox ways start to bring them back together.

title: The Swiss Family Robinson: Flone of the Mysterious Island
description: After a family survives a shipwreck, they live together on a beautiful deserted island, where every day is filled with unusual adventures.

title: Enemy
description: A gripping story of espionage during peaceful times follows a group of security officers who rely on their intellect, investigative skills and love for their country to help them win the final victory. They are ordinary people around us with unusual backgrounds and secret identities in a gunless war against hidden opponents.

title: The Dragon Pearl
description: Josh and Ling were expecting a boring vacation visiting each of their parents at an archaeological dig in China. But the new friends soon discover they're right in the middle of an adventure when they find a Chinese Golden Dragon.

title: Mojin: The Lost Legend
description: Three grave robbers living in New York City come out of retirement to accept a job raiding ancient tombs in China for priceless artifacts in this action/adventure release. Based on a book written by Zhang Muye.

title: The Sealer
description: Blade master Osagami Kakeru is on a quest to neutralize the corrupting “blades of filth” forged from human evil, risking his own soul in the process.

title: Creation of the Gods I: Kingdom of Storms
description: To save the mortal world, the gods intervene by investing in a champion brave enough to challenge the evil king—even if it may cost him everything.

title: Legend of the Demon Seal
description: Fengxue expresses her feelings with original comic books. In her imaginary world, she takes on the mission of defeating evil creatures.

title: Shogun's Shadow
description: Takechiyo and seven accompanying samurais find themselves in constant battle after Takechiyo's father, the Shogun, orders his assassination.

title: Flash Point
description: Donnie Yen stars in this tale of an inspector who fights against a Vietnamese-Chinese gang, despite the danger it poses to an undercover cop.

title: A Little Reunion
description: En su último año de escuela juntos, tres estudiantes viven altibajos, risas y lágrimas mientras se preparan para el examen de admisión universitaria.

title: Run, Tiger Run!
description: A young orphan with dreams of joining the elite Chinese Travelguard is joined by a mysterious stranger on a dangerous journey to deliver a package.

title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
description: Young student Liu is urged to rise against the Manchu oppression in China, but the revolution has disastrous consequences. Escaping the massacre, Liu seeks shelter in the Shaolin Temple where the monks train him in their famous martial arts skills.

title: Divine Destiny
description: Orphan Ji Ruo Chen was mistakenly identified as the banished heir of the Immortal Realm, because of the blue stone he stole from its rightful owner. Ji Ruo Chen was chosen as one of the disciples for cultivation under the guidance of the Xixuan sect's leader. Unexpectedly, he's fallen for Zhang Yin Yin--the daughter of a leading member of the sect.

title: Minning Town
description: The drama tells the story that under the guidance of national poverty alleviation policy and Fujian's counterpart assistance, Xihaigu residents who have been relocated since 1990 have been overcoming various difficulties, exploring ways to get rid of poverty, eventually building a weak "Dry beach" into a shiny "Golden beach.

title: Goodbye Monster
description: While battling the Dark Spirit, a young doctor accidentally ruins his island and is banished from Kunlun Hospital. But when a young boy comes to him for healing, he may have one more chance to redeem himself-and restore his home.

title: Ronja, the Robber's Daughter
description: Presented by Studio Ghibli. The daughter of a professional robber, Ronja realizes the complicated nature of her father's profession when she befriends Birk, the child of a rival tribe. She struggles to balance this friendship with her family relationship but comes to understand, differences can be overcome with the help of love and understanding.

title: The House of the Lost on the Cape
description: The story of two lost souls—one a teenage runaway, and the other an orphaned girl—who find comfort in a mysterious elderly woman’s home.

title: Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan
description: "Heaven's Door!" – with these words, manga artist Kishibe Rohan turns people into “books” to learn their secrets and write in additional instructions. Rohan must summon all his powers to face down the peculiar incidents that come his way. Based on the popular spinoff of Jojo's Bizarre Adventure by Araki Hirohiko.©LUCKY LAND COMMUNICATIONS / SHUEISHA ©NHK / P.I.C.S.

title: Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan: At a Confessional
description: Manga artist Rohan Kishibe visits a church in Venice and hears a masked man confess that he accidentally killed a vagrant and was cast a curse that brings him despair when he is most happy. Rohan becomes engrossed in this mysterious confession and uses his special ability to turn people into books and read their memories and experiences… Eventually, he finds that he is under the same curse.

title: Rohan at the Louvre
description: Rohan Kishibe is a mangaka who can read people like a book. At work on a new creation, Rohan recalls a tale of the blackest painting ever made. Called the most evil of paintings, it used a paint that should not exist. Driven by the events linked to it, Rohan and his editor, Izumi, go to the Louvre in France for answers.©2023 "Rohan at the Louvre" Film Partners ©LUCKY LAND COMMUNICATIONS/SHUEISHA

title: Giant Python
description: Un grupo de personas encuentra sus vidas en peligro cuando descubren una serpiente gigante custodiando el árbol mágico por el que pasaron.

title: Huge Shark
description: Four friends who find themselves stranded in a small boat and circled by a blood-thirsty shark must devise a plan to survive or become its next meal.

title: The Final Master
description: In 1930s China, unrest rules the nation.  Chen, the last Wing Chun master, arrives in Tianjin to expand his kung fu - but his ambition gets him entangled in a power struggle between Tianjin's martial arts Grandmaster, a dominant underworld Madam, and the town's military leaders.

title: Return of Ultraman
description: After saving a child, Hideki Gô finds his life force joined with Ultraman. Together, they protect Earth against the attacks of monsters and aliens.

title: Cantonen Iron Kung Fu
description: When Black Eagle, a wicked and greedy businessman, attempts to dominate the local supply routes, a brave laborer named Leung must fight him.

title: Journal of the Mysterious Creatures
description: Yoshihito, an young man, decides to rent out an empty room in the house he lives in in order to earn a living.He runs into a wolf girl and a female vampire who wants to move in, and his life as a landlord begins.He meets a god there and is sentenced to serve as an examiner, tasked to manage the different races living in the empty rooms. His funny and slapstick life with various races begins now.

title: The Gravity of a Rainbow
description: A story about three modern-day women who make different decisions, how it affects them in the workplace and changes their friendship and how they find love.

title: Shadow
description: Un comandante se enfrenta a peligros dentro y fuera de los muros del palacio. Pero tiene un arma secreta: una sombra que puede engañar a sus enemigos.

title: Two on the Edge
description: After she ages out of her orphanage, Otose tries to become independent, but traumatic childhood memories spoil her attempt at a fresh start.

title: Broker
description: Qiu Jia Ning is a core member of a research lab spearheaded by the leading pharmaceutical company in the nation. As their experiment enters the clinical phase, a new researcher by the name of Zhou Xiao Shan joins the team. His sharp acumen and quiet nature attract Jia Ning's attention. In reality, he is a broker who has walked into their lives for the purpose of stealing Jia Ning's research.

title: Ninja vs. Gokudo
description: The ninja banish evil from the shadows. The gokudo gather lonely outcasts and commit crimes. The grudge they forged centuries ago is rekindled in the present day. The ninja Shinoha meets Kiwami, a gokudo with the face of a businessman. Unknowing of the other's identity, they bond over anime, but the war between ninja and gokudo intensifies. Who will survive and who will perish, ninja or gokudo?

title: Saving General Yang
description: Seven sons must take on an army of thousands, brave treacherous conditions, face their nemesis, and find a way home—all to rescue their patriarch.

title: Raging Fire
description: DI Bong (Donnie Yen) discovers his former protégé gone rogue is behind a brutal crime. A score needs to be settled once and for all.

title: Fall in Love Like a Star
description: A couple who broke up years ago reunite in a passionate and bittersweet love after he finds stardom as a pop idol and she becomes his manager.

title: We Are All Alone
description: Mo Xiang Wan is known as the iron-willed agent of showbiz and she has helped many young talents rise to stardom. Ten years ago, she dated Mo Bei, a hotshot lawyer who specializes in commercial law. Their paths cross again as Mo Xiang Wan tries to fulfill her dreams.

title: Destroy All Monsters
description: With stellar effects work by Sadamasa Arikawa—taking over from the fabled Eiji Tsuburaya—Destroy All Monsters! dazzles with its primary-colored cataclysms. Climaxing with a fierce battle between kaiju rivals, this barnstorming sequel loads its spectacle with a sharp critique of colonial oppression.

title: Parasite in Love
description: A social outcast with a paralyzing fear of dirt finds the remedy to his loneliness in a high school girl suffering from her own self-isolating phobia.

title: Love's in Sight!
description: A headstrong but love shy girl from a school for the blind meets a hot headed yet purehearted delinquent boy, an encounter that changes everything. Yukiko, who can barely make out light and color, and Morio, a quick to fight but sincere teen, grow closer as they understand each other. A heartwarming, funny new generation rom com inspired by Yankee kun to Hakujou Girl. ©Uoyama/KADOKAWA ©NIPPON TV

title: Dinosaur World
description: The best players from around the world are gathered to be Russell's lab rats in his new game inside a manufactured world populated with dinosaurs.

title: Striking Rescue
description: Bai An, a Muay Thai expert, embarks on a mission of revenge against the mysterious crime syndicate that brutally murdered his wife and child.

title: The Death Duel
description: When a bitter dispute leaves a promising martial artist blind in one eye, he continues to train while plotting revenge against the man who did it.

title: Tales of Little Women
description: Based on Louisa May Alcott's beloved novel and set during the American Civil War, the March family shares the bonds of love through hardship and joy.

title: I Am Not Madame Bovary
description: Li Xuelian and her husband stage a fake divorce to secure a second apartment in the city reserved by the government for single people. But when her husband remarries six months later-as agreed-but to a different woman, a furious Li files a lawsuit with the county court. Losing her case only makes Li more determined to take her fight to the highest levels of government in Beijing.

title: My Girlfriend's Boyfriend
description: Ah Zhai, whose never had a girlfriend, accidentally buys himself a boyfriend; when he tries to fix his mistake by replacing his devoted robo-beau with a robot girlfriend, a delivery mishap makes her fall for the other robot instead of him.

title: A Quest to Heal
description: During the Ming Dynasty, pugilist Luo Ming Yi sneaks into the imperial jail to rescue her senior Li Shi Zhen. She is stopped by Bi Zheng, a Brocaded Robe Guard, and the two unknowingly travel through time to 2020. They eventually ended up in a restaurant founded by the descendants of Li Shi Zhen. Currently helmed by an incompetent, Ming Yi is determined to help him turn the business around.

title: Love Will Tear Us Apart
description: Ten years ago, Ly Qinyang confessed his love for Ling Yiyao in front of the whole school. He promised to marry her in the future.

title: Battlefield: Fall of The World
description: When Earth succumbs to an alien invasion, troops from around the world gather to stop the monsters and defend what's left of the planet.

title: Wolf Warrior
description: A special forces soldier takes on a group of deadly foreign mercenaries who were hired to assassinate him by a vindictive drug lord.

title: GoShogun: The Time Étranger
description: Remy Shimoda is in a hurry. She's on her way to a reunion with the other members of the Go Shogun team, and she's late. A police action with some robbers gets in her way, so she runs the robbers off the road. Her vision blurs and she gets into an accident.

title: The Handcuff
description: Handcuff is a biographical film about the life of Hong Kong Gangster Chen Hui Man. In the film, Chan wants to quit the triads and retire to Europe but the dons have other ideas.

title: The Butcher's Blade
description: A low-ranking constable faces persecution, becomes a scapegoat in a theft case, and gets rescued by his teacher. Now caught between serving corrupt officials or fighting for freedom, he must choose his path.

title: Shock Wave 2
description: A terrorist expert in explosives, whose gang has been dismantled, seeks revenge. He threatens to blow up a Hong Kong tunnel with hundreds of hostages. The policeman who has already beaten him once must stop him again.

title: Monster Hunt 2
description: Monster Hunt 2 is the giggly, nutty, and wildly entertaining live-action sequel to the megahit 2015 family film that broke all box office records in China.

title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
description: After a 15-year personal rivalry, an underworld gang war erupts when a financier puts a price on the head of Hong Kong's most powerful drug dealer.

title: OSHINOKO
description: Two pop idol Ai fans are reincarnated as her “secret” baby twins, Aqua and Ruby, and grow up supporting her until the tragic day she is stabbed by a stalker. Flash forward a few years later and Aqua and Ruby are high school students determined to make it on their own in the cutthroat world of entertainment for personal reasons. (c) Aka Akasaka× Mengo Yokoyari / SHUEISHA, TOEI

title: Polar Rescue
description: A young boy goes missing during a snowstorm, launching his parents and the local authorities into a frenzied, race-against-time search operation.

title: THE GHOST IN THE SHELL
description: 2029, a near-future Japan. The full cyborg Motoko Kusanagi envisions a task force that preemptively strikes emerging threats. She and her team are scouted by Daisuke Aramaki as Public Security Section 9, AKA the "Shell Squad." An international conspiracy hints at a hacker known as The "Puppet Master." What fate awaits Kusanagi? What is the hacker's endgame? A new era of cyberpunk action begins!

title: Douluo Continent
description: It tells the story of Tang San who overcomes many difficulties to protect his loved ones, bring honor to his sect, help his country and become the strongest and bravest soul master. Having lost his mother, Tang San and his father depended on each other to survive. Because he had to bear heavy burdens since childhood, Tang San grew up meticulous and mature for his age.

title: Novoland: Pearl Eclipse
description: Make a Naga mermaid cry, the shed tears will turn into priceless luminous pearls. Hai Shi is a young girl living in a coastal village where people use the ruse of killing their children to make mermaids cry and gather the pearls to pay for taxes. It was on such a fishing trip that Hai Shi's father was killed.Hai Shi's town was ransacked by soldiers and she develops a grudge against the emperor

title: Shanghai Affairs
description: A Shanghai doctor tries to help the town's poor people while dealing with a murderous gang and his feelings for the gang leader's sister.

title: Shaolin
description: Following a devastating betrayal, a general seeks refuge at a temple and meets a quirky cook who shows him the secrets to martial arts.

title: Aces Go Places V: The Terracotta Hit
The Legend
description: Martial artists join a secret society to topple a tyrant. Amid the chaos, a kung fu fighter vies for a merchant’s daughter in a contest.

title: The Legend II
description: Cantonese hero Fong Sai Yuk contends with romantic entanglements and complex loyalties while working for a secret society seeking to topple a tyrant.

title: Matchless Mulan
description: During a Rouran invasion in ancient China, Mulan takes her father's place in the military. Struggling with the notion of taking lives, she forms bonds with fellow soldiers. Tasked with rescuing Prince Yuan Hong, Mulan embraces her warrior spirit, defending her loved ones courageously.

title: A Cool Fish 2
description: The "scumbag" Chen Sanjin and the "ruthless woman" Xue Fangmei, who broke up on the streets of Bangkok, unexpectedly became involved in a kidnapping activity by a criminal group.

title: Drug Stamps
description: Un astuto policía se infiltra en una organización criminal que fabrica una nueva generación de drogas para intentar desmantelar su operación.

title: NIPPON SANGOKU: The Three Nations of the Crimson Sun
description: A revolution sparked by nuclear war, natural disaster, and misrule leads to the collapse of Japanese society. The country splits into three nations vying for hegemony, and the Sangoku era begins. Aoteru Misumi, a former agricultural officer, vows to reunify Japan. He rises through the ranks with only his knowledge and eloquence. Witness the legend of the man later hailed as a genius strategist.

title: Kunlun Tomb
description: Hong Kong antique dealer Ming Shu commissions Hu Ba Yi, Wang Kai Xuan and Shirley Yang to look for the glacier corpse within the demonic kingdom from the legends of King Gesar. Having just escaped the "worm" valley, they embark on a new journey to unravel a curse.

title: Our Time Will Come
description: In the 1940s Japanese occupation of Hong Kong, a brave woman, Fang Gu, leads the fight for freedom, in this historical drama from legendary auteur Ann Hui. Together with a band of resistance groups and like-minded youths, Fang battles in the struggle to escape the powerful Japanese forces.

title: Heaven's Coin
description: Heaven's Coin is a story of pure love between a girl who faces life bravely and joyfully with her innate emotional strength and liveliness despite her hearing and speech impairment and a man who has lost his memory of her whom he loves. (C)NTV

title: Star Abyss
description: As humanity embarks on interstellar travel through leap gates, a starship carrying 15 passengers becomes trapped in the depths of one.

title: Romance of a Twin Flower
description: A historical drama about a witty young woman navigating romance, secrets, and intrigue after losing her memory in ancient China.

title: Under the Microscope
description: When Shuai Jia Mo, who is obsessed with mathematics, stumbles upon a historical problem in Jinhua County, he's met with multiple obstacles in his attempts to correct the mistake, triggering a tension between various stakeholders.

title: The Taking of Tiger Mountain
description: A ruthless outlaw bandit with a compound on Tiger Mountain is targeted for a takedown by a resistance captain who sends in an investigator as a mole.

title: Insanity
description: 3 years after suffering a mental breakdown that resulted in his wife's death, a schizophrenic is released after being declared cured. But when he accidentally kills again his doctor goes to extreme lengths to hide his patient's crime.

title: Aces Go Places III: Our Man from Bond Street
Aces Go Places IV: You Never Die Twice
Moonlight
description: After graduating university with a major in financing, Chu Li successfully enters her dream company, Yuan Yue Publishing House. There she meets author Zhou Chuan, who is said to be gentle as a jade when he's really not.

title: Crossing Hennessy
description: Set up on a blind date by their meddling families, Loy & Oi Lin initially aren't attracted to each other at all--but as their determined aunts continue to throw them together, they develop a friendship that arouses the suspicions of everyone around them.

title: Earth Rescue Day
description: The human race’s only chance at fighting against the alien giant that annihilated planet Earth is in the hands of a young boy. Can he save humanity?

title: Be Yourself
description: As four young women enter their journey at the Southwest Communication University, they are met with barriers they must overcome. They continue to have friction due to their personalities and living habits. As they grow and transform together, they finally understand each other and become close friends by relying on one another.

title: Killer Bee Invasion
description: Mercenaries sent to rescue scientists from the Island of Death step into a biochemical crisis stemming from a quickly breeding swarm of killer bees.

title: The Legend of Bruce Lee
description: Targeted by street gangs, the young and talented martial artist Bruce Lee (Danny Chan, IP MAN 3) is forced to leave Hong Kong for America, where his fiery character and kung fu feats will become the stuff of legends.

title: 杰米拉
description: Jamila, a lawyer and head of the administrative prosecution, lives a quiet family life with her doctor husband Ziyad, and her family. However, her life turns upside down when her father dies, leaving all his possessions to her alone, and then events follow.

title: Tokyo Vampire Hotel
description: Manami goes out to celebrate her 22nd birthday with friends and narrowly misses being killed in a murder rampage. Manami runs for her life but is chased by K, a member of the Dracula clan, and Yamada, a Corvin, AKA Neo Vampire. Manami is the one prophesied to rescue the Dracula clan. What is K's mission? And Manami's fate? The battle between humans, Vampires and Neo Vampires begins. 2017 NIKKATSU

title: Tokyo Wine Party People
description: A business woman attends a wine party and meets a charming man who, despite his impressive knowledge of wine, seems to be hiding something.

title: Tokyo Girl
description: The story follows Aya (Asami Mizukawa) from the time she moves to Tokyo at age 23 up until she turns 40. Aya has to adjust to the different values and perceptions of the big city as she struggles with challenging situations. We get to follow Aya’s move from one neighborhood to another as she maneuvers her career and love life. © Watanabe Entertainment

title: Rapid Action
description: Blaming himself for his wife’s death, Gao leaves the security industry until his old boss returns six years later and forces him back into the fold.

title: A Seven-Faced Man
description: The young heir to one of China's largest corporations has seven other people living inside his brain, all with conflicting desires-AKA, Disassociative Identity Disorder. But when one of his alternate personalities starts falling for a psychiatric student, he finds that she could be the key to regaining control of his brain.

title: Shiba Park
description: A trio of middle-aged acquaintances whose Shiba Inus play together at a dog park suddenly gets personal when a love life mystery enters their world.

title: Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc.
description: Magical girls: strong, cool, the ultimate dream job. College student Kana Sakuragi is job hunting - without much luck! One day, she is caught up in an attack by a "Kaii." Fiesty magical girl Hitomi Koshigaya flies to the rescue, and Kana uses her excellent memory to help her take it down. Hired as a magical girl by Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc., Kana takes her first step into the working world!

title: Tougen Anki
description: After his father is murdered, a rebellious teen discovers his Oni ancestry and enters an academy to hone his powers for the secret demon-hero war.

title: Cold Bloom
description: A young woman searches for forgiveness in the face of tragedy in this award-winning drama. When Shiori's husband passes after a horrific Tsunami, she finds a complex attraction to Takumi, the man responsible for her late husband's death. Can Shiori forgive Takumi and find love again?

title: Hikaru no Go
description: Sixth year primary school student Shi Guang discovered an old Go board in his grandfather's house. Upon touching the Go board, he was possessed by the spirit of a Go master from the Southern Dynasty, during the reign of Emperor Song, named Chu Ying, that resides within. Chu Ying dedicated his life to Go. And under his influence, Shi Guang gradually developed a passion for the game.

title: Chu Liuxiang: The Beginning
description: Liuxiang Chu (Pinchao Guo) who aims to become a "Bandit Chief" accidentally meets Qianyu Mu (Kang Ning), the new leader of Shenshui Palace. The two of them face their common enemies and also fight for their forbidden love.

title: Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX
description: Amate Yuzuriha is a high-school student living peacefully in a space colony floating in outer space. When she meets a girl named Nyaan, Amate is drawn into the illegal mobile suit dueling sport known as Clan Battle. Under the entry name "Machu," she throws herself into fierce battle day after day, piloting the GQuuuuuuX.

title: Jigen Daisuke
description: Feeling unhappy with his gun, Jigen is looking for the world’s best gunsmith. He finally finds out that Chiharu, who runs a watch shop, is the person he’s been seeking. Then, Jigen meets Oto, who comes to Chiharu’s shop looking for a gun. Jigen finds out about Oto's secrets and the mysterious organization that’s after her. After Oto is kidnapped, Jigen gets into a desperate battle to save her.

title: Kingdom of Conquerors
description: In the early 13th century, when the nomadic clans of Mongolia were at war, Genghis Khan conquered them all and united them under one banner. His own.

title: The Honest Realtor
description: Hotshot Saichi Nagase is Tosaka Real Estate’s top realtor. He lies through his teeth and will stop at nothing to seal a deal. One day, he disturbs a monument located at a construction site. Cursed with the inability to tell a lie, he is forced to run his mouth off with things that are better left unsaid. With so many angry clients, he's got no hope of surviving as an honest realtor.

title: Musashi
description: Musashi Miyamoto, a famous swordsman. The truth about Musashi, based on historical facts. Battle against the Yoshioka family in Kyoto. Battle with the strongest, Kojiro Sasaki. Battles with a chain sickle and a crossed spear. The whole story of Musashi.

title: Evil Dead Trap
description: A TV station employee takes a camera crew out to an abandoned factory to investigate a purported snuff film that was made there, only to end up running for her life.

title: To Live Through Death
description: Ex-con fights a human-smuggling ring with a cop to save his daughter on a Pacific island.

title: Crippled Avengers
description: After the death of his wife, warlord Dao Tian-du turns evil and holds a town in thrall to his reign of fear, but four of the villain's crippled victims seek the help of a wise kung fu master as they train to eliminate the tyrant.

title: He Won't Kill, She Won't Die
description: A listless high schooler embarks on a transformative friendship with a suicidal classmate after watching her bury a dead bee with care and respect.

title: Contract Killer
description: Two hitmen, one a novice and the other a veteran with poor luck, band together to find the "King of Killers" for whom there is a large reward.

title: SPL: Kill Zone
description: An inspector and his unit are after crime boss Wong Po, willing to capture him at all costs. Po enlists his top henchmen to end their dirty schemes.

title: Paradox
description: Después de que su hija desaparece, un negociador de la policía une fuerzas con un oficial local para recorrer Tailandia y localizarla.

title: The Silent Service
description: An MSDF submarine collides with a U.S. nuclear submarine, crushing all 76 people on board, including its CO, Shiro Kaieda. However, the crew survives. The accident is a cover story to get the MSDF submarine’s crew on board the Seabat, a nuclear submarine secretly built by the Japanese and U.S. governments. However, Kaieda loads the Seabat with nuclear missiles and suddenly mutinies and flees.

title: Clan of the White Lotus
description: After the chief of the White Lotus Clan kills Hung Wen-ting’s wife and brother, Hung barely escapes. Set on vengeance, Hung withdraws from the world and—with the help of his brother’s widow—learns acupuncture and embroidery to master a new martial technique that could defeat the evil leader.

title: The Legendary Strike
description: A caper begins when a Japanese emissary buys a valuable pearl dubbed the Buddha's Relic from a corrupt Ching Dynasty prince who aims to steal it back.

title: Legend of Two Sisters In the Chaos
description: During the Later Zhou Dynasty, the Fu family was the focus of world attention to the well-known prophecy given to Fu Yan Qing that states that one of the daughters of the Fu family would become the future Empress.

title: Blossom in Heart
description: Gu Begonia (Li Yi Tong) comes to Kun Yang to look for her missing father. She chases a thief who steals her suitcase to a makeup store that belongs to Yue Xuan (Deng Lun). Gu Begonia begins to work for Yue Xuan in order to pay back the damages in the store. Yue Xuan and his brother, Yue Ming (Hanson Yang), falls in love with Gu Begonia. Their love for Gu Begonia triggers a big drama.

title: Customs Frontline
description: The discovery of illegal arms in Hong Kong waters leads a team of customs officers on an action-packed quest to find and take down the dealers.

title: Deep Sea Python
description: Después del ataque de pitones de aguas profundas asesinas, un pescador y un escritor deben dejar de lado sus diferencias para poder sobrevivir.

title: God Raiga Vs. King Ohga
description: As gargantuan monster Raiga comes back to terrorize a resort in Japan, another colossus, Ohga, fights him as their duel rips the city to shreds.

title: Deep Sea Mutant Snake
description: A man in search of answers to his fiancée’s death finds himself on a cruise ship that comes under attack by a creature from the deep.

title: Baby Steps
description: From Oscar-winning producer of The Wedding Banquet and Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon, comes this comedy which takes an honest look at gay family issues in complicated dynamo of a cross-cultural and generational Taiwanese-American family.

title: In a Class of Her Own
description: The daughter of an impoverished family, Xue Wen Xi knows all about hardship. This is why, when an opportunity to take work as a writer presented itself, she willingly took the job; even though doing so meant she had to disguise herself as a boy. The ruse seemed innocent enough, until the day the Prime Minister's son, Feng Cheng Jun walked into her life.

title: I Did It My Way
description: Undercover cop Ho is tasked with taking down an unknown drug lord. When it turns out to be his friend George, the stakes couldn’t be higher.

title: Soul of Chiba
description: Determined to track down the vicious drug lord who killed his master, a martial arts disciple teams up with an undercover cop to seek revenge.

title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
description: Nearly 20 years after the theft of the Shura Mask, the little ahriman takes back control to become the successor with the duty to guard the city.

title: Story in the Temple Red Lily
description: When a power-hungry baron mobilizes his forces to claim the throne, a fierce swordswoman and a band of brave warriors assemble to protect the emperor.

title: Chongqing Hot Pot
description: Three friends discover their restaurant is connected to a bank vault. Will they take the risk for the big payday that could change their lives forever?

title: The Chinese Widow
description: As the 1941 attack on Pearl Harbor shocks the world, a U.S. pilot sent on an Allied mission to bomb Japan runs out of fuel and is saved by a widow.

title: Rainless Love in a Godless Land
description: All the gods will be leaving before the last rain of doomsday. However, an ordinary human girl unexpectedly puts a dent in their plans to retreat thus causing the world to move towards the unknown. Before the final day of judgment, a love story between human and god unfolds.

title: The Infernal Walker
description: Two officers have been planted as moles by the rival party for 10 years. Both have risen through the ranks within the organization, but deep down they are fed up with the dead-end job as undercover cops and wish to start off new lives.

title: Blade of the Immortal
description: A cursed samurai, burdened with immortality, aids a young woman in avenging her family while battling enemies to reclaim his soul.

title: Blade of the Immortal
description: Edo, an era of warriors. There lived an immortal man, the Slayer of Hundreds, 'Manji.' He meets Rin, who has sworn vengeance for her parents. Rin's grudge is against a group of swordmasters – Ittou-ryu. She asks Manji to be her bodyguard on her journey. He refuses, but then sees his late sister in Rin. So began the violent struggle that would bring even the immortal Manji to his knees.

title: Boonie Bears: Homeward Journey
description: It’s up to two brave bears to band together and speak out against a powerful logger who intends to chop down all the trees in their forest.

title: Bakugan Battle Brawlers
description: Únete a Dan y sus amigos mientras luchan contra sus Bakugan Brawlers para salvar Vestroia y la Tierra, y restaurar la paz en las dos dimensiones.

title: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman
description: Beryl Gardenant, a middle-aged swordsman running a dojo in the backwaters, lives a quiet life, until Allucia, former student and Commander of the Royal Order of Knights, appears! Beryl’s life is about to change dramatically! City life. Old students. New friends and formidable foes. It’s all too much. But after years of training, he has mad skills, and he’s been dubbed “the backwater swordmaster.”

title: Howling Village
description: A psychologist looking to find out how her brother disappeared goes to a cursed town called Howling Village and finds out dark and shocking truths.

title: The Criminal
description: A random mass stabbing, major food company Titus Foods, and a mysterious infant disease. These three things have as much in common as Detective Soma, hack writer Yarimizu, and the stabbing's lone survivor, Shuji. Yet, these men are now embroiled in a risky quest for the truth. What they find, though, is more heinous than they imagined, making them question just who is the real criminal?

title: Crazy Samurai Musashi
description: Miyamoto Musashi fights for his life against 400 warriors, earning a place in history as the Crazy Samurai Musashi.

title: Detective Dee and the Mystery of the Phantom Flame
description: As a Chinese Empress is set for inauguration, an exiled detective is ordered to solve the mysterious deaths that could delay her launch to the throne.

title: Detective Dee: The Four Heavenly Kings
description: While trying to clear his name of wrongdoing to Empress Wu, Detective Dee takes on an investigation into a crime spree with a supernatural twist.

title: Detection of Di Renjie
description: Enter the enigmatic world of ancient China as brilliant detective Di Renjie unravels a series of puzzling murders. With sharp intellect and a skilled partner, he delves into a web of secrets and conspiracies, uncovering a thrilling tale of deception and justice.

title: Howl from Beyond the Fog
description: Set in the Meiji era during the late 19th Century, a blind girl enlists a blind lake creature to help her scare developers off her family’s land.

title: Yakuza Wolf 2: Extend My Condolences
description: Chiba exacts his revenge for the setup that sent him to prison by attacking Asao Uchida's lonely, clifftop mansion in a no-holds barred massacre.

title: Wolf Pack
description: Seeking answers about his father’s suspicious death, a young medic infiltrates a mercenary group and uncovers a deadly international conspiracy.

title: Weakest Beast
description: She has the perfect smile. The perfect career. She is beloved by all. He is a man of the world. A ladies’ man. A gifted accountant. Two people who seem to have it all, but not all that glitters is gold. This is a tale of two strangers releasing their inhibitions in a way that only strangers can. If only we could be like the beasts that roam wild and free…©NIPPON TV

title: Ninja Scroll: The Series
description: In feudal Japan, the Edo period brought a time of delicate peace bought with blood. This is a chronicle of the life of Jubei Kibagami as he wanders the countryside as a ninja for hire. At this time, ninja clans are everywhere. One clan, the Hiruko Clan, doomed to live and die in darkness, protects a sacred treasure called the Dragon Stone. The Kimon Clan, however, bent on reviving the power o...

title: Sweet Combat
description: The daughter of a global Chinese business family goes against all expectations when she begins boxing and falls in love with her trainer.

title: The Revenge
description: A reunion among three childhood friends at a villa brings them face to face with an evil spirit that causes them to turn against each other.

title: Crazy Fist
description: Años después de retirarse, un ex campeón de MMA tiene que dar un paso atrás en el ring cuando su mejor amigo muere en circunstancias sospechosas.

title: The Neighbor of Healing Has a Secret
Eunuch of the Western Palace
description: Four rebels with unique fighting skills are brought together to block an Eunuch's attempt to rise to power using Japanese influence.

title: Yes, Madam!
description: A pair of hard-kicking detectives are on the case of a murder linked to microfilm sought by a triad boss and in the possession of two unlucky thieves.

title: In the Line of Duty 3
description: Genji Nakamura and his soul-mate and partner Michiko Nishiwaki are thieves for the notorious Red Army terrorist organization in Japan. After pulling off the jewelry heist of the century, they are now planning to use the jewelry they've snatched to buy an arms cache from gun smugglers in Hong Kong for their movement.

title: Eye for an Eye
description: A master swordsman looks for revenge after being caught in the middle of a power struggle that results in the execution of an innocent woman's family.

title: Blind War
description: After being blinded during a courthouse siege, a disgraced SWAT captain must join forces with an unlikely ally to rescue his kidnapped daughter.

title: AIBOU: Tokyo Detective Duo
description: On the planet Eternia, a young prince gains the ability to become a powerful warrior to defend Castle Grayskull against the dark lord Skeletor.

title: 100 Days
description: When a successful executive returns to his rural hometown for his mother's funeral, he learns that his father expects him to marry within 100 days to ensure safe passage for his mother's soul.

title: Guilty Flag
description: One day, his wife and children vanished. They had just begun building their home. He searches for them, but he can't find any clue. The sympathy he had received changes direction. "Did the husband kill them?" Everyone becomes suspicious of him. Will he get his family back? Where does the truth lie? Who will be the first to discover the truth? Project by Akimoto Yasushi ©NIPPON TV

title: Kurara: The Dazzling Life of Hokusai's Daughter
description: A historical drama full of triumph and love about the daughter of famed Japanese painter Hokusai and how her love of dazzling colors made her career.

title: Off the Record
description: [With ENG Subtitles] As a journalist, Kate’s trained to expose the truth. But when she uncovers shocking details after her mother’s death, she faces her toughest “off the record”—her own birth.

title: Freedom Strikes a Blow
description: A muscular martial arts warrior tries to leave his past behind and becomes a dock worker, but the cruel owner’s iron fist leads him to fight again.

title: The Thunder
description: A story that revolves around a father and son who represent two generations of policemen as they risk their lives in the war against drugs.

title: One More Shot
description: After a chance meeting with a technology company technician, retired bodyguard Long Wei is enrolled in the testing of virtual reality products.

title: The Knight of Shadows: Between Yin and Yang
description: A visual feast of action propels this story of a demon hunter forced to journey through parallel worlds to save local young girls from evil forces.

title: Fukuyadou Honpo: Kyoto Love Story
description: Fukuyadou Honpo is a traditional Kyoto sweet shop with 450 years of history.
