This romantic drama depicts the careers, love lives and dreams of three sisters. - Based On The Book: "FUKUYADOU HONPO -POCKET EDITION- " (Yayomi Yuchi/ SHUEISHA Inc.) - Scriptwriter: Yuko Nagata - Music: Yusuke Hayashi - Producer: Yuri Sekikawa - Associate Producer: Akihiko Takaishi (C) Yayomi Yuchi, SHUEISHA / The icon

title: Marry My Husband: Japan
description: Misa has been a supporting character all her life, blindly trusting her best friend and husband. When she discovers their affair, the betrayal results in her death. Waking up ten years in the past, Misa vows to become the main character of her own story. She plans to ruin her betrayers by making them marry each other, but after meeting her director at work, starts to consider who she truly is.

title: Cute Programmer
description: After falling in love with genius programmer Jiang Yi Cheng, Lu Li enrols into the school he once studied at, and also took up the same major - calculus. Setting Jiang Yi Cheng as her role model in her heart, she achieves good grades in school. However after graduation, she did not expect that Jiang Yi Cheng's company does not recruit female employees.

title: Air Doll
description: A life-size blow-up doll develops a soul, immerses herself in the living world, and falls in love with a video store clerk.

title: Invincible Swordsman
description: The land of Jianghu is in danger. Cult leader Dongbang Bubai wants to take over the peaceful realm with dangerous demons by her side. It's up to retired swordsman Linghu Chong to pick up his weapon against this existential threat.

title: Fist of Fury 2
description: Martial artist Chen Shan arrives in Shanghai to mourn his brother's death and sets out to seek vengeance against the Japanese fighters who killed him.

title: The Rescue
description: A rescue unit within the Chinese Coast Guard is forced to overcome their personal differences to resolve a crisis.

title: Map for The Wedding
description: Rika and Takuya are single and thriving. One day, their manager announces that an unmarried employee will have to get transferred to Alaska! To dodge the bullet, the two plan a fake wedding. But then, they gradually fall for each other. From a loving couple's divorce to the reality of a childless marriage, this series closes in on the diverse form of marriage in the modern age.

title: The Wasted Times
description: A gangster, a star actress, and a rouge soldier collide in this World War II thriller. As the Japanese army invades China, mobster Lu refuses to collaborate with the army. Watabe, a secret soldier assigned to protect actress Xiao, violently betrays her. Years later, after the war had ended, Lu and Xiao plot their vengeance on the soldier.

title: American Girl
description: When her mother gets sick, 13-year-old Fen moves back to Taiwan, where she struggles to fit in amid the 2003 SARS epidemic.

title: Kung Food
description: Super Bao, an innocent steamed stuffed bun, dreams of becoming a great hero. Now he must battle the evil Pirate King to save the world of foods.

title: Enter the Fat Dragon
description: Action icon Donnie Yen stars as a super cop who becomes depressed and obese after a break-up and just before he gets a murder case to save his job.

title: So Young 2: Never Gone
description: A couple reunite when they move into the same neighbourhood after living apart for a few years.

title: Cupid's Kitchen
description: Blessed with an acute sense of taste, Lin Ke Song has the unique ability to identify the ingredients in any dish, with just a single bite. Despite her rare gift, she has never been much of a cook and as such, has never given much thought to pursue a career in the culinary arts. At least not until the day she met Michelin-certified chef, Jiang Qian Fan.

title: Meet You at the Blossom
description: After a fateful and unexpected encounter, the son of Jiangnan's wealthiest man falls for the icy beauty Huai En, but she hides a secret.

title: Girl on Edge
description: Welcome to the "Wild West of the Last Frontier" - the Aleutian Islands. Life on the Edge follows pioneers and thrill-seekers carving out lives in one of Earth's most remote, punishing environments. Braving brutal weather and isolation, they build businesses, infrastructure, and off-grid homes, testing their limits in a fight to thrive at the edge of the world.

title: True Legend
description: Su Can's life is destroyed when his vengeful brother returns from war. A new fighting style will give him the power to reclaim what's his.

title: God of War
description: In 16th century China, maverick Commander Yu leads a small army against hordes of Japanese pirates who invade the coastline and take over Cengang.

title: Ip Man 2
description: In British-occupied Hong Kong, new arrival Ip Man attempts to open an academy to teach his unique Wing Chun martial arts style.

title: Ip Man 3
description: Hong Kong, 1959. A crooked real estate developer leads a band of gangsters in a property coup that can only be stopped by the Wing Chun grandmaster.

title: Ip Man 4: The Finale
description: The legendary Wing Chun master travels to San Francisco and tries to ease tensions between the local kung fu leaders and his star student, Bruce Lee.

title: Ip Man: The Final Fight
description: The legendary Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man must once again fight when rival kung fu styles draw him into the seedy underworld of the Triads.

title: The Bloody Fists
description: When a band of evil martial arts experts returns to China after a two year exile, it’s up to a loner and a karate fighter to save the country.

title: My Blueberry Nights
description: A heartbroken young woman journeys across America to understand the truth about love, and meets some unexpected characters along the way.

title: Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26
description: Six studios and seven directors adapt the early works of Tatsuki Fujimoto, the mastermind behind "Chainsaw Man," into an anime anthology. Each episode is an anime adaptation of a short story he drew from ages seventeen to twenty-six, including the first manga he ever submitted for competition. Watch as vivid tales of young love, chaos, madness, and the bonds between people unfold in each episode.

title: Tiger & Crane Fists
description: Two martial arts masters who practice rival fighting styles must overcome their differences and join forces to defeat a common enemy.

title: Bushido
description: Samurai is ordered to slay his disciple. Must the samurai obey the ruthless order? A chase in the snow, a fight, and then a duel. Who will survive in the end? What is justice? What is Bushido? Yasuo Mikami Office Co., Ltd.

title: Gone with the Light
description: Part of the people living on earth were disappeared after a sudden white light. The film revolves around a group of people that disappear after a mysterious light falls upon the city, leaving the survivors to try and unravel the mystery.

title: Monkey King: Hero Is Back
description: A young boy escapes the monstrous army attacking his tiny village and encounters a legendary hero with the power to save his people.

title: Journey to the West: Conquering the Demons
description: An action-fantasy epic about a young and courageous demon hunter who must vanquish three separate demons in a world that’s filled with their cruelty.

title: The Monkey King 2
description: It’s up to the brave Monkey King to escort a monk away from a wasteland as he attempts to retrieve sacred scriptures, which will stop a demon.

title: Islanders
description: Li Xianhong, a charismatic entrepreneur, is entangled in a web of complicated relationships with his business partner, Xiaowen, his assistant, Hanrong, and a young woman, Lilian. Lilian reconnects with her senior Jay, and jealousy brews. When Xianhong’s offhand remarks spark a public backlash, social media erupts, and Xianhong faces the decision that could cost him everything he holds dear.

title: Namiya
description: Three drifters shacked up at an abandoned store embark on a time-traveling journey, linking them to others whose lives were touched by the shop-owner.

title: The Prosecutor
description: A famed cop-turned-prosecutor who doesn’t play by the rules races against time to exonerate a small-time drug smuggler framed by corrupt lawyers.

title: Peep Time
description: The story follows Shinichi Toneli (Shingo Katori), a clumsy resident of Apt. 301 whose unexpected behavior amuses his neighbor in Apt. 302, Jiro Kasuya (Jiro Sato), who peeps through a hole. The story starts when Jiro's daughter Akane (Chihiro Yamamoto) finds out about her dad's hobby and she joins him peeping through a hole...

title: Tasokare Hotel
description: Neko Tsukahara llega al Hotel Tasokare, un lugar de eterno crepúsculo, en busca de recuerdos, respuestas y para encontrar su próximo destino.

title: The Dinner Table Detective
description: Rich heiress Reiko Hosho lives a double life as a novice detective, fighting crime under Inspector Kazamatsuri—also from a wealthy family. After work, Reiko sheds her pantsuit to don a lovely dress for dinner each day. Difficult cases force her to confide in her butler Kageyama, who proceeds to savagely ridicule her inability to solve mysteries, all while brilliantly unraveling each case himself.

title: Let the Bullets Fly
description: Once the darling of the art-film world, Jiang Wen set the local box office ablaze with this rip-roaring action spectacular. With a star-studded cast headlined by Chow Yun Fat, Let the Bullets Fly takes to the boondocks of 1920s China for a gleefully madcap, elaborately political genre mash-up.

title: Battle of Memories
description: A cutting-edge procedure that can switch a person’s mind with another and clear memories goes wrong for a man who gets the mind of a serial killer.

title: Norjmaa
description: During WWII, Mongolian goat herder Norjmaa finds two injured soldiers, one Japanese and one Russian. She takes them into her Ger (Mongolian portable home) and tends to their wounds with traditional Mongolian medicine, thereby saving their lives. However, when the two enemies are strong enough, each man seems to have only one thing on their mind - murdering one another. Norjmaa has war wounds of her own from her troubled past to deal with. How can she make them see reason and compassion when all three of them speak different languages?

title: Treasure Inn
description: Two low-ranking constables, accompanied by two con artists and a mysterious doctor, work together to find the crook who stole a precious statue.

title: Penance
description: Tragedy strikes when young Emili is shockingly murdered by a mysterious stranger. The other four girls present at the scene of the crime—Sae, Maki, Akiko, and Yuka—are unable to remember the killer’s face. The crime goes unsolved. Fifteen years later, Sae is paid a surprise visit on her wedding day.

title: My Heroic Husband
description: A modern businessman travels back to ancient times, where he lands in the body of a man about to be married into a family of cloth merchants.

title: The Bodyguard
description: Un hombre encargado de proteger a la hija de una familia adinerada se enfrenta a una peligrosa pandilla que busca apoderarse de ella.

title: Ways of Kung Fu
description: Exiled by the evil monk who seized control of his Shaolin temple, a protege finds refuge with a kung fu family that teaches him how to fight back.

title: Chasing the Dragon
description: A real-life hopeful immigrant from China is disabled and transforms into a notorious drug lord, ruthlessly carving out an empire in British Hong Kong.

title: Chasing the Dragon II: Wild Wild Bunch
description: An undercover agent (Louis Koo) must infiltrate a notorious gang led by the kidnap kingpin (Tony Leung Ka Fai) in this action-packed thriller based on real-life crimes that terrorized Hong Long's elite in the 1990s.

title: Mystic Shrine Maiden
description: Toko works as a shrine maiden. Her days are full of joy as she would be called out by the village people to play or sometimes simply savor time with nothing spectacular to do. One day, Toko finds out that the village festival which she has been waiting with great anticipation will be cancelled due to an old superstition.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's
description: New Domino City, the playground of legendary duelist Yugi Muto, has transformed into a futuristic society where dueling has kicked into overdrive.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V
description: Yuya Sakaki’s dream is to follow in his father’s footsteps and become the greatest “duel-tainer” in history – and he just might pull it off when he suddenly discovers Pendulum Summoning, a never-before-seen technique that lets him summon many monsters at once! But when countless rivals emerge to steal his spotlight, Yuya needs to gear up his game because dueling has evolved into a non-stop wor...

title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Dark Side of Dimensions
description: The stakes have never been higher, the rivalries never as fierce, the risks never so great. Yugi is back in action and ready to save the world.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal
description: An aspirational kid looking to become the Duel Monsters champion and an odd visitor in search of his lost memories team up to search for rare cards.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters
description: Yugi Moto solves an Ancient Egyptian Puzzle and brings forth a dark and powerful alter ego. Whenever he and his friends are threatened by evil in Duel Monster Card Game, this alter ego breaks out to save them.

title: The Game Changer
description: Two escaped prisoners join one of the most powerful gangs in Shanghai, the Green Gang, as the right-hand men of the head boss Mr. Tang. When Mr. Tang tries to gain total control over business dealings in Shanghai, he discovers his closest allies are not who they seem and turn against his own men to protect his power.

title: Overprotected Kahoko
description: Kahoko is a college student and the epitome of an overprotected child birthed by modern Japan. She has always been under the care of her helicopter parents. Her world changes when one day, a young man calls her out, saying, "People like you will ruin Japan!" Thus begins the story of her self-discovery, where every day she encounters something new. ©NIPPON TV

title: Shaolin Kung-Fu Mystagogue
description: The evil Ching government has taken over and is out to rid the land of the remaining Ming rebel patriots, including the still surviving Ming Prince. Unknowingly, the evil Ching overlord and his men capture the incognito Prince and throw him in jail.  Hearing word of the Prince's capture, Shao Chang and Fang Ping mount a rescue effort to get the Prince before his identity is found out.

title: Love Story of Court Enemies
description: During the Yuan year of the Yongzheng era, Yu Xing and her sister Cai Feng are separated; Yu Xing enters the palace as a chef trainee after learning that Cai Feng is a consort candidate there.

title: The Legend Of Bruce Lee
description: In this semi-biography, Bruce Lee strives to perfect his fighting style while being threatened by Kung Fu schools jealous of his power and ability.

title: Return to the Jurassic
description: A quest for a cancer-curing plant leads a research expedition to a remote island where they uncover a lost Jurassic world—and living dinosaurs.

title: The Sacrifice
description: Based on the rarely told story of the People's Volunteer Army of China as it faces its last major battle in Kumsong during the end of the Korean War.

title: Fearless Kung Fu Elements
description: A family in China being plagued by a demonic entity use the five elements in the universe – gold, wood, earth, water and fire – in a kung fu battle.

title: The Royal Cat
description: In a vibrant ancient city of magic and mystery, a curious young apprentice teams up with a witty, tailless talking cat to solve two urgent cases: the missing crown prince and townsfolk turning into animals. With the Mid-Autumn Festival nearing, they must uncover the royal secret in time.

title: Tetsujin 28
description: It’s been ten years since World War II ended, and now a young boy uses his control over a giant robot to accomplish his own secret missions.

title: Tetsujin 28: Morning Moon of Midday
description: Ten years after World War II. Boy detective Shoutarou solves mysteries and fights crime with the help of Tetsujin 28, the 50-foot tall giant robot left for him by his late genius father. This time, he reunites with his lost brother, who can also take control of the iron giant!

title: Gintama
description: In 17th century feudal Tokyo, a young samurai struggles to keep his craft alive after extraterrestrials have invaded the land and outlawed all swords.

title: Ronin Warriors: Legend of the Inferno Armor
description: In this anime classic, the Samurai Troopers must head back into battle when a mysterious warrior begins a deadly attack.

title: Brothers
description: A family is torn apart when two brothers find themselves on opposite sides of the 1936 Chinese civil war between the Communist Party and Kuomintang.

title: The Underground War
description: In 2248, dormant C40 team members are awakened by an AI control system to execute a top-secret mission to destroy all medicine in a gene research lab.

title: Looking Up
description: In the midst of an emergency in space, an astronaut reflects on his unconventional relationship with his father, who pushed him to follow his dreams.

title: The Mouse and the Cat:  Nine Ghosts Blood Wolf
description: Zhan Zhao and Bai Yu Tang team up to investigate a series of strange death events in Bianliang City and stop the mysterious force behind them.

title: The Demon Suppressors: West Barbarian Beast
description: The 40th year of the Wangzhao Dynasty brings chaos to the world and the ultimate fight between good and evil with the birth of a beast lord.

title: The Promise of Chang’an
description: The drama tells the story of the ups and downs of Dasheng kingdom from turbulence to prosperity. He Lan Mingyu grows up from a pure and innocent girl to a queen mother who cares about her family and country.

title: Fog Monster from Chang'an
description: A village is attacked by deadly monsters living in a mist that has overtaken their town. One man risks his life to find the cause and end the curse that plagues his people.

title: Born to Fly
description: An unforeseen mid-air threat forces a talented young air force pilot to test not only the capabilities of his top-secret aircraft, but his own limits.

title: Our Shiny Days
description: A music-filled journey following Chen Jing, her male best friend, and a group of eccentric female students who are passionate about traditional Chinese music. Together, they form a band to challenge the preference of Western music at their music academy.

title: Tea Pets
description: A boy and his lucky clay toy sidekicks live happily in a tea shop, until a robot from the future arrives to take them on a magical mission.

title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
description: A detective plots his revenge against the motorbike crime syndicate behind a string of thefts in Foshan that attacked his pregnant wife.

title: The Yin Yang Master Zero
description: Japanese sorcery begins here -the story of the most powerful Yin Yang Master, Abe no Seimei, who really existed during the Heian period. Experience “Sorcery Entertainment” like never before, which uncover the secrets of the young Seimei!©2024 "The Yin Yang Master Zero" Film Partners

title: Shocking Kung Fu of Huo's
description: 20 years after the Revolution of 1911, Huo Zhenshan opens a school to promote Chinese martial arts. But a new challenge in the black market emerges.

title: The Green Hornet
description: Enter the Green Hornet.  The Green Hornet along with his Boomerang throwing assistant, Alfred, the dynamic duo soon draw interest from a tough top cop who wants to unmask the hornet and a nosy reporter. Nonstop action!

title: Song of the Assassins
description: After completing his training, an elite young assassin embarks on his first mission and is quickly ensnared in an intricate plot by powerful people, forcing him to go on the run from the government and rival assassin groups alike.

title: It Stopped Raining
description: Yukisuke is attracted to a girl Koyomi, who runs a small stand of taiyaki pastry that he often buys. Koyomi is hospitalized, however, by a car accident on a rainy day after they go out together, and wakes up with short term memory loss, where she cannot remember anything beyond the present day. Yukisuke tries to live close to her as before but the lack of collective memory starts to stagger him.

title: Extraordinary Mission
description: An undercover police officer in China becomes embroiled in a fierce attempt to take down a hostile drug trafficking syndicate from the inside.

title: Eagle Shadow Fist
description: Set during the Japanese occupation of China during WWII, a group of Chinese rebels tries to oust the Japanese forces from a small town.

title: A Wind Named Amnesia
description: Two years after a mysterious wind rushes through the earth and erases all human knowledge and memory, a young man travels America to find its source.

title: Takeshi's Castle Japan
description: Worldwide sensation Takeshi's Castle returns after 34 years! Popular games are revived on a larger scale and new, terrifying obstacles appear one after another. The lord of the castle, Beat Takeshi, entrusts Bananaman to protect it. Subaru Kimura is the attack force’s new leader. The elite team gathers to bring down the revived Takeshi’s Castle. The greatest battle in history begins!

title: Back to the Wharf
description: An escaped convict for homicide returns to his hometown after 15 years, only to get caught up in a scheme involving the daughter of his victim.

title: Luoyang
description: Chinese drama "Luoyang" (2021) is adapted from Ma Boyong's novel of the same name, which tells a series of stories during the Wu Zhou period where a group of people from different classes investigated the unsettled case in Luoyang.

title: The Wind Blows From Longxi
description: In 228 A.D., warring kingdoms send spies to infiltrate enemy ranks, steal secrets, recover weapons and regain power.

title: Candy Color Paradox
description: Reporter Satoshi and photographer Motoharu clash as they investigate the biggest scandals, but sparks begin to fly as they uncover secrets together.

title: The Last Blood
description: Disciples of a high priest in Singapore battle traitors and Red Army terrorists as they seek a rare blood transfusion to save the revered leader.

title: Legend of the Millennium Dragon
description: A 15-year-old boy goes 1,200 years back in time to discover his unlikely destiny as the savior to end the war between the humans and demons.

title: Cromartie High School
description: Student Kamiyama gets an education at Cromartie High, a surreal school of hard knocks like none on Earth.

title: Creamy Mami: Forever Once More
description: After Mami's final concert, rumors begin to spread that the idol is making a comeback. Yuu teams up with friends to get to the bottom of it.

title: Samurai Reincarnation
description: The villain is called Amakusa Shiro Tokaisada. He is actually based on a real christian samurai. The movie was one of the inspirations for the game called 'Samurai Shodown' (actual spelling)

title: Demon City Shinjuku
description: Tokyo. The glittering skyline that once rivaled any in the world, lies cracked and crumbling under the weight of an oppressive evil. A single man stands responsible - the tyrannical Levih Rah who has created this Demon City in Shinjuku, the heart of Tokyo. But and he doesn't plan on stopping there! Rah's mission is to destroy the entire planet... For years, no one has dared to cross the foul moat which Rah has built around the Demon City. However, the young, beautiful Sayaka Rama is desperate to rescue her father, who has been taken captive by Rah and his monstrous minions. She enlists the help of Kyoya, a streetwise Tokyo teenager. The two bravely venture into the Demon City, where they encounter the fascinating, mystical character Mephisto, whose spiritual healing powers could save them from annihilation. But can this rugged band actually overcome the might of Rah's army of thugs? And even if they do, will they be able - destroy the Levih Rah himself? Or will the perish as all others before them?

title: Legend of the Naga Pearls
description: Magical pearls of a mystical, ancient tribe fall into mortal hands. The tribe’s royal heir and a group of heroes race to prevent the tribe’s demise.

title: Secret of Chinese Kung Fu
description: When a pair of sisters rescues a martial artist from drowning, he agrees to help train them and their village to fight local thugs.

title: My Little Sweet Pea
description: Since her father died, Mugiko lives with her older brother, Norio. Her mother Ayako left home when she was little and never come back. But one day, she suddenly appears. What will happen to this estranged family?

title: Hot Girl
description: A rebellious young woman finds her calling at a bodyguard training center where she faces intense challenges and a clash of wills with her instructor.

title: Rise of the Legend
description: An extraordinarily powerful martial artist returns to where his father was assassinated to free the people from his nemesis, a ruthless crime lord.

title: Dragon Fist
description: This vintage Jackie Chan film from 1979 sees him as a worker who becomes involved in a hardcore feud between his dead boss’s killer and gangsters.

title: Dragon Tiger Gate
description: Three martial arts masters emerge from the back streets of Hong Kong to help the powerless fight injustice at the hands of the criminal underground.

title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
description: A masked freedom fighter, a female warrior, and a corrupt, Ming Dynasty eunuch converge at a remote inn that sits atop a buried city of treasures.

title: Lung Fung Restaurant
description: Ex-con falls for a bar girl, but his past returns when he vows to save his former boss, putting love and loyalty to the test.

title: Throne of Elves
description: In the mythical Elven world of Altera, an epic battle unfolds between a beautiful princess and a dark elf who has acquired a powerful jewel.

title: Lobster Cop
description: When undercover cops set up a drug sting in a seafood restaurant, they risk blowing their cover when their lobster recipe becomes an accidental hit.

title: Longmen Town Inn
description: Weighing his own sense of justice against family loyalty, a legendary swordsman battles his father and brothers—and becomes a hero in the process.

title: Ride On
description: Action legend Jackie Chan (Vanguard, Rush Hour, Police Story) is back in an action-packed and heart-warming tribute to the world of stunts which made him an international superstar. A washed-up stuntman and his stunt horse become an overnight social media sensation when their real-life fight with debt collectors goes viral.
